The Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, escorted it to Tàilíng.
In the third month, on the day Gēngyín,
Shìzōng was buried at Tàilíng,
and Empress Xiàojìng Xiàn Hòú was interred beside him.
On the day Rénchén,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
On the day Guǐsì,
Emperor Shìzōng Xiàn Huángdì and Empress Xiàojìng Xiàn Hòú were enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple,
and an imperial edict granting varying degrees of amnesty was issued.
On the day Xīnchǒu,
Bǎodé and others were ordered to deliver the edict of enshrinement to Cháoxiǎn.
On the day Jiǎchén,
Tú Tiānxiāng was dismissed.
Zhào Hóngēn was appointed President of the Board of Works.
Gù Cóng was appointed to assist the President of the Board of Civil Office.
On the day Wùshēn,
Hanlin scholars, censors, and investigating censors were ordered to submit memorials on classics, history, and current affairs in rotation.
On the day Gēngxū,
the Right Guard General was relocated to Guīhuà Xīnchéng,
and two additional Deputy Lieutenant-Generals were added.
On the day Xīnhài,
Shuòsè was transferred to be Governor of Sìchuān.
On the day Rénzǐ,
Yáng Yǒngbīn was transferred to be Governor of Húběi.
In the fourth month, on the day Jiǎzǐ,
due to drought, the Board of Punishments was ordered to clear minor cases.
On the day Yǐmǎo,
instructions and admonitions were given to ministers who offered advice.
On the day Jǐsì,
the Qīngkǒu and the Jiāngnán Grand Canal were dredged.
Relief was provided for drought victims in Jiāngníng and Chángzhōu prefectures in Jiāngsū.
On the day Jiǎxū,
sacrifices were offered to Heaven at the Yuánqiú Altar,
with Shìzōng enshrined as a co-sacrificer.
The next day, an imperial edict granting varying degrees of amnesty was issued.
On this day,
it rained.
Fùěrdān, Chén Tài, and Yuè Zhōngqí were released.
On the day Bǐngzǐ,
the regular land tax for Shùntiān and Zhílì was remitted.
On the day Jǐmǎo,
Yǐn Jìshàn was summoned to the capital.
Zhāng Yǔnsuí was appointed acting Governor-General of Yúnnán.
On the day Jiǎshēn,
the regular land tax for flood-affected areas in Hánchuān and five other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Húběi was remitted.
Nánzhǎng offered tribute.
On the day Dīnghài,
the regular land tax for flood-affected areas in Xiāo and Dàng counties in Jiāngsū was remitted.
In the fifth month, on the day Rénchén,
Yú Mǐnzhōng and three hundred twenty-four others were granted the Jinshì degree with varying ranks.
On the day Guǐsì,
the regular land tax for flood-affected areas in Jīngzhōu and Ānlù prefectures in Húběi was remitted.
On the day Yǐwèi,
relief was provided for flood victims in Nányáng and twelve other prefectures and counties in Hénán.
On the day Wùxū,
an imperial examination was held for Hanlin scholars, Supervisors of the Household, and other officials.
Chén Dàshòu and three others were promoted to the first rank,
while others were promoted or demoted by varying degrees.
New Jinshì degree holders this year were permitted to submit memorials on local advantages and disadvantages.
On the day Wùshēn,
one million taels of regular grain and money tax for Shāndōng were remitted.
On the day Xīnhài,
sacrifices were offered to Earth at the Fāngzé Altar,
with Shìzōng enshrined as a co-sacrificer.
The rice tax for Kāijiàn and Ēnpíng counties in Guǎngdōng was abolished.
On the day Yǐmǎo,
the extra taxes in Yǒngzhōu and other places in Húnán were abolished.
The regular land tax for flood-affected areas in Sùzhōu, Ānhuī, was remitted.
The regular land tax for flood-affected areas in Ránhé and four other prefectures and counties in Zhèjiāng was remitted.
Relief was provided for hail victims in Shāngnán and Fūshī counties in Shǎnxī.
On the day Jiǎxū,
due to the Emperor holding court and the abundant timely rain,
the attending officials were granted varying amounts of silk fabrics.
On the day Xīnyǒu,
the Qūtián Fǎ (land reclamation method) was ordered to be tried in Zhílì.
On the day Wùxū,
relief was provided for flood victims in Shídài and six other prefectures and counties in Ānhuī.
In autumn, the seventh month, on the day *wùzǐ*,
due to the breaching of the Yǒngdìng Hé,
Vice Commander Cèlèng and others of the Imperial Bodyguard were dispatched to Lúgōuqiáo and Liángxiāng to provide relief to the disaster victims.
On the day *guǐmǎo*,
Imperial Bodyguard Sōngfú and others were ordered to Wén'ān, Bàzhōu, and other places to provide relief to the disaster victims.
On the day *yǐwèi*,
Gù Cóng was ordered to investigate the various works along the Yǒngdìng Hé that had been breached.
On the day *bǐngshēn*,
relief was provided to Dépíng, Yánggǔ, and other prefectures and counties in Shāndōng for drought and hail disasters.
On the day *rényín*,
relief was provided to Wǎnpíng, Qīngyuàn, and eighty-one other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Shùnzhí for drought disasters.
The imperial examination for "Erudite and Grand Scholars Who Have Arrived Later" was held at the Tǐrén Gé,
and Wàn Sōnglíng and others were granted official positions.
On the day *bǐngchén*,
it was ordered that provincial fixed taxes be remitted;
those already paid were to be offset against the regular tax for the following year,
and this was established as a regulation.
Relief was provided for flood disasters in Yīxiàn and fourteen other prefectures and counties in Ānhuī.
The eighth month, on the first day *dīngsì*,
relief was provided for hail disasters in Ānsài and three other counties in Shǎnxī.
The Yáo bandits in Chéngbù County, Húnán, were suppressed.
Relief was provided for drought disasters in Píngfān and four other counties in Gānsù.
Four Imperial Censor-Inspectors of Grain Transport were ordered to be stationed in Huái'ān, Jìníng, Tiānjīn, and Tōngzhōu.
On the day *jiǎxū*,
È'ěrtài was ordered to thoroughly investigate the waterways and water conservancy of Zhílì.
On the day *bǐngzǐ*,
Gù Cóng was appointed acting Governor-General of Waterways in Zhílì.
On the day *dīngchǒu*,
seven-tenths of the outstanding fixed tax for the flood disaster in Dàngshān, Jiāngsū, was remitted.
On the day *rénwǔ*,
the position of Grand General of Wēiníng Garrison in Guìzhōu was re-established.
The great stone fish-scale seawall in Zhèjiāng was constructed.
The fixed tax for this year's drought disaster in Lìchéng and twenty-eight other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Shāndōng was remitted.
On the day *jiǎshēn*,
relief was provided for the drought disaster in Huìníng, Gānsù,
and for flood disasters in Xiápǔ and other prefectures and counties in Fújiàn.
The ninth month, on the day *xīnmǎo*,
Hādài, Minister Counsellor for the Northern Route, was recalled to the capital,
and Māní was appointed to replace him.
On the day *yǐwèi*,
Mǐ'ěrhāshū'ěr, a Dzungar Muslim, surrendered.
On the day *yǐwèi*,
Yáng Yǒngbīn was appointed Governor of Jiāngsū.
On the day *jǐhài*,
relief was provided for coastal wind disasters in Mǐnxiàn and other prefectures and counties in Fújiàn.
On the day *jiǎchén*,
the Censorate was instructed and admonished not to speak of matters with personal bias.
Shǐ Yízhí was summoned to the capital.
Dépèi was appointed Governor-General of Húguǎng,
and Yuán Zhǎnchéng was appointed Governor of Gānsù.
Relief was provided for drought disasters in Xīngxiàn and twelve other prefectures and counties in Shānxī.
On the day *xīnhài*,
relief was provided for flood disasters in Níngxià County, Gānsù.
On the day *guǐchǒu*,
the summer tax for the previous year in Níngzhōu, Yúnnán, was remitted.
On the day *yǐmǎo*,
Nàsūtú was appointed acting Minister of War.
The intercalary ninth month, on the day *guǐhài*,
the fixed tax for this year's flood disasters in Xīhuá and four other counties in Hénán was remitted.
On the day *dīngmǎo*,
Yǐn Jìshàn was appointed Minister of Justice,
and also tasked with affairs of the Ministry of War.
Qìngfù was transferred to be Governor-General of Yúnnán.
Nàsūtú was appointed Governor-General of Liǎngjiāng.
On the day *jiǎxū*,
relief was provided to salt-field households in Chánglú, Lútái, and other salt fields affected by floods.
Miscellaneous taxes were abolished in Yuánzhōu and Ráozhōu prefectures in Jiāngxī.
On the day *bǐngzǐ*,
the construction of the imperial tombs at Mǎlányù was completed.
On the day *xīnsì*,
relief was provided for wind disasters in Xiápǔ and two other counties in Fújiàn.
On the day *rénwǔ*,
relief was provided for flood disasters at Xiǎoqīnghé Post Station in Fèngtiān.
Chén Hóngmóu, Provincial Administration Commissioner of Yúnnán, was impeached for improperly memorializing on the reclamation affairs of his province,
and the matter was sent to the Ministry for severe deliberation.
Relief was provided for flood disasters in Shàngyuán and twenty-five other prefectures and counties in Jiāngsū,
with additional varying relief.
Relief was provided for hail disasters in Ānshùn and other prefectures, sub-prefectures, and counties in Guìzhōu.
In winter, the tenth month, on the first day *yǐyǒu*,
relief was provided for frost disasters in Yǒngjì and three other counties in Shānxī.
On the day *dīnghài*,
the Three Imperial Tombs of Shèngjīng were repaired.
On the day *wùzǐ*,
the Emperor proceeded to the Eastern Tombs.
On the day *xīnmǎo*,
the Emperor paid respects at Zhāoxī Líng, Xiàolíng, and Xiàodōng Líng.
On the day *yǐwèi*,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
On the day *bǐngshēn*,
Zhāng Jiāhàn, Grand General of Ānxī Garrison, was condemned to decapitation for extorting military provisions.
Cuī Jì was appointed Governor of Shǎnxī,
Yǐn Huìyī was appointed Governor of Hénán,
and Zhāng Kǎi was appointed Governor of Húběi.
On the day *jǐhài*,
Grand Secretary Yǐn Tài requested retirement due to illness,
but was graciously persuaded to stay.
On the day *guǐmǎo*,
relief was provided for flood disasters in Qíhé and twenty-eight other prefectures and garrisons in Shāndōng.
The fixed tax for this year's insect disaster in Chúnxiàn, Jiāngnán, and outstanding silver and rice in Táoyuán and three other counties were remitted.
On the day *dīngwèi*,
relief was provided for flood disasters in Hēilóngjiāng.
On the day *wùshēn*,
the Fèngxiān Diàn was repaired.
On the day *xīnhài*,
the fixed tax for the drought disaster in Píngfān, Gānsù, was remitted.
The eleventh month, on the day *yǐmǎo*,
relief was provided for drought disasters in Shòuzhōu and Huòqiū, Ānhuī.
The fixed tax for this year's flood disasters in Jìngbiān and eight other prefectures and counties in Shǎnxī was remitted.
On the day *dīngsì*,
King Lǐ Yǐn of Cháoxiǎn requested the enfeoffment of Crown Prince Lǐ Xuān;
the Ministry of Rites stated that he was not yet of age,
but the Emperor specially granted the request.
On the day *guǐhài*,
relief was provided for hail disasters in Lángdài and three other sub-prefectures and counties in Guìzhōu.
On the day *yǐchǒu*,
the fixed tax for flood-affected areas in Héjīn, Shānxī, was abolished.
On the day *bǐngyín*,
relief was provided for flood disasters in Tàipíng and eleven other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Ānhuī.
On the day *xīnwèi*,
the Emperor proceeded to Tàilíng,
and the position of Superintendent was changed to Deputy Lieutenant-General.
Outstanding taxes in Tóngshān and Dàngshān counties, Jiāngnán, were remitted.
On the day *rényín*,
sacrifices were offered and announcements made at Tàilíng,
and the Emperor put off his mourning attire.
On the day *yǐhài*,
relief was provided for drought disasters in Huánxiàn, Lánzhōu, Gānsù,
and Sānshuǐ and ten other counties in Guǎngdōng.
The Emperor returned to the capital.
On the day *wùyín*,
on the occasion of the Empress Dowager's birthday,
the Emperor attended at Cíníng Gōng,
leading the princes and grand ministers in offering congratulations.
From this year on, it was done annually.
On the day *jǐmǎo*,
the *dīngyín* tax for drought disasters in Xīngxiàn and four other prefectures and counties in Shānxī was remitted.
On the day *gēngchén*,
it was ordered that the Grand Council be re-established,
with Grand Secretaries È'ěrtài and Zhāng Tíngyù,
Ministers Nàqīn and Hǎiwàng,
and Vice-Ministers Nàyántài and Bāndì as Grand Councilors.
The twelfth month, on the first day *jiǎshēn*,
Cáoyùn Zǒngdū Bǔxī was dismissed,
and Zhákèdān was appointed to replace him.
Láibǎo was appointed Minister of Works.
The fixed tax for the previous year's flood disaster in Fùníng, Jiāngnán, was remitted.
On the day *dīnghài*,
the Emperor presided at Tàihé Diàn,
and his principal consort Fùchá Shì was enfeoffed as Empress.
On the day *wùzǐ*,
the Empress Dowager was invited to preside at Cíníng Gōng,
and after the Emperor, leading the princes and grand ministers, offered congratulations,
the Emperor presided at Tàihé Diàn,
where the assembled officials offered congratulations,
and an imperial edict granting varying degrees of special favor was issued.
On the day *xīnmǎo*,
the fixed tax for flood disasters in Lìshuǐ and twelve other prefectures and counties in Jiāngsū was remitted.
On the day *rénchén*,
relief was provided for hail disasters in Fǔgǔ and three other counties in Shǎnxī.
On the day *jiǎwǔ*,
with the successful completion of the ceremony for the enfeoffment of the Empress,
an additional honorary title, Chóngqìng Cíxuān Huáng Tàihòu, was conferred upon the Empress Dowager.
The Empress Dowager was invited to preside at Cíníng Gōng,
and the Emperor, leading the princes and grand ministers, offered congratulations;
the following day, an imperial edict granting varying degrees of special favor was issued.
On the day *jǐhài*,
this year's hearth tax for drought disasters in Zhílì was remitted.
The fixed tax for flood disasters in Níngxià, Gānsù, was remitted.
On the day *rényín*,
È'ěrtài was enfeoffed as a third-class Earl.
Relief was provided for wind and tide disasters in Mǐnxiàn and six other counties in Fújiàn, and Hǎikāng and seven other counties in Guǎngdōng.
Grand Secretary Màizhù requested to retire due to illness,
which was granted.
Liúqiú offered tribute of local products.
On the day *guǐmǎo*,
Zhāng Tíngyù was enfeoffed as a third-class Earl.
On the day *xīnhài*,
relief was provided for flood disasters in Zhuōzhōu.
In the third year, in the spring, the first month, on the *jiǎyín* day,
the Emperor for the first time held the New Year's Day court celebration.
He led the princes and all civil and military ministers to Shòukāng Gōng to congratulate the Empress Dowager.
After the ceremony,
he proceeded to the Tàihé Diàn to receive congratulations.
From this point on, the New Year's Day ceremony was conducted in the same manner annually.
On the *yǐmǎo* day,
Fúmǐn was appointed Grand Secretary of the Wǔyīng Diàn,
and Mǎěrtài was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
On the *xīnyǒu* day,
prayers for a good harvest were offered to the Supreme Being,
with Shìzōng enshrined as co-worshipped.
On the *guǐhài* day,
an order was issued to commence the *jīngyán* (Imperial lectures on the Classics).
On the *jiǎzǐ* day,
the Emperor for the first time visited Yuánmíng Yuán,
and arranged for the Empress Dowager to reside at Chàngchūn Yuán.
On the *wùchén* day,
at the Zhèngdàguāngmíng Diàn,
a banquet was granted to the tributary foreign princes and internal ministers and Grand Secretaries.
On the *guǐyǒu* day,
Zhū Zǎo was appointed Governor-General of Riverways for Zhílì,
and Gù Cóng was appointed to assist in riverway affairs.
On the *dīngchǒu* day,
Gáěrdān Cèlíng of Zhǔngáěr sent envoys bearing memorials to the capital,
and also presented sable furs.
Vice Minister Ākèdūn was dispatched as the chief envoy,
Imperial Guard Wàngzháěr and Qíngqiánmén Táijí Émègēn as deputy envoys,
carrying an imperial edict to Zhǔngáěr to discuss and fix the border.
On the *jǐmǎo* day,
the Emperor returned to the palace from Yuánmíng Yuán.
On the *xīnsì* day,
in preparation for visiting the Tàilíng Mausoleum,
Èěrtài was ordered to oversee all affairs in the capital.
In the second month, on the *dīnghài* day,
offerings were made to the former teacher Kǒngzǐ.
On the *wùzǐ* day,
the Emperor visited Yuánmíng Yuán.
On the *guǐsì* day,
the Zhǔngáěr envoys were granted an audience,
and were rewarded with silver and silk according to their ranks.
On the *wùxū* day,
the Emperor visited the Tàilíng Mausoleum.
On the *jǐhài* day,
the Emperor offered sacrifices at the Tàilíng Mausoleum.
On the *xīnchǒu* day,
the Emperor visited Nányuàn for a hunting expedition.
On the *rényín* day,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
the *jīngyán* lectures were held.
From this point on, they were held once every second month of each season,
becoming a regular practice.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
the land tax quota for flood-stricken Qíhé and thirty-two other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Shāndōng was remitted.
On the *xīnhài* day,
the Emperor personally tilled the ceremonial field,
adding one furrow.
From this point on, this was done annually.
On the *rénzǐ* day,
Zhào Hóng'ēn was dismissed from office for accepting bribes,
Gāo Qízhuō was appointed Minister of Works,
and Zhāng Qú was appointed Governor of Húnán.
In the third month, on the *guǐchǒu* day (new moon),
relief was provided for the eight typhoon-stricken counties, including Mǐnxiàn, in Fújiàn.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
the Emperor visited the Tàixué to offer sacrifices,
and at the Yílún Táng,
ordered lectures on the *Zhōngyōng* and *Shàngshū*.
On the *yǐmǎo* day,
Cuī Jì was transferred to be Governor of Húběi,
and Zhāng Kǎi was appointed Governor of Xī'ān.
On the *jǐwèi* day,
the land tax quota for flood-stricken Liùhé and twelve other prefectures and counties in Jiāngsū was remitted,
and the land tax quota for drought-stricken Sānshuǐ and ten other prefectures and counties in Guǎngdōng was remitted.
On the *xīnyǒu* day,
relief was provided for flood-stricken Shàngyuán and twenty-five other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Jiāngsū,
and their land tax quotas were remitted.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
the Emperor visited Hēilóng Tán to pray for rain.
On the *xīnwèi* day,
the land tax quota for drought-stricken Lánzhōu and other areas in Gānsù was remitted.
On the *rénshēn* day,
due to the drought, the Ministry of Justice was ordered to clear up ordinary cases.
On the *guǐyǒu* day,
the land tax quota for flood-stricken Tàipíng and eleven other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Ānhuī was remitted.
On the *dīngchǒu* day,
the outstanding land tax for Miǎnyáng Zhōu in Húběi was remitted.
In the summer, the fourth month, on the *jiǎshēn* day,
due to the drought, an order was issued to solicit advice.
The contributions from governors-general and governors were suspended.
Minister of the Línyuàn Sēnggé retired,
and Nàyántài replaced him.
On the *jǐchǒu* day,
Sūn Jiāgàn was transferred to be Minister of Personnel,
Zhào Guólín was appointed Minister of Justice,
and Sūn Guóxǐ was appointed Governor of Ānhuī.
On the *rénchén* day,
Gù Cóng was ordered to go to Zhílì to work with Zhū Zǎo on river conservancy projects.
The land tax quota for flood-stricken Lú tái and other salt fields, and Héngshuǐ and other prefectures and counties in Chánglú was remitted.
In the fifth month, on the *guǐchǒu* day,
relief was provided for the ten hail-stricken counties, including Púchéng, in Shǎnxī.
On the *jǐwèi* day,
relief was provided for hail-stricken Zhāngqiū and other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Shāndōng.
On the *gēngshēn* day,
relief was provided for the eight hail-stricken counties, including Luònán, in Shǎnxī.
On the *rénxū* day,
the Miáo people led by Āshā of Dìngfān Zhōu in Guìzhōu revolted,
and Zhāng Guǎngsì suppressed them.
On the *xīnwèi* day,
Éěrtú was transferred to be General of Fèngtiān,
and Bódì was appointed General of Hēilóngjiāng.
On the *yǐhài* day,
the land tax quota for Sōngjiāng Fǔ in Jiāngnán was remitted.
On the *xīnsì* day,
relief was provided for the eight drought-stricken counties, including Jìngbiān, in Shǎnxī.
In the sixth month, on the *gēngyín* day,
relief was provided for the four hail-stricken counties, including Dōngpíng, in Shāndōng.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
Censor-in-Chief of the Left Yáng Rǔgǔ requested retirement,
which was granted.
In the autumn, the seventh month, on the *rénzǐ* day,
former Censor-in-Chief of the Left Péng Wéixīn was reinstated to his original post.
On the *dīngsì* day,
the land tax quota for drought-stricken Zhào'ān Xiàn in Fújiàn was remitted.
On the *guǐhài* day,
arrears in grain tribute for Wēnzhōu and other garrisons in Zhèjiāng were remitted.
On the *yǐchǒu* day,
Shǐ Yízhí was transferred to be Minister of Works,
and Gāo Qízhuō was transferred to be Minister of Revenue.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
Chá Láng'ā was ordered to enter the Grand Secretariat to handle affairs.
Èmídá was transferred to be Governor-General of Chuānshǎn.
Mǎěrtài was appointed Governor-General of Liǎngguǎng,
Chá Kèdān was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left,
and Tuōshí was appointed Governor-General of Grain Transport.
Grand Secretary Yǐn Tài requested retirement,
which was granted.
In the eighth month, on the *bǐngxū* day,
locusts appeared in Hǎizhōu in Jiāngsū, Tánchéng and other prefectures and counties in Shāndōng.
Relief was provided for flood-stricken Shímén Xiàn in Húnán, and Wǔwēi and two other counties in Gānsù.
On the *jǐchǒu* day,
Hǎi Wàng went into mourning,
and Nàqīn temporarily held the post of Minister of Revenue.
On the *jǐhài* day,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to visit the Tàilíng Mausoleum.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
the Emperor proceeded to the Tàilíng Mausoleum to perform the three-year memorial ceremony.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Nányuàn,
and the Emperor went hunting.
On the *wùshēn* day,
relief was provided for drought-stricken Wàngjiāng and forty-eight other prefectures and garrisons in Ānhuī.
In the ninth month, on the *gēngxū* day (new moon),
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the palace.
The land tax quota for hail-stricken Cháng'ān and fifteen other prefectures and counties in Shǎnxī was remitted.
Relief was provided for hail-stricken Zhāoyuǎn Xiàn in Shāndōng.
On the *wùwǔ* day,
the land tax quota for drought-stricken Zhāngpǔ from the previous year in Fújiàn was remitted.
On the *xīnyǒu* day,
Jī Zēngyún was ordered to enter the Grand Secretariat to handle affairs,
and concurrently manage the affairs of the Yǒngdìng River.
The position of Governor-General of Zhèjiāng was abolished,
and the position of Governor was re-established,
with Hǎo Yùlín remaining Governor-General of Mǐnzhè,
and Lú Zhuó as Governor of Zhèjiāng.
On the *jiǎzǐ* day,
Zhū Zǎo was dismissed from office,
and Nàqīn and Sūn Jiāgàn were sent to investigate him.
Gù Cóng was put in charge of the seal for the Director-General of Riverways.
Ānnán offered tribute.
On the *jǐsì* day,
Grand Secretary Yǐn Tài passed away.
Editor Péng Shùkuí presented the *Shísī Zhēn* (Admonition on Ten Considerations),
and the Emperor commended and rewarded him.
Relief was provided for drought-stricken Niǎnbó and other areas in Gānsù.
On the *dīngchǒu* day,
the land tax quota for flood-stricken Jiāngníng and fifty-two other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Jiāngsū was remitted,
and relief was also provided.
On the *wùyín* day,
relief was provided for drought-stricken Táiwān.
Winter, 10th month, *gēngchén* first day [of the month].
Relief was provided for areas afflicted by hailstorms in six prefectures and counties, including Āndìng in Shǎnxī.
On *xīnsì*,
the current year's hailstorm taxes were remitted for eight prefectures and counties, including Zōupíng in Shāndōng.
On *rénwǔ*,
outstanding taxes were remitted for water-affected prefectures and counties in Zhílì.
Outstanding taxes were remitted for disaster-affected prefectures and counties in Jiāngsū and Ānhuī.
On *xīnmǎo*,
the Emperor's second son, Yǒnglián, passed away.
Court was suspended for five days.
As, after his ascension to the throne,
the Emperor had personally written a secret decree naming Yǒnglián as Crown Prince,
all ceremonies were conducted according to the rites for a Crown Prince.
Relief was provided for drought-stricken areas in fifty prefectures, counties, and *wèi*, including Huáiníng in Ānhuī.
On *rénchén*,
Gāo Qízhuō, Minister of Revenue, passed away.
On *bǐngshēn*,
Rènlánzhī was transferred to serve as Minister of Revenue.
Zhào Guólín was appointed Minister of Rites.
Shǐ Yízhí was appointed Minister of Justice.
Zhào Diànzuì was appointed Minister of Works.
On *dīngyǒu*,
the Crown Prince Yǒnglián was posthumously granted the title Duānhuì Huáng Tàizǐ.
Lǐ Wèi, Governor-General of Zhílì, was dismissed due to illness.
Sūn Jiāgàn was ordered to act in his stead.
On *jǐhài*,
relief was provided for drought-stricken prefectures and counties, including Jí'ān in Zhèjiāng.
On *gēngzǐ*,
Lǐ Yǐn, King of Cháoxiǎn, presented a memorial congratulating the Emperor on bestowing a new honorific title upon the Empress Dowager and on the conferment of the Empress's title.
He also presented a memorial expressing gratitude for the enfeoffment of the Crown Prince,
and submitted local products as tribute.
On *rényín*,
the Emperor visited Tiáncūn
to offer sacrifices for Duānhuì Huáng Tàizǐ.
On *guǐmǎo*,
outstanding grain taxes were remitted for Jiāngnán, Jiāngxī, and Hénán.
On *yǐsì*,
Sūn Jiāgàn was appointed Governor-General of Zhílì.
Gān Rǔlái was appointed Minister of Personnel and concurrently Minister of War.
Yáng Chāozēng was appointed Minister of War.
On *bǐngwǔ*,
Gù Cóng was appointed Governor-General of Riverways for Zhílì.
11th month, *jǐyǒu* first day [of the month].
Guǎngdōng's Hǎinán Circuit was restored as Léiqióng Circuit.
Gāoléi Circuit was changed to Gāolián Circuit.
On *gēngxū*,
as Sūn Jiāgàn impeached Bèilè Yǔnhù,
the Emperor commended him
and allowed his proposal.
Yǔnhù was sent to the Imperial Clan Court for strict deliberation.
On *rénzǐ*,
relief was provided for drought-stricken areas in six counties and *wèi*, including Huátíng in Jiāngsū.
Relief was provided for drought-stricken Shímén County in Húnán.
On *guǐchǒu*,
the current year's insect disaster taxes were remitted for four prefectures and counties, including Níngyuǎn in Fèngtiān.
Relief was provided for areas afflicted by hailstorms in Guī'ān and Wūchéng in Zhèjiāng,
and four prefectures and counties, including Suídé in Shǎnxī.
Relief was provided for drought-stricken areas in six prefectures and counties, including Xiàogǎn in Húběi.
On *guǐchǒu*,
the current year's drought taxes were remitted for eight prefectures and counties, including Xìnyáng in Hénán.
Relief was provided for drought-stricken areas in Yìngshān in Húběi, and three prefectures and counties, including Zhōngzhōu in Sìchuān.
On *yǐchǒu*,
the annual lake and beach rents for Huái'ān and Xúzhōu prefectures in Jiāngnán were remitted.
Hailstorm taxes were remitted for Zhāoyuǎn County in Shāndōng.
On *gēngwǔ*,
Jī Zēngyún, Grand Secretary, requested retirement due to illness,
which was granted.
On *rénshēn*,
an earthquake occurred in Níngxià, Gānsù.
Water surged in new canals.
The seat of Bǎofēng County was submerged.
200,000 *liǎng* of silver were disbursed from the Lánzhōu treasury.
Bāndì, Vice Minister of War, was ordered to go and provide relief.
On *yǐhài*,
Xìngguì, Minister of Personnel, requested retirement,
which was granted.
On *dīngchǒu*,
outstanding taxes were remitted for various prefectures and departments in Xuānhuà, Zhílì.
12th month, *yǐmǎo* first day [of the month].
Nàqīn was transferred to serve as Minister of Personnel.
On *gēngchén*,
relief was provided for flood-stricken areas in six counties, including Shèhóng in Sìchuān.
Relief was provided for the current year's drought in the Liǎnghuái salt fields.
On *bǐngxū*,
Péng Wéixīn was stripped of his office.
Wèi Tíngzhēn was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
On *dīnghài*,
an earthquake occurred in Níngxià, Gānsù.
On *jiǎwǔ*,
relief was provided for insect disaster in Píngfān, Gānsù.
Wāng Méng, Grand Minister of the Court of Judicial Review, was ordered to oversee river projects in Jiāngnán.
Shàng Jìng, King of Liúqiú, dispatched envoys to present a memorial congratulating the Emperor on his ascension,
and offered tribute.
On *wùxū*,
Gǎ'ěrdāncèlíng, Taiji of Zhǔngá'ěr, dispatched Hālyǔ and others to accompany Vice Minister Ākèdūn and others to Jīngshī,
where they presented a memorial.
On *yǐsì*,
Zhǔngá'ěr envoys Hālyǔ and others were granted an audience.
The Emperor decreed:
"I greatly commend your proposal that the pasturelands do not cross the Ā'ěrtái Mountains.
The relocation of Tuō'ěrhé and Bùyántú garrisons inwards
is not feasible."
The 4th year, spring, 1st month, *jǐyǒu*.
The Emperor held court in the western heated chamber of the Qiánqīnggōng.

Ninety-nine princes, ministers, Hanlin scholars, officials from the Censorate and Offices of Scrutiny, as well as Governors-General, Governors, and Education Commissioners in the capital, were summoned and granted a banquet.
They composed poems in the *Bóliángtǐ* style.
On *dīngmǎo*,
earthquake disaster taxes were remitted for five counties, including Níngxià in Gānsù.
On *rénshēn*,
Jī Zēngyún, Grand Secretary, passed away.
Zhào Guólín was appointed Grand Secretary.
Rènlánzhī was transferred to serve as Minister of Rites.
Chén Déhuá was appointed Minister of Revenue.
2nd month, *jǐmǎo*.
Zhāng Qú was transferred to serve as Governor of Jiāngsū.
Féng Guāngyù was appointed Governor of Húnán.
On *bǐngxū*,
taxes on cooking hearths and land affected by floods were remitted for four prefectures and counties, including Cāngzhōu in Zhílì, and four *chǎng*, including Xīngguó.
Hailstorm taxes were remitted for four *tīng*, prefectures, and counties, including Lángdài in Guìzhōu.
On *yǐwèi*,
wind disaster taxes were remitted for Jìngyuǎn in Gānsù.
On *bǐngshēn*,
Mèngkètèmù'ěr and other people from the Zhǔngá'ěr tribe surrendered.
Taxes were remitted for flood-stricken Xiánníng and Zhèn'ān in Shǎnxī,
and insect disaster taxes for Liǔgōu Wèi in Gānsù.
On *wùxū*,
salt taxes were remitted for the newly opened Miáojiāng territories of Yǒngshùn and Yǒngsuí in Húnán.
Outstanding taxes were remitted for counties including Shàngyú in Zhèjiāng.
On *gēngzǐ*,
Gǎ'ěrdāncèlíng, Taiji of Zhǔngá'ěr, requested that the Ā'ěrtài Mountains be made the border,
which was granted.
Drought taxes were remitted for five counties and *wèi*, including Zhōngxiáng in Húběi.
3rd month, *dīngwèi* first day [of the month].
On *jǐyǒu*,
Yǎ'ěrtú was summoned to the capital.
Ālántài was appointed Assistant Minister for the Northern Route.
Outstanding taxes were remitted for four prefectures and counties, including Sùzhōu in Ānhuī.
The Ministry of Personnel presented a memorial concerning the expiration of selection terms.
The Emperor ordered the Ministers, Censors-in-Chief, and Vice Ministers to recommend individuals like Lù Lóngqí and Péng Péng.
Last year's drought taxes were remitted for Yìngshān in Húběi.
On *jiǎzǐ*,
a Military Preparedness Circuit of Rèhé was established,
stationed in Chéngdé Prefecture.
Nàqīn was ordered to assist as Grand Secretary.
On *wùchén*,
due to drought, the annual taxes for Zhílì, Jiāngsū, and Ānhuī provinces were specially remitted.
On *rénshēn*,
Wèi Tíngzhēn was appointed Minister of Works.
Relief was provided for flood-stricken areas in six counties, including Wén'ān in Zhílì.
Summer, 4th month, *dīngmǎo*.
Last year's drought taxes were remitted for Shòuzhōu in Ānhuī.
On *wùyín*,
drought taxes were remitted for seven counties, including Dānyáng in Jiāngsū.
On *xīnsì*,
Zhuāng Yǒugōng and 328 other individuals were granted the *Jìnshì* degree with varying ranks.
On *rénwǔ*,
last year's outstanding drought taxes for Chánglú were remitted.
On *bǐngxū*,
due to drought, a special order was issued to solicit opinions.
The Ministry of Justice was ordered to clear minor cases,
and commute sentences below penal servitude.
On *jiǎwǔ*,
drought taxes were remitted for three prefectures and counties, including Zhōngzhōu in Sìchuān.
On *yǐwèi*,
Chén Shìguān was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
On *guǐmǎo*,
Kùkùmù, Yánbù, and Yèlèng, three Khans from the Bālèbù tribe in Xīzàng, offered tribute.
5th month, *jiǎzǐ*.
Lǐ Yǐn, King of Cháoxiǎn, expressed gratitude for the bestowed national biographies,
and presented local products as tribute.
On *wùchén*,
the stone embankment of Hǎiníng in Zhèjiāng was rebuilt.
On *xīnwèi*,
Mǎ Qí, retired Grand Secretary, passed away.
On *guǐyǒu*,
È'ěrtài, Zhāng Tíngyù, and Fúmǐn were promoted to Grand Tutor.
Xú Běn and Nàqīn were promoted to Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.
Gān Rǔlái, Hǎi Wàng, È Shàn, Yǐn Jìchāng, Xú Yuánmèng, Sūn Jiāgàn, and Qìng Fù were promoted to Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince.
6th month, *gēngchén*.
Shuòsè was transferred to serve as Governor of Shāndōng.
Fāng Xiǎn was appointed Governor of Sìchuān.
On *jiǎchén*,
last year's disaster taxes were remitted for Chìjīn Suǒ in Gānsù.
Locusts afflicted seven prefectures, including Jǐnán in Shāndōng.
The river in Cáoxiàn breached its banks.
Relief was still provided for disaster victims in the six water-affected prefectures and counties.
Hailstorms afflicted six prefectures and counties, including Qín'ān in Gānsù.
In autumn, in the seventh month, on the day Wùshēn,
Èfù Cèlíng (son-in-law to the emperor) reported leading troops and stationing them at È'ěrhǎi Xīlāwūsū,
and also dividing forces to be stationed near È'ěrkūn Hé, Qíqí'ěrlǐkè, È'ěrdénízhāo, Tǎmì'ěr, and Wūlǐyàsūtái,
to guard against the Zhǔngá'ěr.
On the day Gēngxū,
due to hail disasters in the fifteen prefectures and counties of Qín'ān and others in Gānsù,
an order was issued that whether the disaster had already occurred or not yet fully developed,
the full year's regular tax would be remitted for all.
On the day Xīnyǒu,
relief was granted for flood disasters in the forty-seven prefectures and counties of Xiángfú and others in Hénán.
On the day Rénxū,
relief was granted to the salt households (cǎozàohù) in Hǎifēng and other counties of Shāndōng.
On the day Jiǎzǐ,
relief was granted for floods, hail, and various other disasters in the thirteen prefectures, counties, and garrisons (wèi) of Suīníng and others in Jiāngsū,
and for drought in Fáng Xiàn, Húběi.
On the day Bǐngyín,
Gān Rǔlái, Minister of the Board of Civil Office (Lìbù Shàngshū), passed away.
Hǎo Yùlín was appointed Minister of the Board of Civil Office,
imperial kinsman Dépèi as Governor-General of Mǐn-Zhè (Fújiàn and Zhèjiāng),
and Bāndì as Governor-General of Húguǎng (Húběi and Húnán).
On the day Jǐsì,
relief was granted for hail disaster in Sùzhōu, Ānhuī.
On the day Gēngshēn,
Mǎláng rebels, including Yǐcháng, from Ānnán came to surrender.
Relief was granted for hail disasters in the two counties of Lìjīn and others in Shāndōng.
On the day Rénshēn,
relief was granted for flood disasters in Kāizhōu and other prefectures and counties of Zhílì, and Hǎizhōu and other prefectures and counties of Jiāngsū.
Locust plagues occurred in Huái'ān, Jiāngsū, and Fèngyáng and other prefectures and departments of Ānhuī.
In the eighth month, on the day Bǐngzǐ,
Censor Zhāng Méi impeached various high officials for obstructing avenues of speech.
The Emperor rebuked him for being gradually tainted by Fāng Bāo's bad habits,
and summoned the Manchu and Han high officials who reported on affairs to instruct them.
On the day Xīnsì,
relief was granted for flood disasters in Shāngqiū and other prefectures and counties of Hénán.
On the day Rénwǔ,
Zhāng Guǎngsì was awarded for his achievements in managing the Miáo territory,
receiving the title of Hereditary Captain-Lieutenant of the Third Class (Sānděng Qīngchē Dūwèi),
while Huáng Tíngguì and others received differing promotions in titles and ranks.
On the day Wùzǐ,
relief was granted for flood disasters in the sixty-six prefectures, counties, and garrisons (wèi suǒ) of Lìchéng and others in Shāndōng,
and the collection of old and new regular taxes was suspended.
On the day Gēngyín,
Jiǎng Zhènshēng, a gòngshēng (tribute student) from Jīntán Xiàn, Jiāngsū, presented his handwritten Thirteen Classics.
He was bestowed with the title of Guózǐjiān Xuézhèng (National University Instructor).
In the ninth month, on the day Yǐsì (the first day of the month),
Tán Xíngyì, acting Provincial Commander-in-Chief (Tídū) of Guǎngxī, reported that the Zhèng clan in Ānnán had seized exclusive power,
and that Shào Jùngōng of Qīnghuà Zhèn and Lí Zhuó had raised troops to fight the Zhèng clan internally.
This was reported to the Emperor.
On the day Bǐngwǔ,
the water-damaged grain tribute (cáoliáng) from Hǎizhōu and Gànyú, two prefectures in Jiāngsū, was remitted.
On the day Wùshēn,
relief was granted for flood disasters in the thirty-seven prefectures and counties of Xiángfú and others in Hénán, with varying degrees of relief.
On the day Dīngsì,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, visited the imperial mausoleums.
On the day Gēngshēn,
the Emperor visited Zhāoxī Líng, Xiàolíng, Xiàodōng Líng, and Jǐnglíng.
Relief was granted for flood disasters in Línyì and other counties in Shāndōng.
On the day Guǐhài,
relief was granted for flood disaster in Zhāngyè Dōnglèbǎo, Gānsù.
Relief was granted for flood disasters in Dèngzhōu and other four prefectures and counties in Hénán,
and for drought in Yúcì and other three counties in Shānxī.
An order was given to suspend the collection of grain tribute (cáoliáng) in Jiāngsū and Ānhuī.
The Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, returned to the palace.
On the day Gēngwǔ,
due to illness, the Emperor ordered Prince Hé, Hóngzhòu, to perform the rites for the winter solstice (mèngdōng shíxiǎnglǐ) on his behalf.
One third of the grain and fodder (liángcǎo) in Qín'ān and other fifteen prefectures and counties of Gānsù was remitted,
as well as the current year's regular taxes (èfù) for all water and hail disasters in Língzhōu, Niǎnbó and other prefectures and counties.
In winter, in the tenth month, on the day Dīngchǒu,
Yīlāsīmùdìng, a Huí (Muslim) from Zhǔngá'ěr, came to surrender.
On the day Gēngchén,
due to flood disasters in Hǎizhōu and other four prefectures and counties in Jiāngsū,
arrears of taxes were remitted.
On the day Jiǎshēn,
on the first anniversary of Crown Prince Duānhuì's death,
the Emperor went to Tiáncūn to offer libations.
On the day Yǐyǒu,
relief was granted for flood disasters in Lìchéng and other sixty-six prefectures and counties in Shāndōng,
and silver was provided for repairing houses.
On the day Dīnghài,
regular taxes (èfù) for hail disasters in Xīngpíng and other sixteen prefectures and counties in Shǎnxī were remitted.
On the day Jǐchǒu,
Princes Zhuāng (Yǔnlù) and Lǐ (Hóng) and others were involved in an incident.
The Imperial Clan Court (Zōngrénfǔ) proposed stripping them of their noble titles and placing them under house arrest.
The Emperor said:
"Prince Zhuāng is leniently excused.
Prince Lǐ (Hóng), Bèilè Hóngchāng, and Bèizǐ Hóngpǔ are all stripped of their titles.
Hóngshēng is to be perpetually placed under house arrest.
Hóngxì's princely title
was by special imperial decree from the late Emperor (Huángkǎo),
so his princely title (wánghào) is leniently retained,
but his stipend is suspended."
On the day Bǐngshēn,
Mǎlántài was released.
On the day Jǐhài,
the wife of Èlǔtè Zásàkè Duōluó Jùnwáng and Héshuò Èfù Ābǎo, Héshuò Gégé, presented the imperial seal passed down by Gùshí Hàn.
An edict was issued to return it to her.
On the day Rényín,
Èfù Cèlíng, the Dìngbiān Zuǒ Fùjiāngjūn (Deputy General of the Left for Pacifying the Borders), was summoned to the capital.
Hóngmò was enfeoffed as Jùnwáng,
inheriting the title of Prince Lǐ.
On the day Guǐmǎo,
the Emperor went to the Southern Hunting Park (Nányuàn) for a hunt.
In the eleventh month, on the day Bǐngwǔ,
the Emperor performed the Grand Review Ceremony (dàyuè lǐ),
firing five arrows consecutively, all hitting the target.
The attending princes and high officials were bestowed with silver and silk in varying amounts.
On the day Wùshēn,
Hǎo Yùlín was appointed acting Governor-General of Liǎngjiāng (Jiāngsū and Ānhuī).
On the day Gēngxū,
Yǐn Huìyī was summoned to the capital,
and Yǎ'ěrtú was appointed Governor of Hénán.
Relief was granted for flood disasters in Āndōng and other fifteen prefectures and counties in Jiāngsū, with varying degrees of relief.
On the day Rénshēn,
the regular tax (èfù) for Níngxià for the following year was remitted.
In the twelfth month, on the day Guǐyǒu (the first day of the month),
regular taxes (èfù) for flood disasters in Jīnxiāng and other six prefectures and garrisons (wèi) in Shāndōng were remitted.
On the day Bǐngzǐ,
grain tribute (cáoliáng) in Ānjí and other prefectures and counties of Zhèjiāng was remitted,
as well as the regular tax (èfù) for drought in Luóshān, Hénán.
On the day Wùyín,
Hóng, for asking Āntài
"whether the Zhǔngá'ěr could reach the capital,
and how long the Emperor's life would be,"
was proposed to be sentenced to immediate strangulation.
An edict was issued to commute his death sentence,
to perpetual house arrest,
while Āntài was sentenced to strangulation.
Arrears of taxes (būfù) in Yúlín and other eleven prefectures and counties in Shǎnxī were remitted.
On the day Guǐwèi,
regular taxes (èfù) for flood disasters in Xiángfú and other forty-four prefectures and counties in Hénán were remitted.
On the day Yǐyǒu,
Bèilè Pōluónài was promoted to Jùnwáng.
On the day Gēngyín,
regular taxes (èfù) for flood disasters in Shāngqiū and other ten prefectures and counties in Hénán were remitted.
On the day Rénchén,
Hǎliǔ and others had an audience.
On the day Jiǎwǔ,
Chēchén Hàn Dámǎlín and others were summoned and granted tea.
In the fifth year, in spring, in the first month, on the day Dīngwèi,
relief was granted for drought disasters in Sùzhōu and other eight prefectures and counties,
and Lújiāng and other ten prefectures, counties, and garrisons (wèi) in Ānhuī, with varying degrees of relief.
On the day Dīngmǎo,
Cháoxiǎn (Joseon Korea) paid tribute.
On the day Xīnwèi,
Wūhètú and Bālíng'ā were ordered to escort Zhǔngá'ěr people to Xīzàng (Tibet) to boil tea.
The Miáo in Suīníng, Húnán, rebelled;
Féng Guāngyù and others were ordered to suppress them.
In the second month,
Liúqiú (Ryukyu) paid tribute.
On the day Yǐhài,
Èfù Cèlíng and others were ordered to demarcate the nomadic borders (yóumù biānjiè) between various tribes and Zhǔngá'ěr.
Hǎliǔ returned,
was summoned and granted tea,
and commended for the success of the peace negotiations.
On the day Xīnsì,
Yīlèshèn was appointed General of Suīyuǎn Chéng.
On the day Guǐwèi,
Wèi Tíngzhēn, Minister of the Board of Works (Gōngbù Shàngshū), was dismissed.
An edict was reissued to the Nine Ministers (Jiǔ Qīng),
to avoid repeating past mistakes of indecisiveness (móléng fùchè).
Regular taxes (èfù) for flood disasters in Zhāngqiū and other sixty prefectures, counties, and garrisons (wèi) in Shāndōng were remitted.
On the day Wùzǐ,
the previous year's regular tax (èfù) for Xiāngyáng Xiàn Garrison (wèi) in Húběi was remitted.
On the day Rénchén,
the previous year's regular taxes (èfù) for hail disaster in Sùzhōu, Ānhuī, and flood disasters in Téngxiàn and other five counties in Shāndōng were remitted.
On the day Wùxū,
Hán Guāngjī was appointed Minister of the Board of Works.
On the day Xīnchǒu,
the previous year's regular taxes (èfù) for drought disasters in Hànyáng and other four counties in Húběi were remitted.
In the third month, on the day Gēngxū,
Yǐn Jìshàn was appointed Governor-General of Chuān-Shǎn (Sìchuān and Shǎnxī),
and Èshàn was appointed acting Minister of the Board of Punishments (Xíngbù Shàngshū).
On the day Rénzǐ,
the previous year's regular tax (èfù) for flood disaster in Xióngxiàn, Zhílì, was remitted.
On the day Jiǎzǐ,
regular taxes (èfù) for flood disasters in Zhānhuà and other salt fields (chǎng) and counties in Shāndōng were remitted.
On the day Gēngwǔ,
the Miáo bandits in Lìlín and Guǐchōng villages in Húnán were pacified.
In summer, in the fourth month, on the day Bǐngxū,
relief was granted for disasters in Bǎnpǔ and other salt fields (chǎng) in Liǎnghuái (the region between the Huai River and the Yangtze River).
On the day Wùzǐ,
Censor Chǔ Tài was sentenced to decapitation for accepting bribes.
Regular taxes (èfù) for drought disasters in Jiāzhōu and Huáiyuǎn, Shǎnxī, were remitted.
On the day Jǐchǒu,
Nàsūtú was appointed Minister of the Board of Punishments.
On the day Jiǎwǔ,
due to drought, the Nine Ministers (Jiǔ Qīng) were summoned for an audience,
and instructed to directly point out deficiencies in governance.
The Shāndōng River Administration (Shāndōng Hédào) was changed to the Canal Administration (Yùnhé Dào),
and the Yǎn-Yí-Cáo Circuit (Yǎnyícáo Dào) was changed to the巡道 (Fēnxún Dào) for the three prefectures of Yǎn, Yí, and Cáo,
managing river works.
On the day Wùxū,
Rèn Lánzhī and Táo Zhèngjìng, Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices (Tàicháng Sìqīng), were found guilty of forming cliques,
and referred to the Board for strict deliberation.
On the *jiǎyín* day of the fifth month,
the Emperor proceeded to Hēilóngtán to pray for rain.
On the *bǐngchén* day,
he ordered the Ministry of Punishments to clear up common legal cases.
On the *jiǎzǐ* day,
Yáng Chāocéng was appointed Acting Governor-General of Liǎngjiāng.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
an edict was issued to Féng Guāngyù and the Huguang Provincial Military Commander Dù Kǎi to suppress and capture the Yao bandits of Chéngbù and Suíníng.
On the *guǐyǒu* day of the sixth month,
Àlǐgǔn and Zhū Bìjiē were ordered to investigate the floods and droughts in Yízhōu and other areas of Shandong.
On the *wùyín* day,
Shandong, Jiangsu, and Anhui were ordered to exterminate locust nymphs.
Zhāng Guǎngsì was summoned to the capital.
On the *rénchén* day,
relief was provided for the flood disaster in Qínzhōu, Gansu.
On the *wùxū* day,
Fúzhōu General Lóngshēng was impeached for accepting bribes,
stripped of his position, and prosecuted.
On the *jiǎchén* day of the intercalary sixth month,
the Miao people of Yìníng, Guangxi, rebelled,
and Mǎ'ěrtài was ordered to Guìlín to direct military affairs.
On the *xīnhài* day,
Kā'ěrjǐshàn was appointed Governor of Shanxi.
Dù Kǎi was ordered to lead Hunan troops to the front.
On the *yǐmǎo* day,
Zhāng Guǎngsì was ordered to Hunan to assist in military affairs.
On the *jiǎzǐ* day,
the Junggar Taiji Gá'ěrdān Cèlíng sent envoys to present a memorial.
In the autumn, on the *guǐyǒu* day of the seventh month,
Zhāng Qú was transferred to be Governor of Hubei.
Xú Shìlín was appointed Governor of Jiangsu.
Fāng Xiǎn was transferred to be Governor of Guangxi,
Shuòsè to be Governor of Sichuan,
and Zhū Dìngyuán to be Governor of Shandong.
On the *yǐhài* day,
an imperial letter was bestowed upon Gá'ěrdān Cèlíng,
and the Junggar envoy was instructed that the Altai Mountains would serve as the border,
and that those who grazed south of the mountains
should remain in their old territories.
A Grand Coordinator for Ānxī, Gansu, was established,
stationed in Hāmì.
On the *dīngchǒu* day,
Bǔxī was appointed General of Suīyuǎnchéng.
On the *xīnsì* day,
an imperial edict suspended this year's autumn executions.
On the *jiǎshēn* day,
Zhāng Guǎngsì remained to manage post-disaster affairs in Hunan.
Relief was provided for famine in Xuānchéng Guard, Anhui.
On the *jǐchǒu* day,

this year's land tax was remitted for nineteen prefectures, counties, and guards in Féngyáng, Anhui, affected by floods, and for four prefectures and counties in Wúwéi and other areas affected by drought.
On the *jiǎwǔ* day,
relief was provided for famine in Xúgōu, Shanxi.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
relief was provided for famine in Wǔwēi and two other counties in Gansu.
On the *wùxū* day,
Bāndì reported that Commander-in-chief Liú Cèmíng and others had successively captured the Miao strongholds of Chángpíng,
and arrested Lǐ Ālán and others who first incited rebellious talk.
On the first day of the eighth month, *jǐhài*,
the Man bandits of Yíshān county, Guangxi, were pacified.
On the *gēngzǐ* day,
an edict stated:
"I have reviewed the miscellaneous accounts for annual funds and provisions in the Jiang provinces;
these originated from the previous Míng dynasty,
and the land and labor service book has not been compiled,
causing burdens for both officials and commoners.
All of them shall be exempted."
On the *gēngxū* day,
Bāndì reported the pacification of all Miao strongholds at Yánjǐngkǒu.
On the *rénxū* day,
the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to reside in Nányuàn.
Relief was provided for famine in Yǒngdìng, Fujian.
This year's land tax was remitted for Famine in Zhōngmóu and thirteen other prefectures and counties in Henan affected by floods.
On the *wùchén* day,
Tán Xíngyì reported that the Annam people had enthroned Lóng Biāo as king,
who usurped the reign title Yuán Jǐngxīng.
On the *guǐyǒu* day,
Yáng Chāocéng was transferred to be Minister of Personnel,
still serving as Acting Governor-General of Liǎngjiāng.
Shǐ Yízhí was appointed Minister of War.
Hán Guāngjī was appointed Minister of Punishments.
Chén Shìguān was appointed Minister of Public Works.
On the *xīnsì* day,
Grand Secretary Assistant Minister of Rites Sāntài requested retirement,
but was persuaded to stay.
Relief was provided for famine in Shàngháng, Fujian.
Relief was provided for flood disaster in Yúháng and sixteen other prefectures, counties, halls, and guards in Zhejiang.
On the *bǐngxū* day,
the Zhūjiāzhá dike on the river in Sùqiān county, Jiangsu, burst,
and an order was given to build a diversion dam.
On the *dīnghài* day,
a stone seawall was constructed at Wújiābīn in Bǎoshān county, Jiangsu.
Relief was provided for famine in Jiāzhōu and other prefectures and counties in Shaanxi.
Wáng Ānguó was appointed Censor-in-chief of the Left.
The Yǒngdìng River returned to its old course.
In winter, on the first day of the tenth month, *wùxū*,
Cháng'ān was appointed Grand Coordinator of Grain Transport.
On the *rénwǔ* day,
the Emperor visited the Tàilíng Mausoleum.
On the *yǐsì* day,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
Relief was provided for flood disaster in Miánzhú and two other counties in Sichuan.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
this year's land tax for flood disaster in Píngluó, Gansu, was remitted,
and half the tax for Níngxià and Níngshuò was also remitted.
On the *bǐngchén* day,
Vice Censor-in-chief Liú Zǎo requested the suspension and reduction of construction at Yuánmíngyuán,
which the Emperor graciously accepted.
Relief was provided for typhoon disaster in Táiwān and Zhūluó, Fujian.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
Zhāng Guǎngsì reported the capture of Miao bandits Lì Xiányǔ and others,
and Dài Míngyáng and others who joined the Yao bandits,
and the capture of Píngxī and other strongholds.
On the *jǐsì* day of the eleventh month,
Nàsūtú was appointed Acting Governor-General of Huguang.
On the *gēngwǔ* day,
Láibǎo was transferred to be Minister of Punishments.
Hādáhā was appointed Minister of Public Works.
On the *bǐngzǐ* day,
Yáng Chāocéng impeached Yàbǐng Jùn, Governor of Jiangxi,
and Gāo Bīn was ordered to jointly investigate the case.
On the *jǐmǎo* day,
Wáng Huán was summoned to the capital.
Wáng Ānguó was ordered to manage the affairs of the Governor of Guangdong as Censor-in-chief of the Left.
Àlǐgǔn was ordered to jointly investigate and prosecute Yàbǐng Jùn with Gāo Bīn.
Liú Wúlóng was appointed Censor-in-chief of the Left.
On the *yǐyǒu* day,
court officials were ordered to recommend people they knew,
such as Tāng Bīn, Lù Lóngqí, Chén Bīn, and Péng Péng.
Relief was provided for famine in Jiāzhōu and six other prefectures and counties in Shaanxi.
On the *rénzǐ* day of the twelfth month,
Zhāng Guǎngsì advanced to suppress the Miao and Yao people of Chéngbù and Suíníng in Hunan,
and Yìníng in Guangxi,
and pacified them all.
This year's land tax for hail disaster in Xuānchéng and Xuānzhōu two counties and guards in Anhui was remitted.
This year's land tax for hail disaster in Tuōkètūo City and other areas was remitted.
On the *rénzǐ* day,
arrears of tax in Pútái, Shandong, were remitted.
In the spring of the sixth year, on the *jiǎxū* day of the first month,
the Grand Coordinator of Ānxī was abolished,
and a Provincial Military Commander was established.
On the *bǐngzǐ* day,
arrears of tax in Mǐnxiàn and four other counties in Fujian were remitted.
On the *jiǎshēn* day,
È'ěrtài and Nèqīn were ordered to jointly inspect the Yǒngdìng River project with Sūn Jiāgàn and Gù Cóng.
Counselor-in-chief Ādài was ordered to be stationed in Wūlǐyǎsūtái.
Qìngtài was appointed Counselor-in-chief of the Northern Route Army Camp.
On the *wùzǐ* day,
the land tax for Bāzhōu and Xióngxiàn was remitted.
On the *jiǎwǔ* day,
Bāndì was ordered to continue serving in the Grand Council.
In the second month,
Censor Cóng Dòng requested a temporary halt to imperial hunts,
which the Emperor explained as a means to train soldiers and awe distant regions.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
Wányán Wěi was appointed Deputy Grand Coordinator of the Southern River.
This year's land tax for flood disaster in Zhōngxiáng and four other counties and guards in Hubei was remitted.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
this year's land tax for hail disaster in Jiāzhōu and two other prefectures and counties in Shaanxi was remitted.
On the *gēngshēn* day,
a circuit inspectorate was added in Guīhuàchéng, Shanxi.
On the *rénshēn* day of the third month,
Vice Minister Yáng Sìjǐng was ordered to Shanxi to jointly investigate the case of Kā'ěrqīn, Shanxi Education Commissioner, who was accused of taking bribes to sell student qualifications.
On the *jiǎshēn* day,
due to Censor Zhòng Yǒngtán's impeachment of È Shàn for accepting bribes,
Yí Qīnwáng and others were ordered to investigate the case.
È Shàn was stripped of his position and arrested for questioning.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
Zhòng Yǒngtán was promoted to Vice Censor-in-chief.
In summer, on the first day of the fourth month, *yǐwèi*,
Grand Secretary Zhào Guólín requested retirement,
which was denied.
This year's land tax for flood disaster, insect plague, and reed tax for civilian settlements in Fēngxiàn and ten other prefectures, counties, and guards in Jiangsu was remitted.
On the *jiǎchén* day,
last year's land tax for flood disaster in Bāzhōu and ten other prefectures and counties in Shùntiān Zhílì was remitted.
Qìngfù was appointed Acting Governor-General of Liangguang,
and Zhāng Yǔnsuí was appointed Acting Governor-General of Yungui.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
È Shàn was granted permission to commit suicide.
On the *wùyín* day of the fifth month,
arrears of tax in Táiwān, Fujian, were remitted.
Relief was provided for flood disaster in Xīngguó and other counties in Jiangxi,
and Rénnǎi and Píngyuè in Guizhou.
On the *jiǎwǔ* day of the sixth month, the first day of the lunar month,
the arrears of land tax from the previous year's flood disaster in six prefectures and counties, including Shǎnxī's Jiāzhōu, were remitted.
On the *bǐngshēn* day,
Xú Shìlín, the巡撫 (Xúnfǔ) of Jiāngsū, was granted leave to visit his parents.
Chén Dàshòu was transferred to act in his stead.
Zhāng Kǎi was appointed as the Ǎnhuī Xúnfǔ.
On the *gēngzǐ* day,
Wáng Ānguó was ordered to investigate the accumulated abuses in grain collection in Guǎngdōng.
On the *yǐsì* day,
following an impeachment by Censor Lǐ Yǎn regarding the concealment of disasters in Gānsù,
Yīn Jìshàn was ordered to jointly investigate the matter.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
Lú Zhuó, the Zhèjiāng Xúnfǔ, was removed from his post.
Dé pèi and Vice Commander Wāng Zhālè were ordered to interrogate him.
Relief was provided for flood disasters in twelve prefectures and counties, including Sùzhōu in Ǎnhuī,
and for flood disasters in prefectures and counties including Shānyáng in Jiāngsū.
Zhào Guólín was demoted
for recommending unsuitable individuals.
In autumn, in the seventh month,
arrears of land tax for prefectures under Sūzhōu in Jiāngsū were remitted.
On the *jiǎzǐ* day,
Kā'ěrqīn was executed by beheading.
On the *bǐngzǐ* day,
Sàhāliàng was sentenced to execution by beheading.
On the *wùyín* day,
Yuán Zhǎnchéng, the Gānsù Xúnfǔ, was removed from his post
following an impeachment by Censor Hú Dìng.
Vice Commander Xīn Zhù was ordered to proceed and jointly interrogate him with Yīn Jìshàn.
On the *guǐwèi* day,
an imperial edict suspended this year's autumn executions.
On the *wùzǐ* day,
the Emperor conducted his first autumn hunt.
He escorted the Empress Dowager to the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng,
and three-tenths of the land tax for the areas traversed was remitted.
From then on, this became an annual practice,
and the land tax for prefectures and counties along the hunting route was reduced.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
relief was provided for flood disasters in two counties, including Wǔníng in Jiāngxī.
On the *rénchén* day,
the Emperor reviewed troops at Gǔběikǒu.
Relief was provided for famine in Yǒng'ān and Guīshàn counties in Guǎngdōng.
In the eighth month, on the *guǐsì* day,
relief was provided for flood disasters in nineteen prefectures, counties, and garrisons, including Sùzhōu in Ǎnhuī.
On the *gēngzǐ* day,
the Emperor stopped at Zhāngsānyíng.
On the *xīnchǒu* day,
the Emperor went hunting.
Relief was provided for flood disasters in eighteen prefectures and counties, including Shānyáng in Jiāngsū, and in salt fields including Guǎndú.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
Yáng Chāozēng was recalled to the capital.
Nàsūtú was transferred to be the Liǎngjiāng Zǒngdū,
and Sūn Jiāgàn was made the Húguǎng Zǒngdū.
Gāo Bīn was appointed as the Zhílì Zǒngdū,
and Wányán Wěi as the Jiāngnán Hédào Zǒngdū.
The position of Zhílì Hédào Zǒngdū was abolished,
and Gāo Bīn was ordered to concurrently manage Zhílì river affairs.
On the *xīnhài* day,
General Jídǎng'ā of Nínggǔtǎ was summoned to the capital,
and È'ěrdá was appointed to replace him.
In the ninth month, on the *guǐhài* day, the first day of the lunar month,
Chén Hóngmóu was appointed as the Gānsù Xúnfǔ.
On the *yǐchǒu* day,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to reside at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
Relief was provided for famine in twenty-six prefectures, counties, and sub-prefectures, including Nánhǎi in Guǎngdōng.
The Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back.
On the *rénshēn* day,
Wáng Shù was appointed as the Fújiàn Xúnfǔ,
and Yáng Xí fú as the Guǎngxī Xúnfǔ.
On the *jiǎxū* day,
Chén Hóngmóu was transferred to be the Jiāngxī Xúnfǔ,
and Huáng Tíngguì was appointed as the Gānsù Xúnfǔ.
Tribute grain (cáoliáng) affected by disasters in Jiāngsū and Ǎnhuī in the third and fourth years of Qiánlóng was remitted.
On the *jǐmǎo* day,
Hán Guāngjī was transferred to be the Gōngbù Shàngshū.
Liú Wúlóng was appointed as the Xíngbù Shàngshū.
On the *xīnsì* day,
the former Jiāngsū Xúnfǔ, Xú Shìlín, passed away.
Chén Dàshòu was appointed as the Jiāngsū Xúnfǔ,
and Zhāng Kǎi as the Ǎnhuī Xúnfǔ.
Relief was provided for famine in eight counties, including Fúqīng in Fújiàn, and in garrisons and camps including Chángfú.
On the *dīnghài* day,
Liú Tǒngxūn was appointed as the Zuǒ Dūyùshǐ.
In winter, in the tenth month, on the *gēngzǐ* day,
relief was provided for typhoon disasters in twenty-four prefectures and counties, including Qióngshān in Guǎngdōng.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
relief was provided for flood disasters in thirty-one prefectures, counties, and garrisons, including Sùzhōu in Ǎnhuī,
and the land tax and tribute grain for three prefectures and counties, including Sùzhōu, were remitted.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
relief was provided for famine in Língzhōu and other places in Gānsù.
On the *bǐngchén* day,
relief was provided for flood disasters for the Dīng (male adults) of the four banners of Rèhé.
In the eleventh month, on the *jiǎzǐ* day,
relief was provided for famine among salt-producing households in Liǎnghuái.
On the *yǐchǒu* day,
Dǎosūn, the King of Nánzhǎng, dispatched envoys to present tribute.
On the *bǐngyín* day,
relief was provided for hail and flood disasters in fourteen prefectures and counties, including Píngfān in Gānsù.
On the *jǐsì* day,
Censor Lǐ Yǎn's memorial regarding the famine situation in Gānsù was found to be untrue,
and the Board proposed his dismissal.
The Emperor said:
"Rather than punishing an official of remonstrance and thereby opening the door to concealing disasters,
it is better to be lenient to broaden our understanding."
He was ordered to be dismissed but retained in office.
On the *wùyín* day,
the land tax for flood disasters in fifteen prefectures, counties, and garrisons, including Shānyáng in Jiāngsū, was remitted.
Relief was provided for famine in thirty-four prefectures, counties, and garrisons, including Jùróng.
On the *bǐngxū* day,
for the Empress Dowager's fiftieth birthday celebration,
the Emperor attended the Cíníng Palace,
and led the princes, grandees, and others in offering congratulations.
In the twelfth month, on the *yǐwèi* day,
Liú Tǒngxūn requested the suspension of promotions for close relatives of Zhāng Tíngyù and the reduction of affairs managed by Nèqīn.
The Emperor commended him.
On the *bǐngshēn* day,
Grand Secretary Zhāng Tíngyù requested to be relieved of his Board duties,
which was not permitted.
On the *xīnchǒu* day,
the land tax for five years of flood damage in two counties, including Wǔwēi in Gānsù, was remitted.
Relief was provided for drought disasters in prefectures and counties including Jiāngpǔ in Jiāngsū.
The land tax for flood damage in two counties, including Xiāngxiāng in Húnán, was remitted.
On the *yǐsì* day,
the current year's land tax for nineteen prefectures and counties, including Rénhé in Zhèjiāng, was remitted.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
the land tax for drought disasters in sixteen prefectures, counties, and garrisons, including Lìchéng in Shāndōng, was remitted.
On the *gēngxū* day,
the land tax for drought disasters in three counties, including Yǒngchāng in Gānsù, was remitted.
The Ryukyu Kingdom presented tribute.
Cháng'ān was transferred to be the Zhèjiāng Xúnfǔ,
and Gù Cóng was made the Cáoyùn Zǒngdū.
Liú Tǒngxūn was ordered to proceed to Zhèjiāng to jointly inspect the sea dikes.
Relief was provided for flood and drought disasters in seventeen prefectures and counties, including Shèngxiàn in Zhèjiāng, and in areas including Rénhé.
In the spring of the seventh year, in the first month, on the *rénxū* day,
Shǐ Yízhí was transferred to be the Lìbù Shàngshū,
and Rèn Lánzhī was made the Bīngbù Shàngshū.
Zhào Guólín was appointed as the Lǐbù Shàngshū.
On the *gēngwǔ* day,
it was decided that a total of 4,000 soldiers would be recruited from Suīyuǎnéng, Yòuwèi, Guīhuàchéng Tǔmòtè, and Cháhār;
4,500 soldiers for the first detachment and 6,500 soldiers for the second detachment of the Inner Zásàkè;
to provide aid to the northern route army camps.
Additionally, camels and horses were to be placed along the route at É'ěrdénízhāo for use.
On the *wùyín* day,
due to the Nàkèsù thirty-nine tribes providing camels and horses for the Zhǔngá'ěr advance into Tibet,
their land tax for this year was remitted.
On the *jiǎshēn* day,
relief was provided for famine victims in the two prefectures of Fèngyáng and Yǐngzhōu,
and the one prefecture of Sìzhōu in Ǎnhuī.
On the *gēngyín* day,
the Zhǔngá'ěr presented tribute.
In the second month, on the *xīnmǎo* day, the first day of the lunar month,
the Emperor proceeded to the Tàilíng.
On the *yǐwèi* day,
the Emperor visited the Tàilíng.
On this day,
he returned to the capital.
On the *bǐngshēn* day,
Korea presented tribute.
On the *wùxū* day,
the Emperor went to Nányuàn for a hunt.
On the *jǐhài* day,
the Ryukyu Kingdom presented tribute.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
Lǐbù Shàngshū Zhào Guólín requested retirement,
which was not granted.
On the *yǐmǎo* day,
Jídǎng'ā was appointed as the Guīhuàchéng Dūtǒng.
In the third month, on the *gēngshēn* day, the first day of the lunar month,
the Emperor, concerned about the drought,
reissued an order for remonstrance,
and instructed the Nine Ministers and Grandees to fulfill their duties to the state.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
the Grand Secretaries, Nine Ministers, Dūdū, and Xúnfǔ were ordered to recommend officials of remonstrance like Mǎ Zhōu and Yáng Chéng.
On the *yǐhài* day,
due to the drought, the Xíngbù was ordered to clear minor cases,
and the provinces were to follow suit.
Yàn Sīshèng was appointed as the Shāndōng Xúnfǔ.
On the *xīnsì* day,
Gá'ěrdāncèlíng, Taiji of Zhǔngá'ěr, sent envoys Chuīnàmùkā and others to present a memorial and local products,
pleading for unlimited annual trade.
On the *rénwǔ* day,
considering Gá'ěrdāncèlíng's memorial to be cunning,
an edict was issued to the Grandees of the Northwest and Western Route Army Camps to pay extra attention to defense.
On the *wùzǐ* day,
the Emperor proceeded to Hēilóngtán to pray for rain.
Nàsūtú, the Liǎngjiāng Zǒngdū, was severely reprimanded
for omissions in his disaster relief efforts.
Summer, the fourth month, on the *gēngyín* day, the first day of the month,
the Zǔngé'ěr (Dzungar) envoys Chuīnàmùkā and others entered the court for an audience.
One Deputy Commander-in-Chief (*Fùdū Tǒng*) was removed each from Cáibāgōu and Dúshíkǒu.
One Deputy Commander-in-Chief was added to Tiānjīn.
The Gǔběikǒu Admiral (*Tídú*) was placed in charge of the post stations outside Dúshíkǒu.
The overdue taxes for the previous year, incurred due to floods, were remitted for Yǒngchéng and two other counties in Hénán.
On the *jiǎwǔ* day,
Jīnshēng and 322 other individuals were granted the degree of *Jìnshì Jíyǐ Chūshēn* with varying ranks.
Dépèi was transferred to serve as Governor-General (*Zǒngdū*) of Liǎngjiāng,
and Nàsūtú as Governor-General of Mǐnzhè.
On the *yǐwèi* day,
over 300,000 *liǎng* of silver were allocated for disaster relief in Ānhuī,
and permission was granted to purchase rice from Húguǎng for sale at stable prices.
On the *xīnchǒu* day,
relief was provided for flood-affected areas in Sùzhōu and other prefectures, counties, and garrisons (*wèi*) in Ānhuī.
On the *jiǎchén* day,
an imperial edict was bestowed upon the Zǔngé'ěr (*Dzungar*) Taiji Gáěrdān Cèlíng,
reiterating warnings concerning past disputes
and repeated violations of established treaties.
It also decreed the cessation of the current requests for trade and a change of route to Gásī,
while still granting rewards as per custom.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
taxes on flood-damaged land were remitted for Wéichuān and ten other counties in Hénán.
Overdue taxes due to hurricane disaster were remitted for Fúqīng and six other counties in Fújiàn.
On the *bǐngchén* day,
Liúwúlóng, Minister of Justice (*Xíngbù Shàngshū*), passed away.
Zhāngzhào was appointed Minister of Justice.
The fifth month, on the *jǐwèi* day, the first day of the month,
due to lack of rain in Shùntiān, Bǎodìng, and six other prefectures,
as well as Yìzhōu and four other departments (*zhōu*),
an order was given to halt the collection of new and old grain taxes.
Regulations were established for the relocation of Manchu soldiers to garrison and cultivate land in Lālín and Ālèchǔkā,
and a Deputy Commander-in-Chief was appointed.
Bālíngā was appointed to this position.
On the *wùchén* day,
based on an impeachment by Imperial Censor (*Yùshǐ*) Húdìng,
the appointment of Zhàohóng'ēn as Vice Minister of Justice (*Xíngbù Shìláng*) was rescinded.
On the *guǐyǒu* day,
the rituals for the rain prayer ceremony (*Yú Jì*) were established,
and imperial music was composed for it.
Overdue taxes on fields submerged by the Zhāoyáng Hú lake in Pèixiàn, Jiāngsū, were remitted.
On the *bǐngxū* day,
it was forbidden to refer to Mongols as
"barbarians" in memorials.
The King of Liúqiú Guó was commended
for assisting Chinese shipwreck victims who had drifted to their shores.
Zhāngyǔnsuí reported that the chieftain Zhàohèhǎn of Mènggěn, an area beyond the Měngzhē border, had been expelled
and had fled into Miǎndiàn (Burma).
The sixth month, on the *jiǎyín* day,
an edict was issued to Governors-General (*Dūdú*) and Governors (*Fǔ*) to supervise and direct departments (*zhōu*) and counties (*xiàn*) in managing agricultural land (*dìlì*).
On the *wùshēn* day,
local officials were strictly instructed to earnestly manage the sale of grain at stable prices.
Autumn, the seventh month, on the *jǐwèi* day,
an order was given to assist Japanese shipwreck victims in returning to their country.
Outstanding taxes were remitted for Wúzhōu and two other prefectures in Guǎngxī.
On the *xīnyǒu* day,
overdue taxes on barren land were remitted for Fánzhì in Shānxī and Wǔyuán in Guǎngxī.
On the *yǐchǒu* day,
Zhàoguólín, Minister of Rites (*Lǐbù Shàngshū*), requested retirement.
The Emperor reprimanded him for pretense
and stripped him of his office.
Rènlánzhī was transferred to serve as Minister of Rites,
Chéndéhuá as Minister of War (*Bīngbù Shàngshū*),
and Xúběn concurrently managed the Ministry of Revenue (*Hùbù Shàngshū*).
On the *bǐngyín* day,
Grand Secretary (*Dàxuéshì*) Èěrtài was ordered to concurrently hold the title of Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard (*Shìwèi Nèidàchén*).
Relief was ordered for flood-stricken areas in Shānyáng and other prefectures and counties in Jiāngsū.
Relief and compassion were ordered for flood-stricken areas in Fùníng and other prefectures and counties in Jiāngsū.
On the *guǐwèi* day,
Gāobīn and Zhōuxuéjiàn were ordered to go to Jiāngnán to investigate disaster relief and water conservancy.
On the *jiǎshēn* day,
relief was provided for areas affected by floods and hail in Hànchuān, Xiāngyáng, and other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Húběi,
and overdue taxes were suspended.
On the *bǐngxū* day,
relief was provided for Jiāngpǔ and eighteen other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Jiāngsū, and Línhuái and other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Ānhuī.

Relief and compassion were provided for disaster victims in Xìngguó and other prefectures and counties in Jiāngxī, Chún'ān and other prefectures and counties in Zhèjiāng, Lǐlíng and seven other prefectures and counties in Húnán, Yìxiàn and nine other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Shāndōng, and Dídào and three other prefectures, counties, and sub-prefectures (*tīng*) in Gānsù.
The eighth month, on the *wùzǐ* day,
the Huánghé and Huáihé rivers in Jiāngnán both swelled.
Provincial officials (*Jiānglì*) were ordered to rescue the flood-stricken populace,
without being bound by usual conventions.
Strict instructions were given to be cautious in military administration.
Over 2.5 million *liǎng* of silver were allocated for disaster relief in Jiāngsū and Ānhuī.
On the *gēngyín* day,
this year's overdue taxes were remitted for flood-affected areas in Jiāngsū and Ānhuī.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
the Empress's personal silkworm-rearing ceremony was established.
On the *wùxū* day,
outstanding taxes from the thirteenth year of Yǒngzhèng were remitted for Zhílì, Jiāngsū, Ānhuī, Fújiàn, Gānsù, Guǎngdōng, and other provinces,
and outstanding grain tribute (*cáoxiàng*) from the thirteenth year of Yǒngzhèng was remitted for Jiāngnán and Zhèjiāng.
On the *gēngzǐ* day,
an edict instructed Hénán and other provinces to provide relief for displaced people from Jiāngnán.
On the *rénchén* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, visited Nányuàn.
The Emperor participated in a hunt.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
relief was provided for flood-stricken Xìngguó in Jiāngxī.
On the *yǐsì* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, visited Liàngyīngtái to review the hunt.
The ninth month, on the *dīngsì* day, the first day of the month,
100,000 *shí* of grain tribute rice, originally destined for Shāndōng, was diverted from Jiāngsū
to be used for relief sales in the regions of Huái, Xú, Fèng, and Yǐng.
Relief was provided for flood-stricken Qiánjiāng and nine other prefectures and counties in Húběi.
On the *xīnyǒu* day,
overdue taxes due to wind disaster were remitted for Yázhōu and one other prefecture and county in Guǎngdōng.
This year's grain tribute taxes were remitted for flood-affected areas in Fèng, Yǐng, and Sì, three prefectures/departments in Ānhuī.
For areas not severely affected, taxes were commuted.
Relief was provided for flood-stricken Xiāngyīn and eight other counties in Húnán.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
the Emperor visited the Eastern Mausoleums (*Dōnglíng*).
On the *gēngwǔ* day,
the Emperor visited Zhāoxī Líng, Xiào Líng, Xiàodōng Líng, and Jǐng Líng.
This year's grain tribute taxes were remitted for flood-affected Shānyáng and twenty other prefectures and counties in Jiāngsū.
On the *rénshēn* day,
the Emperor visited Pánshān.
Relief and compassion were provided with over 2.9 million *liǎng* of silver and over 2.2 million *shí* of rice and grain for disaster victims in Jiāngsū and Ānhuī.
An additional 1 million *liǎng* of silver were ordered to be allocated from neighboring provinces for aid next spring.
On the *yǐhài* day,
the Emperor visited Bìjì Shān.
On the *wùyín* day,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
Winter, the tenth month, on the *bǐngxū* day,
50,000 *shí* each of next year's grain tribute rice from Shāndōng and Hénán were allocated for disaster relief in Jiāngnán,
and an equal amount was to be purchased and transported from outside Gǔběikǒu via Zhílì to replenish.
On the *jǐchǒu* day,
overdue taxes due to drought were remitted for Lìchéng and eighteen other prefectures and counties in Shāndōng.
On the *gēngyín* day,
Jiāngnán was ordered to retain 200,000 *shí* of grain tribute from the *guǐhài* year,
and an additional 200,000 *shí* of grain tribute from Shāndōng,
and 200,000 *shí* of granary rice from Hénán,
were to be transported to Jiāngnán for disaster relief.
On the *guǐsì* day,
Péishǐ, Admiral of Zhèjiāng, and others were stripped of their positions and investigated for embezzlement and fraud.
On the *rénchén* day,
relief was provided for famine-stricken Shānyáng and twenty-seven other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Jiāngsū.
On the *jiǎwǔ* day,
an order was given to clear pending legal cases.
On the *yǐwèi* day,
100,000 *shí* of granary grain along the river in Shāndōng were ordered to be transported to Jiāngnán for disaster relief.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
relief was provided for flood-stricken Fèngyáng and twenty-three other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Ānhuī.
On the *jiǎchén* day,
Lǐyǐn, King of Cháoxiǎn (Korea), presented a memorial expressing gratitude for the repeated leniency shown to his countrymen, Jīnshízōng and others, who had crossed the border and committed crimes.
The Emperor said:
"This is an act of My grace to distant peoples.
If they rely on this leniency
and commit more crimes,
it will not be My original intention to protect foreign vassals.
The King should strictly restrain them
so that they do not violate the law."
Sāilèné was appointed Governor (*Xúnfǔ*) of Shǎnxī.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
relief was provided for famine-stricken Yǒngchéng and twelve other prefectures and counties in Hénán.
On the *xīnhài* day,
the Emperor visited the palace of the Sùnyì Mì Tài Fēi to inquire about her illness.
On the *rénzǐ* day,
relief was provided for flood-stricken Shānyáng and six other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Jiāngsū.
The eleventh month, on the *bǐngchén* day, the first day of the month,
the Grand Secretaries and others presented a memorial on the compilation style of the *Míng Shǐ* (History of the Ming Dynasty).
The Emperor said:
"What you, My ministers, see is consistent with My intent.
Continuing the righteous path of the *Chūnqiū* (Spring and Autumn Annals)
and providing a clear mirror for future generations to observe,
let Us, ruler and ministers, strive together."
Relief was provided for flood and famine-stricken Hànchuān and eleven other prefectures and counties in Húběi.
On the *wùwǔ* day,
relief was provided for flood-stricken Ruì'ān and other counties, sub-prefectures (*tīng*), and salt-fields (*chǎng*) in Zhèjiāng, and Xiāngyīn and eight other counties in Húnán.
On the *gēngshēn* day,
in Zhāngpǔ county, Fújiàn, members of a secret society murdered the county magistrate.
An order was given to deal with them severely.
On the *rénxū* day,
relief was provided for flood-stricken Jiāozhōu and nine other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Shāndōng.
On the *guǐhài* day,
relief was provided for areas affected by floods and hail in Dídào and other prefectures and counties in Gānsù.
On the *yǐhài* day,
an order was given to administer justice with both leniency and strictness,
ensuring fairness.
Chénshìguān was ordered to collaborate with Gāobīn to investigate water conservancy in Jiāngnán.
On the *wùyín* day,
an edict was issued that the Empress Dowager would be accompanied to Shèngjīng next spring to visit the imperial mausoleums.
On the *gēngchén* day,
due to the initial establishment of the rituals for the Abstinence Palace (*Zhāigōng*),
the Emperor visited the Abstinence Palace on this day.
On the *bǐngxū* day of the twelfth month,
relief was distributed to the famine-stricken people in the seven *zhōu*, *xiàn*, and *wèi* of Jìníng and other places in Shāndōng.
On the *dīnghài* day,
an examination was ordered for selecting talented officials for the Censorate and other positions.
Zhōu Xuéjiàn recommended three people, all from his native place,
and an edict was issued to reprimand him.
Zhòng Yǒngtán, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief, was ordered to investigate the famine relief jointly with Zhōu Xuéjiàn.
On the *rénchén* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, visited Yíngtái.
On the *bǐngzǐ* day,
Zhòng Yǒngtán and È Róng'ān were arrested for leaking confidential information
and handed over to the Department of Justice (*Shènxíngsī*) of the Imperial Household Department (*Nèiwùfǔ*).
Qìng Wáng and others were ordered to try them.
The over-assessed silver tax for barren land in Yóuxī and three other *xiàn* in Fújiàn was remitted.
On the *jǐhài* day,
Zhāng Kǎi, Governor of Ānhuī, was summoned to the capital.
Kā'ěrjǐshàn was transferred to replace him.
È'ěrtài's crime of shielding Zhòng Yǒngtán was ordered to be treated leniently.
The extra tax from flood-stricken areas in Jìzhōu and three other *zhōu* and *xiàn* in Zhílì was remitted.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
grain from Jílín Wūlā granary was allocated and transported to relieve drought-stricken areas like Qíqíhā'ěr.
On the *gēngxū* day,
famine relief was distributed in Chéngdé and five other *zhōu* and *xiàn* in Fèngtiān.
The extra tax from flood-stricken areas in Jiāozhōu and ten other *zhōu*, *xiàn*, and *wèi* in Shāndōng was remitted.
On the *xīnhài* day,
Wányán Wěi was transferred to be the Grand Director-General of Rivers for Hédōng,
and Bái Zhōngshān was appointed Grand Director-General of Rivers for Jiāngnán.
On the *yǐmǎo* day,
an edict stated:
"In the flood-stricken areas of Jiāngnán, the land has dried out,
and cultivation cannot be delayed.
The provincial officials should urge the disaster victims to cherish their fields and cattle,
or provide funds for their upkeep.
Do not treat this as a trivial matter."
In the first month of spring of the eighth year, on the *dīngsì* day,
È Róng'ān was exempted from being exiled to the military post,
and was ordered to continue working in the Imperial Study (*Shàngshūfáng*).
Zhòng Yǒngtán died in prison.
Sūn Jiāgàn was summoned to the capital.
Ā'ěrsài was appointed Governor-General of Húguǎng.
On the *jiǎzǐ* day,
Chén Shìguān and others memorialized about repairing the riverways and water conservancy projects in the prefectures of Huái, Xú, Yáng, Hǎi in Jiāngsū,
and Fèng, Yǐng, Sì in Ānhuī.
This was sent to Grand Secretary È'ěrtài and other high officials for discussion and implementation.
On the *jǐmǎo* day,
Grand Councilors Xú Běn, Bāndì, and Nàyàntài were ordered to accompany the Emperor to Shèngjīng.
On the *xīnsì* day,
Consultant Ministers Ādài and Tǎ'ěrmǎ were recalled to the capital,
and Lābùdūn and Wū'ěrdēng were appointed to replace them.
On the *rénchén* day,
Lǐ Fú, Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat, retired and took his leave from the Emperor.
The Emperor responded with "Be as cautious at the end as at the beginning,"
and bestowed a poem to commend him.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
