the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, resided at the Imperial Summer Resort.
On the day Jiǎxū,
Méi Juéchéng, Left Censor-in-Chief (Zuǒ Dū Yùshǐ), retired.
On the day Bǐngzǐ,
an edict ordered that the Assistant Prefect (Tóngzhī) Lǐ Tūn and Garrison Commander (Shǒubèi) Zhāng Bīn, who had bungled the river works, be executed by beheading at the Tóngshān work site.
Cèlèng and others were ordered to bind Gāo Bīn and Zhāng Shīzài, make them witness the execution, and then release them.
On the day Dīngchǒu,
relief was provided for flood-stricken Lìjīn and other counties in Shāndōng.
In winter, the tenth month, on the day Gēngyín,
the King of Sūlù sent an envoy Láo Dúwàncházhá to request allegiance,
and the matter was referred to the ministries for deliberation.
On the day Xīnmǎo,
Liú Tǒngxūn was summoned to the capital.
On the day Yǐwèi,
relief was provided for this year's tidal disaster in Hǎifēng and five other counties in Shāndōng.
Zhōng Yīn was appointed Acting Governor-General of Shǎnxī and Gānsù.
On the day Xīnchǒu,
Yáng Xífú was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief,
Hú Báochuán was transferred to be Governor of Húnán,
Héngwén as Governor of Shānxī,
and Zhāng Ruòzhèn as Governor of Húběi.
On the day Guǐmǎo,
the new and old stipulated taxes for Fùníng and twenty-five other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Jiāngsū were partially remitted.
On the day Yǐsì,
relief was provided for flood-stricken Tàihú and twenty-nine other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Ānhuī.
On the day Gēngxū,
the stipulated tax for Qiántáng and twenty-seven other prefectures, counties, departments, and garrisons in Zhèjiāng, affected by drought, was partially remitted.
In the eleventh month, on the day Jǐwèi,
Sū Chāng was summoned to the capital,
and Hènián was appointed Governor of Guǎngdōng.
On the day Guǐhài,
Liú Zhènyǔ, a student from Jiāngxī, was executed
for words such as “changing clothing and ritual systems”
in his book *Zhìpíng Xīncè*.
On the day Jiǎzǐ,
relief was provided for flood and hail disasters in Lán and twenty-eight other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Gānsù,
and the stipulated tax was partially remitted.
On the day Jiǎxū,
Yáng Yìngjū was appointed Governor of Shāndōng.
The Zunghar Dorbod Taiji Chēlíng Wūbāshí and others led their respective tribes to surrender.
On the day Bǐngzǐ,
relief was provided for drought in Yùhuán Hall, Zhèjiāng.
On the day Gēngchén,
Wáng Dài, the Prefect of Chízhōufǔ in Ānhuī, was stripped of his post due to embezzlement.
He fled and resisted arrest,
and was executed by beheading.
In the twelfth month, on the day Bǐngxū,
relief was provided for drought in Fù'ān and other salt fields in Liǎnghuái.
The surrendered Dorbod Taiji Chēlíng and others were ordered to relocate to Hūlúnbèiěr.
On the day Dīnghài,
Sūn Jiāgàn, Assistant Grand Secretary (Xiéyàn Dàxuéshì) and Minister of Personnel (Lìbù Shàngshū), passed away.
Yùbǎo, Nǔsān, and Sàlāllè were appointed Northern Route Assistant Commanders (Běilù Cānzàn Dàchén).
Shūhèdé was ordered to go to the Éěrkūn military camp.
On the day Gēngyín,
Jiǎng Pǔ, Minister of Revenue (Hùbù Shàngshū), was appointed Assistant Grand Secretary.
Huáng Tíngguì was appointed Minister of Personnel,
and still supervised the Governor-General of Sìchuān,
Èěrdá was appointed Acting Governor-General.
On the day Bǐngshēn,
Jiāngnán's Zhāngjiā Mǎlù and the two sluice gates of Shàobóhú were simultaneously closed on the same day.
On the day Gēngzǐ,
because the Zunghar Taiji Dawachi had not sent envoys to the capital,
Yǒngcháng was ordered to temporarily suspend trade.
In the nineteenth year, in spring, the first month, on the day Rénzǐ,

relief was provided for last year's flood disaster in Sùzhōu and fourteen other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Ānhuī, and Fùníng and fourteen other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Jiāngsū.
On the day Rénxū,
Sàlāllè and others were ordered to suppress the Zunghar Ulianghai who had entered the passes.
On the day Yǐhài,
Yáng Xífú was appointed Acting Minister of Personnel,
and È Mǐdá was relieved of his concurrent duties.
On the day Dīngchǒu,
Liúqiú offered tribute.
On the day Jǐmǎo,
the Zunghar Taiji Chēlíng and others came for an audience.
In the second month, on the day Bǐngshēn,
relief was provided for the 18th year's flood disaster in Lánshān, Shāndōng.
On the day Wùxū,
Sūlù offered tribute,
and the Governor-General and Governor of Guǎngdōng were ordered to send a dispatch to the King, prohibiting him from using inland merchants as envoys.
Relief was provided for tidal disasters in Chāngyì and three other counties, and Yǒngfēng and four other salt fields in Shāndōng.
On the day Guǐmǎo,
Cèlèng was summoned to the capital.
On the day Yǐsì,
Kùběn of the Zunghar Ulianghai surrendered.
On the day Jǐyǒu,
Cèlèng was ordered to go to the Northern Route military camp.
On the *xīnhài* day of the third month, the first day of the lunar month,
Bái Zhōngshān was appointed Grand Governor of River Affairs for Hédōng.
Yáng Yìngjū was appointed acting in this role.
The Zunghar *taijis* Āmù'ěrsānnà and others had an internal conflict with Dáwǎqí.
On the *wùwǔ* day,
Shūhèdé, Chénggǔnzhábù, and Sàlálè were ordered to come to the capital.
The Khalkha Prince Élínqìn Duō'ěrdé was put in charge of Khalkha military affairs.
On the *gēngshēn* day,
Yuè Zhōngqí, the Provincial Commander-in-Chief of Sìchuān, died.
Relief was provided for flood victims in Qiánjiāng and three other prefectures and counties, as well as guards, in Húběi.
Taxes were also remitted to varying degrees.
On the *guǐhài* day,
the regular taxes for the eighteenth year in Dàchéng and nine other prefectures and counties in Zhílì, affected by floods, hail, and drought, were remitted.
On the *gēngwǔ* day,
the regular taxes for the eighteenth year in Tàipíng and twenty-four other prefectures and counties, as well as guards, in Ānhuī, affected by floods, were remitted,
and relief was also provided.
On the *yǐhài* day,
relief was provided to salt-field households in Fù'ān and eleven other salt-producing areas in Liǎnghuái.
On the *gēngchén* day of the fourth month in summer, the first day of the lunar month,
Liú Tǒngxūn and Wāng Yóudūn were granted the title of Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.
Fāng Guānchéng, Kā'ěrjǐshàn, and Huáng Tíngguì were granted the title of Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince.
Èróng'ān and Kāitài were granted the title of Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince.
Yǒngcháng and Shuòsè were granted the title of Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince.
The Zunghar *taiji* Chēlíng and others were ordered to come for an audience.
On the *gēngyín* day,
Chénggǔnzhábù was demoted to Khalkha Deputy General.
Cèléng was appointed Left Deputy General of Dìngbiān.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
Bāndì was summoned back to the capital.
Yáng Yìngjū was appointed acting Grand Governor of Liǎngguǎng.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
Commander-in-Chief Déníng and Zunghar *taiji* Sèbùténg were appointed Advisory Ministers for the Northern Army Camp.
This month,

the regular taxes for salt-field households in Cāngzhōu and one other salt-producing area in Chánglú, affected by drought last year, and for salt-field households in Cāngzhōu and one other prefecture in Zhílì, affected by floods last year, were remitted.
Relief was provided for drought victims in Lán and fourteen other prefectures and counties in Gānsù last year.
Relief was provided for flood victims in Sùzhōu and eleven other prefectures and counties in Ānhuī, and Fùníng and twenty-two other prefectures and counties in Jiāngsū last year.
On the *gēngxū* day of the intercalary fourth month, the first day of the lunar month,
Zhuāng Péiyīn and 232 others were granted the *jìnshì* degree with varying ranks.
On the *jǐwèi* day,
the regular taxes for Qiánjiāng and three other prefectures and counties, as well as guards, in Húběi, affected by floods last year, were remitted.
On the *xīnwèi* day,
Sèbùténg came for an audience.
Grand Secretary Fùhéng was ordered to go to Zhāngjiākǒu to convey the imperial decree and welcome him.
He was enfeoffed as a *Bèilè*.
On the *rénshēn* day,
it rained in the capital.
On the *xīnsì* day of the fifth month,
Qīngbǎo was appointed General of Hēilóngjiāng.
Due to the internal strife in Zunghar,
an imperial edict was issued for two routes of troops to advance and capture Yīlí.
Yǒngcháng and Cèléng were summoned to the capital
for direct instruction on strategy.
On the *jiǎshēn* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, toured Shèngjīng.
On the *wùzǐ* day,
the regular taxes for Tàipíng and twenty-four other prefectures and counties, as well as guards, in Ānhuī, affected by floods last year, were remitted.
On the *gēngyín* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, sojourned at the Summer Mountain Resort.
Zunghar *taiji* Chēlíng was enfeoffed as a Prince (*Qīnwáng*),
Chēlíng Wūbāshí as a Commander-Prince (*Jùnwáng*),
Chēlíng Mèngkè as a *Bèilè*,
and Mèngkètèmù'ěr, Bānzhū'ěr, and Gēndūn as *Bèizǐ*.
On the *guǐsì* day,
the regular taxes for salt-field households in Miàowān and ten other salt-producing areas in Zhèjiāng, affected by floods in the eighteenth year, were remitted.
Those severely affected were provided with relief.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
the regular taxes for salt-field households in Yǒngfù and two other salt-producing areas belonging to Chánglú, affected by floods last year, were remitted.
On the *wùxū* day,
Chén Hóngmóu was summoned to the capital.
Liú Tǒngxūn was ordered to assist Yǒngcháng in managing the affairs of the Grand Governor of Shǎnxī and Gānsù.
Chén Hóngmóu was transferred as Governor of Shǎnxī.
Zhōngyīn was appointed Governor of Fújiàn.
On the *jǐhài* day,
Yǎ'ěrhāsàn was summoned to the capital.
Èlèshùn was transferred as Governor of Zhèjiāng.
Èchāng was appointed Governor of Gānsù.
On the *rénzǐ* day of the sixth month,
relief was provided for flood victims in Lóngxī and other prefectures and counties in Fújiàn.
On the *gēngshēn* day,
relief was provided for drought victims in Lán and four other prefectures and counties in Gānsù.
On the *rénxū* day,
Āmù'ěrsānnà and others were defeated by Dáwǎqí
and fled to the land of É'ěrqísī Kuíbóhéshuò.
Cèléng and others were ordered to receive and assist those who surrendered.
On the *rénshēn* day,
Yǎ'ěrhāsàn was appointed acting Vice Minister of the Board of Revenue
and to serve in the Grand Council.
On the *xīnsì* day of the seventh month in autumn,
relief was provided for flood victims in Jìzhōu and other prefectures and counties in Zhílì.
On the *rénwǔ* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, traveled to Shèngjīng.
On the *guǐwèi* day,
Imperial Guard Commander Tǎlèmǎshàn and Deputy Commander-in-Chief Zhálèháng'ā were appointed Advisory Ministers for the Northern Army Camp.
On the *bǐngxū* day,
due to the escape of Bāláng, a Wūliánghǎi person,
Chēbùdéng was demoted to *Bèizǐ*.
Advisory Ministers Ānchóng'ā and Déníng were condemned to decapitation.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
Āmù'ěrsānnà led his troops to surrender.
Sàlálè was ordered to welcome him.
On the *jǐhài* day,
the Emperor sojourned at the main camp east of Zhāngwǔtái River,
and the Empress Dowager stayed in the imperial tent.
On the *gēngzǐ* day,
due to the Khalkha *taiji* Dānbāzhábù's failure,
he was ordered to be executed by decapitation.
Cèléng, Shūhèdé, Sèbùténg, and Sàlálè were summoned to the capital.
Élínqìn Duō'ěrdé was appointed acting General.
Zhàohuì was appointed Advisory Minister.
On the *rényín* day,
Āmù'ěrsānnà was ordered to come for an audience.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
Bāndì was appointed Minister of War
and acting Left Deputy General of Dìngbiān.
Ālǐgǔn was appointed Commandant of the Gendarmerie.
Relief was provided for flood victims in Xīnghuà and other prefectures and counties in Jiāngsū.
On the *xīnhài* day of the eighth month,
Yáng Yìngjū was formally appointed Grand Governor of Liǎngguǎng.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
Dálèdǎng'ā was appointed General of Hēilóngjiāng.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
the Emperor sojourned in Jílín.
On the *yǐmǎo* day,
the Emperor went to Wēndéhéng Mountain to offer sacrifices to Chángbái Mountain and Sōnghuā River from a distance.
On the *dīngsì* day,
Èróng'ān was summoned to the imperial temporary residence.
Yǐn Jìshàn was appointed acting Grand Governor of Liǎngjiāng.
On the *jǐwèi* day,
relief was provided for flood victims in Qíqíhā'ěr and two other cities.
On the *gēngshēn* day,
relief was provided for drought victims in Lán and four other prefectures and counties in Gānsù.
On the *bǐngyín* day,
the Emperor inspected Huīfā city.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
Āmù'ěrsānnà was ordered to move his nomadic encampment to È'ěrkūn and Tǎmì'ěr.
On the *guǐyǒu* day,
Chēlíng Mèngkè, Chēlíng Wūbāshí, and Nèmòkù were appointed Advisory Ministers for the Western Route.
On the *yǐhài* day,
Dálèdǎng'ā, Wūlèdēng, Nǔsān, and Zhàohuì were appointed Advisory Ministers for the Northern Route.
Sàlálè, Ālántài, and Yùbǎo were appointed Advisory Ministers for the Western Route.
On the *dīngchǒu* day of the ninth month, the first day of the lunar month,
relief was provided for salt-field households in Jiǎoxié and other salt-producing areas in Liǎnghuái affected by tidal disasters.
On the *xīnsì* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager and the Empress, visited Yǒnglíng.
Sàlálè and others campaigned against Wūliánghǎi.
On the *jiǎshēn* day,
the regular taxes for Lán and fourteen other prefectures and counties in Gānsù, affected by floods and hail, were remitted.
On the *bǐngxū* day,
the Zhāolíng and Fúlíng Mausoleums were visited.
On the *dīnghài* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, sojourned in Shèngjīng.
On the *wùwǔ* day,
the Emperor, leading his officials, went to perform the congratulatory ceremony for the Empress Dowager.
He held court in Chóngzhèng Hall to receive congratulations.
The poll tax (*dīngfù*) for the current year in Fèngtiān Prefecture was remitted.
From outside Shānhǎiguān and places like Nínggǔtǎ,
all capital crimes, whether already judged or not, were reduced in severity.
Crimes below military exile were all pardoned.
King Yī Jīn of Cháoxiǎn sent envoys to Shèngjīng to present tribute.
On the *jǐchǒu* day,
the autumn executions for the current year were suspended.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
the Emperor visited the Temple of Confucius.
On the *guǐsì* day,
the Emperor held court in Dàzhèng Hall.
The imperial cuisine was presented by the imperial clan members (*zōngshì*), collateral imperial relatives (*juéluó*), and generals of Shèngjīng.
On the *jiǎwǔ* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager and the Empress, returned from Shèngjīng.
On the *jǐhài* day,
the regular taxes for Wǔqīng and three other counties in Zhílì were reduced.
On the *xīnchǒu* day,
Bāndì was appointed Left Deputy General of Dìngbiān.
Èróng'ān was appointed Advisory Minister.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
Chēlíng Wūbāshí, Nèmòkù, Chēlíng Mèngkè, and others were ordered to proceed to the Western Route
and serve above the Advisory Ministers.
Khalkha Prince Bāyā'ěrsīdì and others were to serve as commanders in the Northern Army Camp.
In winter, in the tenth month, on the day *Guǐchǒu*,
relief was provided for flood victims in sixteen *zhōu* and *xiàn* of Shāndōng, including Huìmín, and in three administrative areas, including Wèi and Yǒnghé.
On the day *Jiǎyín*,
Wèi Zhézhì was transferred to be the巡撫 (xúnfǔ) of Guǎngxī,
Èlèshùn was transferred to be the巡撫 (xúnfǔ) of Ānhuī,
and Zhōu Rénjì was appointed as the巡撫 (xúnfǔ) of Zhèjiāng.
On the day *Yǐmǎo*,
relief was provided for flood victims of this year in nineteen *zhōu* and *xiàn* of Ānhuī, including Shòuzhōu, and for hail victims in Mǎyì, Shānxī.
On the day *Bǐngchén*,
the Emperor, having escorted the Empress Dowager, returned to the palace.
On the day *Wùwǔ*,
the Emperor held court in the Tàihé Diàn,
receiving memorials and congratulations from all civil and military officials, from princes downwards.
On the day *Jǐwèi*,
Wāng Yóudūn, the 尚書 (shàngshū) of the Ministry of Public Works, was put in charge of the Ministry of Punishments.
On the day *Xīnyǒu*,
relief was provided for flood victims in sixteen *zhōu* and *xiàn* of Jiāngsū, including Fùníng,
and taxes were remitted in varying degrees.
On the day *Xīnwèi*,
three thousand Manchu soldiers from the capital were moved to Álèchǔkā and other places for garrisoning and farming,
and one Assistant Commander-in-Chief and one Deputy Commander were added.
On the day *Gēngwǔ*,
Èmídá was appointed acting 尚書 (shàngshū) of the Ministry of Personnel.
In the eleventh month, on the day *Wùyín*,
relief was provided for wind disaster victims in two *xiàn* of Fújiàn, including Zhūluó.
The Emperor visited the Nányuàn.
Sū Lǎodān Mǎhǎn Mǎ'ānróulǜlín, King of the Sūlù Kingdom, sent envoys to offer local products as tribute.
Àbùdáshí, a *tàijí* of the Kè'ěrtángtè clan of Zhǔngá'ěr, surrendered.
On the day *Gēngchén*,
relief was provided for flood and hail famine victims in fifteen *zhōu* and *xiàn* of Shùntiān Zhílì, including Wǔqīng,
and regular taxes were remitted in varying degrees.
On the day *Yǐyǒu*,
the Emperor visited the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the day *Dīnghài*,
Àmù'ěrsāná, a *tàijí* of Huīté, and Nèmòkù, a *tàijí* of Dù'ěrbótè, along with their surrendered followers, welcomed the imperial carriage at Guǎngrén Lǐng.
On this day,
the Emperor summoned Àmù'ěrsāná and others, hosted a banquet for them,
and bestowed awards in varying degrees.
On the day *Wùzǐ*,
Àmù'ěrsāná was enfeoffed as a Prince (Qīnwáng),
Nèmòkù and Bānzhū'ěr were enfeoffed as Princes of the Second Rank (Jùnwáng);
Gāngduō'ěrzhǐ and Bātúbóluòtè, *tàijí* of Dù'ěrbótè,
and Zházhēncān and Qímùkù'ěr, *tàijí* of Huīté, were enfeoffed as Beile;
Bùtúkèsēn, É'ěrdění, and Luólěiyúnduān, *tàijí* of Dù'ěrbótè,
and Déjìtè, Pǔ'ěrpǔ, and Kèshíkè, *tàijí* of Huīté, were enfeoffed as Beizi;
Gēndūnzhábù and others, *tàijí* of Huīté,
and Bùyántègūsī and others, *tàijí* of Dù'ěrbótè, were enfeoffed as Duke (Gōng);
Wūbāshí and others, *tàijí* of Dù'ěrbótè,
and Yīshí and others, *tàijí* of Huīté, were enfeoffed as First-Rank *Tàijí*.
Àmù'ěrsāná, Prince (Qīnwáng) of Huīté, was appointed as the Northern Route Counselor Minister,
and Nèmòkù, Prince of the Second Rank (Jùnwáng), was appointed as the Western Route Counselor Minister.
Élínqīnduō'ěrzhǐ was ordered to be the Western Route Counselor Minister,
and Bāndì was summoned to the capital.
Àmù'ěrsāná was ordered to act as General,
with Éfù Sèbùténgbāléizhū'ěr assisting.
Chélíng and Chélíng Wūbāshí were ordered to go to the Western Route army camp,
and Nèmòkù, Àmù'ěrsāná, and Bānzhū'ěr were ordered to go to the Northern Route army camp.
On the day *Wùxū*,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
In the twelfth month, on the day *Wùshēn*,
Bāndì was appointed General Dingbei,
Àmù'ěrsāná was appointed Left Deputy General Dingbian,
Yǒngcháng was appointed General Dingxi,
and Sàlālā was appointed Right Deputy General Dingbian.
On the day *Xīnhài*,
the Emperor visited Grand Secretary Láibǎo and retired Grand Secretary Fúmǐn's residences to inquire about their illnesses.

Qīnwáng Gùlún Éfù Sèbùténgbāléizhū'ěr, Qīnwáng-ranked Línqìn, Jùnwáng Nèmòkù, Bānzhū'ěr, Jùnwáng-ranked Qīnggǔn Zábǔ, Shàngshū-ranked Gōng Dálèdǎng'ā, Zǒngdū-ranked Bó Éróng'ān, and Hùjūn Tǒnglǐng Wūlèdēng were appointed Northern Route Counselor Ministers,

and Qīnwáng Élínqīnduō'ěrzhǐ, Chélíng, Jùnwáng Chélíng Wūbāshí, Bèilè Chélíng Mèngkè, Sèbùténg, Bèizǐ Zhāláfēng'ā, Gōng Bātúmèngkè, Mǎshíbātú, and Jiāngjūn Ālántài were appointed Western Route Counselor Ministers.
On the day *Guǐhài*,
Lí Wéiyī, King of Ānnán, presented local products.
Relief was provided for flood victims in fifteen *tīng*, *zhōu*, *xiàn*, and *wèi* of Gānsù, including Hézhōu.
On the day *Bǐngyín*,
Éróng'ān was transferred to be a Western Route Counselor Minister,
and Ālántài and Kùkèxīnmǎmùtè were appointed Northern Route Counselor Ministers.
In the twentieth year, in spring, in the first month, on the day *Dīngchǒu*,

Left Deputy General Dingbian Àmù'ěrsāná was ordered to lead Counselor Ministers Éfù Sèbùténgbāléizhū'ěr, Jùnwáng-ranked Qīnggǔn Zábǔ, Nèidàchén Mǎmùtè, and Fèngtiān Jiāngjūn Ālántài to advance from the northern route for the campaign;
Right Deputy General Dingbian Sàlālā was ordered to lead Counselor Ministers Jùnwáng Bānzhū'ěr, Bèilè-ranked Zhāláfēng'ā, and Nèidàchén Éróng'ān to advance from the western route for the campaign.
On the day *Guǐwèi*,
Ālǐgǔn was appointed acting 尚書 (shàngshū) of the Ministry of Punishments.
On the day *Guǐmǎo*,
the tribute and taxes of Wūliánghǎi, Zháhāqìn, Bāoqìn, and others were remitted for one year.
In the second month, on the first day *Yǐsì*,
there was a solar eclipse.
Zhàohuì was ordered to remain in Wūlǐyàsūtái to assist in military affairs,
acting above the leading ministers.
On the day *Bǐngwǔ*,
Cháoxiǎn offered local products as tribute.
On the day *Yǐmǎo*,
the Emperor visited the Dōnglíng.
On the day *Wùwǔ*,
the Emperor visited the Zhāoxī Líng, Xiàolíng, Xiàodōng Líng, and Jǐnglíng,
and offered libations at the tomb of Empress Xiàoxián.
On the day *Jǐwèi*,
Fàn Shíshòu was summoned to the capital,
Hú Bǎochuán was transferred to be the巡撫 (xúnfǔ) of Jiāngxī,
Yáng Xíyì was appointed acting巡撫 (xúnfǔ) of Húnán,
and Jiǎng Pǔ was appointed acting 尚書 (shàngshū) of the Ministry of Personnel.
Relief was provided for flood victims in twelve *zhōu* and *xiàn* of Shāndōng, including Huìmín.
On the day *Gēngshēn*,
Qílún, a person from the Gálězátè tribe of Zhǔngá'ěr, surrendered.
On the day *Dīngmǎo*,
relief was provided for earthquake victims in Yìmén and Shípíng, Yúnnán.
On the day *Jǐsì*,
relief was provided for last year's disaster victims in Gāoyóu and other *zhōu* and *xiàn* of Jiāngsū.
In the third month, on the day *Bǐngzǐ*,
Yǒngcháng and others reported that Élútè Yèkèmíng'ānbāyá'ěr had surrendered.
On the day *Wùyín*,
the regular taxes for flood victims of the nineteenth year in twenty-two *zhōu* and *xiàn* of Jiāngsū, including Jiāngpǔ, were remitted.
On the day *Jǐmǎo*,
the Emperor proceeded to the Tàilíng.
Èchāng was summoned to the capital,
Chén Hóngmóu was transferred to be the巡撫 (xúnfǔ) of Gānsù,
and Táizhù was appointed acting巡撫 (xúnfǔ) of Shǎnxī.
On the day *Rénwǔ*,
the Emperor visited the Tàilíng.
On the day *Yǐyǒu*,
the Emperor stopped at Wújiāzhuāng,
and inspected the dikes of the Yǒngdìng Hé.
On the day *Bǐngxū*,
the Emperor visited Liàngyīng Tái for a hunt,
killing one bear and two tigers.
The Grand Secretaries, Nine Chief Ministers, Hanlin and Zhan Examiners, and Censors were summoned,
and it was decreed that Hú Zhōngzǎo's poems were rebellious,
and the crimes of Zhāng Tàikāi for publishing them and Èchāng for singing in harmony with them were pronounced.
It was ordered that they be strictly interrogated and judgment rendered.
On the day *Gēngyín*,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
Èchāng was dismissed from office and arrested for questioning.
On the day *Rénchén*,
Gāo Bīn died.
Zhāng Shīzài was released to return to his hometown.
On the day *Yǐwèi*,
Záhāqìn Demùqíbāhāmànjí and Zǎisāng Dūnduōkè and others surrendered.
On the day *Gēngzǐ*,
the regular taxes for this year's drought disaster in six *zhōu* and *xiàn* of Zhílì, including Bàzhōu, were remitted.
On the day *Rényín*,
Gálězàngduō'ěrzhǐ and other *tàijí* of Zhǔngá'ěr surrendered.
In summer, in the fourth month, on the day *Bǐngwǔ*,
Élínhābì'ěrgá Zǎisāng Ābāgásī and others surrendered.
On the day *Rénzǐ*,
retired Grand Mentor and Grand Secretary Zhāng Tíngyù died,
and it was ordered, in accordance with the last will of Shìzōng,
that he be enshrined in the Tàimiào.
On the day *Jiǎyín*,
Hú Zhōngzǎo was beheaded.
On the day *Yǐchǒu*,
Mǎnggālíkè, a *bókè* of Tǔlǔfān, surrendered.
The regular taxes for flood victims in three areas of Chánglú, including Yǒnglì, and one *xiàn* of Hǎifēng were remitted.
On the day *Bǐngyín*,
the regular taxes for flood victims in sixteen *zhōu* and *xiàn* of Shāndōng, including Huìmín, were remitted.
On the day *Dīngmǎo*,
Gǔnbùzhábù and other *tàijí* of Chuōluósī, as well as the Khojas of Yè'ěrqiāng and other Muslim regions, surrendered.
On the day *Wùchén*,
Shàng Mù, Crown Prince of the Liúqiú Kingdom, sent envoys to offer tribute and request enfeoffment,
which was granted.
On the day *Rénshēn*,
Jísài Zǎisāng Qíbāhàn surrendered.
On the *jiǎxū* day of the fifth month, the first day of the lunar month,
exemption was granted from the decreed land tax for drought and flood-stricken areas in nineteen prefectures and counties, including Ānhuī's Shòuzhōu.
Gōnggélèbāmupīlè, the Vice-General of the Khālkhà Chēchén Hán, was stripped of his title,
but retained in the army to render service.
Démùchǔkè, a Zāsàkè Jùnwáng, replaced him.
On the *wùyín* day,
relief was provided for flood-stricken areas in seven prefectures and counties, including Fèngtiān's Chéngdé.
On the *gēngchén* day,
Quánkuí, a Shìjiǎng of the Hànlín Yuàn, and Zhōuhuáng, a Biānxiū, were ordered to go to Liúqiú for an investiture mission.
On the *xīnsì* day,
Hétōng'émògēn Zǎisāng Ézhétè and others surrendered.
On the *rénwǔ* day,
Kùtúqínà'ěr Zǎisāng Sàlái surrendered.
On the *jiǎshēn* day,
Zhǔngá'ěr Zǎisāng Wūlǔmù surrendered.
On the *wùzǐ* day,
Ālèdáqīn Étuòkè Zǎisāng Tǎ'ěrbā surrendered.
On the *jǐchǒu* day,
Dáwāqí fled to Tèkèsī.
On the *gēngyín* day,
Shǐ Yízhí retired with his original rank.
Èchāng was granted the order to commit suicide.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
Huáng Tíngguì was appointed Wǔyīngdiàn Dàxuéshì,
and remained as the Governor-General of Sìchuān.
Wáng Ānguó was transferred to be Lìbù Shàngshū,
Yáng Xíyǔ was appointed Lǐbù Shàngshū,
and Hé Guózōng was appointed Zuǒ Dūyùshǐ.
Chén Hóngmóu was transferred to be the Governor of Húnán,
Wú Dáshàn was appointed the Governor of Gānsù,
and Tú'ěrbǐng'ā was appointed the Governor of Hénán.
On the *rénchén* day,
Āmù'ěrsāná reported the pacification of Yīlí,
and Āmù'ěrsāná was rewarded with double pay for a Qīnwáng,
and his son was enfeoffed as a Shìzǐ.
Bāndì and Sàlái were promoted to Yīděng Gōng,
and Mǎmùtè to Sānděng Gōng.
Sèbùténgbālèzhū'ěr, a Qīnwáng, was rewarded with double pay.
Zālāfēng'ā was enfeoffed as a Jùnwáng,
Chēbùdēngzābù and Pǔ'ěrpǔ as Bèilè.
Chēlǐng, a Qīnwáng, was rewarded with double pay.
Chēlǐng Wūbāshí, Bānzhū'ěr, and Nèmòkù were enfeoffed as Qīnwáng,
Cèlèngmèngkè as a Jùnwáng.
Fùhéng was again granted the title of Yīděng Gōng.
The Jūnjī Dàchén and others also received varying rewards.
Relief was provided for flood-stricken areas in Jiāngsū's Qīnghé, Tóngshān, and other prefectures and counties.
On the *guǐsì* day,
Dálèdǎng'ā was summoned to the capital to assist with the duties of a Dàxuéshì,
and Chuòlèduō was appointed acting Hēilóngjiāng Jiāngjūn.
Dàxuéshì Fùhéng declined the Gōng title,
which was granted.
Bāndì was enfeoffed as Chéngyǒng Gōng,
Sàlái as Chāoyǒng Gōng,
and Mǎmùtè as Xìnyǒng Gōng.
On the *guǐmǎo* day of the sixth month, the first day of the lunar month,
the pacification of the Zhǔn tribe was announced at the Tàimiào.
Officials were dispatched to offer sacrifices to Heaven, Earth, the Gods of Grain and Soil, and the Former Master Kǒngzǐ.
The Four Wèi Lātè were ordered to follow the example of Khālkhà,
with each tribe establishing one Méngzhǎng and one Fùjiāngjūn.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
Āmù'ěrsāná reported that his troops had reached Gédēngshān,
and greatly defeated Dáwāqí's forces.
Kālābātúlǔ Āyùxī, Bātú Jí'ěrgálè, Cháhāshí, and others were enfeoffed as Nánjué,
and also appointed Sànzhí Dàchén,
with others receiving varying rewards.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
the honorific title for the Empress Dowager was augmented to Chóngqìng Cíxuān Kānghuì Dūnhé Yùshòu Chóngxǐ Huángtàihòu,
and an imperial edict granting varying general amnesties was issued.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
Ākèdūn was dismissed.
Èmídá was appointed Xíngbù Shàngshū,
and continued as acting Lìbù Shàngshū.
Ālǐgǔn was appointed acting Bīngbù Shàngshū.
Yǒngcháng was demoted to Shìláng.
Dàxuéshì Huáng Tíngguì was appointed Shǎnxī-Gānsù Zǒngdū.
KāitàI was transferred to be Sìchuān Zǒngdū.
Liú Tǒngxūn was summoned to the capital.
Shuòsè was appointed acting Húguǎng Zǒngdū.
Àibìdá was appointed acting Yúnguì Zǒngdū.
On the *jǐwèi* day,
Luóbùzàngdānjīn and others were escorted to the capital.
Officials were dispatched to offer sacrifices at the Tàimiào,
and the ceremony for presenting captives was held.
On the *gēngshēn* day,
the Emperor presided over the reception of captives at the Wǔmén.
Luóbùzàngdānjīn's crimes were pardoned.
Bāláng and Mèngkètèmù'ěr were executed.
On the *jiǎzǐ* day,
Bāndì and others reported that Āmù'ěrsāná had clandestine dealings with various chieftains,
arbitrarily killed Dáwāqí's Zǎisāngs,
and plotted to seize Yīlí.
An imperial edict was issued ordering him to immediately come for an audience.
On the *wùchén* day,
Dáwāqí was captured,
and the Zhǔn tribe was pacified.
In the seventh month of autumn, on the *wùyín* day,
Dù'ěrbótè Táijí Béishí'āgáshí and others surrendered.
On the *dīnghài* day,
Wūlántài was enfeoffed as a Nánjué for capturing Dáwāqí.
Hēilóngjiāng Jiāngjūn Chuòlèduō was transferred to be Jīngzhōu Jiāngjūn,
and Dásè replaced him.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day of the eighth month,
relief was provided for flood and hail-stricken areas in seven prefectures and counties, including Jiāngsū's Hǎizhōu.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, toured Mùlán.
On the *rénzǐ* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, stayed at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
relief was provided for flood-stricken areas in twenty-two prefectures, counties, and garrisons, including Shāndōng's Jīnxiāng.
Zhǔngá'ěr Táijí Béishí'āgáshí was enfeoffed as a Qīnwáng.
On the *dīngsì* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, arrived at Mùlán for a hunting expedition.
On the *gēngshēn* day,
Yǐn Jìshàn was summoned to Rèhé.
On the *rénshēn* day of the ninth month, the first day of the lunar month,
exemption was granted from last year's decreed land tax for three flood-stricken counties, including Fújiàn's Táiwān.
On the *jiǎxū* day,
the Emperor presided at the temporary palace.
Chuòluósī Gélèzàngduō'ěrzǐ and others came for an audience,
and were granted a banquet.
Āmù'ěrsāná, who was to come for an audience,
rebelled upon reaching Wūlónggǔ,
and plundered the È'ěrqísī postal station.
On the *bǐngzǐ* day,
Zhǔngá'ěr chieftains Ābāgásī and others rebelled.
Yǒngcháng was reinstated as Nèidàchén,
and continued to handle the affairs of the Dìngxī Jiāngjūn.
Cèlèng, Yùbǎo, and Zālāfēng'ā were appointed Cānzàn Dàchén.
Hādáhā was ordered to remain in Wūlǐyàsūtái,
and work together with Ālántài.
On the *dīngchǒu* day,
Āmù'ěrsāná attacked Yīlí.
On the *gēngchén* day,
an edict to appease Āmù'ěrsāná was issued.
On the *rénwǔ* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, returned to stay at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the *guǐwèi* day,
Gélèzàngduō'ěrzǐ and others were bestowed with official robes and caps.
Gélèzàngduō'ěrzǐ was enfeoffed as Chuòluósī Hán,
Chēlǐng as Dù'ěrbótè Hán,
Shākèdū'ěrmànjì as Héshuòtè Hán,
and Bāyǎ'ěr as Huīté Hán.
Khālkhà Jùnwáng Sāngzhāi Duō'ěrzǐ was promoted to Qīnwáng.
Hādáhā and others were ordered to suppress Āmù'ěrsāná.
On the *dīnghài* day,
Cèlèng was appointed Dìngxī Jiāngjūn.
For capturing and executing the rebel chieftain Táilākè and others of Bāoqìn, Khālkhà Jùnwáng Bāyǎ'ěrshìdì and others were rewarded.
Bāyǎ'ěrshìdì was promoted to Qīnwáng,
Shākèdū'ěrzābù to Bèilè,
and Dá'ěrzhǎ Nuò'ěrbùzābù to Bèizǐ.
Relief was provided for flood victims of the current year in fifteen prefectures and counties, including Zhèjiāng's Shānyīn, five settlements including Cáwú, and one locality in Húzhōu,
and in Yúnnán's Jiànchuān prefecture.
Relief was provided for flood victims of the current year in eight prefectures, counties, and garrisons, including Húběi's Jiānglíng.
On the *gēngyín* day,
Yǒngcháng was arrested and brought to the capital.
Cèlèng was demoted to Cānzàn Dàchén,
and Zālāfēng'ā was appointed Dìngxī Jiāngjūn.
Liú Tǒngxūn, who retreated from Bālǐkūn to Hāmì,
was severely reprimanded.
On the *bǐngshēn* day,
Liú Tǒngxūn was arrested and brought to the capital.
Fāng Guānchéng was ordered to go to the military camp to manage provisions and supplies.
Èmídá was appointed acting Zhílì Zǒngdū.
Gélèzàngduō'ěrzǐ's son, Nuò'ěrbùlínqìn, attacked Ābāgásī,
defeated him,
and captured Démùqíbānzā.
He was additionally enfeoffed as a Jùnwáng.
Bèilè Qímùkù'ěr was enfeoffed as a Jùnwáng.
Ālǐgǔn was appointed acting Xíngbù Shàngshū.
Wāng Yóudūn was transferred to be Xíngbù Shàngshū.
On the *wùxū* day,
Hùbù Shàngshū Hǎiwàng passed away.
In winter, in the tenth month, on the *xīnchǒu* day (1st day of the month),
Cèlèng was stripped of his office and arrested for questioning.
Má Ènà and Kānìng'ā, Deputy Commanders-in-chief, were ordered to be the Expeditionary Commanders for the western route.
On the *jiáchén* day,
Wèi Zhézì was appointed Minister of Works,
and Èbǎo was acting Governor of Guǎngxī.
On the *wùshēn* day,
relief was provided for flood disasters in the prefectures, counties, and areas of Kuàijī and other places in Zhèjiāng.
Fùdé was appointed Counselor-in-chief.
On the *rénzǐ* day,
Liú Tǒngxūn and Cèlèng were pardoned and sent to the military camp
to serve as staff officers.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
relief was provided for flood disasters in Zōuxiàn and nineteen other prefectures and counties, and the Wèi and Guāntái areas in Shāndōng.
On the *dīngsì* day,
Dáwǎqí and others were brought to the capital.
Officials were dispatched to offer sacrifices at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and the Altars of Land and Grain,
and the ceremony of presenting captives was held.
On the *wùwǔ* day,
the Emperor proceeded to the gate tower to receive the captives,
and Dáwǎqí and others were released.
Relief was provided for flood and famine victims in Wúwéi and thirty-two other prefectures and counties in Ānhuī.
Lǐ Yuánliàng was appointed acting Minister of Works.
On the *xīnyǒu* day,
Cèlèng was reinstated as Counselor-in-chief,
acting General of Dìngxī,
and ordered to advance and suppress Āmù'ěrsā'nà.
On the *jiázǐ* day,
General Bāndì and Minister Èróng'ān were defeated at Wūlánkùtúlè
and died there.
Deputy General Sàlālā was captured.
On the *bǐngyín* day,
Hādáhā was appointed Left Deputy General of Dìngbiān,
Yá'ěrhāsàn was appointed Counselor-in-chief,
Dálèdǎng'ā was appointed Right Deputy General of Dìngbiān,
and Ālántài was appointed Counselor-in-chief of Wūlǐyǎsūtái.
In the eleventh month, on the *xīnwèi* day,
Sèbùténg, Prince of the Dù'ěrbótè, was appointed Counselor-in-chief for the northern route.
On the *guǐyǒu* day,
Cèlèng was appointed Grand Minister of the Interior and General of Dìngxī,
Zhāláfēng'ā was appointed Right Deputy General of Dìngbiān,
and Dálèdǎng'ā was appointed Counselor-in-chief.
Qīnggǔnzábǔ was pardoned of his crime.
On the *jiǎxū* day,
Èlèzhéyī and Hāsàkè Xīlá were appointed Counselor-in-chief,
and Nímǎ was appointed Grand Minister of the Interior and Counselor-in-chief.
An earthquake occurred in Jiànchuān Prefecture, Yúnnán.
On the *rénwǔ* day,
Èlèshùn was transferred to be Governor of Shāndōng,
Gāo Jìn to be Governor of Ānhuī,
and Xītèkù to be Commander of Bālǐkūn.
On the *guǐwèi* day,
Dáwǎqí was pardoned of his crime,
enfeoffed as a Prince,
and granted a residence in the capital.
On the *jiǎwǔ* day,
Gálèzázhátè Démùqí Dānbì came to surrender.
In the twelfth month, on the *guǐmǎo* day,
Wūlèdēng was reinstated as Expeditionary Commander.
Lú Zhuō was acting Governor of Shǎnxī.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
Assistant Minister Liú Lún was ordered to Zhèjiāng to investigate and handle the case of former Governor Èlèshùn,
and also to investigate relief efforts in Jiāngnán and Zhèjiāng.
On the *wùshēn* day,
the tribute and taxes for Yīlí for this year were remitted.
Fùsēn, General of Jílín, was appointed Minister of War,
and Èlèdēng replaced him.
On the *jǐwèi* day,
relief was provided for flood and frost disasters in Suǒlún and Dáhū'ěr.
Relief was provided for flood disasters in Qiánjiāng and six other prefectures, counties, and Wèi in Húběi.
Relief was provided for this year's flood disasters in Xúdú and twelve other areas in Liǎnghuái, and Kělán Prefecture in Shānxī, with varying amounts.
Annals of Gāozōng, Vol. 3, Reign Year 21, Spring, First Month
On the *gēngwǔ* day,
the Prince Consort, Prince of Kē'ěrqìn Sèbùténgbālèzhū'ěr, was stripped of his title and imprisoned
for mishandling military affairs.
Prince Èlínqìnduō'ěrdài of Kā'ěrkā was executed
for carelessly releasing Āmù'ěrsā'nà.
On the *jǐmǎo* day,
Dáshídáwá's wife, the wife of the late Chief Taiji of Zhǔngá'ěr, led her followers to surrender.
She was enfeoffed as Chēchénmò'ěrgēnhātún.
Yǐn Jìshàn was ordered to Zhèjiāng to jointly review Èlèshùn's case.
On the *dīnghài* day,
Hādān and others, leaders of Ābāgásī, came to surrender.
On the *yǐwèi* day,
Hādáhā was ordered to advance from Ā'ěrtài to assist in the suppression.
Former Deputy General Sàlālā returned from Zhūlèdūzīsī.
He was ordered to jointly manage the seal of Deputy General with Èlèzhéyī.
Dálèdǎng'ā, Assistant Grand Secretary, was ordered to advance from Zhūlèdūzīsī to assist in the suppression.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
Ākèdūn, retired Assistant Grand Secretary, passed away.
In the second month, on the *guǐmǎo* day,
Héqǐ, Resident Minister of Bālǐkūn, was granted the seal of an Imperial Commissioner.
On the *wùshēn* day,
Yáng Tíngzhāng was appointed Governor of Zhèjiāng.
On the *xīnhài* day,
the Emperor set out on his imperial tour to visit Kǒnglín.
Based on Cèlèng's report of capturing Āmù'ěrsā'nà,
the Emperor ordered the visit to be changed to Tàilíng.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
the Emperor visited Tàilíng.
Three-tenths of the land tax for the prefectures and counties traversed in Zhílì and Shāndōng was remitted,
and five-tenths for areas with poor harvests.
On the *yǐmǎo* day,
the Emperor journeyed to Shāndōng
and proceeded to Kǒnglín.
The additional taxes for tidal disasters in Hǎifēng and three other counties in Shāndōng were remitted.
On the *rénchén* day,
relief was provided for flood disasters in Lánshān and other prefectures and counties in Shāndōng.
On the *guǐhài* day,
relief was provided for flood disasters in Rénhé and fifteen other prefectures, counties, and areas in Zhèjiāng.
On the *jiázǐ* day,
Wèi Zhézì, Minister of Works, was dismissed due to illness,
and Zhào Hóng'ēn replaced him.
Cèlèng reported erroneously that Āmù'ěrsā'nà had been captured.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
Sàlālā was ordered to be stationed at Tènnàgér as Deputy General.
On the *wùchén* day,
Shuòsè was appointed Governor-General of Húguǎng,
and Guō Yīyù was appointed Governor of Yúnnán.
In the third month, on the *jǐsì* day (1st day of the month),
the Emperor arrived at Qūfù
and visited the Temple of Confucius, the First Teacher.
Qīngbǎo was appointed General of Shèngjīng.
On the *gēngwǔ* day,
the ceremony of offering sacrifices to Confucius was completed.
The Emperor visited Kǒnglín, Shàohào Líng, and Yuánshèng Zhōu Gōng Miào.
The additional taxes for Qūfù in the *dīngchǒu* year were remitted.
On the *xīnwèi* day,
relief was provided for flood disasters in Zōuxiàn and seventeen other prefectures, counties, and Wèi in Shāndōng.
On the *bǐngxū* day,
the river tax for flood-affected Sùqiān in Jiāngsū was remitted,
and the additional taxes for flood disasters in Qiánjiāng and five other prefectures and counties in Húběi for the previous year were remitted.
On the *dīnghài* day,
Hādáhā was ordered to advance to Wūliánghǎibùyántú,
with Qīnggǔnzábǔ and Chēbùdēng as Counselor-in-chief.
Cèlèng and others reported the recapture of Yīlí.
On the *wùzǐ* day,

the additional taxes for flood disasters in Sùzhōu and twenty-one other prefectures, counties, and Wèi in Ānhuī, and Fùníng and seventy-two other prefectures, counties, and Wèi in Jiāngsū for the previous year were remitted.
On the *rénchén* day,
the Emperor visited Zhāoxī Líng, Xiàolíng, and Jǐnglíng,
and offered wine at the tomb of Empress Xiàoxián.
On the *bǐngshēn* day,
Èlèshùn was granted suicide.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
In summer, in the fourth month, on the *rénzǐ* day,
the additional taxes for tidal disasters in Zōuxiàn and nineteen other prefectures, counties, and Wèi in Shāndōng for the previous year were remitted.
Dálèdǎng'ā was ordered to advance from the western route and Hādáhā from the northern route to campaign against Hāsàkè,
with Háníng'ā and Èshí as Counselor-in-chief.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
Grand Secretary Fùhéng was ordered to Èlínkābì'ěrgá to rectify military affairs.
Cèlèng and Yùbǎo were arrested for questioning.
Wūlèdēng was executed for carelessly releasing Āmù'ěrsā'nà.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
Minister Ālǐgùn was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
On the *dīngsì* day,
Fùhéng was recalled to the capital.
Fùdé reported a victory over Hāsàkè at Sàibó Sūtái.
On the *rénxū* day,
the additional taxes for frost disaster in Kělán Prefecture, Shānxī, for twenty years were remitted.
On the *guǐhài* day,
Yá'ěrhāsàn and Liú Lún, Grand Councilors, were dismissed.
Qiú Yuēxiū was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
On the *yǐchǒu* day,
Liú Tǒngxūn was recalled to the capital.
In the fifth month, on the *wùchén* day (1st day of the month),
Yùbǎo was demoted to Expeditionary Commander.
Dálèdǎng'ā was appointed Right Deputy General of Dìngbiān,
and Bālù was appointed Counselor-in-chief.
On the *yǐhài* day,
the additional taxes for disaster in Rénhé and thirteen other prefectures and counties in Zhèjiāng for the previous year were remitted.
On the *gēngchén* day,
the Emperor proceeded to Hēilóngtán to pray for rain.
On the *yǐyǒu* day,
Má Ènà and Dáshíchèlíng were appointed Counselor-in-chief.
On the *dīnghài* day,
the civilian and military farm taxes for Gānzhōu and three other prefectures in Gānsù for this year were remitted.
Relief was provided for frost and hail disasters in Gāolán and twenty other sub-prefectures, prefectures, and counties in Gānsù for the previous year.
On the *xīnchǒu* day,
Gálèzázhátè Zǎisāng Gēndūn and others came to surrender.
On the *rénzǐ* day,
Má Ènà was appointed Commander of Guīhuàchéng.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
Hé Guózōng was demoted.
Zhào Hóng'ēn was appointed Censor-in-chief of the Left,
Wāng Yóudūn was transferred to be Minister of Works,
and Liú Tǒngxūn was appointed Minister of Punishments.
On the *bǐngchén* day,
Zǎisāng Sàiyīnbókè, belonging to Bóshí'āgáshí, came to surrender.
On the *guǐhài* day,
Taiji Bóshí'āgáshí of Dù'ěrbótè sent an envoy to surrender.
He was ordered to be enfeoffed as a Prince.
On the *yǐchǒu* day,
Taiji Wūbāshí of Dù'ěrbótè was enfeoffed as a Beizi.
In autumn, in the seventh month, on the day Wùchén,
the tax quota for the previous year's flood disaster in Wúwéi and thirty-two other zhōu and wèi in Ānhuī was remitted.
On the day Rénshēn,
Tèlènggǔtè Zàisāng Dūnduōkè and Gǔ'ěrbān Hézhuó and others at Jí'ěrmǎtái feigned surrender.
Hādáhā and others led troops to annihilate them.
Hādáhā was appointed a領侍衞內大臣 (Lǐng Shìwèi Nèi Dàchén),
Chēbùdēngzhābù a Jùnwáng,
Tángkālù and Shūhèdé Vice-Commanders,
Sāndūbùduō'ěrzhǐ a Gōngjué (Duke),
and others were deliberated on and received varying ranks.
On the day Gēngchén,
Húbǎo, the Grand Coordinator of Grain Transport, passed away.
Zhāng Shīzài was appointed to replace him.
On the day Dīnghài,
the Emperor went to Qīnghé,
and offered sacrifices at the funeral rites of Bāndì and Èróng'ān.
On the day Rénchén,
as Qīnggǔn Zábù's rebellious acts were manifest,
an imperial decree ordered Shūmíng, Chénggǔnzhābù, and others to capture and suppress him.
On the day Guǐsì,
Kùchē Bókè Èduì and others surrendered.
In the eighth month, on the day Rén Yín,
Chuò'ěrdūo was appointed General of Hēilóngjiāng.
On the day Yǐsì,
Kā'ěrkā Qīnwáng Chénggǔnzhābù was appointed Deputy General of the Left for Pacifying the Borders,
and Shūmíng, Ālántài, Sāngzhāiduō'ěrzhǐ, Déqìnzhābù, and Tǎlěmǎshàn were appointed Counsellors.
On the day Xīnhài,
Nàmùzhálè and Démùchǔkè were appointed Counsellors.
Bǎodé was appointed Acting General of Suíyuǎnchéng.
On the day Guǐchǒu,
the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager on the autumn hunt in Mùlán.
Ābāgāsī and others were executed by dismemberment in the marketplace.
On the day Wùwǔ,
relief was provided to the six banners, including Zhāsàkè Fǔguó Gōng Chénggǔn of the Chēchén Hàn tribe, for drought disaster.
Élǔtè Dámǎlín surrendered.
On the day Gēngshēn,
the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager on a tour to Mùlán,
and conducted a hunt.
Hútúlíng'ā, Fùchāng, Bǎodé, Zhékùnà, and Ā'ěrbīn were appointed Counsellors,
to assist Chénggǔnzhābù in his duties.
Bǎoyún was appointed Acting General of Suíyuǎnchéng.
On the day Rénxū,
Táijí Béishí'āgáshí came to court,
was granted an audience at the temporary palace,
and was given a banquet.
On the day Guǐhài,
Chénggǔnzhābù and others received their deliberation.
On the day Jiǎzǐ,
Kā'ěrkā Bèilè Pǐnjí Chēmùchǔkèzhābù was appointed to manage the post stations,
and was enfeoffed as a Bèilè.
On the day Yǐchǒu,
Hādáhā and others campaigned against the Hāsàkè,
and defeated them decisively.
Zhālāfēng'ā was appointed a Bèizǐ,
and Míngruì a Vice-Commander.
Relief was provided to Cháng'ān and thirteen other tīng, zhōu, and xiàn in Shǎnxī for hail disaster.
In the ninth month, on the day Jiǎxū,
Dáwǎqí's close relative, Táijí Bālǐ, led his household to surrender.
They were ordered to graze their herds in the Zhāhāqìn area.
On the day Dīngchǒu,
Tu'ěrhùtè Táijí Dūnduōbùdáshí sent his envoy Chuīzhābù to present tribute.
The Emperor granted him an audience at the imperial tent,
and gave him a banquet.
On the day Wùzǐ,
the accumulated tax arrears from the first to the fifteenth year of Qiánlóng in Gānsù were remitted,
as well as the current year's tax quotas for Níngxià, Ānxī, and twenty-two other zhōu, xiàn, and wèi, with varying reductions.
On the day Gēngyín,
the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager back to the Summer Resort.
Dù'ěrbótè Qīnwáng Béishí'āgáshí was appointed Alliance Chief.
On the day Yǐwèi,
the King of Xiāmluó (Siam) sent envoys to present local products as tribute.
Relief was provided to Yútái and other xiàn in Shāndōng for flood disaster.
In the intercalary ninth month, on the day Guǐmǎo,
Tǎmùchǔkèzhābù, son of Luóbùzàng Chēlèng, was enfeoffed as a Bèilè.
On the day Wùshēn,
the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager on their return journey.
On the day Gēngxū,
Āguì was appointed Counsellor for the Northern Route.
Loans of seeds and rations were approved for households in Hēilóngjiāng affected by floods.
On the day Jiǎyín,
the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager back to the capital.
Relief was provided to Sùzhōu and twelve other zhōu, xiàn, and wèi in Ānhuī for flood disaster.
On the day Xīnyǒu,
the calamity-stricken grain tribute in Qīnghé and twelve other zhōu, xiàn, and wèi in Jiāngsū was remitted.
In winter, in the tenth month, on the day Wùchén,
Hādáhā was ordered to serve as Counsellor and assist Chénggǔnzhābù in his duties,
while Ālǐgǔn and Fùdé returned to the capital.
On the day Rénshēn,
as Fùlèhè had failed to prevent the river from bursting its banks,
he was summoned back to the capital.
Àibìdá was appointed Grand Coordinator of Waterways,
with Liú Tǒngxūn acting in his stead.
Hènián was transferred to be Governor of Shāndōng,
and Yǐn Jìshàn was appointed Governor-General of the Two Jiāngs,
concurrently managing river affairs.
On the day Guǐyǒu,
Mǎnfú was appointed General of Bālǐkūn.
On the day Bǐngzǐ,
as Zhàohuì received news of Húojízhàn's rebellion in the Huíbù,
he dispatched Āmíndào and others to advance with troops.
On the day Wùyín,
Huīté Táijí Bāyǎ'ěr rebelled and plundered Hónghuō'ěrbài and Zhāhāqìn.
Héqǐ, the General of Níngxià, was ordered to suppress him.
On the day Jǐmǎo,
relief was provided to Yánqìng and eight other zhōu, xiàn, and wèi in Zhílì for this year's flood and hail disasters.
On the day Yǐyǒu,
Fúmǐn, a Grand Secretary in retirement, passed away.
In the eleventh month, on the day Dīngwèi,
relief was provided to Gāolán and twenty-six other tīng, zhōu, and xiàn in Gānsù for flood and hail disasters.
On the day Xīnhài,
Chén Hóngmóu was transferred to be Governor of Shǎnxī,
and Túlèbǐng'ā Governor of Húnán.
On the day Jiǎyín,
it was ordered that Cèlèng and Yùbǎo still be arrested and interrogated.
Zhālāfēng'ā's title of Gōngjué (Duke) was demoted.
Dálèdǎng'ā was appointed General Pacifying the West,
Zhàohuì Deputy General of the Right for Pacifying the Borders,
and Yǒngguì Counsellor.
On the day Gēngshēn,
Hāsàkè Xīlābāmǎ and the Huírén Mánggálìkè led a multitude to attack General Héqǐ at Pìzhǎn.
Héqǐ fought bravely and died.
It was ordered that he be posthumously honored like Fùqīng and Lābùdùn.
On the day Jǐwèi,
Huáng Tíngguì reported preparing thirty thousand horses,
and increasing troops stationed in Hāmì and other places.
The Emperor
praised him for his "clear determination and responsibility."
Huáng Tíngguì was bestowed with a double-eyed peacock feather and the hereditary title of Qí Dūwèi.
On the day Rénxū,
Wáng Ānguó was relieved of his post due to illness.
Wāng Yóudūn was appointed Acting President of the Board of Civil Office,
Zhào Hóng'ēn Acting President of the Board of Works,
and Hé Guózōng Acting Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
In the twelfth month, on the first day Jiǎzǐ,
Cèlèng and Yùbǎo were arrested and brought to the capital,
but were killed by Élǔtè people en route.
On the day Gēngwǔ,
relief was provided to Fényáng and other xiàn in Shānxī for flood disaster.
On the day Xīnwèi,
an imperial decree bestowed upon Zhébùzūn Dānbā Hútúkètú the additional title of Fūjiào Ānzhòng Lǎmā.
On the day Rénshēn,
Lú Zhuó was appointed Governor of Húběi.
Relief was provided to Jīnxiāng and twenty-one other zhōu, xiàn, and wèi in Shāndōng for flood disaster.
On the day Jiǎxū,
the current year's quota taxes for commoners' fields and military farms' land in Zhōuzhì and four other xiàn in Shǎnxī for flood disaster were remitted by half.
On the day Wùyín,
Qīnggǔn Zábù was captured at Hánggājiǎnggāsī.
Chénggǔnzhābù was rewarded with a yellow girdle,
one of his sons was enfeoffed as a hereditary prince,
and Nàmùzhálè was enfeoffed as a First-Class Earl.
On the day Jǐmǎo,
Hútúlíng'ā and others were summoned back to the capital.
For the merit of capturing Qīnggǔn Zábù,
Bèilè Chēmùchǔkèzhābù was promoted to the rank of Jùnwáng,
and Bèilè Wàngbùduō'ěrzhǐ and others were bestowed with double-eyed peacock feathers.
On the day Bǐngxū,
Dálèdǎng'ā was dismissed from his post as Associate Grand Secretary,
and Èmídá was appointed to replace him.
In the twenty-second year, in spring, the first month, on the *jiǎwǔ* day,
due to the southern tour, the accumulated arrears of taxes for Jiangsu, Ānhuī, and Zhèjiāng were remitted.
Chénggǔnzhābù was appointed as General Dìngbiān,
to advance and suppress from Bālǐkūn.
Chēbùdéngzhābù was made acting Deputy General Dìngbiān of the Left for the Northern Route.
Shūhèdé, Fùdé, and Èshí were appointed as Counselor Ministers.
Sèbùténgbālèzhūěr, Ālǐgǔn, Míngruì, and others were appointed as Leader Ministers.
On the *yǐwèi* day,
relief was provided for the flood disaster in Qīnghé and nineteen other prefectures and counties in Jiāngsū.
On the *wùxū* day,
Sōngchūn was appointed as General of Jīngzhōu.
Mánggǔlài was appointed as Counselor Minister,
to proceed to the Northern Route army camp.
On the *jǐhài* day,
Hādáhā was appointed as Counselor Minister,
stationed at Kēbùduō.
On the *gēngzǐ* day,
Háníngā and Yǒngguì were appointed as Counselor Ministers.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, embarked on a southern tour.
On the *jiáchén* day,
Wāng Yóudūn was appointed Minister of Personnel.
Hé Guózōng was transferred to Minister of Rites.
Qín Huìtián was transferred to Minister of Works.
Zhào Hóngēn was reinstated as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
Bái Zhōngshān was appointed Grand Director of Rivers for Jiāngnán.
Zhāng Shīzài was appointed Grand Director of Rivers for Hédōng.
Yáng Xífú was appointed Grand Director of Grain Transport.
Àibìdá was appointed Governor of Jiāngsū.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
arrears of taxes for Jìnghǎi and three other prefectures and counties in Zhílì were remitted.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
three-tenths of the current year's money and grain taxes for areas in Zhílì and Shāndōng passed through were remitted,
and five-tenths for disaster-stricken areas.
On the *rénzǐ* day,
relief was provided for the flood disaster in Jìníng, five prefectures and counties, and guards in Shāndōng.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
Āsīhā was appointed Counselor Minister for the Northern Route.
On the *jǐwèi* day,
Jī Huáng was appointed Vice Grand Director of Rivers for Jiāngnán.
Āguì was ordered to remain in Wūlǐyàsūtái to manage affairs.
On the *rénxū* day,
Gálèzàngduōěrjǐ, Dáshíchēlǐng, and others rebelled.
In the second month, on the *guǐhài* day, the first day of the lunar month,
three-tenths of the current year's money and grain taxes for areas in Jiāngnán and Zhèjiāng passed through were remitted,
and five-tenths for disaster-stricken areas.
On the *jiǎzǐ* day,
relief was provided for disaster victims in Qīnghé, fourteen prefectures, counties, and guards in Jiāngsū, and Sùzhōu, four prefectures, counties, and guards in Ānhuī.
On the *bǐngyín* day,
Zhàohuì arrived with his entire army at Wūlǔmùqí.
He was enfeoffed as a First-class Earl,
with hereditary succession.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, crossed the river to Tiānfēizhà,
and inspected the wooden dragons.
Accumulated arrears of grain transport levies in Jiāngnán from before Qiánlóng 10th year were remitted.
Unpaid discount silver for salt households in Liǎnghuái from Qiánlóng 17th to 19th years were remitted.
On the *yǐhài* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, crossed the Jiāng.
On the *guǐwèi* day,
the Emperor visited the Gāoyì Garden of Fàn Zhòngyān, a minister of the Sòng dynasty.
On the *jiǎshēn* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, visited Sūzhōufǔ.
On the *yǐyǒu* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, personally inspected the weaving workshops.
Fùsēn was transferred to Minister of Personnel.
Nàmùzhálè was appointed Minister of Works.
Ālǐgǔn was demoted to Vice Minister.
Zhàohuì was appointed Minister of Revenue and Grand Minister of the Imperial Guard.
Shūhèdé was appointed Minister of War.
Chénggǔnzhābù and Zhàohuì were ordered to suppress the rebelling Èlǔtè people along separate routes.
On the *bǐngxū* day,
the Emperor reviewed troops at the training ground behind Jiāxīngfǔ.
On the *dīnghài* day,
the Emperor reviewed troops at Shíménzhèn.
On the *jǐchǒu* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, visited Hángzhōufǔ.
On the *gēngyín* day,
the Emperor reviewed troops.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
private debts in Qíhé and three other prefectures and counties in Shāndōng were remitted,
as well as the fixed taxes for hail and flood disasters in Fényáng and two other counties in Shānxī, and Qīnghé and twelve other prefectures and counties in Jiāngsū.
In the third month, on the *dīngyǒu* day,
Gálèzàngduōěrjǐ captured Yīlí.
Chénggǔnzhābù was ordered to attack him.
On the *gēngzǐ* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, sojourned at Sūzhōufǔ.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, visited Jiāngníngfǔ.
The current year's fixed taxes for counties directly under the jurisdiction of Jiāngníng and Sūzhōu in Jiāngnán,
and Hángzhōu in Zhèjiāng, were remitted.
On the *gēngxū* day,
the Emperor offered sacrifices at the mausoleum of Míng Tàizǔ.
Huīté Táijí Chēbùdéngduōěrjǐ rebelled.
Hādáhā attacked and captured him.
All able-bodied men were ordered to be executed,
and the women were bestowed upon the Kāěrkā.
On the *xīnhài* day,
Hādáhā was appointed Minister of War.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, crossed the Jiāng.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
former Grand Secretary Shǐ Yízhí was summoned back to the Grand Secretariat to manage affairs.
Huáng Tíngguì continued to serve as Grand Secretary concurrently overseeing the Governor-General of Shǎnxī and Gānsù.
On the *bǐngchén* day,
fixed taxes for hail and flood disasters in Tóngguān and other prefectures, departments, and counties in Shǎnxī from the previous year were remitted.
Liú Tǒngxūn was summoned to the imperial residence.
On the *jǐwèi* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, crossed the river.
In summer, the fourth month, on the *rénxū* day, the first day of the lunar month,
Fāng Guānchéng, the Governor-General of Zhílì, impeached and reported that patrol inspector Zhāng Ruòyíng had unauthorizedly punished a eunuch monk.
The Emperor reprimanded him for lacking good judgment,
but still decreed that eunuchs who caused trouble outside should be subject to punishment by others.
On the *yǐchǒu* day,
fixed taxes on land in Huái'ān and three other prefectures and departments in Jiāngsū were remitted.
Liú Tǒngxūn was ordered to supervise the repair of the stone works at Xúzhōu.
Vice Minister Mènglín was ordered to supervise the repair of river works below Liùtáng.
Vice Grand Director of Rivers Jī Huáng was ordered to supervise the repair of the Zhāoguān rolling dam and branch river.
All were to be handled in consultation with the Governor-General, Governor, and Grand Director of Rivers.
Chénggǔnzhābù, Zhàohuì, Shūhèdé, and others were summoned to the capital.
Yǎěrhāshàn was appointed Counselor Minister,
and given charge of the seal of the Deputy General Dìngbiān of the Right.
Ālǐgǔn was ordered to be stationed at Bālǐkūn to manage affairs.
On the *bǐngyín* day,
the Emperor arrived at Sūnjiājí to inspect dike works.
Tángkēlù captured Chēbùdéngduōěrjǐ.
The people of Pǔěrpǔ's tribe were bestowed upon Wūliánghǎi.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
the Emperor crossed the river,
and arrived at Jīngshānqiáo and Hánzhuāngzhá to inspect river works.
On the *wùchén* day,
fixed taxes for hail and flood disasters in Yánqìng and other prefectures, counties, and guards in Zhílì from the 21st year were remitted.
On the *gēngwǔ* day,
the grain quotas for Líjìng and five other villages belonging to Hǎifēng county in Shāndōng were reduced,
and arrears of taxes from the 11th to 20th years were remitted.
Sōng'ālǐ was appointed General of Suíyuǎnchéng.
Pǔěrpǔ was captured.
On the *xīnwèi* day,
the Emperor went to Quēlǐ to offer sacrifices to the Former Teacher Kǒngzǐ.
The Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, sojourned at Língyán.
Shǐ Yízhí was reinstated as Grand Secretary of Wényuāngé concurrently Minister of Personnel.
On the *yǐhài* day,
Sōng'ālǐ was transferred to General of Liángzhōu.
Bǎodé was appointed General of Suíyuǎnchéng.
On the *wùyín* day,
arrears of taxes for Jìníng and five other prefectures and counties in Shāndōng were remitted.
On the *jǐmǎo* day,
Jiǎng Bǐng was transferred to Governor of Hénán.
Āsīhā was appointed Governor of Húnán.
On the *gēngchén* day,
arrears of taxes for Xiàyì and four other counties in Hénán were remitted.
On the *xīnsì* day,
due to Duàn Chāngxù, a student from Xiàyì, having hidden a fake edict of Wú Sānguì,
Fāng Guānchéng was ordered to go to Hénán and jointly interrogate him strictly with Túlèbǐng'ā.
On the *yǐyǒu* day,
Hé Guózōng was dismissed.
On the *dīnghài* day,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
Qín Huìtián was appointed acting Minister of Rites.
On the *wùzǐ* day,
former Provincial Administration Commissioner Péng Jiāpíng was dismissed and arrested for questioning for having hidden unofficial histories from the late Míng dynasty.
Guī Xuānguāng was appointed Minister of Rites.
On the *gēngyín* day,
there was a fire in Xiàmén, Fújiàn.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
the Emperor went to Lándiànchǎng to welcome the Empress Dowager to reside in Chàngchūnyuán.
On the *yǐsì* day,
Cài Yǐtái and 242 others were granted the title of *Jìnshì* in varying ranks.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
Huòjízàn rebelled.
Deputy Commander Āmíndào died in battle.
In the sixth month, on the *xīnyǒu* day, the first day of the lunar month,
Hú Bǎochuán was appointed Governor of Hénán.
Āsīhā was made acting Governor of Jiāngxī.
On the *rénxū* day,
fixed taxes for Gānsù and Xiàyì and four other counties in Hénán for the next year were remitted.
On the *guǐhài* day,
Àibìdá was appointed Governor-General of Yúnnán and Guìzhōu.
Chén Hóngmóu was transferred to Governor of Jiāngsū.
Míngdé was transferred to Governor of Shǎnxī.
Dìngcháng was transferred to Governor of Shānxī.
On the *jiǎzǐ* day,
relief was provided for the flood disaster in Yānlíng and other prefectures and counties in Hénán.
On the *wùchén* day,
Péng Jiāpíng was sentenced to beheading.
On the *dīngchǒu* day,
the Dálishídáwá tribe was granted two months' rations.
On the *guǐwèi* day,
Kāěrkā Dámálín rebelled.
Sāngzhàiduōěrjǐ was ordered to attack him.
On the *jǐchǒu* day,

relief was provided for the flood disaster in Sùzhōu and sixteen other prefectures, counties, and guards in Ānhuī, and hail and flood disasters in Niǎnbó and thirty-eight other prefectures, counties, and departments in Gānsù.
In autumn, the seventh month, on the day Xīnmǎo (the first day of the month),
relief was provided for flood-stricken prefectures and counties in Shāndōng, such as Guǎntáo.
On the day Rénchén,
Liú Zǎo was appointed Governor of Yúnnán.
On the day Guǐmǎo,
Péng Jiāpíng was granted the command to commit suicide.
Shǐ Yízhí was ordered to continue concurrently serving in the Ministry of Public Works (Gōngbù).
On the day Yǐsì,
relief was provided for flood and hail-stricken prefectures and counties in Ānhuī, such as Sùzhōu, a total of ten.
On the day Bǐngwǔ,
relief was provided for flood-stricken prefectures and counties in Shāndōng, such as Dōngpíng Zhōu, a total of five.
Huò Bāyā'ěr was granted the title of Grand Minister of the Interior (Nèidàchén) and
Bèilè Luóbùzàng Duō'ěrzì was enfeoffed as a Jùnwáng.
On the day Dīngwèi,
Yáng Yìngjū was appointed Governor-General of Mǐnzhè,
Hènián was appointed Governor-General of Liǎngguǎng,
Jiǎng Zhōu was appointed Governor of Shāndōng,
Tǎ Yǒngníng was appointed Governor of Shānxī.
Ābùlài, Khan of the Hāsàkè, sent envoys to present tribute.
On the day Wùshēn,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, toured Mùlán.
On the day Guǐchǒu,
the Ölöd Tàijí Húnqí and others killed Zhánàgá'ěrbù,
and presented his head to surrender.
On the day Wùwǔ,

relief was provided for flood-stricken prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Shāndōng, such as Jìníng, a total of thirty-two, and for flood-stricken prefectures and counties in Fújiàn, such as Lóngyán, a total of two.
In the eighth month, on the day Bǐngyín,
Hāsàkè Huòjí Bó'ěrgēn and others surrendered.
On the day Dīngmǎo,
Sàlāshàn was appointed General of Jílín,
Fùsēn served concurrently in his stead.
On the day Wùchén,
relief was provided for drought-stricken garrisons in Gānsù, such as Liǔgōu, a total of three.
On the day Yǐhài,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, toured Mùlán,
and held a hunting expedition.
Relief was provided for flood-stricken Fényáng in Shānxī.
On the day Xīnsì,
Bāyā'ěr and Dáshìchēlìng were executed.
In the ninth month, on the day Guǐsì,
the various departments of Kèlìè tè and Wūlù tè were pacified.
On the day Jiǎwǔ,
the Emperor was at the traveling palace,
envoys from Hāsàkè Ābùlài and others were granted an audience,
and a banquet was bestowed upon them.
On the day Wùxū,
Fùlèhún was appointed Governor of Húnán.
Húnqí and others rebelled again.
On the day Gēngzǐ,
the two Zǎisàngs of the Ölöd, Shālāsī and Mǎhūsī, rebelled,
Dūtǒng Mǎnfú was ordered to suppress them.
Yǎ'ěrhāsàn was appointed Minister of War (Bīngbù Shàngshū).
On the day Xīnchǒu,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, returned to reside at the Mountain Resort (Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng).
On the day Rènyín,
Nímǎ and others were executed by dismemberment in front of the tomb of the late General Hèqǐ.
On the day Dīngwèi,
Liú Tǒngxūn was ordered to proceed to Shāndōng and Jiāngnán to manage river engineering projects.
On the day Xīnhài,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital (Jīngshī).
In winter, the tenth month, on the day Rénxū,
the Emperor visited the Nányuàn,
and held a hunting expedition.
On the day Guǐhài,
Liúqiú presented tribute.
On the day Yǐchǒu,
Yǎ'ěrhāsàn was appointed acting Dingbian Right Assistant General.
On the day Dīngmǎo,
Chēbùdēngzhábù was summoned to the capital,
Nàmùzhálè was appointed acting Dingbian Left Assistant General.
Āguì proceeded to Kēbùduō,
Mǎnggǔlái was appointed Counselor-Minister for the Northern Route.
On the day Xīnwèi,
Zhàohuì was appointed Dingbian General,
Chēbùdēngzhábù was appointed Dingbian Right Assistant General.
On the day Bǐngxū,
Yǒngguì was appointed Governor of Shǎnxī.
In the eleventh month, on the day Bǐngshēn,
the Khalkha Prince Déqìnděngzhábù was appointed Counselor-Minister for the Northern Route.
On the day Rénzǐ,
Wú Bài was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief (Zuǒ Dū Yùshǐ).
On the day Wùwǔ,
relief was provided for frost and hail and other disasters in Gānsù, such as Gāolán, a total of twenty-two departments, prefectures, and counties.
In the twelfth month, on the day Guǐhài,
Chén Hóngmóu was appointed Governor-General of Liǎngguǎng,
Lǐ Shìyáo served concurrently in his stead,
Tuō'ēnduō was appointed Governor of Jiāngsū,
Ā'ěrtài was appointed Governor of Shāndōng.
On the day Jǐsì,
Grand Secretary Chén Shìguān requested retirement,
which was granted.
On the day Yǐhài,
Chēmùchǔkèzhábù was enfeoffed as a Jùnwáng.
On the day Dīngchǒu,
relief was provided for disaster-stricken Zālǔtè, Ālǔ, and Kē'ěrqìn Banners.
On the day Gēngchén,
Shūhèdé was stripped of his office for missing an opportunity.
On the day Jiǎshēn,
Shǐ Yízhí and Chén Shìguān were granted the title of Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince (Tàizǐ Tàifù),
Èmídá and Liú Tǒngxūn were granted the title of Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince (Tàizǐ Tàibǎo).
In this year,
Cháoxiǎn, Xiānmó, and Liúqiú presented tribute.
In the twenty-third year, spring, the first month, on the day Jǐchǒu,
relief was provided for one month for disaster victims in prefectures in Hénán, such as Wèihuī.
Arrears of taxes from the 16th to the 22nd year of Qiánlóng in Gānsù were remitted.
On the day Gēngyín,
Zhàohuì and Chēbùdēngzhábù were ordered to suppress Shālābólè,
Yǎ'ěrhāsàn and Èmínhézhuō were ordered to conquer Huíbù.
On the day Xīnmǎo,

relief was provided to various degrees for disaster victims in Jiāngsū, such as Qīnghé, a total of eighteen prefectures and counties, and in Ānhuī, such as Sùzhōu, a total of ten prefectures and counties.
On the day Guǐyǒu,
relief was provided for disaster victims in Zhílì, such as Dàmíng, and other prefectures and counties.
On the day Bǐngwǔ,
because Russia presented the corpse of Āmù'ěrsànà for verification and the Hāsàkè declared themselves vassals and offered tribute,
this was announced to both domestic and foreign audiences.
On the day Jǐyǒu,
Wāng Yóudūn, Minister of Personnel (Lìbù Shàngshū), died,
the Emperor personally offered sacrifices.
On the day Rénzǐ,
Liú Tǒngxūn was appointed Minister of Personnel (Lìbù Shàngshū),
Qín Huìtián was transferred to be Minister of Justice (Xíngbù Shàngshū),
Jī Huáng was appointed Minister of Public Works (Gōngbù Shàngshū),
Zhōng Yīn was transferred to be Governor of Guǎngdōng,
Zhōu Wǎn was appointed Governor of Fújiàn,
Zhōu Rénjì was appointed acting Governor of Guìzhōu.
On the day Guǐchǒu,
Yǎ'ěrhāsàn was appointed Jingni General,
Èmínhézhuō and Háníng'ā were appointed Counselor-Ministers,
Shùndéné, Àilóng'ā, and Yùsùbù were appointed Leader-Ministers,
to conquer Huíbù.
Yǒngguì and Dìngcháng were ordered to manage military agricultural settlements as Imperial Commissioners.
In the second month, on the day Gēngshēn,
Cháoxiǎn presented tribute.
On the day Guǐhài,
relief was provided for drought-stricken prefectures and counties in Shǎnxī, such as Jiāzhōu, a total of eight.
On the day Yǐchǒu,
relief was provided for disaster victims in Dézhōu and other thirty-seven prefectures, counties, and garrisons.
In the third month, on the day Gēngyín,
the Emperor visited the Western Mausoleums (Xīlíng).
On the day Guǐsì,
the Emperor visited Zhāoxīlíng, Xiàolíng, Xiàodōnglíng, and Jǐnglíng.
On the day Gēngzǐ,
the Emperor visited Tàilíng.
On the day Xīnchǒu,
Zhàohuì and others advanced their troops to Shālābólè,
captured Zhāhāqìn Hālābài,
and completely annihilated his forces.
Shèlèng fled,
Héshuòqí and Tángkālù were ordered to pursue and capture him.
On the day Rènyín,
excess taxes were remitted to various degrees in Jiāngsū, such as Shānyáng, a total of twenty-five prefectures, counties, and garrisons.
On the day Yǐsì,
an imperial examination was held for officials of the Hanlin Academy and the Grand Secretariat,
Wáng Míngshèng and three others were promoted to the first rank,
the rest were promoted or demoted to various degrees.
An examination was held for officials transferred from ministries and courts to the Hanlin Academy,
Dé'ěrtài was promoted to the first rank,
the rest were promoted or demoted to various degrees.
On the day Dīngwèi,
Wú Shìgōng was appointed Governor of Fújiàn,
Zhōng Yīn was appointed Governor of Shǎnxī,
Tuō'ēnduō was appointed Governor of Guǎngdōng,
Zhuāng Yǒugōng was appointed acting Governor of Jiāngsū,
Féng Qián was appointed Governor of Húběi.
In summer, the fourth month, on the day Rénxū,
arrears of taxes from the 3rd to the 10th year of Qiánlóng in Gānsù, such as Lánzhōu, a total of six prefectures and counties, were remitted.
On the day Wùchén,
Èfù Sèbùténgbālèzhú'ěr was re-enfeoffed as a Qīnwáng.
Arrears of taxes from the 10th to the 20th year of Qiánlóng in Zhílì, such as Bàzhōu, a total of thirty-three prefectures, counties, and departments, were remitted.
On the day Gēngwǔ,
the retired Grand Secretary Chén Shìguān died.
On the day Rénshēn,
Lǐ Yuánliàng was ordered to concurrently serve as acting Minister of Revenue (Hùbù Shàngshū).
Excess taxes for flood disasters of the previous year in Zhílì, such as Wèi Xiàn, and twenty-nine other prefectures, counties, and departments, were remitted.
On the day Bǐngzǐ,
Chén Hóngmóu was ordered to return to Jiāngsū,
and to manage gubernatorial affairs with the title of Governor-General.
Féng Qián was appointed Governor of Húnán,
Zhuāng Yǒugōng was appointed acting Governor of Húběi,
Lǐ Shìyáo was appointed acting Governor-General of Liǎngguǎng.
On the day Gēngchén,
the Emperor went to Hēilóngtán to pray for rain.
On the day Rénwǔ,
due to the drought, the Ministry of Justice (Xíngbù) was ordered to clear minor cases,
and reduce sentences below penal servitude,
Zhílì followed suit.
In the fifth month, on the day Wùzǐ,
the entire province of Gānsù was exempted from excess taxes for twenty-four years.
On the day Guǐchǒu,
relief was provided for drought disasters in Shǎnxī, such as Yán'ān, a total of three prefectures and counties.
In the sixth month, on the day Xīnwèi,
arrears of taxes in Shǎnxī, such as Yúlín, a total of eight prefectures and counties, were remitted.
On the day Guǐwèi,
excess taxes of the previous year in Shǎnxī, such as Jìngbiān, a total of eight prefectures and counties, were remitted.
In Zhílì, such as Yuánchéng, and other prefectures and counties, there were locusts.
In the autumn, seventh month, on the day dìnghài,
remitted the annual tribute tax for twenty-two years of wind disaster in Gānsù, Ānxī, and other three prefectures and garrisons.
On the day jǐchǒu,
the Hé burst its banks at Máochéngpù.
On the day gēngyín,
Huòjízàn reinforced Kùchē,
and Yǎěrhāshàn and others defeated him.
Remitted the annual tribute tax for drought disaster in Táiwān County, Fújiàn.
On the day bǐngshēn,
Huáng Tíngguì was promoted to Shàobǎo,
Yáng Yìngjū and Kāitàizhǐ to Tàizǐ Tàibǎo,
Yáng Xíyù to Tàizǐ Shàoshī,
Chén Hóngmóu, Gāo Jìn, and Hú Bǎozhuán to Tàizǐ Shàofù,
and Bái Zhōngshān, Àibìdá, and Wú Dáshàn to Tàizǐ Shàobǎo.
On the day wùxū,
relief was provided for flood and hail disasters in Jìnglè and other prefectures and counties in Shānxī.
On the day gēngzǐ,
the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager on the autumn hunt at Mùlán.
On the day rényín,
Shèlèng fled to Russia.
Āguì was recalled.
On the day guǐmǎo,
Mǎmùtèhūlíbǐmǐlóng of the Right Wing Bùlǔtè sent his younger brother Shěěrbókè to pay respects.
An edict was issued to capture and present Hāsàkè Xīlà.
On the day yǐsì,
Nàmùzhálè was appointed Jìngnì Jiāngjūn,
and Sāntài as Cāncàn Dàchén.
An edict was issued for Zhàohuì to proceed to Kùchē.
On the day bǐngwǔ,
the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to reside at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the day wùshēn,
Chēbùdēngzhábù was granted the rank of Qīnwáng.
On the day rénzǐ,
relief was provided for drought and hail disasters in Yán'ān and seventeen other prefectures and counties in Shǎnxī.
Eighth month, on the day bǐngyín,
it rained.
On the day jǐsì,
the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager on a hunting expedition to Mùlán.
On the day jiǎxū,
Dōulài was appointed Bīngbù Shàngshū.
On the day dīngchǒu,
relief was provided for drought disasters in Gāolán and twenty-four other prefectures, counties, and halls in Gānsù.
On the day rénwǔ,
Mǎngdálà, King of the Miǎndiàn Kingdom, was killed by the savage Déléngyě,
and Wèngjíyá, the indigenous official of Mùshūpù, proclaimed himself king.
Ninth month, on the day jǐchǒu,
a banquet was bestowed upon the Bùlǔtè envoy Shěěrbókè.
Tídū Mǎ Déshèng was executed
for missing the opportunity to attack Kùchē.
On the day gēngyín,
Túlíbài of the Right Hāsàkè Department and Túěrzhàn of the Táshígān Huírén, among others, surrendered.
On the day bǐngshēn,
the Empress Dowager resided at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the day wùxū,
Guī Xuānguāng was transferred to Zǒudu Yùshǐ,
Jī Huáng was appointed Lǐbù Shàngshū,
and Liáng Shīzhèng was ordered to temporarily serve as Gōngbù Shàngshū.
The minister stationed in Yīlí was ordered to concurrently manage the affairs of the Huíbù.
On the day jǐhài,
relief was provided for flood disasters in Rénhé and other counties in Zhèjiāng.
On the day jiǎchén,
the Hālāhālěibākè Huíbù surrendered.
On the day gēngxū,
Bókè Huòjísī and others from Hétián City surrendered.
On the day rénzǐ,
Wūshí City surrendered.
Winter, tenth month, on the day guǐhài,
relief was provided for flood disasters in Qiántáng and sixteen other counties and areas in Zhèjiāng,
and for frost disaster in the Shuòpíng Prefecture of Shānxī.
On the day dīngmǎo,
relief was provided for flood, hail, and frost disasters in Dàchéng and nine other counties in Zhílì.
Zhàohuì advanced his troops from Bāěrcǐkè to Yèěrqiāng.
On the day jiǎxū,
Wú Bài retired due to illness,
and Démǐn was appointed Zǒudu Yùshǐ.
Relief was provided for flood disasters in Cāngzhōu and six other prefectures, counties, and areas in Zhílì.
Eleventh month, on the first day jiǎshēn,
the Right Hāsàkè Department sent envoys to pay tribute,
and a banquet was bestowed upon them.
On the day yǐyǒu,
the Emperor returned.
On the day bǐngxū,
the Emperor went on a hunting expedition to Nányuàn.
On the day wùzǐ,
the Emperor held a grand review.
On the day jǐchǒu,
Ālígǔn was appointed Cāncàn Dàchén,
and dispatched to Zhàohuì's military camp.
On the day xīnmǎo,
relief was provided for flood, drought, and tidal disasters in Hǎizhōu and five other prefectures and counties in Jiāngsū.
On the day dīngyǒu,
Zhàohuì arrived outside Yèěrqiāng City,
and was trapped in the rebels' encirclement.
Fùdé was appointed Dìngbiān Yòufù Jiāngjūn,
Ālígǔn, Àilóng'ā, Fúlù, and Shūhèdé were appointed Cāncàn Dàchén,
to go to Yèěrqiāng to support him.
On the day jǐhài,
due to simultaneous solar and lunar eclipses on the first and fifteenth day of the twelfth month,
an edict was issued for self-reflection and cultivation.
On the day xīnchǒu,
Bókè Ālìmùshā of Kèlǐyǎ surrendered.
On the day jiǎchén,
due to Zhàohuì's deep penetration and fierce battle,
he was enfeoffed as Yīděng Wǔyì Móuyóugōng,
Émǐnhézhuó was promoted to Jùnwáng rank,
and Huòjísī to Bèizǐ with Bèilè rank.
On the day dīngwèi,
Nàmùzhálè, Sāntài, and Kuímǎdài, while going to support Zhàohuì,
encountered rebels on the way,
and died.
Nàmùzhálè was posthumously granted the title of Gōngjué, Sāntài the title of Zǐjué, and Kuímǎdài a hereditary position.
Shūhèdé was appointed Gōngbù Shàngshū.
On the day gēngxū,
Fùdé went to Yèěrqiāng.
Twelfth month, on the first day guǐchǒu,
there was a solar eclipse.
Zǒufù Dūyùshǐ Sūn Hào submitted a memorial requesting the cessation of imperial tours next year.
The Emperor reprimanded him for his confused and erroneous views,
reassigned him to a third-rank Jingting position,
and issued an edict
"to emulate the Imperial Ancestors in military training and diligent labor"
to both the capital and the provinces.
Relief was provided for wind disasters in Táiwān and four other counties in Fújiàn.
Additional relief was provided for flood disasters in Rénhé and seven other counties in Zhèjiāng.
On the day rénxū,
Qiú Yuēxiū was dismissed from serving in the Jūnjīchù.
On the day dīngmǎo,
the annual tribute tax for flood-damaged fields in Zhāngyì and four other prefectures and counties in Gānsù was remitted.
On the day wùchén,
Qíbākèyǎlāmùpílé, Jasag Junwang of Khalkha, was promoted to Qīnwáng.
On the day rényín,
the annual tribute tax for this year's flood disaster in Qiántáng and seven other counties in Zhèjiāng was remitted.
Twenty-fourth year, spring, first month, on the day jiǎshēn,
the annual tribute tax for the entire province of Gānsù for next year and all accumulated arrears from previous years were remitted.
On the day guǐsì,
Yǎěrhāshàn was executed by beheading.
On the day jǐhài,
Grand Secretary Bó Huáng Tíngguì passed away.
Wú Dáshàn was appointed Shǎnxī-Gānsù Zǒngdū,
Míngdé was appointed Gānsù Xúnfǔ,
temporarily overseeing the Zǒngdū.
Lǐ Shìyáo was appointed Liǎngguǎng Zǒngdū.
On the day guǐmǎo,
Jiǎng Pǔ was appointed Dàxuéshì,
still managing Hùbù Shàngshū,
Liáng Shīzhèng was appointed Bīngbù Shàngshū,
Guī Xuānguāng was appointed Gōngbù Shàngshū,
Chén Déhuá was appointed Zǒudu Yùshǐ,
Lǐ Yuánliàng concurrently managed the Mǎnshàngshū of the Bīngbù,
and Sū Chāng temporarily served as the Mǎn Gōngbù Shàngshū.
Second month, on the day rényīn,
Hānníng'ā was condemned to beheading.
On the day guǐhài,
relief was provided for drought disasters in Chēdōubù and three other banners.
On the day jiǎzǐ,
Fùdé and Ālígǔn battled Huòjízàn at Hūěrmán,
and thoroughly defeated him.
Fùdé was enfeoffed as Sānděng Bó,
and Shūhèdé, Ālígǔn, Dòubīn, and others were granted hereditary positions.
Shūhèdé was ordered to return to Ākèsū to handle affairs.
On the day jǐsì,
Fùdé's troops arrived at Yèěrqiāng,
and joined Zhàohuì's forces in attack.
Fùdé was promoted to Yīděng Bó.
Chēbùdēngzhábù was appointed Fù Jiāngjūn,
and Fúlù and Chēmùchǔkèzhábù as Cāncàn Dàchén.
Èsīmàn and others captured Kèlǐyǎ.
Bālù was ordered to reinforce Hétián.
On the day gēngchén,
Zhàohuì and Fùdé returned to Ākèsū,
and were severely reprimanded.
Third month, on the day guǐwèi,
Shūhèdé and Huòjísī were ordered to be stationed in Hétián,
to intercept the rebels' escape routes.
On the day jǐchǒu,
Wūlèdēng, a first-class Imperial Guard, and Qínǔhún, a Deputy Commander, were appointed Běilù Cāncàn Dàchén.
On the day rénchén,
Yáng Yìngjū was recalled to the capital,
and Yáng Tíngzhāng was ordered to temporarily serve as Mǐn-Zhè Zǒngdū.
On the day jiǎwǔ,
a comet was seen.
On the day jǐhài,
Míngruì was promoted to Chéng'ēn Yìyóugōng.
Locusts appeared in Huái'ān and three other prefectures and departments in Jiāngsū.
In the summer, fourth month, on the day Xīnhài,
Fùdé and others reinforced Hétián.
On the day Guǐchǒu,
Āguì was appointed Assistant Grand Minister of the Army Camp under Fùdé.
On the day Dīngsì,
a grand imperial sacrifice for rain was held.
Heaven was sacrificed to at the Huánqiú.
The Emperor, hoping for rain for the farmlands,
ordered the imperial procession to stop,
