Yǐn Jìshàn was summoned to the Grand Council to manage affairs.
Gāo Jìn was appointed Governor-General of Liǎngjiāng.
Lǐ Hóng was transferred to be Governor-General of Riverways in Jiāngnán,
and Lǐ Qīngshí was appointed Governor-General of Riverways in Hédōng.
On the day Rén'yín,
Sùchéng's crime of corruption and debauchery leading to rebellion was posthumously investigated,
his property confiscated,
and his son exiled to Yīlí.
Nàshìtōng and Kǎtǎhǎi, for concealing the defeat,
had their property confiscated and were punished.
Yǒngguì was ordered to proceed to Kèshígáěr to manage affairs.
Tuō'ēnduō was appointed acting Minister of Rites.
On the day Guǐmǎo,
the Emperor crossed the Yellow River.
In the summer, fourth month, on the first day Bǐngwǔ,
relief was granted for the previous year's hail, flood, drought, and frost disasters in thirty-six prefectures, sub-prefectures, and counties including Hézhōu in Gānsù.
On the day Gēngxū,
regular taxes for the previous year's flood disaster were remitted for twelve prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Hànyáng in Húběi.
On the day Xīnhài,
the posthumous title Wénjiǎn was granted to the late Minister of Justice, Wáng Shìzhēn.
On the day Dīngsì,
the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, stayed in Dézhōu.
On the day Gēngshēn,
the Huái-Xú river circuit in Jiāngsū was abolished.
On the day Bǐngyín,
the Emperor returned to Jīngshī.
On the day Gēngwǔ,
the Emperor welcomed the Empress Dowager to reside in Chàngchūnyuán.
On the day Xīnwèi,
the Khāsàk envoys Ètuōěrjì and others had an audience.
In the fifth month, on the day Yǐhài,
Khalkha Junwang Luòbùzàng Duōěrzì was promoted to Qīnwáng.
On the day Yǐyǒu,
the Emperor visited the funeral place of Guǒ Jùnwáng Hóngzhòu,
and the tomb of Jiǎnqín Qīnwáng Qítōng'ā, offering libations.
Hétián Grand Minister managing affairs, Héchéng, for extorting the Huí people,
was dismissed from office and arrested for questioning.
Yǐlètú was ordered to proceed to Tǎěrbāhātái to manage affairs.
On the day Xīnmǎo,
there was an earthquake in Jīngshī.
On the day Dīngyǒu,
regular taxes for the previous year's flood disaster were remitted for nineteen prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Huáiníng in Ānhuī.
On the day Jiǎchén,
Nàshìtōng and Kǎtǎhǎi, for delaying military affairs,
were executed.
In the sixth month, on the day Jǐyǒu,
Yáng Tíngzhāng was appointed acting Governor-General of Liǎngguǎng,
Míngshān temporarily acting,
and Dǒng Bāngdá acting Minister of Public Works.
On the day Yǐmǎo,
Imperial Consort Lìng, of the Wèi clan, was promoted to Imperial Noble Consort.
On the day Jǐsì,
Míngruì was instructed not to accept the surrender of the Wūshí rebel Huí.
In the autumn, seventh month, on the day Xīnsì,
the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, hunted in Mùlán.
On the day Wùzǐ,
Guānbǎo was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
On the day Yǐwèi,
the former Hétián Grand Minister managing affairs, Héchéng, was confirmed to be corrupt upon interrogation,
and was executed.
On the day Dīngyǒu,
Khalkha Qīnwáng Sāngzhāi Duōěrzì was stripped of his title.
In the eighth month, on the first day Jiǎchén,
the sentences of those whose capital punishment was suspended three or more times in the court and autumn reviews were reduced.
On the day Jǐwèi,
the Emperor visited Mùlán for a hunting expedition.
On the day Gēngshēn,
relief was granted for drought in eleven prefectures and counties including Jìngyuǎn in Gānsù.
On the day Jiǎzǐ,
there was an earthquake in prefectures and counties including Níngyuǎn in Gānsù;
relief and aid were ordered,
along with the remission of the current year's regular tax.
In the ninth month, on the day Bǐngzǐ,
relief was granted for flood in twenty-one prefectures and counties including Zhāngqiū in Shāndōng.
On the day Wùyín,
Yǐn Jìshàn was ordered to oversee the Ministry of War,
and Liú Tǒngxūn to oversee the Ministry of Justice.
The rebel Huí of Wūshí surrendered the city.
On the day Yǐyǒu,
Gāo Héng was appointed Grand Minister of the Imperial Household Department.
On the day Xīnmǎo,
Míngruì and others, for failing to completely exterminate the rebels of Wūshí,
sending them to Yīlí,
were referred to the ministry for severe deliberation.
On the day Xīnchǒu,
Lǐ Shìyáo was appointed acting Minister of Public Works.
In the winter, tenth month, on the day Jǐyǒu,
Míngruì and Āguì, for errors in managing the Wūshí affairs,
were stripped of their ranks but retained in their posts.
Relief was granted for flood in three salt fields including Cāngzhōu under Chánglú.
On the day Jǐsì,
Yáng Yìngjū had an audience with the Emperor.
Hé Qízhōng was appointed acting Governor-General of Shǎnxī and Gānsù,
and Tāng Pìn acting Governor of Shǎnxī.
In the eleventh month, on the day Guǐyǒu,
regular taxes for the current year's drought disaster were remitted for six prefectures and counties including Hǎizhōu in Jiāngsū.
On the day Yǐyǒu,
due to the old age of Minister of Personnel Fù Sēn,
he was granted the title of Grand Minister,
and Tuō'ēnduō was transferred to replace him.
Tuō Yōng was appointed Minister of War.
Féng Qián was transferred to be Governor of Ānhuī.
On the day Gēngyín,
Chǒudá, for colluding with Sāngzhāi Duōěrzì in private trade with Russia,
was executed.
Míngruì and others reported that they had completely exterminated the Huí rebels who had joined the Wūshí rebellion.
On the day Xīnmǎo,
relief was granted for flood in eighteen prefectures and counties including Zhāngqiū in Shāndōng,
and for hail and frost disasters in twelve prefectures and counties including Dídao in Gānsù.
On the day Jiǎwǔ,
Āguì was appointed Assistant Grand Minister of Tǎěrbāhātái,
replacing Āntài, who returned to the capital.
On the day Dīngwèi,
Āguì was relieved of his post as Minister of Public Works,
and Yùnzhù replaced him.
Sōngchūn was appointed General of Suíyuǎnchéng.
On the day Wùshēn,
relief was granted for drought in eleven prefectures and counties including Jìngyuǎn in Gānsù,
and regular taxes were remitted.
On the day Yǐmǎo,
relief was granted for flood in fifteen prefectures and counties including Qíhé in Shāndōng.
On the day Dīngmǎo,
Tuō'ēnduō was ordered to also act as Minister of War.
On the day Rénchén,
the fifth imperial son, Yǒngqí, was ennobled as Róng Qīnwáng.
In the twelfth month, on the day Wùwǔ,
Zhāng Lín, a gòngshēng from Jìngyáng County in Shǎnxī, for his family's seven generations living together,
was bestowed with imperial poems and silk.
Basic Annals, Volume 13, Basic Annals of Gāozōng, Volume 4
In the thirty-first year, spring, the first month, on the *rénshēn* day, the first day of the month,
an edict was issued stating that since the emperor had ruled for thirty years,
the land of Huáxià was peaceful,
and the whole world had opened up.
Starting from this year,
all provinces were to be universally exempted from grain tribute once.
On the *jiǎxū* day,
arrears of taxes from Jingyuǎn and fourteen other prefectures, departments, and counties in Gānsù, and from the three prefectures and departments of Yán'ān and others in Shǎnxī, were remitted.
On the *bǐngxū* day,
the official army of Yúnnán, while suppressing the Mǎng rebels in Měngzhù,
suffered a defeat.
Yáng Yìngjū was transferred to be the Governor-General of Yún-Guì,
Wú Dáshàn was transferred to be the Governor-General of Shǎn-Gān,
and Hé Qízhōng was dispatched to protect them.
Liú Zǎo was transferred to be the Governor-General of Hú-Guǎng,
and Tāng Pìn was appointed Acting Shǎnxī Provincial Governor.
On the *guǐsì* day,
Zhuāng Yǒugōng, Minister of Justice, was impeached for fabricating a case concerning Duàn Chénggōng's trial,
was stripped of his position and imprisoned,
and his property confiscated.
Lǐ Shìyáo was transferred to be Minister of Justice,
Zhāng Tàikāi was appointed Minister of Rites,
and Fàn Shíshòu was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.
In the second month, on the *rénwǔ* day,
Liú Zǎo was demoted to Húběi Provincial Governor,
and was still to be severely deliberated upon by the Board with Dá Qǐ, the Yúnnán Commander-in-Chief.
Dìngcháng was appointed Governor-General of Hú-Guǎng,
Lǐ Yīnpéi was transferred to be Fújiàn Provincial Governor,
Cháng Jūn was appointed Húnán Provincial Governor,
and Tāng Pìn was appointed Yúnnán Provincial Governor.
On the *gēngxū* day,
the Emperor visited the Eastern Mausoleum.
On the *xīnhài* day,
Hé Qízhōng was stripped of his position and interrogated for compensating Duàn Chénggōng's deficit.
Shū Hèdé was appointed Acting Governor-General of Shǎn-Gān.
Four officials were ordered to go to Shǎnxī to meet Zhāng Bǎo and jointly handle the case of Duàn Chénggōng's deficit.
Míngshān was transferred to be Shǎnxī Provincial Governor,
and Wú Shàoshī was appointed Jiāngxī Provincial Governor.
On the *gēngshēn* day,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
On the *xīnyǒu* day,
Zhuāng Yǒugōng was sentenced to execution.
On the *rénxū* day,
the Emperor visited the Tàilíng Mausoleum.
On the *guǐhài* day,
Liú Zǎo was stripped of his position,
and remained in Yúnnán to serve.
On the *jiǎzǐ* day,
Èníng was appointed Húběi Provincial Governor.
On the *wùchén* day,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
In the third month, on the *dīnghài* day,
Liú Zǎo committed suicide out of fear of punishment.
On the *jǐchǒu* day,
Yáng Yìngjū reported that the native chieftains of Měnglóng and other areas had pledged allegiance again.
In summer, the fourth month, on the *xīnchǒu* day,
Yáng Yìngjū reported that the headman of Dàměngyǎng had pledged allegiance,
and the official army advanced to capture Zhěngqiàn and Měnggèn.
On the *rènyín* day,
an edict was issued to the whole country, announcing the pacification of the Mǎng rebels in Zhěngqiàn.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
Hé Qízhōng was sentenced to execution,
and Duàn Chénggōng was executed.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
the current year's fixed taxes for Pǔténg and thirteen other native chieftains in Yúnnán, as well as the arrears of taxes from Měnglóng, were remitted.
On the *jiǎzǐ* day,
Zhāng Shūxūn and 213 others were granted the *jìnshì* degree with various distinctions.
In the fifth month, on the *jiǎxū* day,
the Emperor went to Hēilóngtán to pray for rain.
On the *wùyín* day,
the Zhèngyī Zhēnrén was ordered to hold the rank of a third-grade official.
On the *bǐngxū* day,
the Emperor went to Hēilóngtán to pray for rain.
In the sixth month, on the *bǐngwǔ* day,
Yáng Yìngjū reported that Zhào Zhāi, headman of Měngyǒng, and Bā Hùměng, headman of Měnglóngshā, and others had pledged allegiance.
On the *wùshēn* day,
the late Westerner Láng Shìníng, who held the third-grade title, was granted the title of Attendant-in-Waiting.
In autumn, the seventh month, on the *bǐngzǐ* day,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager on an autumn hunt in Mùlán.
On the *jǐmǎo* day,
because Ālǐgǔn and Yú Mǐnzhōng were accompanying the emperor,
Shū Hèdé was ordered to concurrently act as Minister of Revenue.
On the *rénwǔ* day,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to reside at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On this day,
the Empress passed away.
On the *guǐwèi* day,
an edict stated that since the Empress had accompanied the emperor on his tour of Jiāng-Zhè the previous year,
and had not fully performed her filial duties,
her funeral rites would follow the precedent of an Imperial Noble Consort.
On the *guǐsì* day,
Censor Lǐ Yùmíng reported that the Empress's funeral rites did not follow the proper precedent,
which displeased the Emperor,
and he was exiled to Yīlí.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
Yáng Yìngjū reported that Gádìyáwēng, headman of Hādà, and Lǎzháxìlì, headman of Měngsā, had pledged allegiance.
In the eighth month, on the *jǐhài* day,
relief was provided for flood victims in Xiāngyīn and thirteen other counties and guards in Húnán.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
the Emperor went to Mùlán for a hunting expedition.
Zhuāng Yǒugōng's crime was pardoned,
and he was reinstated as Fújiàn Provincial Governor.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
Yīlí suffered from a locust plague.
On the *yǐmǎo* day,
the Hánjiātáng River in Tóngshān County, Jiāngsū, breached its banks.
On the *guǐhài* day,
the Deputy Lieutenant-General of Cháhā'ěr was abolished,
and one officer was retained to be stationed in Zhāngjiākǒu.
In the ninth month, on the *rénshēn* day,
the fixed taxes for Jingyuǎn and nine other counties in Gānsù,
and for the two counties of Hóngshuǐ and Dōnglè, which suffered from drought, were remitted.
On the *jǐmǎo* day,
relief was provided for flood victims in Lìchéng and fifty-five other counties, and Dōngchāng and five other guards and stations in Shāndōng,
and both old and new fixed taxes were remitted.
On the *yǐwèi* day,
Yáng Yìngjū went to Yǒngchāng to receive the surrender of Mùbāng.
In winter, the tenth month, on the *jǐhài* day,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the capital.
On the *wùshēn* day,
Yáng Yìngjū reported that the headmen of the Zhěngmài, Jǐngxian, and Jǐnghǎi tribes had pledged allegiance.
On the *xīnhài* day,
the breach in Hánjiātáng was closed.
Péng Qǐfēng, Minister of War, was demoted and appointed Attendant-in-Waiting.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
Lù Zōngkǎi was appointed Minister of War.
On the *rénxū* day,
the Yǐnán Circuit in Yúnnán was newly established.
In the eleventh month, on the *yǐhài* day,
Yáng Yìngjū reported that
the headmen of the Dàshān, Měngyù, and Měngdá tribes of Myàndiàn had pledged allegiance.
On the *wùyín* day,
due to Yáng Yìngjū's illness,
Yáng Tíngzhāng was ordered to go to Yǒngchāng to take over the handling of the Myàndiàn bandits.
On the *guǐsì* day,
Fúlíng'ān, an imperial guard, was ordered to take an imperial physician to examine Yáng Yìngjū's illness.
In the twelfth month, on the *yǐsì* day,
Èníng was transferred to be Húnán Provincial Governor,
and Èbǎo was appointed Húběi Provincial Governor.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
Bālù was appointed General of Suīyuǎnchéng.
In this year,
Cháoxiǎn and Liúqiú paid tribute.
In the thirty-second year, spring, the first month, on the *yǐhài* day,
the official army of Yúnnán, while suppressing the Myàndiàn bandits in Xīnjiē,
suffered a defeat,
and Yáng Tíngzhāng was ordered to return to Guǎngdōng.
In the second month, on the *yǐwèi* day,
due to Yáng Yìngjū's illness,
his son, Yáng Chóngyīng, the Jiāngsū Provincial Judicial Commissioner, was ordered to go to Yǒngchāng to assist in military affairs.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
the official army of Yúnnán battled the Myàndiàn bandits at Dǐmájīang,
suffered a defeat,
and Commander-in-Chief Lǐ Shíshēng was arrested and imprisoned.
On the *wùshēn* day,
Èníng was transferred to be Yúnnán Provincial Governor.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
Zhūang Qīnwáng Yǔnlù passed away.
On the *bǐngchén* day,
the Emperor personally offered sacrifices.
On the *jǐwèi* day,
the Emperor toured Tiānjīn.
On the *guǐhài* day,
relief was provided for disaster victims in Chéngdé and five other prefectures and counties in Fèngtiān, and in Xīngjīng and Fènghuángchéng.
In the third month, on the *yǐchǒu* day, the first day of the month,
the Emperor inspected the Zǐyáhén embankment.
Yáng Yìngjū was summoned to the Grand Council to handle affairs,
and Míngruì was appointed Governor-General of Yún-Guì.
On the *bǐngyín* day,
Tuōyōng was transferred to be Minister of Works,
and Míngruì was appointed Minister of War.
On the *jǐsì* day,
arrears of taxes for the entire Zhílì province were remitted.
On the *gēngwǔ* day,
the Emperor reviewed the Manchu garrison troops in Tiānjīn.
Āguì was appointed General of Yīlí.
On the *rénshēn* day,
the Emperor reviewed the Green Standard Army.
On the *gēngchén* day,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
On the *xīnsì* day,
Grand Secretary Yáng Yìngjū was stripped of his position.
On the *rénwǔ* day,
because the Myàndiàn bandits had invaded Zhǎndá and Lóngchuān,
Yáng Yìngjū's crimes of dereliction and mismanagement were publicly announced.
On the *guǐwèi* day,
Èníng was ordered to go to Pǔ'ěr to handle military affairs.
On the *gēngyín* day,
Lǐ Shìyáo was appointed Governor-General of Liǎngguǎng,
and Yáng Tíngzhāng was summoned to be Minister of Justice.
On the *guǐsì* day,
Èníng was appointed Acting Governor-General of Yún-Guì.
In the summer, fourth month, on the day Jǐyǒu,
the Emperor went to Hēilóngtán to pray for rain.
On the day Gēngxū,
due to the prevalence of miasma in the border regions of Yúnnán,
it was ordered to temporarily halt the advance of troops.
On the day Gēngshēn,
Zhāng Tàikāi was ordered to manage the affairs of the Zuo Dū Yùshǐ while holding the position of Lǐbù Shàngshū,
and Jī Huáng was appointed acting Lǐbù Shàngshū.
In the fifth month, on the day Jǐsì,
È Bǎo was made Guìzhōu Xúnfǔ,
and Dìng Cháng was concurrently appointed acting Húběi Xúnfǔ.
On the day Gēngwǔ,
Fàn Shíshòu was made Húběi Xúnfǔ.
Zhāng Tàikāi was transferred to Zuo Dū Yùshǐ,
and Jī Huáng became Lǐbù Shàngshū.
On the day Rénshēn,
Chén Hóngmóu was ordered to manage the Gōngbù.
On the day Bǐngzǐ,
the imperial forces in Yúnnán suffered a defeat at Mùbāng,
and Yáng Níng and others retreated to Lónglíng.
On the day Gēngyín,
Lǐ Shíshēng and Zhū Lún were executed by decapitation.
In the sixth month, on the day Xīnyǒu,
Ér Jǐng'é was made Cānzàn Dàchén,
and dispatched to Yúnnán.
In the autumn, seventh month,
Zhuāng Yǒugōng, the Fújiàn Xúnfǔ, passed away.
Cuī Yīngjiē was transferred to replace him.
Lǐ Qīngshí was made Shāndōng Xúnfǔ,
and Qiú Yuēxiū became Lǐbù Shàngshū.
On the day Rénwǔ,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, went on the autumn hunt at Mùlán.
On the day Wùzǐ,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, stayed at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the day Jǐchǒu,
Shè Túkěn, the Shèngjīng Jiāngjūn, was dismissed,
and Xīnzhù replaced him.
In the intercalary seventh month, on the day Jiǎyín,
Yáng Yīngjū was granted self-execution.
On the day Bǐngchén,
Mǐan bandits crossed the Xiǎo Měnglún Jiāng and invaded Yúnnán Cítōng.
In the eighth month, on the day Guǐyǒu,
Qiú Yuēxiū was transferred to Gōngbù Shàngshū,
and Dǒng Bāngdá became Lǐbù Shàngshū.
On the day Dīngchǒu,
the Emperor visited Mùlán.
On the day Yǐyǒu,
Zhōng Yīn was made Guǎngdōng Xúnfǔ.
On the day Yǐchǒu,
Míng Ruì was instructed to have É Lèdēng'é replace Tán Wǔgé in advancing troops along different routes.
In the ninth month, on the day Gēngzǐ,
disaster relief was provided for flood victims in Húběi's Jiāngxià and twenty-seven other counties, and Wǔchāng and seven other garrisons.
On the day Jiǎyín,
Tuō'ēnduō was appointed acting Bīngbù Shàngshū.
In the winter, tenth month, on the day Rénxū,
Lǐ Yīnpéi was granted self-execution.
On the day Jǐmǎo,
Míng Ruì was instructed to manage the governor-general's affairs as a general.
In the eleventh month, on the day Rén'yín,
disaster relief was provided for hail-stricken commoners in Gānsù's Píngliáng and thirty-four other prefectures, departments, and counties.
On the day Rénzǐ,
È Bǎo was transferred to Húběi Xúnfǔ.
On the day Dīngsì,
Míng Ruì was secretly instructed
that since Āwǎ could not be taken quickly,
he should retreat to Mùbāng.
In the twelfth month, on the day Jiǎxū,
Yáng Níng was stripped of his office and banished to Yīlí.
On the day Wùyín,
Míng Ruì reported crossing the Dàdié Jiāng and advancing to Xībó,
and the local chieftains Luówàiyào Tè and others from Bōlóng and other places submitted.
In the spring of the thirty-third year, first month, on the day Xīnmǎo,
Míng Ruì reported conquering Mánjié.
On the day Rénchén,
Míng Ruì was enfeoffed as a First-Class Chéngyì Jiāyǒng Gōng,
and granted a yellow belt, a ruby finial, and a four-dragon embroidered robe.
On the day Dīngyǒu,
Míng Ruì advanced to Sòngsài.
On the day Gēngzǐ,
Zhāng Bǎo was transferred to Shāndōng Xúnfǔ,
and Sū'ěrdé was made Shānxī Xúnfǔ.
On the day Bǐngwǔ,
Xīnzhù, the Shèngjīng Jiāngjūn, passed away,
and Míngfú was transferred to replace him.
Sū Chāng, the Mǐnzhè Zǒngdū, passed away.
On the day Dīngwèi,
Ā Lǐgǔn was appointed Cānzàn Dàchén,
and sent to the Yúnnán military camp.
Cuī Yīngjiē was made Mǐnzhè Zǒngdū,
and Fù Níhàn became Fújiàn Xúnfǔ.
On the day Jiǎyín,
the Mǐan people besieged Mùbāng.
In the second month, on the day Bǐngyín,
an edict was issued regarding the military campaign in Miǎndiàn,
stating that underestimating the enemy led to defeat,
and taking responsibility for this himself,
ordered Míng Ruì and others to withdraw their troops.
É Lèdēng'é and Tán Wǔgé were stripped of their offices and arrested for interrogation.
È Níng was ordered to return to Yúnnán,
and Ā Lǐgǔn was appointed acting Yúnguì Zǒngdū,
stationed at Yǒngchāng.
The Mǐan people captured Mùbāng,
and Zhū Lúnà died there.
On the day Wùyín,
the Emperor returned to Yuánmíngyuán.
On the day Bǐngxū,
Míng Ruì and others were defeated at Měngyù,
and died there.
Ā Guì was summoned to the capital,
and Yī Lètú was appointed acting Yīlí Jiāngjūn.
Fù Héng was made Jīnglüè,
Ā Lǐgǔn and Ā Guì were made Fù Jiāngjūn,
Shū Hèdé was made Cānzàn Dàchén,
and sent to Yúnnán.
È Níng was made Yúnguì Zǒngdū,
and Míng Dé was transferred to Yúnnán Xúnfǔ.
Fú Lóng'ān was made Bīngbù Shàngshū,
and ordered to study and serve in the Jūnjīchù.
Yǒng Dé was made Zhèjiāng Xúnfǔ,
Zhāng Bǎo was transferred to Jiāngsū Xúnfǔ,
Fù Níhàn to Shāndōng Xúnfǔ,
È Bǎo to Fújiàn Xúnfǔ,
and Chéng Táo to Húběi Xúnfǔ.
In the third month, on the day Guǐsì,
the land tax for the 32nd year for flood-affected areas in Shāndōng's Gāoyuàn and three other counties was remitted.
On the day Yǐsì,
È Bǎo was transferred to Guǎngxī Xúnfǔ,
Zhōng Yīn to Fújiàn Xúnfǔ,
Liáng Qīng to Guǎngdōng Xúnfǔ,
Qián Dù to Guìzhōu Xúnfǔ,
Bā Lù to Cháhār Dūtǒng,
and Fù Liáng to Suīyuǎn Chéng Jiāngjūn.
On the day Guǐchǒu,
the land tax for the 32nd year for flood-affected areas in Jiāngxī's Nánchāng and thirteen other counties was remitted.
In the summer, fourth month, on the day Dīngmǎo,
Qián Dù was transferred to Guǎngdōng Xúnfǔ.
On the day Jǐsì,
the land tax for the 32nd year for flood-affected areas in Ānhuī's Ānqìng and seven other prefectures and departments was remitted.
On the day Rénshēn,
the Emperor personally examined Hánlín, Zhànshì, and other officials,
promoting Wú Xǐngqīn and two others to first class,
while others were promoted or demoted according to their merits.
Officials transferred from ministries and courts to the Hánlín and other positions were examined,
and Juéluó Bāyànxué was promoted to first class,
while others were promoted or demoted according to their merits.
On the day Jiǎshēn,
É Lèdēng'é was executed by dismemberment in the marketplace,
and Tán Wǔgé was executed by decapitation.
On the day Yǐyǒu,
the Emperor personally offered sacrifices to Míng Ruì, Zhālāfēng'ā, and Guānyīnbǎo.
In the fifth month, on the day Gēngshēn,
Míng Dé was ordered to proceed to Yǒngchāng.
On the day Yǐchǒu,
Sèbùténg Bāléizhū'ěr was dismissed due to illness,
and Yī Lètú was made Lǐfānyuàn Shàngshū.
On the day Gēngwǔ,
Guānbǎo was newly appointed acting Lǐfānyuàn Shàngshū.
On the day Xīnsì,
Fàn Shíshòu was made Zuo Dū Yùshǐ.
On the day Rénwǔ,
Ā Guì was made Yúnguì Zǒngdū.
Yǐn Jìshàn and Gāo Jìn, for concealing longstanding abuses in the Liǎng Huái salt administration and not reporting them,
were both handed over to the appropriate board for severe deliberation.
In the autumn, seventh month, on the day Guǐsì,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, went on the autumn hunt at Mùlán.
On the day Jiǎwǔ,
Tuōyōng was transferred to Bīngbù Shàngshū.
Guānbǎo was made Xíngbù Shàngshū,
still concurrently holding the position of acting Lǐfānyuàn Shàngshū.
On the day Jǐhài,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, stayed at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the day Xīnchǒu,
Yǐn Lètú was made Yīlí Jiāngjūn,
still concurrently holding the position of Lǐfānyuàn Shàngshū.
On the day Rénzǐ,
Jì Yún was stripped of his office for leaking imperial edicts concerning the confiscation of the property of former transport commissioner Lú Jiànzēng,
and banished to Wūlǔmùqí.
In the eighth month, on the *dìngmǎo* day,
Russia was permitted to trade at Qiàkètú.
On the *xīnwèi* day,
the Emperor went to Mùlán for a hunting expedition.
On the *rénshēn* day,
Fāng Guānchéng, Governor-General of Zhílì, passed away.
Yáng Tíngzhāng was appointed to succeed him.
Qiú Yuēxiū was transferred to be Minister of Punishments (Xíngbù Shàngshū),
and Cài Xīn was appointed Minister of Works (Gōngbù Shàngshū).
On the *jiǎxū* day,
Lǐ Shìyáo reported that
Siam (Xiānluó) had been defeated by the Burmese.
The grandson of its king, Zhào Cuì, fled to Héxiānzhèn in Annan.
The local official, Mò Shìlín, took him in and cared for him.
A man from the interior, Gān Ēnchì, occupied Siam
and requested a title of enfeoffment.
Mò Shìlín was greatly commended.
Gān Ēnchì was ordered to find a close relative of their lord to establish as king;
if he could not, he was not to claim the title of king himself.
On the *jǐmǎo* day,
Tuō'ēnduō, Yú Mǐnzhōng, and Cuī Yīngjiē were granted the title of Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince (Tàizǐ Tàibǎo).
Tuō Yōng and Yáng Tíngzhāng were granted the title of Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince (Tàizǐ Shàobǎo).
In the ninth month, on the *wùzǐ* day,
Sōngchūn was appointed acting General of Yīlí.
On the *yǐwèi* day,
the Emperor returned to reside at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the *wùxū* day,
Gāo Héng and Pǔ Fú were sentenced to beheading.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital (Jīngshī).
Èbǎo was appointed Governor of Shānxī.
Fùsēng'ā, General of Hēilóngjiāng, was transferred to be General of Xī'ān,
and Fù Yù was appointed to succeed him.
In winter, the tenth month, on the *jǐwèi* day,
the disaster-stricken annual land tax for thirty-two years was remitted for Píngliáng and twelve other prefectures and counties in Gānsù.
On the *xīnwèi* day,
Gōng Zhàolín was appointed Governor of Guǎngxī.
On the *xīnsì* day,
Gāo Héng, Pǔ Fú, and Dá Sè were executed by beheading.
Hǎi Míng and others had their sentences commuted to a suspended death sentence.
In the eleventh month, on the *wùxū* day,
as the letter from the Burmese was insolent,
À Lǐgǔn was ordered to prepare for an advance and suppression campaign.
In the twelfth month, on the *jǐwèi* day,
Fùmíng'ān was appointed Governor of Shāndōng,
and Kuí Yì was appointed acting Governor of Húběi.
Yáng Xífú, Governor-General of Caoyun (Cáoyùn Zǒngdū), passed away.
Liáng Zhùhóng was appointed acting to succeed him.
On the *yǐchǒu* day,
Dìngcháng, Governor-General of Húguǎng, passed away.
Wú Dáshàn was transferred to succeed him.
Zhāng Bǎo was concurrently appointed acting Governor-General of Liǎngjiāng.
Míngshān was appointed Governor-General of Shǎnxī-Gānsù.
Āsīhā was transferred to be Governor of Shǎnxī,
and Wénshòu was appointed Governor of Hénán.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
Míngfú was summoned to the capital.
Érdéméng'é was appointed acting General of Shèngjīng.
On the *jiǎxū* day,
relief was provided for flood victims in Fèngtiān, Chéngdé, and four other prefectures and counties.
On the *rénwǔ* day,
Āsīhā was kept as Governor of Hénán,
and Wénshòu was transferred to be Governor of Shǎnxī.
In the thirty-fourth year, spring, the first month, on the *bǐngxū* day,
the annual land tax for this year was remitted for areas where imperial troops passed through in Yúnnán, and for Yǒngchāng and three other prefectures and sub-prefectures.
For areas not passed through,
five-tenths were remitted,
and three-tenths of the annual land tax for this year was also remitted for areas passed through by imperial troops in Húběi, Húnán, and Guìzhōu provinces.
On the *gēngyín* day,
as the Burmese letter was arrogant and rebellious,
Vice General Ā Guì and Vice General À Lǐgǔn were ordered to assist Fùhéng in the punitive expedition.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
Míngdé was appointed Governor-General of Yún-Guì,
stationed at Yǒngchāng,
and Kāníng'ā was appointed Governor of Yúnnán.
On the *rénchén* day,
À Lǐgǔn and others defeated the Burmese at Nándǐbà.
Two hundred thousand *shí* of stored rice from Tōngcāng were allocated for disaster relief in Bàzhōu and twelve other prefectures and counties.
On the *jiǎwǔ* day,
Zhuólèqí and others, sons of Ālèbǐsī, from the Right Wing Khazakhs, came to pay respects at court.
On the *yǐwèi* day,
Hénglù was transferred to be General of Shèngjīng,
Fù Liáng was appointed General of Jílín,
and Cháng Zài was appointed General of Suíyuǎnchéng.
On the *xīnchǒu* day,
Fùhéng departed for Yúnnán.
Guānbǎo was appointed acting Minister of Revenue (Hùbù Shàngshū).
The Vice Commandant (Fù Dūtǒng) of the Right Wing of Níngxià and the Vice Commandant of Lālín in Jílín were abolished.
Cháng Qīng was appointed acting General of Suíyuǎnchéng.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
Fùhéng was granted imperial armor and helmet.
On the *wùshēn* day,
Guānbǎo was ordered to assist as Grand Secretary (Dàxuéshì).
Fúlóng'ān was appointed acting Minister of Punishments.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
as Zhào Wēng, the younger brother of the King of Nánzhǎng (Laos), sent envoys requesting troops for revenge,
Ā Guì and others were ordered to prepare to advance troops from Nánzhǎng in separate routes.
In the second month, on the first day (*jiǎyín shuò*),
Jī Huáng was demoted due to an incident.
Chéng Jǐngyī was appointed Minister of Works.
On the *yǐchǒu* day,
Fùníhàn was appointed Governor of Ānhuī.
On the *guǐwèi* day,
Fùhéng was ordered to reorganize the horse administration in Yúnnán.
Nuòlún was appointed General of Suíyuǎnchéng.
In the third month, on the *yǐyǒu* day,
Yǐlètú, General of Yīlí, was ordered to proceed to the military camp in Yúnnán.
On the *jǐchǒu* day,
Yī'ěrtú was appointed Counselor Minister (Cānzàn Dàchén) of Wūlǐyǎsūtái.
On the *xīnchǒu* day,
Fúlù, Grand Minister of the Imperial Guard (Lǐng Shìwèi Nèidàchén) of the Bordered White Banner, was dismissed.
Ā Guì was appointed to succeed him.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
Ā Guì was appointed acting Governor-General of Yún-Guì.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
Wòlǐsūlè Tǒng and others from the Right Wing Khazakhs entered for an audience.
They were ordered to be seated and granted tea,
and presented with varying court robes and caps.
On the *wùshēn* day,
relief was provided for the disaster victims of the previous year in Gāolán and twenty-nine other prefectures, counties, and departments in Gānsù.
The annual land tax for the previous year was remitted for Héfèi and sixteen other prefectures and counties, and Lúzhōu and five other guards in Ānhuī.
In summer, the fourth month, on the *jǐwèi* day,
Wēn Fú was appointed Governor of Fújiàn.
On the *rénshēn* day,
Fùhéng advanced troops to Lǎoguāntún,
and Ā Guì advanced troops to Měngmì.
On the *dīngchǒu* day,
Chén Chūzhé and one hundred fifty-one others were granted the *jìnshì jíshì* degree with varying ranks.
In the fifth month, on the *jǐchǒu* day,
one Jiangning Vice Commandant was abolished.
In the sixth month, on the *bǐngchén* day,
Āsīhā was appointed Governor-General of Yún-Guì,
and Kāníng'ā was appointed Governor of Hénán.
On the *dīngsì* day,
Fùhéng reported that the native chieftain of Měnggǒng (Mogaung) had submitted.
On the *wùyín* day,
the Jiāng Dyke at Huángméi in Húběi burst.
Wú Dáshàn, Governor-General of Húguǎng, and Kuí Yì, Governor of Húběi, were ordered to inspect it.
In autumn, the seventh month, on the *dīnghài* day,
Míngdé was appointed acting Governor-General of Yún-Guì,
and moved his station to Téngyuè to manage military affairs.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
one Leader-Minister of Bāyàndài City in Yīlí was established.
Fùhéng reported that the native chieftain of Měngmì (Momeik) had submitted.
On the *jiǎwǔ* day,
Lǐ Shìyáo reported that Siam was still occupied by Gān Ēnchì.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
Dǒng Bāngdá, Minister of Rites (Lǐbù Shàngshū), passed away.
On the *jǐhài* day,
Lù Zōngkǎi was transferred to be Minister of Rites,
and Cài Xīn was appointed Minister of War (Bīngbù Shàngshū).
Wú Shàoshī was appointed Minister of Punishments,
Hǎi Míng was appointed Governor of Jiāngxī,
and Liáng Guózhì was appointed Governor of Húběi.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
Lǐ Shìyáo ordered Mò Shìlín to join the Siamese chieftains to attack Gān Ēnchì.
In the eighth month, on the *yǐchǒu* day,
the Emperor went to Mùlán for a hunting expedition.
On the *jǐsì* day,
as Cài Chēn hanged himself in prison,
Sūn Xiàoyú, Surveillance Commissioner (Ànchásǐ) of Fújiàn, was stripped of his office
and sent to a military post.
In the ninth month, on the *bǐngxū* day,
Ā Guì arrived at Mánmù (Bhamo).
On the *jǐchǒu* day,
the Emperor returned to reside at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the *yǐwèi* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
On the *jǐhài* day,
Ā Guì and Yǐlètú were ordered to meet Fùhéng at Mánmù for a joint force.
On the *rényín* day,
Liú Tǒngxūn was ordered to jointly inspect the Grand Canal in Shāndōng.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
Fùhéng reported that Húnjué, the native chieftain of Měnggǒng, led his people to surrender.
The Emperor commended him
and specially awarded him a three-eyed peacock feather.
On the *wùshēn* day,
Fùhéng arrived at Měngyǎng (Mohnyin).
Ā Guì reported the capture of Hākǎn
and crossing the river.
Ā Guì was ordered to suppress the rebels at Xīnjiē.
In winter, the tenth month, on the day Yǐmǎo,
Zhāngbǎo was appointed acting Governor-General of Yún-Guì,
Míngdé was appointed acting Provincial Governor of Yúnnán.
Yǒngdé was transferred to be Provincial Governor of Jiāngsū.
Xióng Xuépéng was recalled to be acting Provincial Governor of Zhèjiāng.
Zēnghǎi was appointed acting General of Yīlí.
On the day Dīngsì,
Fùhéng reported the capture of Měngyǎng.
On the day Guǐhài,
Liáng Guózhì concurrently acted as Governor-General of Húguǎng.
On the day Jiǎzǐ,
as Āguì was unable to capture Lǎoguāntún,
he was stripped of his rank of Deputy General
and made a Councillor-Minister.
Yīlètú was appointed Deputy General.
Kāníng'ā was transferred to be Provincial Governor of Guìzhōu,
Fùníhàn to be Provincial Governor of Hénán.
Hú Wénbó was appointed Provincial Governor of Ānhuī.
On the day Yǐchǒu,
Fùhéng reported reaching Xīnjiē.
Zhāngbǎo was ordered to be stationed at Lǎoguāntún.
On the day Rénshēn,
Yǒngguì was transferred to be Minister of Rítual (Lǐbù Shàngshū),
Tuōyōng to be Minister of Personnel (Lìbù Shàngshū),
Yīlètú to be Minister of War (Bīngbù Shàngshū),
with Tuōyōng concurrently acting.
Wú Shàoshī was transferred to be Minister of Rítual.
Qiú Yuēxiū was appointed Minister of Justice (Xíngbù Shàngshū).
The eleventh month, on the day Yǐyǒu,
the Deputy General and Minister of Revenue (Hùbù Shàngshū), Ālǐgǔn, died in the army.
Āguì was ordered to continue serving as Deputy General,
and Yǐnlètú was also appointed Deputy General,
Wū Sāntài and Chángqīng as Councillor-Ministers.
Guānbǎo was transferred to be Minister of Revenue.
Sù'ěrnà was appointed Minister of Justice,
Tuō'ēnduō acting Censor-in-Chief of the Left (Zuǒ Dū Yùshǐ).
On the day Wùzǐ,
Fùhéng and others attacked Lǎoguāntún.
On the day Guǐsì,
Huáng Dēngxián was appointed Grand Coordinator of Grain Transport (Cáoyùn Zǒngdū).
On the day Bǐngshēn,
due to the malarial mists in Miǎndi
and the great losses suffered by the official army,
the army was ordered to return to camp at Yěniúbà,
the Strategist Fùhéng was recalled,
and Āguì was left to manage the aftermath.
On the day Jǐhài,
Guānbǎo was recalled to be acting Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
On the day Dīngwèi,
Fùhéng and others failed to capture Lǎoguāntún.
The local official, through the Burmese chieftain Měng Bó, sent a Púyè letter to the military camp to beg for surrender.
The Emperor ordered the army to return.
The twelfth month, on the day Xīnhài,

five-tenths of the land tax and grain levies for the following year were remitted for the areas in Yúnnán managing military supplies and the three prefectures and sub-prefectures of Yǒngchāng and others.
For the provinces of Zhílì, Hénán, Húběi, Húnán, Guìzhōu and others, three-tenths were remitted for the prefectures and counties through which the officials and troops passed.
Gōng Zhàolín was transferred to be Provincial Governor of Húnán,
Débǎo was appointed Provincial Governor of Guǎngdōng,
Chén Huīzǔ was appointed Provincial Governor of Guǎngxī.
On the day Yǐmǎo,
Fùhéng and others reported that the Burmese chieftain Měng Bó had declared himself a vassal and offered tribute.
An imperial edict stated that a decree would be issued upon his arrival in the capital.
On the day Jǐsì,
as the Emperor was to visit the Eastern Tombs with the Empress Dowager the following year
and tour Tiānjīn,
three-tenths of the land tax and grain levies for the 35th year of Qiánlóng were remitted for the passing areas and those belonging to Tiānjīn Prefecture.
Āguì was appointed Minister of Rítual.
The 35th year, spring, the first month, on the day Jǐmǎo (new moon),
to celebrate the Emperor's sixtieth birthday
and the Empress Dowager's eightieth birthday the following year,
an imperial edict proclaimed a general remission of the regular land tax and grain levies for all provinces once.
On the day Xīnmǎo,
Zēnghǎi was appointed Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs (Lǐfānyuàn Shàngshū).
On the day Dīngwèi,
Lāwàngduō'ěrjì, the heir apparent of the Khalkha Heshūo Qīnwáng Chénggǔnzābù, was granted the title of Gùlún Èfù.
The second month, on the day Yǐchǒu,
the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to visit the Eastern Tombs.
On the day Gēngwǔ,
the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager on their return journey,
stopping at Pánshān.
On the day Rénshēn,
as the tribute memorial from the Burmese chieftain Měng Bó had not arrived,
Zhāngbǎo was instructed to prepare for it
and strictly forbid trade.
The third month, on the day Jǐmǎo,
the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager back to the capital.
Wú Shàoshī was recalled to be a Director (Lángzhōng) in the Ministry of Justice.
On the day Xīnsì,
Gōng Zhàolín was transferred to be Provincial Governor of Guìzhōu,
Wú Dáshàn concurrently acted as Provincial Governor of Húnán as Governor-General of Húguǎng.
On the day Rénwǔ,
the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to visit the Western Tombs (Tàilíng),
and toured Tiānjīn.
On the day Bǐngxū,
the Emperor visited the Western Tombs.
On the day Jǐchǒu,

the accumulated land tax and silver owed from the 31st to 33rd years of Qiánlóng, and the routinely borrowed and disaster-borrowed grain, for the passing prefectures and counties and those belonging to Tiānjīn Prefecture were remitted;
the accumulated land tax and silver and converted silver (zhé sè yínliǎng) owed from the 31st to 33rd years of Qiánlóng for Zhílì were remitted.
Punishments below military exile for Zhílì were reduced.
The silver and grain for which collection was postponed due to disaster from the 31st to 33rd years of Qiánlóng for Zhílì were remitted.
On the day Jiǎwǔ,
the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to stay at Tiānjīn Prefecture.
On the day Bǐngshēn,
the Emperor reviewed the banner garrison troops.
The Strategist Grand Secretary Fùhéng returned to the capital,
and was ordered, along with Fúlóng'ān, to continue serving as Minister of the Imperial Household Department (Zǒngguǎn Nèiwùfǔ Dàchén).
On the day Wùxū,
Yǒngdé was transferred to be Provincial Governor of Hénán,
Sàzài acted as Provincial Governor of Jiāngsū.
On the day Guǐmǎo,
the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager back to the capital.
On the day Jǐyǒu,
regarding the Burmese chieftain Suǒmùbāng and the local headman Xiànwèngtuán and others,
an edict reproached Hā Guóxìng for his embellishment and compromise,
recalled him to the capital,
and appointed Chángqīng to replace him as Commander-in-Chief (Tídū) of Yúnnán.
On the day Jǐwèi,
Fùliáng was recalled to the capital,
and Fùchūn was appointed General of Jílín.
On the day Bǐngyín,
there was a locust plague in Tiānjīn,
and Yáng Tíngzhāng was ordered to supervise the extermination.
On the day Gēngwǔ,
the Emperor went to Hēilóngtán to pray for rain.
In this month,
the regular land tax for eight prefectures and counties including Rénchéng in Zhèjiāng,
and the two guards (wèi) of Háng-Yán and Jiā-Hú,
and Dìngyuǎn County in Shǎnxī, which had suffered from floods and hail in the 34th year, was remitted.
The fifth month, on the day Dīngchǒu (new moon),
there was a solar eclipse.
On the day Rénwǔ,
as the Eighth Prince had entered the city without permission,
Guānbǎo and Tāng Xiānjiǎ, who served in the Imperial Study (Shàngshūfáng), were stripped of their positions,
and warned.
On the day Yǐwèi,
in response to the prayer for rain, the Ministry of Justice was ordered to clear minor prison cases,
and reduce punishments below military exile.
The intercalary fifth month, on the day Bǐngwǔ (new moon),
Qiú Yuēxiū was ordered to go to Jìzhōu and Bǎochí and other areas to exterminate locusts.
On the day Wùshēn,
there was heavy rain in the capital.
On the day Jǐwèi,
Wēnfú was appointed Vice Minister of Personnel (Lìbù Shìláng),
serving in the Grand Council (Jīnjīchù).
On the day Jiǎzǐ,
Qiú Yuēxiū was dismissed for ineffective locust extermination,
Chéng Jǐngyī was transferred to be Minister of Justice.
Fàn Shíshòu was appointed Minister of Works (Gōngbù Shàngshū),
Zhāng Ruòjùn was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
The sixth month, on the day Jiǎshēn,
Āguì and others were ordered to dispatch Hǎi Lánchá and Hā Guóxìng to advance troops.
On the day Bǐngxū,
there was a locust plague in Yǒngchéng in Hénán, Dàngshān in Jiāngsū, Sùzhōu in Ānhuī and other prefectures and counties.
On the day Dīnghài,
Guānbǎo was transferred to be Minister of Justice,
Sù'ěrnà to be Minister of Revenue.
On the day Rénchén,
Fēngshēng'é was appointed acting Minister of War.
On the day Jiǎwǔ,
Miáoxiāngyào and others from Gǔzhōu, Guìzhōu, were executed.
Vice Minister Wǔ Nàxǐ was ordered to go to Gǔběikǒu to inspect flood damage together with Commander-in-Chief Wáng Jìntài,
20,000 taels of silver from the imperial treasury were issued for relief,
and granaries were opened for relief grain sales.
Autumn, the seventh month, on the day Yǐsì (new moon),
Lǐ Shìyáo reported
that the local official Mò Shìlín of Héxiān Township requested an imperial edict to the Burmese barbarians to restore Siam,
which was refused.
On the day Bǐngwǔ,
Zēnghǎi was appointed General of Hēilóngjiāng,
Wēnfú was appointed Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
Hé'ěrjīng'é and Wǔ Nàxǐ were ordered to go to Gǔběikǒu to plan river works.
On the day Rénzǐ,
due to conflicts between Xiǎojīnchuān and Wòkèshí Tǔsī,
Governor-General of Sìchuān Ā'ěrtài was ordered to summon the Xiǎojīnchuān Tǔsī and admonish them.
On the day Guǐchǒu,
the Emperor visited the residence of Hé Qīnwáng Hóngzhòu to check on his illness.
On the day Dīngsì,
Hé Qīnwáng Hóngzhòu died.
The Grand Guardian Grand Secretary Fùhéng died.
On the day Wùwǔ,

Wáng Shìfāng, a 112-year-old former Instructor (Xùndǎo) of Suìchāng County School in Zhèjiāng, who came to the capital to offer birthday felicitations, was bestowed the title of Director (Sīyè) of the Imperial Academy (Guózǐjiān),
and received an emolument while in retirement.
On the day Xīnyǒu,
Péi Zōngxī was appointed Provincial Governor of Ānhuī.
On the day Jiǎzǐ,
200,000 shi of grain from the grain transport were intercepted to relieve flood disaster in Wǔqīng and other six counties.
Nuòmùqīn was appointed Provincial Governor of Yúnnán.
In the eighth month, on the day Wùyín,
because Assistant General Ā-Guì handled affairs with cunning,
he was stripped of his titles of Grand Minister of the Imperial Guard, Minister of Rites, and Gūshān Ején of the Bordered Red Banner Han Army,
and was demoted to Grand Minister, dismissed from his post but retained to handle Assistant General affairs.
On the day Jǐmǎo,
Yǒng-Guì was appointed Minister of Rites,
and Guān-Bǎo was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.
Ā-Ěr-Tài reported that Sēng-Gé-Sāng had confessed his crimes
and surrendered the Dámùbā Zōng area and the indigenous people he had plundered.
On the day Xīnsì,
Liú Tǒng-Xūn was ordered to concurrently manage the Ministry of Personnel.
On the day Bǐngxū,
on the occasion of the Emperor's Birthday,
the Emperor went to the Empress Dowager's palace to perform the rites.
He then presided over the Tài-Hé-Diàn,
where princes and all civil and military officials below them presented memorials
and performed congratulatory rites.
By imperial decree, the celebratory banquet was canceled.
Fēng-Shēng-É was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
On the day Jǐchǒu,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Rèhé.
On the day Yǐwèi,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager and sojourned at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the day Jǐhài,
the Emperor visited Mùlán.
In the ninth month, on the day Bǐngwǔ,
Ā-Ěr-Tài was appointed Grand Secretary of the Wǔyīng Diàn,
but was to remain to handle the affairs of the Governor-General of Sìchuān.
On the day Wùwǔ,
the Emperor returned to sojourn at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the day Jiǎzǐ,
Gāo-Jìn was ordered to concurrently act as Governor-General of Grain Transport.
In the winter, tenth month, on the new moon Guǐyǒu,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the capital.
On the day Xīnsì,
Cuī Yīng-Jiē was summoned to the capital,
and Zhōng-Yīn was ordered to act as Governor-General of Mǐn-Zhè.
On the day Rénwǔ,
Ā-Ěr-Tài was summoned to the capital,
Dé-Fú was appointed acting Governor-General of Sìchuān,
and Wú Dá-Shàn was appointed concurrently acting Governor of Húnán.
Sà-Zài was summoned to the capital,
and Lǐ-Hú was ordered to act as Governor of Jiāngsū.
On the day Jiǎwǔ,
Ā-Guì and others reported that the Burmese envoy from Lǎo-Guān-Tún had sent a letter,
requesting a halt to the military advance this year,
which was granted.
On the day Dīngyǒu,
Grand Secretary Chén Hóng-Móu requested retirement due to old age and illness,
and an imperial decree graciously urged him to stay.
In the twelfth month, on the day Jiǎxū,
three-tenths of the allocated grain tribute for Xīnjiāng for this year was remitted.
On the day Bǐngzǐ,
Cuī Yīng-Jiē was appointed Governor-General of Grain Transport.
On the day Bǐngxū,
Ā-Guì and Zhāng-Bǎo were instructed to secretly deliberate on an expedition to suppress the Burmese bandits.
On the day Gēngyín,
Lǐ-Hú was appointed Governor of Guìzhōu.
In the spring of the thirty-sixth year, first month, on the day Jiǎchén,
the allocated grain levy for Táiwān Fǔ, Fújiàn province, for this year was remitted.
On the day Yǐsì,
one-tenth of the official rent for Guǎngzhōu, Sháozhōu and other prefectures and subprefectures in Guǎngdōng province for this year was remitted,

and three-tenths of the official rent for Guìlín and seven other prefectures and subprefectures in Guǎngxī province for this year, as well as the school rent for Guìlín, Pínglè and other prefectures and subprefectures, was remitted.
On the day Dīngwèi,

the allocated grain tribute for the commoners and indigenous people of Níngyuǎn and four other prefectures and subprefectures, various battalions of the Jiànchāng Zhen banner, and Léibō and other departments in Sìchuān for this year was remitted.
On the day Jǐwèi,
Dé-Fú was transferred to act as Governor-General of Yún-Guì,
and Ā-Ěr-Tài was ordered to return to his post as Governor-General of Sìchuān.
In the second month, on the day Jiǎxū,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager on an eastern tour.
On the day Gēngchén,
Grand Minister Bā-Tú-Jì-Ěr-Gá-Lè was ordered to jointly examine, with Jí-Fú, the case of mutual accusations involving the Uriankhai Assistant Gūshān Ején Mò-Ní-Zhā-Bù and others.
On the day Xīnsì,
Grand Secretary Chén Hóng-Móu requested retirement due to illness,
which was granted,
and he was bestowed the title of Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.
The outstanding borrowed grain owed by the commoners of Cāngzhōu and fifteen other prefectures and counties in Zhílì was remitted,
as well as five-tenths of the money and grain taxes for Wǔqīng County for this year.
On the day Guǐwèi,
Secretary Qíu Yuē-Xiū was ordered to jointly plan the river works in Zhílì with Yáng Tíng-Zhāng and Zhōu Yuán-Lǐ.
On the day Bǐngxū,
three-tenths of the allocated tax for the prefectures and counties traversed in Shāndōng for this year was remitted, and five-tenths for disaster-stricken areas.
The land and poll tax for Tái'ān and two other counties in Shāndōng for this year was remitted.
On the day Gēngyín,
the outstanding borrowed grain owed by the commoners of various jurisdictions in Jǐnán, Shāndōng, and the overdue taxes of Dōngpíng Zhōu and Dōngpíng Suǒ were remitted.
Regarding Ā-Guì's request for a major expedition against Burma,
he was severely reprimanded.
On the day Xīnmǎo,
the outstanding silver owed for wheat by the commoners of Jǐnán and six other prefectures in Shāndōng was remitted.
Liú-Lún was appointed Grand Secretary,
concurrently managing the Ministry of Works,
and Yú Mǐn-Zhōng was appointed Assistant Grand Secretary.
Chéng Jǐng-Yī was transferred to be Minister of Personnel,
Fàn Shí-Shòu was appointed Minister of Punishments,
and Qíu Yuē-Xiū was appointed Minister of Works.
On the day Bǐngshēn,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to visit the Dài-Yuè Temple,
and the Emperor ascended Mount Tàishān.
On the day Yǐsì,
the Emperor arrived at Qūfù to pay respects at the temple of the Former Sage Kǒng Fūzǐ.
On the day Bǐngwǔ,
the Emperor offered sacrifices at the temple of the Former Sage Kǒng Fūzǐ.
On the day Dīngwèi,
the Emperor visited the Kǒng Lín.
He offered sacrifices at the Mausoleum of Shào-Hào and the Temple of Yuán Shèng Zhōu Gōng.
Yǎnshèng Gōng Kǒng Zhāo-Huàn and his clan members were granted silver and silk in varying amounts.
On the day Wùshēn,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the capital.
On the day Yǐmǎo,
Grand Secretary Yǐn Jì-Shàn and others, Minister Guān-Bǎo and others, Governor-General Yáng Tíng-Zhāng and others, and Governor Zhōng-Yīn and others were asked for their opinions.
Grand Secretary of the Cabinet Lù Zōng-Kǎi and others were allowed to retire with their original ranks.
On the day Wùwǔ,
Fù-Míng-Ān was appointed Governor-General of Mǐn-Zhè, and Zhōu Yuán-Lǐ was appointed Governor of Shāndōng.
On the day Gēngshēn,
due to continuous disasters in Gānsù in recent years,
the outstanding borrowed seeds, rations, and granary grain for the entire province were remitted.
On the day Jiǎzǐ,
the Emperor inspected the dike at Jiédì.
On the day Yǐchǒu,
Nà-Xùn-Tè-Gǔ-Sī was executed by beheading.
On the day Jǐsì,
Ā-Guì's memorial clarifying that there would not be a major expedition against Burma this year
was submitted to the ministries for severe deliberation.
In the summer, fourth month, on the new moon Xīnwèi,
Lǐ Shì-Yáo was appointed Grand Minister.
On the day Jiǎxū,
Assistant Minister of Revenue Guì-Lín was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
On the day Dīngchǒu,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the capital.
On the day Yǐyǒu,
due to the drought, the Ministry of Punishments was ordered to clear up prison cases,
and reduce sentences for crimes below military exile,
with Zhílì following suit.
On the day Bǐngxū,
the Emperor went to Hēilóng Tán to pray for rain.
On the day Rénchén,
Grand Secretary Yǐn Jì-Shàn passed away.
On the day Yǐwèi,
Huáng Xuān and 160 other people were granted the rank of Jìnshì and other varying degrees.
In the fifth month, on the new moon Xīnchǒu,
Wú Dá-Shàn was transferred to be Governor-General of Shǎn-Gān,
Wén-Shòu was appointed acting Governor-General,
and Lè-Ěr-Jǐn was appointed acting Governor of Shǎnxī.
Fù-Míng-Ān was transferred to be Governor-General of Hú-Guǎng,
and Yǒng-Dé was appointed Governor of Húnán.
Hé-Wěi was appointed Governor of Hénán,
concurrently managing river affairs,
Zhōng-Yīn was appointed Governor-General of Mǐn-Zhè,
and Yú Wén-Yí was appointed Governor of Fújiàn.
On the day Guǐmǎo,
it was ordered to reduce the sentences for those whose executions were deferred three times in autumn reviews.
On the day Jiǎchén,
an edict stated that at a time when punishments should be mitigated, executions of condemned criminals
should be temporarily postponed,
and this was to be made into a standing order.
On the day Yǐsì,
Ā-Guì was stripped of his position for cowardice and hesitation,
and demoted to serve as a soldier.
Wēn-Fú was ordered to hasten to Yúnnán to act as Assistant General.
On the day Rénxū,
Gāo-Jìn was appointed Grand Secretary of the Wénhuá Diàn,
concurrently Minister of Rites,
and was to remain in his post as Governor-General of Liǎng-Jiāng.
Ā-Ěr-Tài was summoned to the Grand Council to handle affairs,
and Dé-Fú was appointed Governor-General of Sìchuān.
In the sixth month, on the day Xīnwèi,
the northern section of the Grand Canal in Zhílì breached.
On the day Jiǎxū,
Nǔ-Sān was appointed Grand Minister of the Imperial Guard of the Plain Yellow Banner.
On the day Wùyín,
Bā-Tú-Jì-Ěr-Gá-Lè was ordered to go to Yīlí to handle the affairs of the Tǔ-Ěr-Hù-Tè's allegiance.
On the day Jǐmǎo,
an edict stated that all Dà-Tái-Jí of the Tǔ-Ěr-Hù-Tè who had pledged allegiance should come to the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng for an imperial audience,
and Èfù Sè-Bù-Téng-Bā-Lè-Zhǔ-Ěr was ordered to hasten to welcome them by post-horse.
On the day Rénwǔ,
the retired Grand Secretary Chén Hóng-Móu passed away.
On the day Guǐsì,
the Tǔ-Ěr-Hù-Tè tribe members were ordered to temporarily settle at Bó-Luó-Bó-Lā.
Regarding Jīnchuān Tǔ-Shè Suǒ-Nuò-Mù's request to be granted the people of Gé-Bù-Shí-Zá Tǔ-Sī,
Ā-Ěr-Tài was ordered to carefully consider the expediency of the matter,
and not be lenient.
In autumn, the seventh month, on the day Rén-yín,
Ā'ěrtài and others reported that the native chieftain of Xiǎojīnchuān was besieging Wòkèshén,
and an order was given to suppress them.
On the day Yǐ-sì,
orders were given to Attendant Minister Guìlín to take ten thousand taels of silver to Gǔběikǒu to join with Provincial Commander Wáng Jìntài to relieve flood victims.
On the day Bǐng-wǔ,
the Yǒngdìng Hé breached its banks.
On the day Dīng-wèi,
Shūhèdé was appointed Acting General of Yīlí.
On the day Wù-shēn,
the Emperor held the autumn hunt at Mùlán.
Because Xiǎojīnchuān had again encroached upon the Míngzhèng tǔsī,
an edict was issued to Ā'ěrtài and others to advance and suppress them.
On the day Dīng-sì,
the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, set out on the imperial procession.
On the day Guǐ-hài,
the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, stayed at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the day Bǐng-yín,
for this imperial tour to Mùlán,
the military officials along the route were negligent,
so Yáng Tíngzhāng, Wáng Jìntài, and others were all handed over to the ministry for severe deliberation.
In the eighth month, on the day Jǐ-chǒu,
Chénggǔnzhābù, Deputy General of the Left for Dingbian and Jasagh Khoshoi Prince of Khalkha, passed away.
Chēbùdēngzhābù was appointed Deputy General of the Left for Dingbian,
and Èfù Láwàngduōěrzhì inherited the title of Jasagh Khoshoi Prince.
Défú was dismissed from serving in the Grand Council.
On the day Gēng-yín,
Grand Secretary and Governor-General of Liangjiang, Gāo Jìn, was summoned to the capital
to investigate the Yǒngdìng Hé riverworks.
Sàzài was appointed Acting Governor-General of Liangjiang concurrently.
On the day Rén-chén,
the breach in the Yǒngdìng Hé was closed.
On the day Guǐ-sì,
the Emperor went on a hunting expedition to Mùlán.
On the day Dīng-yǒu,
Ā'ěrtài was ordered to continue managing the affairs of the Governor-General of Sìchuān,
and Défú was recalled to the capital.
In the ninth month, on the day Wù-xū, the first day of the month,
capital punishments were suspended for this year.
On the day Guǐ-mǎo,
Attendant Minister Qìngguì of the Court of Colonial Affairs was appointed to serve in the Grand Council.
On the day Yǐ-sì,
the Tǔ'ěrhùtáijí Wòbāxī and others were granted an audience,
and rewarded with differing ranks of official hats and court robes.
Deputy General Wēnfú and Counselor Minister Wǔdài were ordered to proceed to the Sìchuān military camp
to confer on advancing and suppressing.
On the day Xīn-hài,
Wòbāxī was enfeoffed as Wūnà'ēn Sùzhūkètú Jiù Tǔ'ěrhùtè Bù Zhuólǐkètú Hàn,
Cèbókèduōěrzhì as Wūnà'ēn Sùzhūkètú Jiù Tǔ'ěrhùtè Bù Bùyántú Qīnwáng,
Shèlèng as Qīngsàitèqílètú Xīn Tǔ'ěrhùtè Bù Bìlìkètú Jùnwáng,
Bāmùbā'ěr as Bìxīlèlètú Jùnwáng,
and the rest were granted differing noble ranks.
On the day Jiǎ-yín,
the Emperor returned to reside at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the day Dīng-mǎo,
Wénshòu was appointed Governor-General of Sìchuān,
and Lè'ěrjǐn was appointed Provincial Governor of Shǎnxī.
Yǒngdé was transferred to be Provincial Governor of Guǎngxī,
Liáng Guózhì as Provincial Governor of Húnán,
and Chén Huīzǔ as Provincial Governor of Húběi.
In winter, the tenth month, on the day Wù-chén, the first day of the month,
Sānbǎo was appointed Provincial Governor of Shānxī.
On the day Jǐ-sì,
the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
Shūhèdé was appointed General Overseer of Yīlí and other places,
Yīlètú as Counselor Minister of Tǎ'ěrbāhātái,
and Āntài as Counselor Minister of Wūshí.
On the day Jiǎ-xū,
Jì Yún was pardoned
and rewarded with the position of Compiler in the Hanlin Academy.
On the day Yǐ-hài,
the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
On the day Jǐ-mǎo,
Gāo Jìn and others reported that the riverworks at Chénjiādàokǒu in Táoyuán Tīng were closed,
and the Emperor praised them.
Gāo Jìn, Qiú Yuēxiū, and Yáng Tíngzhāng were ordered to inspect the Southern Grand Canal.
On the day Dīng-hài,
Yáng Tíngzhāng was recalled to be Minister of Punishments,
Zhōu Yuánlǐ was appointed Governor-General of Zhílì,
and Xú Jī was appointed Provincial Governor of Shāndōng.
On the day Jiǎ-wǔ,
Wú Dáshàn, Governor-General of Shaan-Gan, passed away,
and Wénshòu was transferred to replace him.
In the eleventh month, on the day Jǐ-yǒu,
Dǒng Tiānbì reported capturing Niúchǎng in Xiǎojīnchuān.
On the day Bǐng-chén,
the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, attended Cíníng Gōng,
reverently bestowing the honorific title "Chóngqìng Cíxuān Kānghuì Dūnhé Yùshòu Chúnxī Gōngyì Ānqí Huáng Tàihòu,"
and an imperial edict was issued granting various acts of grace.
Wēnfú was appointed Grand Secretary of Wǔyīng Diàn,
concurrently Minister of War,
and Guìlín was appointed Governor-General of Sìchuān.
On the day Dīng-sì,
Sù'ěrnà was transferred to be Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs,
and Shūhèdé was appointed Minister of Revenue.
On the day Xīn-yǒu,
on the occasion of the Empress Dowager's birthday,
the Emperor proceeded to Shòukāng Gōng
and led the princes and ministers in celebrating.
On the day Rén-xū,
Dǒng Tiānbì attacked Dámùbā Zōng,
but was defeated.
On the day Jiǎ-zǐ,
the Fan (aboriginals) of Xiǎojīnchuān recaptured Niúchǎng.
In the twelfth month, on the day Gēng-wǔ,
Wēnfú reported advancing to Xiàngyáng Píng,
and attacking the Diaokart (blockhouses) of Bāláng Lāshān in Xiǎojīnchuān,
but failed to overcome them.
Guìlín reported capturing Yuēzán Zhài in Xiǎojīnchuān.
Dǒng Tiānbì, Provincial Commander of Sìchuān, was stripped of his office,
and Āguì was appointed Acting Commander.
On the day Yǐ-hài,
the outstanding taxes from thirty-three prefectures and counties in Gānsù, including Lǒngxī, that suffered from floods, droughts, hailstorms, and frost for thirty-three years, were remitted.
On the day Bǐng-xū,
because Sénggésāng, the chieftain of Dàjīnchuān, sent native officials to Guìlín's military camp to offer tribute,
orders were given to reward them and send them back.
On the day Jǐ-chǒu,
Wēnfú reported capturing the Bāláng Lā Diaokart.
On the day Guǐ-sì,
Wēnfú reported advancing to Rìlóng Zōng,
and Dǒng Tiānbì recaptured the various stockades of Wòkèshén tǔsī.
In the thirty-seventh year, spring, the first month, on the day Xīn-chǒu,
the regular grain and bean taxes for the two prefectures of Fèngtiān and Jǐnzhōu were remitted.
The regular silver and grain taxes for the two prefectures and counties of Yùhuán and Hǎiníng in Zhèjiāng were remitted.
The regular military provisions of grain, beans, and wheat for the two prefectures of Dàtóng and others in Shānxī,
as well as three-tenths of the taxes for the fourteen prefectures and departments of Tàiyuán and others, and the various jurisdictions of Guīhuàchéng, were remitted.
On the day Rén-yín,
the regular silver taxes for Hélíngé'ěr and other places, and the Taipu Temple pastures, were remitted,
along with three-tenths of the regular silver taxes for Qīngshuǐ Hé Tīng and the regular grain and bean taxes for the Taipu Temple pastures.
On the day Guǐ-mǎo,
Yáng Tíngzhāng, Minister of Punishments, passed away.
Cuī Yìngjiē was appointed Minister of Punishments,
and Jiāmó was appointed Acting Governor-General of Grain Transport.
On the day Yǐ-sì,
Wēnfú reported capturing Zēngtóugōu and Kǎyā Diaokart in Xiǎojīnchuān.
On the day Dīng-wèi,
Guìlín reported capturing the Diaokart of Guōsōng and Jiǎmù.
On the day Gēng-xū,
Hénglù was appointed Inner Grand Minister.
On the day Guǐ-chǒu,
the city of Wūlǔmùqí was built,
and troops were stationed there for agricultural production.
On the day Guǐ-hài,
Minister Qiú Yuēxiū was ordered to assist Governor-General Zhōu Yuánlǐ of Zhílì in dredging the Yǒngdìng Hé and Northern Grand Canal.
In the second month, on the day Dīng-mǎo,
Āguì was appointed Counselor Minister for the Sìchuān military camp.
On the day Jiǎ-xū,
the Emperor visited Pánshān.
On the day Bǐng-xū,
the Emperor returned to the capital,
and visited Yuánmíng Yuán.
On the day Dīng-hài,
Sèbùténgbālèzhū'ěr was appointed Counselor Minister for the Sìchuān military camp.
On the day Yǐ-wèi,
the regular in-kind rent and grain taxes from the previous year for the twelve prefectures and departments of Xī'ān and others in Shǎnxī were remitted.
In the third month, on the day Bǐng-shēn, the first day of the month,
the outstanding taxes for six to ten years for the eleven prefectures and counties of Jīntán and others in Jiāngsū were remitted.
On the day Wù-xū,
Suǒnuòmùcèlíng was appointed Counselor Minister of Wūlǔmùqí,
Déyún as Leader Minister,
and both were ordered to be subject to the command of the General of Yīlí.
On the day Yǐ-sì,
Fēngshēng'é was appointed Counselor Minister for the Sìchuān military camp.
On the day Jǐ-yǒu,
Zhā Shìzhù, a former magistrate from Luóshān County in Hénán,
was sentenced to beheading
for concealing "Míng Shǐ Jíyào" (Essentials of Ming History).
On the day Rén-zǐ,
Guìlín reported capturing Mùbālā and other places of the Gébùshízhá tǔsī, which were occupied by Dàjīnchuān.
On the day Yǐ-mǎo,
Wēnfú reported capturing Zīlǐ Diaozhai in Xiǎojīnchuān.
On the day Dīng-sì,
Guìlín reported capturing Jídì Guānzhài.
Wēnfú reported capturing Ākèmùyǎ Zhài in Xiǎojīnchuān.
Guìlín reported capturing Dǎnglí and other stockades of the Gébùshízhá tǔsī,
and the Diaokart below Zhāwā Wōyá in Xiǎojīnchuān.
In summer, the fourth month, on the day Bǐng-yín, the first day of the month,
Guìlín reported capturing Āyǎng Dōngshān Liáng and other stockades in Xiǎojīnchuān.
Over 3.76 million *shi* of outstanding grain taxes for years in Gānsù were remitted.
On the day Rén-shēn,
Guìlín reported completely recovering the territory of Gébùshízhá tǔsī,
and capturing Géwū and other places in Xiǎojīnchuān.
An edict was issued to Wēnfú and Guìlín to advance and suppress Suǒnuòmù.
On the day Yǐ-hài,
Lǐ Hú was appointed Provincial Governor of Yúnnán,
and Tú Sīdé Provincial Governor of Guìzhōu.
On the day Rén-wǔ,
Ānxī Dào was changed to Bālǐkūn Túntián Liángwù Bīngbèi Dào,
Gānsù Dào to Ānsù Bīngbèi Dào,
and Liángzhuāng Dào to Gānnliang Bīngbèi Dào.
The Wūlǔmùqí Liángdào was abolished.
On the day Gēng-yín,
Jīn Bǎng and one hundred sixty-two others were granted the *jinshi* degree with differing ranks.
On the day Jiǎ-wǔ,
Guìlín attacked Dāwū Dōng'àn Shānliáng in Xiǎojīnchuān,
but was defeated.
On the *yǐwèi* day of the fifth month, the first day of the lunar month,
Wēn Fú [温福] impeached Sèbùténgbālèzhū'ěr [色布騰巴勒珠爾] for misleading military affairs,
and he was stripped of his titles and offices.
On the *bǐngshēn* day,
the accumulated arrears of taxes from the fifteen *zhōu* and *xiàn* of Cāngzhōu [滄州] and others in Zhílì [直隸] were remitted.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
Shūhèdé [舒赫德] was appointed as the Chief Imperial Bodyguard.
Fú Lóng'ān [福隆安] was ordered to go to Sìchuān [四川] to investigate the case where Ā'ěrtài [阿爾泰] impeached Guì Lín [桂林] for being perverse and fabricating facts.
Tuō Yōng [託庸] was temporarily ordered to concurrently manage the President of the Board of War,
and Suǒ'ěrnà [索爾訥] was appointed acting President of the Board of Works.
On the *rényín* day,
Fú Kāng'ān [福康安], the Vice Minister of the Board of Revenue, was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
Hǎi Lánchá [海蘭察] and others were ordered to proceed to the western military camp in Sìchuān,
and È Lán [鄂蘭] and others to the southern military camp in Sìchuān.
Róng Bǎo [容保] was transferred to be the General of Suīyuǎnchéng [綏遠城].
Guì Lín [桂林] was dismissed from office and arrested for questioning due to concealing setbacks.
Ā'ěrtài [阿爾泰] was appointed acting Governor-General of Sìchuān.
On the *jǐwèi* day,
the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, visited the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng [避暑山莊].
On the *jiǎzǐ* day,
Fù Míng'ān [富明安], the Governor-General of Húguǎng [湖廣], died.
Hǎi Míng [海明] was appointed Governor-General of Húguǎng,
and Hǎi Chéng [海成] was appointed Governor of Jiāngxī [江西].
The fixed taxes of fifteen *zhōu* and *xiàn* in Dàxīng [大興] and others in Zhílì were remitted, with varying amounts.
On the *yǐchǒu* day of the sixth month, the first day of the lunar month,
the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, stayed at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
Wēn Fú [温福] and others captured the Dōngmǎzhài [東瑪寨] fort in Xiǎojīnchuān [小金川].
Ā Guì [阿桂] was ordered to supervise the *tǔsī* [土司] (local chieftains) of Shàngzhōngxiázágǔ [上中下雜谷] and Chuòsījiǎbù [綽斯甲布] in their campaigns against Jīnchuān [金川].
On the *dīngchǒu* day,
the fixed taxes for drought-stricken areas in twenty-five *tīng* and *xiàn* of Gāolán [皐蘭] and others in Gānsù [甘肅] were remitted.
On the *xīnsì* day,
Hénglù [恆祿], the General of Shèngjīng [盛京], died.
Zēng Hǎi [增海] was transferred to replace him.
Fù Yù [傅玉] was appointed General of Hēilóngjiāng [黑龍江].
On the *jiǎshēn* day,
Wén Shòu [文綬] was transferred to be Governor-General of Sìchuān,
Hǎi Míng [海明] to be Governor-General of Shǎnxī-Gānsù [陝甘],
and Lè'ěrjǐn [勒爾謹] was appointed acting Governor-General.
Ā'ěrtài [阿爾泰] was appointed acting Governor-General of Húguǎng.
On the *bǐngxū* day,
Ā'ěrtài [阿爾泰] was dismissed,
and Hǎi Míng [海明] was transferred to be Governor-General of Húguǎng.
Lè'ěrjǐn [勒爾謹] was appointed acting Governor-General of Shǎnxī-Gānsù,
and Fùlèhún [富勒渾] was transferred to be Governor of Shǎnxī [陝西].
Liú Bǐngtián [劉秉恬], the Vice Minister of Granaries, was ordered to go to the western military camp in Sìchuān to supervise the military provisions.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
Hǎi Míng [海明], the Governor-General of Húguǎng, died.
Fùlèhún [富勒渾] was appointed to replace him,
and Chén Huīzǔ [陳輝祖] was appointed acting Governor-General.
Bāyánsān [巴延三] was appointed Governor of Shǎnxī.
In the autumn, on the *yǐwèi* day of the seventh month,
È Bǎo [鄂寶], the Vice Minister of the Board of Punishments, was ordered to go to the southern military camp in Sìchuān to supervise the military provisions,
and Lè'ěrjǐn [勒爾謹] was appointed Governor-General of Shǎnxī-Gānsù.
On the *jǐsì* day of the eighth month,
Ā Guì [阿桂] reported the capture of the Jiǎ'ěrmù Shānliáng [甲爾木山梁] fort in Xiǎojīnchuān.
Ā Guì [阿桂] was appointed an Imperial Bodyguard.
The *tǔsī* [土司] Ānduō'ěr [安多爾] of Bùlākèdǐ [布拉克底] was granted
the title "Gōngshùn" [恭順],
and the *tǔfù* [土婦] (local chieftainess) Jiāyàng [伽讓] of Bāwàng [巴旺] was granted
the title "Gōngyì" [恭懿].
On the *rénshēn* day,
Wēn Fú [温福] and others reported that the rebels of Xiǎojīnchuān attacked the transport route at Mǎ'ěrdíkè [瑪爾迪克],
and Hǎi Lánchá [海蘭察] and others defeated them.
On the *jǐchǒu* day,
Xiǎojīnchuān rebels attacked the Dǎngbà [黨壩] official stockade,
and Ā Guì [阿桂] dispatched Dǒng Tiānbì [董天弼] to reinforce it.
On the *rényín* day of the ninth month,
Wēn Fú [温福] reported advancing to Mùlánbà [木蘭壩],
where the rebels destroyed the forts on the north and south mountains
and gathered to defend the Lùdǐngzōng Shānliáng [路頂宗山梁].
Orders were given to strictly guard the rear route.
Ā Guì [阿桂] reported that the *tǔsī* [土司] of Chuòsījiǎbù [綽斯甲布] had divided their forces to attack Lèwūwéi [勒烏圍].
The Emperor saw the Empress Dowager off as she returned to the capital.
On the *wùshēn* day,
the Emperor returned from the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
the Emperor reported to the Empress Dowager upon her return to the capital.
In winter, on the *rénshēn* day of the tenth month,
Dǒng Tiānbì [董天弼] reported the capture of Mùyánggāng [穆陽岡] and other forts.
On the *rénwǔ* day,
Ā Guì [阿桂] reported the capture of the Jiǎ'ěrmù Shānliáng [甲爾木山梁] in Xiǎojīnchuān.
On the *yǐwèi* day of the eleventh month,
Wēn Fú [温福] and others reported the capture of Lùdǐngzōng [路頂宗] and Kāmùsè'ěr [喀木色爾] fortresses.
On the *bǐngshēn* day,
the fixed taxes on salt wells that had collapsed and been abandoned for thirty-five years in nine *zhōu* and *xiàn* of Lèshān [樂山] and others in Sìchuān were remitted.
On the *xīnchǒu* day,
Qín Huáng [秦璜], the General of Guǎngzhōu [廣州], was dismissed from office and arrested for trial for taking a maidservant as his concubine.
A Vice Military Governor of Liángzhōu [涼州] was established.
One Vice Military Governor of Xī'ān [西安] was abolished.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
Wēn Fú [温福] and others reported the capture of Bó'ěrgēn Shān [博爾根山] and other fortresses.
On the *wùshēn* day,
Ā Guì [阿桂] reported the capture of Wēnggǔ'ěrlǒng [翁古爾壟] and other fortified villages.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
Fùlèhún [富勒渾] was ordered to proceed to Sìchuān,
and Chén Huīzǔ [陳輝祖] was appointed acting Governor-General of Húguǎng.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
Ā Guì [阿桂] reported the capture of Délǐ [得里] and other fortresses.
On the *dīngsì* day,
Ā Guì [阿桂] reported the capture of Bāngjiǎ [邦甲], Lāzōng [拉宗] and other places,
and the indigenous people of the various fortresses in Lāyuē [拉約] surrendered.
On the *guǐhài* day of the twelfth month,
Ā Guì [阿桂] reported the capture of the Sēnggézōng [僧格宗] fortress.
On the *guǐyǒu* day,
Wēn Fú [温福] was appointed General Dìngbiān [定邊];
Ā Guì [阿桂] and Fēngshēng'é [豐昇額] were both appointed Assistant Generals;
Shū Cháng [舒常], Hǎi Lánchá [海蘭察], and Hā Guóxīng [哈國興] were all appointed Grand Councilors;
Fú Kāng'ān [福康安] was appointed Commander of the Vanguard;
Fù Xīng [復興] and others were appointed Commanders of the Vanguard for Wēn Fú's route;
Xīng Zhào [興兆] and others were appointed Commanders of the Vanguard for Ā Guì's route;
Dǒng Tiānbì [董天弼] and others were appointed Commanders of the Vanguard for Fēngshēng'é's route.
Gōnggānúo'ěrbù [工噶諾爾布], the *tǔsī* [土司] of Chuòsījiǎbù [綽斯甲布], was bestowed
the title "Zūnzhuīguīdān" [尊追歸丹].
On the *bǐngzǐ* day,
Wēn Fú [温福] reported the capture of Míngguōzōng [明郭宗] and other forts.
On the *dīngchǒu* day,
Ā Guì [阿桂] reported the capture of the Měinuò [美諾] fortress.
On the *gēngchén* day,
Wēn Fú [温福] reported that the indigenous people of Pénglǔ'ěr [彭魯爾] and other villages had submitted.
On the *xīnsì* day,
Wēn Fú [温福] and others reported the capture of Bùlángguōzōng [布朗郭宗] and Dǐmùdá [底木達] fortresses.
Zé Wàng [澤旺] surrendered,
and Sēnggésāng [僧格桑] fled to Jīnchuān.
On the *yǐyǒu* day,
Qín Huáng [秦璜] was sentenced to beheading for corruption.
On the *bǐngxū* day,
Sà Zǎi [薩載] was appointed Governor of Jiāngsū [江蘇].
On the *dīnghài* day,
Wén Shòu [文綬] was stripped of his office for favoritism;
Liú Bǐngtián [劉秉恬] was appointed Governor-General of Sìchuān,
and continued to supervise military provisions;
Fùlèhún [富勒渾] was appointed acting Governor-General.
In the spring of the thirty-eighth year, on the *rénchén* day of the first month,
Yǒng Dé [永德] was summoned to the capital.
Xióng Xuépéng [熊學鵬] was transferred to be Governor of Guǎngxī [廣西],
and Sānbǎo [三寶] to be Governor of Zhèjiāng [浙江].
È Bǎo [鄂寶] was reinstated as Governor of Shānxī [山西].
As Xiǎojīnchuān was pacified,

the fixed taxes for the thirty-eighth year in fifty-one *tīng*, *zhōu*, and *xiàn* of Chéngdū [成都] and others, where Sìchuān officials and soldiers passed through, and the remaining remitted taxes for the thirty-seventh year in ninety *tīng*, *zhōu*, and *xiàn* of Wēnjiāng [溫江] and others, which provided military provisions, were deferred.
The taxes and tributes of the indigenous people
were similarly deferred.
Wēn Fú [温福] and others advanced to attack Jīnchuān,
dividing their forces into three routes via Kā'ěrsà'ěr [喀爾薩爾], Kālāyī [喀拉依], and Chuòsījiǎbù [綽斯甲布].
On the *jiǎchén* day,
envoys from the Bóluòtè [博羅特] of Khazak came to have an audience.
Ā'ěrtài [阿爾泰] was ordered to commit suicide for corruption.
On the *wùwǔ* day,
Yǒng Guì [永貴] was transferred to be acting President of the Board of Revenue,
and Ā Guì [阿桂] was appointed President of the Board of Rites.
On the *gēngshēn* day of the second month, the first day of the lunar month,
Wēn Fú [温福] and others were ordered to issue a summons to Suǒnuòmù [索諾木] to capture and surrender Sēnggésāng [僧格桑].
On the *gēngyín* day of the third month, the first day of the lunar month,
there was a solar eclipse.
On the *rénchén* day,
the Emperor visited the Tàilíng [泰陵] mausoleum.
He accompanied the Empress Dowager on an inspection tour to Tiānjīn [天津],
remitting three-tenths of this year's land and poll taxes in the areas passed through and in Tiānjīn Fǔ [天津府].
On the *guǐsì* day,
the Emperor inspected the Yongding River dikes.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
the Emperor paid respects at the Tàilíng mausoleum.
On the *wùxū* day,
the Emperor ordered Prince Jiǎn Qīnwáng Fēngnàhēng [簡親王豐訥亨] to accompany the Empress Dowager as she departed from Chàngchūnyuán [暢春園],

remitting the accumulated taxes from the thirty-third to the thirty-sixth year for twenty *zhōu* and *xiàn* in Wǎnpíng [宛平] and others along the imperial route, as well as for the various *zhōu* and *xiàn* under Tiānjīn Fǔ.
On the *jǐhài* day,
the accumulated taxes in Zhílì from the thirty-third to the thirty-fifth year were remitted.
On the *gēngzǐ* day,
the Emperor inspected the Diànhé [淀河] river.
On the *yǐsì* day,
the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, stayed in Tiānjīn.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
The accumulated taxes for the thirty-sixth year in nine *zhōu* and *xiàn* including Tōngzhōu [通州] and Bǎodǐ [寶坻] were remitted.
On the *rénzǐ* day,
the Emperor inspected the Yongding River.
On the *bǐngchén* day,
the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
In the intercalary third month, on the *jǐsì* day,
Zhālāfēng'ā [扎拉豐阿] was appointed Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard.
Liú Tǒngxūn [劉統勳] and others were appointed Chief Presidents for the compilation of the Sīkù Quánshū [四庫全書].
On the *yǐyǒu* day,
Sù'ěrnà [素爾訥] was appointed acting President of the Board of Works.
In the summer, fourth month, on the day Wùxū,
Chuòkètú was appointed Councillor Minister of Wūshí.
On the day Gēngxū,
Suǒlín was ordered to serve as acting Vice Minister of the Board of Rites in the Grand Council.
On the day Xīnhài,
Qìngguì was ordered to be Councillor Minister of Yīlí, as Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs and Deputy Lieutenant-General.
On the day Bǐngchén,
an edict was issued to Gāojìn to provide disaster relief to the flood victims in Qīnghé and other prefectures and counties, as well as the two garrisons of Dàhé and Chánghuái.
On the day Wùwǔ,
Grand Secretary Wēnfú, Minister of the Board of Revenue Shūhèdé, and Minister of the Board of Works Fúlóng'ān were granted the title of Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
Minister of the Board of Rites Wáng Jìhuá and Minister of the Board of Works Qiú Yuēxiū were granted the title of Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

Minister of the Board of Rites Āguì, acting Minister of the Board of War Fēngshēng'é, Governor-General of Zhílì Zhōu Yuánlǐ, Governor-General of Mǐnzhè Zhōngyīn, and Governor-General of Sìchuān Liú Bǐngtián were granted the title of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
In the fifth month, on the day Xīnyǒu,
Minister of the Board of Works Qiú Yuēxiū died,
and Jī Huáng replaced him.
On the day Bǐngyín,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, set out on a tour.
Three-tenths of the money and grain taxes for the current year were remitted in the areas they passed through.
On the day Rénshēn,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, sojourned at the Summer Resort.
On the day Yǐhài,
General of Shèngjīng Zēnghǎi died,
and Hóngshǎng was transferred to replace him.
On the day Dīngchǒu,
the title of Councillor Minister of Wūlǔmùqí was changed to Lieutenant-General,
with Suǒnuòmù Cèlíng appointed to the post,
still under the command of the General of Yīlí.
On the day Jǐmǎo,
the local headman of Měngzhē, Bālìzhāi, and others surrendered.
On the day Guǐwèi,
Chēbùdēng Zhābù was summoned to the capital,
and Lāwàng Duōěrdé was ordered to act as General of Wūlǐyàsūtái.
On the day Yǐsì,
Āguì and others reported that the Jīnchuān rebels had captured the Lama Temple's granary
and attacked and occupied Dǐmùdá and Bùláng Guōzōng.
On the day Jǐyǒu,
Èbǎo reported that the Jīnchuān rebels had attacked and occupied Dàbǎnzhāo.
On the day Rénzǐ,
General of Dìngbiān Wēnfú, Provincial Commander of Sìchuān Mǎ Quán, and acting Provincial Commander of Guìzhōu Niú Tiānbì were defeated at Mùguǒmù,
and all died.
On the day Guǐchǒu,
Āguì was appointed General of Dìngbiān,
and Wēnfú was posthumously granted the title of First-Class Earl.
Zéwàng, father of the chieftain of Xiǎojīnchuān Sēnggésāng, was executed.
Grand Secretary Liú Lún died.
On the day Jiǎyín,
Fùlèhún was appointed Governor-General of Sìchuān,
and Wénshòu was reinstated as Governor-General of Húguǎng.
On the day Bǐngchén,
Āguì reported on the suppression and cleansing of the Xiǎojīnchuān rebels,
destroying all their blockhouses,
and an edict was issued commending him.
In the autumn, seventh month, on the first day Wùwǔ,
Shūhèdé was summoned to the capital,
Yīlètú was appointed General of Yīlí,
and Qìngguì was appointed Councillor Minister of Tǎěrbāhātái.
On the day Jǐwèi,
the Jīnchuān rebels captured Měinuò and Míngguōzōng,
and Hǎilánchá retreated to Rìlóng.
An edict was issued to Āguì to retreat from Zhānggǔ,
and Fēngshēng'é to retreat and station at Bālālang and other places.
On the day Guǐhài,
Fùdé was ordered to go to the military camp as Councillor Minister,
and Āguì was ordered to withdraw the troops from Gáěrlā.
On the day Jiǎzǐ,
Shūhèdé was appointed Grand Secretary of Wǔyīngdiàn.
Āguì was transferred to Minister of the Board of Revenue,
and Yǒngguì to Minister of the Board of Rites.
On the day Bǐngyín,
Qíqíhāěr suffered a locust plague.
On the day Dīngmǎo,
because Wēnfú had mismanaged and ruined affairs,
his First-Class Earldom was revoked,
but he was still granted posthumous honors.
Liú Bǐngtián was stripped of his office.
Orders were given to discuss posthumous honors for Provincial Commanders Mǎ Quán and Niú Tiānbì who died in battle at Mùguǒmù,
Deputy Lieutenant-Generals Bāláng and Āěrsùnà,
Brigade-General Zhāng Dàjīng, and all civil and military officers.
On the day Bǐngxū,
an edict was issued to Āguì to first retake Xiǎojīnchuān,
advancing in three routes to suppress it.
In the eighth month, on the day Wùzǐ,
Āguì was appointed General of Dìngxī.
Yú Mǐnzhōng was appointed Grand Secretary of Wénhuádiàn,
Shūhèdé was put in charge of the Board of Punishments,
and Liú Tǒngxūn was exclusively in charge of the Board of Civil Office.
On the day Jǐchǒu,
Chéng Jǐngyī was ordered to assist as Grand Secretary.
Wáng Jìhuá was transferred to Minister of the Board of Revenue,
Cài Xīn to Minister of the Board of Rites,
and Jī Huáng to Minister of the Board of War.
Yán Xúnqí was appointed Minister of the Board of Works.
On the day Wùxū,
Míngliàng was appointed Right Deputy General of Dìngbiān,
and Fùdé was appointed Councillor Minister.
On the day Rén'yín,
