the Emperor went on a hunting expedition at Mùlán.
In the ninth month, on the day Rénxū,
Hǎilánchá was demoted to Commander of the Vanguard.
On the day Jiǎzǐ,
the Emperor returned to reside at the Summer Resort.
On the day Wùchén,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the capital.
On the day Jǐsì,
Suǒnuòmù took Sēnggésāng and returned to Dàjīnchuān,
sending his elder brother Gāngdákè to Měinuò.
An edict was issued to Āguì to seize the opportunity to recover the territory.
The request from the Board of Revenue to open donations for Jīnchuān military expenses was granted.
On the day Rénshēn,
the Emperor returned to the capital from the Summer Resort.
On the day Jiǎxū,
Duōmǐn was appointed Councillor Minister of Kēbùduō,
and Chēmùchǔkè Zhābù was appointed Councillor Minister of Wūlǐyàsūtái.
On the day Wùyín,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
On the day Gēngchén,
Minister of the Board of Civil Office Tuōyōng retired,
and Guānbǎo was transferred to Minister of the Board of Civil Office.
Yīnglián was appointed Minister of the Board of Punishments,
and still concurrently managed the affairs of Vice Minister of the Board of Revenue.
In the winter, tenth month, on the day Yǐsì,
Prince Héshuò Xián Qīnwáng Yǔnmì died.
On the day Jǐyǒu,
Chēbùdēng Zhābù was stripped of his title as Left Deputy General of Dìngbiān,
but retained his princely title,
and Hútúlíng'ā replaced him.
In the eleventh month, on the day Dīngmǎo,
Āguì and others reported on advancing to suppress Xiǎojīnchuān,
attacking and capturing Zīlǐ Shānliáng and other places,
and recovering Wòkèshí government stockades.
On the day Wùchén,
Fúlù was ordered to go to Xīníng to handle affairs.
Wǔmǐtài was summoned back to the capital.
On the day Jǐsì,
Āguì and others reported on recapturing Měinuò,
and were ordered to advance to suppress Jīnchuān.
On the day Xīnwèi,
Grand Councillor and Grand Secretary Liú Tǒngxūn died,
the Emperor personally attended the memorial service
and posthumously granted him the title of Grand Tutor.
On the day Rénshēn,
Liáng Guózhì was summoned to the capital
to serve in the Grand Council.
Bāyánsān was transferred to Governor of Húnán.
Bì Yuán was appointed Governor of Shǎnxī.
On the day Guǐyǒu,
Míngliàng and others reported on recapturing Sēnggézōng and other blockhouses.
In the twelfth month, on the day Guǐsì,
Zhāngbǎo was appointed Governor-General of Yún-Guì.
On the day Xīnchǒu,
Lǐ Shìyáo was appointed Grand Secretary of Wǔyīngdiàn,
and still concurrently managed the affairs of Governor-General of Liǎngguǎng.
This year,
Cháoxiǎn and Ānnán paid tribute.
In the thirty-ninth year, spring, first month, on the day Bǐngzǐ,
Yáo Lìdé was appointed Governor-General of River Affairs for Hédōng.
On the day Dīngchǒu,
Āguì and others captured Zànbālākè and other mountain ridges.
In the second month, on the first day Jiǎshēn,
Fēngshēng'é and others were ordered to assist Āguì in attacking Lèwūwéi.
On the day Dīnghài,
Míngliàng and others reported on capturing Mùxī and other mountain ridges.
On the day Wùxū,
Fēngshēng'é and others captured Mòěrmǐn mountain ridge.
On the day Yǐsì,
the excess tax burdens for the thirty-eighth year due to flood disaster in Shānyáng and other ten prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Jiāngsū were remitted with varying degrees.
On the day Dīngwèi,
the Emperor went to the Eastern Tombs
and also visited Pánshān.
On the day Gēngxū,
he visited the Zhāoxīlíng, Xiàolíng, Xiàodōnglíng, and Jǐnglíng,
and offered libations at the tomb of Empress Xiàoxián.
He personally attended the memorial service at the tomb of the late Grand Secretary, Duke Fùhéng.
On the day Xīnhài,
the Emperor sojourned at Pánshān.
In the third month, on the day Gēngshēn,
Āguì and others captured Luóbówǎ mountain ridge,
Āguì was granted the title of Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent,
Hǎilánchá was appointed Inner Grand Minister,
and Érsēntè was appointed Minister without Portfolio.
On the day Jiǎzǐ,
the Emperor went on a hunting expedition in the Southern Park.
On the day Xīnwèi,
Āguì and others captured Désīdōng stockade.
On the day Gēngchén,
Míngliàng and others captured Kāzápǔ and other places,
and the Emperor praised and rewarded them.
In the summer, fourth month, on the day Yǐyǒu,
Shùntiān, Dàxīng, and other prefectures and counties suffered a locust plague.
On the day Xīnhài,
due to drought in the capital and nearby areas,
the Board of Punishments was ordered to clear minor cases,
and crimes below military exile were reduced,
and Zhílì followed suit.
On the day Wùxū,
the Emperor commended Censor Lǐ Shùfāng for impeaching Fúlóng'ān's household for causing trouble,
and rewarded him.
In the fifth month, on the *guǐchǒu* day (1st day of the month),
an edict was issued to the Board of Punishments to reduce sentences for crimes that had been deferred one, two, or more times during the autumn and court reviews.
On the *bǐngyín* day,
Zhāngbǎo resigned due to illness,
and Túsīdé was appointed acting Governor-General of Yún-Guì.
On the *wùchén* day,
the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, went on the autumn hunt at Mùlán.
On the *jiǎxū* day,
the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, stayed at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
In the sixth month, on the *guǐmǎo* day,
Àguì and others reported conquering the forts (*diāokǎ*) at Mùěrhúntú.
In autumn, the seventh month, on the *jiǎyín* day,
Àguì and others conquered the mountain forts (*diāokǎ*) at Sèpíngpǔ.
On the *jǐwèi* day,
Àguì and others conquered the mountain forts (*diāokǎ*) at Lāmùlāmù, etc.
On the *rénxū* day,
Àguì and others conquered the temple forts (*sìdiāo*) at Rìzéyǎkǒu and other places.
On the *yǐchǒu* day,
the Èlǔtè tribe of Wūlǔmùqí suffered from a locust plague.
On the *gēngwǔ* day,
Míngliàng and others conquered the forts (*diāokǎ*) on the Dárrtú mountain ridge.
On the *jiǎxū* day,
Yú Mǐnzhōng was accused of failing to report the public affairs entrusted by the eunuch Gāo Yúncóng,
and the matter was submitted to the board for severe deliberation.
Āsīhā was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.
On the *yǐhài* day,
Àsīhā was ordered to serve in the Grand Council (*Jūnjī Chù*).
The eunuch Gāo Yúncóng was executed by beheading.
On the *xīnsì* day,
Àguì and others conquered the forts and stockades (*diāozhài*) at Gélǔwǎjué and other places.
In the eighth month, on the *rénwǔ* day (1st day of the month),
there was a solar eclipse.
On the *rénchén* day,
Fùdé and others conquered the forts (*diāokǎ*) at Mùdānggáěr, Yángquān, and other places.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
the Emperor visited Mùlán for a hunt.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
the Jīnchuān chieftain Chuòwòsījiǎ surrendered,
and offered the body of the bandit leader Sēnggésāng.
In the ninth month, on the *yǐmǎo* day,
evil commoners Wáng Lún and others in Shòuzhāng County, Shāndōng, plotted rebellion,
and Xú Jī, the Governor of Shāndōng, was ordered to suppress and capture them.
On the *dīngsì* day,
Grand Secretary Shūhèdé was ordered to go to Jiāngnán
to join Gāo Jìn in stopping the breach.
On the *wùmǎo* day,
the Emperor returned to the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
Shūhèdé was ordered to first go to Shāndōng to suppress and capture Wáng Lún.
On the *gēngshēn* day,
Prince Consort Lāwàngduōěrzhì and Left Censor-in-Chief Āsīhā were ordered to lead imperial guards (*shìwèi*), military officers (*zhāngjīng*), and soldiers from the Jianrui and Huòqì battalions
to Shāndōng to assist in suppressing Wáng Lún.
On the *xīnyǒu* day,
Wáng Lún besieged Línqīng
and camped at Zháokǒu.
On the *rénxū* day,
the Emperor saw the Empress Dowager off as she returned to the capital.
On the *guǐhài* day,
due to drought in seven counties of Tiānjīn Prefecture,
one hundred thousand *shí* of public grain were ordered to be allocated for relief.
On the *bǐngyín* day,
the Emperor returned to the capital from the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
Wéiyī, Commander-in-Chief of Yǎnzhōu Garrison in Shāndōng, and Gétúkěn, Garrison Commander of Dézhōu City, were
executed by beheading for retreating during battle.
On the *gēngwǔ* day,
due to floods in four counties including Shānyáng in Jiāngsū,
the land tax for the following year was remitted.
On the *rénshēn* day,
the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital (*Jīngshī*).
On the *bǐngzǐ* day,
the bandits in Línqīng, Shāndōng, were pacified,
and Wáng Lún burned himself to death.
In winter, the tenth month, on the *xīnsì* day (1st day of the month),
Yáng Jǐngsù was appointed Governor of Shāndōng.
On the *rénchén* day,
the outstanding land tax for the current year in Xīnchéng, Línqīng, was remitted,
along with five-tenths of the outstanding land tax for Jiùchéng.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
Xú Jī was appointed Governor of Hénán.
In the eleventh month, on the *guǐchǒu* day,
Míngliàng and others conquered the forts and stockades (*diāozhài*) at Rìpáng, etc.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
Shūhèdé was appointed Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard (*Yùqián Dàchén*).
Àguì and others conquered the forts and stockades (*diāozhài*) at Rìěrbādānggá.
Àguì was appointed Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard (*Yùqián Dàchén*),
and Hǎilánchá was appointed Imperial Bodyguard (*Yùqián Shìwèi*).
On the *bǐngchén* day,
due to military campaigns and grain transportation in one hundred and forty prefectures, subprefectures, departments, and counties including Chéngdū in Sìchuān,
their historical land taxes were remitted to varying degrees.
On the *wùchén* day,
Àguì conquered the forts and stockades (*diāozhài*) at Gélǔgǔyākǒu and other places.
In this year,
Cháoxiǎn and Líuqiú came to pay tribute.
In the fortieth year, spring, the first month, on the *jiǎxū* day,
Àguì and others conquered Kāngěrsà mountain ridge.
In the second month, on the *jǐmǎo* day,
Àguì and others conquered the forts and stockades (*diāozhài*) at Jiǎěrnà and other places.
On the *bǐngxū* day,
Àguì conquered the forts and stockades (*diāozhài*) at Sīmòsīdá.
On the *guǐsì* day,
Lǐ Hàn was appointed Governor of Yúnnán.
In the third month, on the *xīnhài* day,
the Emperor visited Pán Shān.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
the Emperor stayed at Pán Shān.
The land tax for thirty-nine years of floods and droughts in nineteen prefectures and counties including Jùróng in Jiāngnán,
and Huái'ān and Dàhé Two Wei garrisons, was remitted.
On the *rénshēn* day,
the land tax for thirty-five years of drought in six prefectures and counties including Cāngzhōu, subordinate to Chánglú, and six salt fields including Yánzhèn,
and five prefectures and counties including Xìnyáng in Hénán, was remitted.
Summer, the fourth month, on the *wùyín* day (1st day of the month),
the land tax for thirty-nine years of drought in fourteen prefectures and counties including Héféi in Ānhuī, and four Wei garrisons including Lúzhōu, was remitted.
On the *bǐngxū* day,

Sèbùténgbālèzhūěr, Military Advisor (*Cānzàn Dàchén*) for the Sìchuān Military Camp, Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard (*Lǐng Shìwèi Nèi Dàchén*), Prince of the First Rank (*Héshuò Qīnwáng*), and Emperor's Son-in-Law of the First Rank (*Gùlún Éfù*), died.
On the *jǐchǒu* day,
Míngshān was appointed Military Advisor (*Cānzàn Dàchén*) for Wūlǐyàsūtái.
On the *rényín* day,
Wú Xīlíng and one hundred and fifty-eight others were granted the *jìnshì* degree with varying ranks.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
Àguì and others conquered the city forts (*chéngdiāo*) at Mùsīgōnggákèyākǒu and other places.
Míngliàng and others conquered Jiǎsuǒ and Yíxǐ.
On the *yǐsì* day,
Míngliàng and others conquered the forts and stockades (*diāozhài*) at Dáěrtú and other places.
Míngliàng and Fúkāng'ān were appointed Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard (*Nèi Dàchén*).
In the fifth month, on the *jǐyǒu* day,
the land tax for thirty-nine years of drought in thirty-nine prefectures and counties including Bàzhōu and Bǎodìng in Zhílì, was remitted.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
Àguì and others reported conquering the forts (*diāokǎ*) at Bāmùtōng and other places.
On the *dīngsì* day,
Míngliàng reported conquering the forts (*diāokǎ*) at Rúzhài, Jiǎsuǒ, and other places.
On the *wùchén* day,
Àguì and others reported conquering the forts and stockades (*diāozhài*) at Gáěrdān, etc.
On the *rénshēn* day,
the Emperor visited Mùlán,
and accompanied the Empress Dowager to stay at the Tāngshān Imperial Palace.
Míngliàng and others reported conquering the forts and stockades (*diāozhài*) at Bāshěshí, etc.
On the *yǐhài* day,
Àguì and others reported conquering the forts and stockades (*diāozhài*) at Xùnkèrzōng, etc.

Fēngshēng'é, who held the titles of Right Vice General Pacifying the Borders (*Dìngbiān Yòufù Jiāngjūn*) and Duke Guǒyì (*Guǒyì Gōng*), was further enfeoffed as Duke Guǒyì Jìyǒng (*Guǒyì Jìyǒng Gōng*).
In the sixth month, on the *dīngchǒu* day (1st day of the month),
the land tax for thirty-nine years of drought in fifteen prefectures and counties including Hànyáng in Húběi, and six Wei garrisons and one post including Wǔchāng, was remitted.
On the *wùyín* day,
the Emperor stayed at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the *guǐwèi* day,
the Emperor went to the Wànshòutíng at Guǎngrénlǐng to welcome the Empress Dowager to stay at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the *rénchén* day,
Fēngshēng'é was appointed Minister of War (*Bīngbù Shàngshū*).
On the *bǐngshēn* day,
Ěrtè, the leading minister, was dismissed from office and arrested for investigation.
On the *gēngzǐ* day,
the position of Leading Minister to Manage the Wūlǔmùqí Èlǔtè Tribes was established,
and Quánjiǎn was appointed to it.
Autumn, the seventh month, on the *rénxū* day,
Àguì and others reported attacking and conquering the mountain ridge forts and stockades (*diāozhài*) at Kūnsèěr and other places.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
Àguì and others conquered the forts and stockades (*diāozhài*) at Zhānggá, etc.
Géshíjiǎmcān, chieftain of the Èluòmù Stockade, and his followers came to surrender.
On the *gēngwǔ* day,
the land tax for thirty-nine years of floods and droughts in seven departments, prefectures, and counties including Gāolán in Gānsù, was remitted.
Àguì and others conquered the forts and stockades (*diāozhài*) in the Zhígǔnǎo area.
In the eighth month, on the *bǐngzǐ* day (1st day of the month),
there was a solar eclipse.
On the *dīngchǒu* day,
Àguì and others conquered the Lóngsīdé Stockade.
Míngliàng and others conquered Zhāwūgǔ mountain ridge.
On the *jǐmǎo* day,
due to floods in over thirty prefectures and counties including Bàzhōu,
five hundred thousand taels of silver from the Zhílì Provincial Treasury were allocated for relief.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
the Emperor visited Mùlán for a hunt.
On the *jǐhài* day,
Àguì and others reported the victory in conquering Lèwūwéi,
and proceeded to suppress the Gálāyī bandit stockade.
The Emperor bestowed generous rewards upon General Àguì,
Vice General Fēngshēng'é,
and Military Advisors Hǎilánchá, Ésēntè, and others for their merits.
On the *xīnchǒu* day,
Shūhèdé was summoned to the imperial temporary residence in Rèhé.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
Luóbùzàngxīlābù was enfeoffed as *Bèizǐ*.
On the *yǐsì* day,
Vice Minister Yuán Shǒudòng and others were ordered to go to Guìzhōu
to investigate the case where Prefect Sū Qiáo reported that the Governor-General, Provincial Treasurer, and Provincial Judicial Commissioner had shielded Assistant Prefect Xí Zuǎn.
In the ninth month, on the *gēngxū* day,
the land tax for thirty-nine years of drought in twelve prefectures and counties including Zhōngxiáng in Húběi, and seven Wei garrisons including Wǔchāng, was remitted.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
the Emperor returned to stay at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the *dīngsì* day,
the Emperor saw the Empress Dowager off as she returned to the capital.
On the *xīnyǒu* day,
Túsīdé impeached Sū Qiáo for excessive levies and extortion,
and Yuán Shǒudòng and others were ordered to conduct a strict interrogation.
On the *bǐngyín* day,
Míngliàng was severely reprimanded
for requesting to go to the western route and missing the opportunity,
and was stripped of his title as Guangzhou General.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
the Emperor, accompanying the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital (*Jīngshī*).
Àguì and others conquered the forts and stockades (*diāozhài*) at Dānggákèdǐ and other places.
In winter, in the tenth month, on the day *jǐmǎo*,
Wǔ Mítài, Resident Amban in Tibet, was summoned
and replaced by Liú Bǎozhù.
On the day *jǐchǒu*,
as Bāzhōu and six other prefectures and counties were severely affected by disaster,
an order was issued to immediately distribute relief in the intercalary tenth month.
On the day *gēngyín*,
the land tax for water, hail, and frost damage in Gānsù, Gāolán, and seventeen other prefectures, counties, and departments was remitted.
On the day *rénchén*,
the Emperor returned to the palace.
On the day *bǐngshēn*,
Péi Zōngxī was transferred to be Governor of Guìzhōu,
Yuán Shǒudòng was ordered to temporarily act in his stead,
Tú Sīdé was appointed acting Governor of Yúnnán,
and Lǐ Zhìyǐng was appointed Governor of Ānhuī.
In the intercalary tenth month, on the day *rénzǐ*,
Sū Qiáo, for extortion and slander,
was sentenced to execution by beheading.
On the day *rénxū*,
Míngliàng and others reported capturing the mountain pass of Zhāwūgǔ.
On the day *jiǎzǐ*,
Āguì and others reported capturing the fortified blockhouses at Xīlǐ Mountain, Huángcǎopíng, and other places;
Commander Cáo Shùn died there.
Yuán Shǒudòng was ordered to go to Sìchuān
to jointly adjudicate the case of Jì Guóxūn with Āyáng'ā.
Qìnghéng was again enfeoffed as Prince Kèqín of the First Rank.
On the day *rénshēn*,
Míngliàng and others captured the village of Ěrdégǔ.
In the eleventh month,
Míngliàng and others captured the fortified blockhouses at Jiǎsuǒ and other places.
On the day *yǐyǒu*,
Fúlù, having failed to fully investigate the case of Lìtǎ'ěr,
was dismissed
and banished to Yīlí.
On the day *jǐchǒu*,
Āguì captured the second peak of Xīlǐ and
advanced to besiege the villages of Yāmǎpéng.
On the day *rénchén*,
Míngliàng and others reported attacking and capturing the fortified blockhouses at Kè'ěrjiǎ'ěrgǔ and other places.
On the day *rényín*,
Āguì and others reported capturing the fortified villages at Shèlègùzǔlǔ, Kēsīguǒmù, Ā'ěrgǔ, and other places.
In the twelfth month, on the day *jiǎchén*, which was the new moon,
there was a solar eclipse.
On the day *dīngwèi*,
Yán Xúnqí, Minister of Public Works, died;
Jī Huáng was transferred to be Minister of Public Works,
Cài Xīn to be Minister of War,
and Cáo Xiùxiān was appointed Minister of Rites.
Āguì and others captured the villages of Sà'ěrwāi and other places.
On the day *bǐngchén*,
Āguì was appointed Grand Minister of the Interior, Imperial Bodyguard of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
Xióng Xuépéng was transferred to be Governor of Guǎngdōng,
and Wú Hǔbǐng was appointed Governor of Guǎngxī.
On the day *jiǎzǐ*,
Míngliàng and others advanced from Dásàgǔ Valley,
successively capturing strategic mountain passes and the riverside villages of Gé'ěrzé.
On the day *bǐngyín*,
Āguì and others captured the villages of Gélónggǔ and other places.
On the day *gēngwǔ*,
Āguì and others advanced from Suǒlónggǔ to occupy the Gázhān mountain pass,
directly attacking Gālāyī.
Their leaders Sèmùlǐ Yǒngzhōng and Bùlóngpǔ Ānàmù surrendered.
On the day *rénshēn*,
Míngliàng and others captured the passes of Jiǎzá and other places,
and the rear routes of Bābùlǐ and Rìgàigǔluò,
advancing to the Dúsōng Pass,
and were to attack Gālāyī jointly the next day.
Their leaders Dágùlādé'ěrwā and others surrendered.
Annals Volume 14, Annals of Emperor Gāozōng, Part 5
In the forty-first year, in spring, in the first month, on the day *guǐyǒu*, which was the new moon,
Fùdé captured the fortified blockhouses of Dágázāpǔdé'ěrwō, Mǎ'ěrbāng, and others.
Míngliàng and others captured the fortified blockhouses of Dúsōng and others.
On the day *jiǎxū*,
Prince Dìng, Miándé, was stripped of his title for colluding with officials of the Board of Rites;
Mián'ēn was ordered to inherit the title.
Āguì captured the fortified blockhouses of Lāwūlā and other places, and the temples of Shèqí and others.
On the day *jǐmǎo*,
Āguì led all the armies to besiege Gālāyī,
and Sǒngnuòmù's mother, his aunt, and sisters surrendered.
Āguì was ordered to be enfeoffed as Duke Chéngmóu Yīngyǒng of the First Rank,
and given a four-dragon official robe and a golden-yellow belt.
Guǒyì Jìyǒng Gōng Fēngshēng'é was additionally rewarded with the rank of First Class Viscount.
Míngliàng was enfeoffed as Earl Xiāngyǒng of the First Rank,
Hǎilánchá as Marquis Chāoyǒng of the First Rank,
Ésēntè as Baron of the First Rank,
Hélóngwǔ as Marquis Guǒyǒng of the Third Rank,
Fúkāng'ān and Pǔ'ěrpǔ as Barons of the Third Rank.
Kuílín was additionally rewarded with the rank of Baron of the First Rank.
Fēngshēng'é, Míngliàng, Hǎilánchá, Kuílín, and Hélóngwǔ were each still granted double-eyed peacock feathers,
and Yú Mǐnzhōng was rewarded with the rank of Light Chariot Commandant of the First Class,
all hereditary.
Āguì requested to resettle the surrendered people in the twelve chieftain areas of Chuòsījiǎbù,
which was granted.
On the day *rénwǔ*,
Āguì was rewarded with purple reins.
On the day *jiǎshēn*,
Míngshàn was transferred to be Amban Councillor of Kēbùduō.
Fǎfúlǐ was appointed Amban Councillor of Wūlǐyàsūtái.
On the day *jǐchǒu*,
Guānbǎo, Minister of Personnel and Assistant Grand Secretary, requested retirement due to illness,
which was granted.
Āguì was appointed Minister of Personnel and Assistant Grand Secretary.
Fēngshēng'é was transferred to be Minister of Revenue,
and Fúlóng'ān to be Minister of War.
Chuòkètú was appointed Minister of Public Works.
On the day *gēngyín*,
Jiāmó was promoted to Vice Minister of the Granaries.
Āsīhā was ordered to act as Governor-General of Grain Transport,
Yǒngguì as acting Minister of Personnel,
and Yīnglián as acting Minister of Revenue.
In the second month, on the day *jǐyǒu*,
Wénshòu was appointed Governor-General of Sìchuān,
and Fùlèhún was transferred to be Governor-General of Húguǎng.
On the day *gēngxū*,
an order was issued that from now on, during sacrifices at the Altar of Land and Grain,
if there is wind or rain,
the sacrifices should be performed inside the hall.
The land tax for the forty-year drought disaster in Jiāngsū, Shàngyuán, and thirty-nine other prefectures and counties, and Zhènjiāng and five other garrisons, was remitted.
On the day *xīnhài*,
the Emperor visited the Eastern Mausoleum.
Because of the visits to the two mausoleums
and the tour of Shāndōng,
three tenths of the current year's land tax was remitted for the prefectures and counties passed through.
On the day *jiǎyín*,
the Emperor visited the Zhāoxī Mausoleum, Xiàolíng, Xiàodōnglíng, and Jǐnglíng,
and offered wine at the mausoleum of Empress Xiàoxián.
Āguì and others reported that Sǒngnuòmù and others had surrendered,
and were being sent to the capital in cages;
the two Jīnchuān regions were pacified.
On the day *yǐmǎo*,
Yǒngguì was ordered to return to Minister of Rites,
still concurrently acting as Minister of Personnel.
On the day *bǐngchén*,
an order was issued to paint portraits of the fifty meritorious officials, before and after the pacification of Jīnchuān, in the Zǐguāng Gé.
A newly established general was ordered to be stationed in Yǎzhōu,
and Guìlín, Provincial Commander-in-Chief of Sìchuān, to be stationed in Jīnchuān.
On the day *dīngsì*,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
On the day *wǔwǔ*,
the Emperor visited the Tàilíng Mausoleum.
Yuán Shǒudòng was ordered to go to Sìchuān
to jointly investigate Amban Councillor Fùdé with Āguì.
On the day *rénxū*,
the Emperor visited the Tàilíng Mausoleum.
A Commander-in-Chief was established for Téngyuè Garrison in Yúnnán.
On the day *dīngmǎo*,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager on a tour to Shāndōng.
On the day *jǐsì*,
the uncollected land tax grain and granary grain for Shùntiān, Zhílì, Tōngzhōu, and twenty-eight other prefectures and counties was remitted.
On the day *gēngwǔ*,
the survey of lake land in Húběi was halted.
The uncollected land tax grain and granary grain for Zhílì, Bāzhōu, and twenty-one other prefectures and counties was remitted.
On the day *xīnwèi*,
the sentences for crimes below military exile in Zhílì were reduced.
On the *dīngchǒu* day of the third month,
the regular taxes for the current year in Tàiyán and Qūfù counties in Shāndōng were remitted.
On the *wùyín* day,
various outstanding civilian taxes in thirty-nine prefectures, counties, and garrisons, including Zōupíng in Shāndōng, were remitted.
On the *jǐmǎo* day,
the General of Chéngdū was newly established,
with Míngliàng appointed to the post.
On the *xīnsì* day,
punishments for crimes by military exiles and lesser offenders in Shāndōng were reduced.
On the *rénwǔ* day,
the postponed collection of grain tribute and tribute levies from eleven prefectures and counties, including Dézhōu in Shāndōng, was remitted.
On the *guǐwèi* day,
Sāzài was appointed Governor-General of Riverways for Jiāngnán,
and Yáng Kuí was appointed Governor of Jiāngsū.
On the *jiǎshēn* day,
Lèlěrjǐn had an audience,
and Bì Yuán was ordered to serve as acting Governor-General of Shǎnxī and Gānsù.
On the *bǐngxū* day,
the Emperor sojourned in Tàiyán,
and visited the Dài Temple.
He ordered the return of tribute articles from governors and governors-general,
and again strictly admonished them.
A Brigade-General was established for Lèwūwéi in Jīnchuān.
On the *dīnghài* day,
the Emperor ascended Mount Tài.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
Wáng Jìhuá, Minister of the Board of Revenue, died,
and Yuán Shǒudòng was appointed to replace him.
The regular taxes for the previous year and the barbarian taxes for the current year in the entire province of Sìchuān were remitted with varying degrees of reduction.
Forty years of regular taxes due to flood disaster in Wǔzhì County, Hénán, were remitted.
On the *yǐwèi* day,
the Emperor arrived at Qūfù,
and visited the Temple of Kǒngzǐ (Confucius).
Forty years of regular taxes due to flood and drought disasters in thirty-two prefectures and counties, including Huáiníng in Ānhuī, and seven garrisons, including Jiànyáng, were remitted.
On the *bǐngshēn* day,
a sacrificial ceremony was offered to the Former Master Kǒngzǐ,
announcing the success in pacifying both Jīnchuān.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
the Emperor visited the Kǒng Lín (Confucian Forest).
Lǐ Zhìyǐng was transferred to be Governor of Guǎngdōng,
and Mǐn Èyuán was appointed Governor of Ānhuī.
On the *wùxū* day,
Fùdé was stripped of his office and arrested for trial.
On the *jǐhài* day,
Dāo Wéipíng and other fleeing barbarians from Chēlǐ, Yúnnán, repented and surrendered themselves.
An imperial edict remitted their death sentence,
but imprisoned them.
On the *gēngzǐ* day,
Héshēn, Vice Minister of the Board of Revenue, was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
On the *xīnchǒu* day,
the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, embarked from Jìníng.
On the *guǐmǎo* day of the fourth month in summer,
due to the pacification of Jīnchuān,
officials were dispatched to offer sacrifices to Heaven and Earth, the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and the Altars of Soil and Grain.
Yīnglián was appointed to concurrently serve as acting Minister of the Board of Revenue.
Liú Yōng was ordered to collaborate with Chén Huīzǔ to inspect the collapsed dikes in Miǎnyáng Prefecture, Húběi.
On the *jiǎchén* day,
Guānbǎo, Grand Secretary Assisting in Administration and Minister of the Board of Personnel, who had retired, died.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
the Emperor reviewed the old city of Línqīng Prefecture.
On the *xīnhài* day,
Āguì was ordered to continue serving in the Grand Council.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
forty years of regular taxes due to flood disaster in fifty-two prefectures and counties, including Bàzhōu in Zhílì, were remitted with varying degrees of reduction.
On the *yǐmǎo* day,
due to the pacification of Jīnchuān,
officials were dispatched to offer sacrifices to Zhāoxīlíng, Xiàolíng, Xiàodōnglíng, Jǐnglíng, Tàilíng, and the tomb of Empress Xiàoxián.
On the *bǐngchén* day,
officials were dispatched to offer sacrifices to Kǒngzǐ Quèlǐ (the birthplace of Confucius).
On the *rénxū* day,
officials were dispatched to offer sacrifices to Yǒnglíng, Fúlíng, and Zhāolíng.
On the *jiǎzǐ* day,
Āsīhā was appointed Governor-General of Grain Transport,
Sùěrnà was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left,
Suǒlín was appointed Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs,
while remaining to handle affairs in Kùlún,
and Fēngshēng'é was ordered to serve as acting Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
On the *yǐchǒu* day,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the capital from Bǎojiàyíng.
On the *bǐngyín* day,
Jīnchuān captives and severed heads were presented at the imperial ancestral temple and altars of soil and grain.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
Āguì, General Fúyuǎn, and others returned triumphantly.
On the *wùchén* day,
the Emperor went to the south of Liángxiāng city to perform the suburban welcoming ceremony,
and bestowed a banquet upon the general and the participating officers and soldiers,
and also awarded Āguì and others one imperial saddle and horse each.
The Emperor returned to the capital.
On the *jǐsì* day,
the captives were received.
The Emperor presided at Yíngtái,
and personally interrogated the captives.
Suǒnuòmù and others were all dismembered in the marketplace.
The Emperor presided at Zǐguāng Gé,
performed the *yǐnzhì* ceremony (triumphal feast),
and bestowed a banquet upon the victorious officers and soldiers, and princes and ministers,
and awarded Āguì, the general, and those below him silver and silk in varying amounts.
On the *gēngwǔ* day,
the barbarian leaders Bùlóngpǔzhànbā, Yámápéng'ākùlǔ, and others were beheaded in the marketplace.
On the *xīnwèi* day, the first day of the fifth month,
the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, presided at Cíníng Gōng,
and conferred an honorary title: Chóngqìng Cíxuān Kānghuì Dūnhé Yùshòu Chúnxī Gōngyì Ānqí Níngyù Huáng Tàihòu (Empress Dowager Chóngqìng Cíxuān Kānghuì Dūnhé Yùshòu Chúnxī Gōngyì Ānqí Níngyù),
and issued an imperial edict extending grace in varying degrees.
On the *wùyín* day,
Fùdé was executed by beheading for falsely accusing Āguì of treason.
On the *xīnsì* day,
the fictitious poll tax silver quota for three counties, including Shílóu in Shānxī, was exempted.
On the *guǐwèi* day,
the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, began the imperial hunt,
the autumn hunt in Mùlán.
On the *jǐchǒu* day,
the Emperor sojourned at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng (Mountain Resort).
On the *gēngzǐ* day, the first day of the sixth month,
the official system for Wényuāngé was established.
On the *rénzǐ* day,
due to drought disaster in twenty-nine prefectures, counties, and departments, including Gāolán in Gānsù,
it was ordered that more market grain be retained to supply the people's food.
On the *gēngshēn* day,
Huáng Bāngníng was sentenced to beheading,
and Sūěrdé, former acting Governor of Guǎngxī, and Guǎngdé, acting Surveillance Commissioner, were arrested for trial.
On the *gēngshēn* day of the seventh month in autumn,
Suǒlín was demoted for dereliction of duty,
and Wǔmítài was appointed Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
On the *dīnghài* day,
Bāyánsān was appointed Governor of Shānxī,
and Èbǎo was transferred to be Governor of Húnán.
On the *dīngwèi* day of the eighth month,
Hútúlíng'ā was summoned,
Bālíng Wáng Bātú was appointed Left Deputy General of Dìngbiān,
and Èfù Lāwàngduōěrzhǐ was appointed Resident Minister in Yīlí.
On the *yǐmǎo* day,
the Emperor went to Mùlán for a hunt.
On the *bǐngzǐ* day of the ninth month,
the Emperor returned to sojourn at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the *gēngchén* day,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the capital.
On the *gēngyín* day,
the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
On the *jǐhài* day, the first day of the tenth month in winter,
Fēngshēng'é was appointed Commandant of the Gendarmerie,
and Fúlóng'ān continued to concurrently manage.
On the *rényín* day,
Róngbǎo, General of Suīyuǎndé City, was dismissed,
and Wǔmítài was appointed to replace him.
On the *jiǎchén* day,
Yīngchéng Gōng Ākèdòng'ā was ordered to serve among the Grand Ministers of the Imperial Bodyguard,
and Kuílín was appointed Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
On the *wùshēn* day,
Zhāng Ruòyàn, Censor-in-Chief of the Left, was dismissed due to illness.
On the *xīnhài* day,
Cuī Yīngjiē was transferred to be Censor-in-Chief of the Left,
and Yú Wényí was appointed Minister of the Board of Punishments.
On the *rénzǐ* day,
Āsīhā was dismissed due to illness,
and Èbǎo was appointed Governor-General of Grain Transport.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
Dūnfú was appointed Governor of Húnán.
On the *bǐngchén* day,
Sānbǎo was ordered to investigate the accumulated malpractices in Zhejiang's grain transport.
On the *jiǎzǐ* day,
due to drought disaster in twenty-nine departments, prefectures, and counties, including Gāolán in Gānsù,
over four million *shí* of accumulated outstanding granary grain from previous years were exempted.
On the *jiǎshēn* day of the eleventh month,
the Sùkù Quánshūguǎn (Imperial Library) was ordered to carefully review various prohibited books,
and classify them for revision or destruction.
An imperial edict stated:
"For the collected writings of various individuals from the late Míng dynasty whose words and ideas conflicted with the current dynasty,
such as Qián Qiānyì and others,
who failed to die for their principles [loyalty],
and wantonly indulged in wild criticism,
they should be investigated and destroyed.
Liú Zōngzhōu and Huáng Dàozhōu upheld integrity in court,
and Xióng Tíngbì possessed outstanding talent and ability for governance.
If their words [advice]
had been adopted at the time,
the downfall might not have been so swift.
Therefore, only the wording needs to be changed;
there is no need to destroy them.
Furthermore, for upright officials like Yáng Lián and others,
even if there are one or two offensive phrases,
they only need to be appropriately revised.
It is truly unbearable to burn and discard them all."
On the Gēngzǐ day of the twelfth month,
an edict was issued for a translation xiāngshì to be held in the eighth month of the Wùxū year,
and a huìshì in the third month of the following year.
On the Bǐngwǔ day,
Míngliàng was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
Wǔmítài was transferred to become the Xi'ān General,
and Bóchéng was appointed acting Suīyuǎnchéng General.
On the Wùshēn day,
Yǎláng'ā was appointed Suīyuǎnchéng General.
On the Jiǎyín day,
the current year's disaster-stricken fixed taxes for Dézhōu and thirty other zhōuxiàn and wèisuǒ in Shāndōng were remitted.
On the Bǐngchén day,
the Burmese chieftain Déluwùn requested the return of officials from the interior.
His request to offer tribute was granted.
An edict was issued for them to proceed to the capital to plead for favor.
On the Wùwǔ day,
the Emperor visited Yíngtái.
The Āqímù Bóké of Kùchē, envoys from Hāsàkè,
and the indigenous chieftain of Míngzhèng in Sìchuān, among others, had an audience.
Each was bestowed with different robes and hats.
On the Wùchén day, the first day of the first month of spring in the forty-second year,
more than 840,000 liǎng of silver owed by the populace of Gānsù from Qiánlóng twenty-third year to thirty-fifth year were remitted.
On the Bǐngzǐ day,
the Emperor reviewed troops at the Yuèwǔlóu,
ordering the various princes, high officials, Mongol vassals, as well as envoys from the Huíbù, Kùchē, Hāsàkè, and the Jīnchuān indigenous chieftain, to observe.
On the Xīnsì day,
due to the Empress Dowager's indisposition,
the Emperor went to Chángchūn Xiānguǎn to inquire about her health.
The Empress Dowager was escorted to Tónglèyuán,
and the Emperor attended her at dinner.
From then on, he visited Chángchūn Xiānguǎn daily to offer greetings.
On the Yǐyǒu day,
due to TúSīdé's memorial stating that the Burmese had pledged allegiance,
Āguì was ordered to Yúnnán to make arrangements.
Lǐ Shìyáo was transferred to be the Yúnguì Governor-General,
Yáng Jǐngsù was appointed Liǎngdù Governor-General,
Hǎo Shuò was appointed Shāndōng Provincial Governor,
TúSīdé returned as Guìzhōu Provincial Governor,
and Péi Zōngxī returned as Yúnnán Provincial Governor.
On the Jǐchǒu day,
Xióng Xuépéng's crime was pardoned.
Sū'ěrdé and Guǎngdé were sentenced to beheading.
On the Gēngyín day,
the Empress Dowager passed away.
Her coffin was enshrined in the main hall of the Cínínggōng.
The Emperor took Hánqīngzhāi as his mourning hut,
and issued the will of the late Empress Dowager.
An edict ordered a hundred days of mourning,
and that princes, high officials, and officials should remove their mourning attire after twenty-seven days.
On the Xīnmǎo day,
the posthumous title of the late Empress Dowager was honored as Xiàoshèngxiàn Empress.
A general remission of taxes was granted once.
On the Rénchén day,
regulations were established for the use of music during official sacrifices at the suburban altars, ancestral temples, and altars of state gods within twenty-seven days.
On the Yǐwèi day,
the mausoleum of the late Empress Dowager was honored as Tàidōnglíng.
On the Bǐngshēn day,
the coffin of the late Empress Dowager was moved to Chàngchūnyuán,
and enshrined in the Jiǔjīng Sānshìdiàn.
The Emperor resided at Yuánmíngyuán.
On the Dīngyǒu day, the first day of the second month,
the Emperor went to Ānyòugōng to perform the announcement of grief ceremony.
The Emperor resided in Wúyìzhāi for mourning.
On the Jǐhài day,
the Emperor returned to reside at Yuánmíngyuán.
On the Gēngzǐ day,
the Emperor went to the Jiǔjīng Sānshìdiàn to offer sacrifices before the coffin of the late Empress Dowager.
The princes and high officials requested to perform the rites every one or two days,
but this was not granted.
On the Jiǎchén day,
an edict ordered the suspension of New Year's Day court greetings within twenty-seven months.
After a hundred days,
when regular court audiences resumed,
an imperial decree should be requested on the day.
On the Yǐsì day,
regulations for imperial attire and official attire during the hundred days and twenty-seven months were established.
On the Jiǎyín day,
Gāo Jìn, together with Āyáng'ā, went to Ānhuī to investigate a case.
Yáng Kuí concurrently served as the Liǎngjiāng Governor-General.
The current year's flood-stricken fixed taxes for Sùzhōu and eight other zhōuxiàn, and Fèngyáng and three other wèisuǒ in Ānhuī in the forty-first year were remitted.
On the Dīngsì day,
the Emperor went to the Jiǔjīng Sānshìdiàn to perform the monthly sacrifice before the coffin of the late Empress Dowager.
Yán Xīshēn was appointed Húnán Provincial Governor.
On the Xīnwèi day of the third month,
Zuǒ Dū Yùshǐ Sù'ěrnà and Dàlǐ Sìqīng Yǐn Jiāquán retired.
On the Rénshēn day,
as Sàzài was going to the capital,
Débǎo was ordered to concurrently serve as the Jiāngnán Hydrology Governor-General.
On the Wùyín day,
Màilāxùn was appointed Zuǒ Dū Yùshǐ.
On the Rénwǔ day,
the Emperor honored the late Empress Dowager with the posthumous title Xiàoshèngcíxuān Kānghuì Dūnhé Jìngtiānguāngshèngxiàn Empress.
On the Wùzǐ day,
Héngshānbǎo was appointed Wūlǐyǎsūtái Remonstrance Minister.
On the Wùxū day of the fourth month of summer,
due to the repeated vacillations of the Burmese in their surrender,
Āguì was recalled to the capital,
while Mènggàn and others sent by the Burmese chieftain were retained.
On the Wùshēn day,
the Emperor went to the Jiǔjīng Sānshìdiàn to perform the ancestral libation ceremony before the coffin of Empress Xiàoshèngxiàn.
On the Jǐyǒu day,
Empress Xiàoshèngxiàn's funeral procession departed.
The Emperor escorted it to Tàidōnglíng,
and remitted seven-tenths of the current year's fixed taxes for the zhōuxiàn along the route.
On the Guǐchǒu day,
the Emperor visited Tàilíng.
On this day,
Empress Xiàoshèngxiàn's coffin arrived at Tàidōnglíng,
and was enshrined in the Lóng'ēndiàn.
On the Bǐngchén day,
the Emperor went to Tàidōnglíng to perform the hundred-day sacrifice before the coffin of Empress Xiàoshèngxiàn.
On the Dīngsì day,
Grand Secretary Shūhèdé passed away.
On the Wùwǔ day,
Yǒngguì was appointed acting Grand Secretary and concurrently Minister of Personnel.
On the Xīnyǒu day,
the current year's flood-stricken fixed taxes for Sùzhōu and eight other zhōuxiàn, and Chánghé and three other wèisuǒ in Ānhuī in the forty-first year were remitted.
On the Rénxū day,
Fúlóng'ān was appointed concurrently acting Minister of Personnel.
On the Jiǎzǐ day,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
On the Yǐchǒu day, the first day of the fifth month,
Empress Xiàoshèngxiàn's spirit tablet was elevated and enshrined in the Tàimiào.
The next day,
an imperial edict granting varying degrees of amnesty was issued.
On the Wùchén day,
the Emperor attended Shūhèdé's funeral and offered a libation.
On the Rénshēn day,
outstanding taxes for Qīngyuàn and ten other zhōuxiàn in Zhílì were remitted.
On the Wùyín day,
due to a general remission of taxes nationwide,
three-tenths of the rent and interest on official estates under Fújiàn Táiwānfǔ were remitted.
On the Jiǎshēn day,
Mǎlánzhèn General Mǎndòu was sentenced to beheading
for digging a passage through a wall at the Dōnglíng.
On the Dīnghài day,
Āguì was appointed Wǔyīngdiàn Grand Secretary,
and concurrently supervised the Ministry of Personnel.
Yīnglián assisted as Grand Secretary.
Minister Guǒyì Jìyǒnggōng Fēngshēng'é's father, Ālǐgǔn, who originally inherited the noble title Guǒyìgōng,
was also granted
the two characters
"Jìyǒng".
Yǒngguì was transferred to be Minister of Personnel,
Fùlèhún was appointed Minister of Rites,
Sānbǎo was appointed Húguǎng Governor-General,
and Wáng Dànwàng was appointed Zhèjiāng Provincial Governor.
The disaster-stricken fixed taxes for Dàxīng and thirty-three other tīng, zhōu, and xiàn in Shùntiān Zhílì were remitted.
On the Yǐmǎo day of the sixth month,
Jílín General Fùchūn was transferred to Hángzhōu General,
and Fúkāng'ān was appointed to succeed him.
On the Jǐwèi day,
the Emperor went to Hēilóngtán to pray for rain.
In the seventh month of autumn,
the disaster-stricken fixed taxes for Gāolán and twenty-nine other tīng, zhōu, and xiàn in Gānsù in the forty-first year were remitted.
On the Bǐngxū day,
three-tenths of the grain and fodder bundles to be levied from various indigenous tribes in Gānsù were remitted.
The Siamese chieftain Zhèng Zhāo offered tribute
and sent the captured Burmese.
Yáng Jǐngsù was instructed to issue a proclamation regarding the request for ennoblement.
On the Gēngzǐ day of the eighth month,
three-tenths of the fixed grain taxes for households in various zhōuxiàn of Wūlǔmùqí were remitted.
On the Gēngshēn day,
Secretary Jīn Jiǎn was ordered to Jílín
to investigate affairs together with Fúkāng'ān.
On the Bǐngzǐ day of the ninth month,
the Emperor visited Tàilíng and Tàidōnglíng.
On the Rénwǔ day,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
On the Wùxū day of the tenth month of winter,
Minister of Revenue Guǒyì Jìyǒnggōng Fēngshēng'é passed away.
Yīnglián was transferred to be Minister of Revenue,
still concurrently supervising the Ministry of Justice.
Défú was appointed Minister of Justice.
On the Yǐsì day,
an edict stated that when it was the year for Shǎnxī's civilian and military farm rents and fodder bundles to be exempt from taxes,
they should all be remitted.
On the Gēngshēn day,
a Mìyún Assistant Commandant was established,
with two thousand garrison troops.
On the Xīnyǒu day,
Yuán Shǒudòng was ordered to Zhèjiāng to investigate the case of the Guī'ān county magistrate Liú Jūn being accused.
Secretaries Zhōu Huáng and Āyáng'ā were ordered to Sìchuān to investigate the case of the Dàzú county magistrate Zhào Xiàngāo being accused.
On the Bǐngyín day of the eleventh month,
Guǎngdé was executed by beheading.
On the Wùchén day,
Hǎichéng was dismissed from his post for shielding Wáng Xīhóu.
Hǎo Shuò was appointed Jiāngxī Provincial Governor,
and Guótài was appointed Shāndōng Provincial Governor.
On the Rénshēn day,
Minister of Justice Yú Wényí requested retirement,
which was granted.
On the Jiǎxū day,
Yuán Shǒudòng was transferred to be Minister of Justice,
and Liáng Guózhì was appointed Minister of Revenue.
On the Yǐyǒu day,
the current year's disaster-stricken fixed taxes for Níngxià and seven other tīng and xiàn in Gānsù were remitted.
In the twelfth month, on the *dīngyǒu* day,
the arrears of taxes for forty-one years, incurred due to disasters, were remitted for seventeen departments and counties, including Gāolán in Gānsù.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
relief was provided to drought-stricken civilians in thirty-two departments, sub-prefectures, and counties, including Gāolán in Gānsù.
In the forty-third year, on the first day of spring, *rénxū* (which was the new moon),
the New Year's court congratulations were excused.
On the *guǐhài* day,
Zhèng Dàjìn was appointed Governor of Hénán.
On the *xīnwèi* day,

the princely title of Ruì Qīnwáng and the original princely titles of Yù Qīnwáng Duōduó, Lǐ Qīnwáng Dàishàn, Zhèng Qīnwáng Jíěrhāláng, Sù Qīnwáng Háogé, and Kèqín Jùnwáng Yuètúo were posthumously restored.
They were also granted the privilege of being enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
On the *jǐmǎo* day,
the Emperor visited the Western Mausoleum,
and three-tenths of the current year's fixed tax was remitted for the areas traversed.
On the *guǐwèi* day,
the Emperor visited the Tàilíng and Tàidōnglíng mausoleums.
On the *jiǎshēn* day,
the Emperor observed the one-year mourning ritual at Tàidōnglíng.
In the second month, on the *dīngyǒu* day,
Cháoxiǎn and Líuqiú sent tribute.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
Tèchéngé was appointed President of the Board of Rites.
Chùokètuō was transferred to President of the Board of Civil Office,
and Fùlèhún to President of the Board of Works.
Tèchéngé was promoted to General of Chéngdū,
and Zhōngyīn was appointed President of the Board of Rites.
Yáng Jǐngsù was transferred to Governor-General of Mǐnzhè,
Guìlín to Governor-General of Liǎngguǎng,
and Lǐ Zhìyǐng was appointed acting Governor-General.
On the *wùwǔ* day,
Chéng Qīnwáng Hóngchàng was appointed Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard for the Plain White Banner.
In the third month, on the *jiǎzǐ* day,
the Emperor went to the Western Mausoleum.
On the *wùchén* day,
the Emperor visited the Tàilíng and Tàidōnglíng mausoleums.
On the *jǐsì* day,
the Emperor personally offered sacrifices at Tàidōnglíng.
On the *yǐhài* day,
the Emperor reviewed the troops of the Jiànruì Battalion.
On the *jǐchǒu* day,
Lǐ Hú was appointed Governor of Húnán.
In the summer, fourth month, on the *xīnmǎo* day,
due to drought in Hénán,
an order was issued to commute sentences for military exiles and lesser crimes in five prefectures, including Kāifēng.
On the *rényín* day,
an order was issued to first remit the land tax for Hénán in the forty-fifth year.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
Sù Qīnwáng Yùnzhe passed away.
On the *yǐsì* day,
the Emperor went to Hēilóngtán to pray for rain.
On the *xīnhài* day,
an order was issued to commute sentences for military exiles and lesser crimes in Hénán.
On the *yǐmǎo* day,
Dài Qúhēng and one hundred fifty-seven others were granted the *jìnshì jíyǐ* degrees with different ranks.
In the fifth month, on the first day, *gēngshēn*,
due to famine in Shāndōng,
an order was issued to pre-remit taxes in money and grain for the forty-fifth year.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
an order was issued for the Governor of Shānxī to concurrently manage the salt administration of Hédōng.
On the *wùchén* day,
Yí Qīnwáng Hóngxiǎo passed away.
In the sixth month, on the *yǐwèi* day,
the Customs Supervisor of Jiǔjiāng, Quándé, was arrested and prosecuted
for overcharging.
In the intercalary sixth month, on the *guǐhài* day,
the Yellow River breached its banks at Xiángfú, Hénán.
In the autumn, seventh month, on the *guǐsì* day,
the Yellow River breached its banks at Yífēng and Kǎochéng, Hénán.
On the *yǐwèi* day,
Yuán Shǒudòng was ordered to go to Hénán
to jointly investigate river works with the River Governor Yáo Lìdé and Governor Zhèng Dàjìn.
On the *wùxū* day,
Gāo Jìn was ordered to supervise dike construction.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
the Emperor went to Shèngjīng to visit the mausoleums,
and three-tenths of the current year's fixed tax was remitted for the various departments and counties in Zhílì and Fèngtiān that were traversed.
In the eighth month, on the *guǐyǒu* day,
as the Yífēng river breach flowed into various departments and counties in Fèngyáng, Ānhuī,
Sàzài and others were instructed to provide relief to the disaster victims.
On the *jiǎxū* day,
the Emperor visited Yǒnglíng.
On the *yǐhài* day,
a grand sacrifice was performed.
On the *jǐmǎo* day,
the Emperor visited Fúlǐng.
The poll tax for the next year was remitted for the prefectures, departments, and counties under Fèngtiān.
On the *gēngchén* day,
a grand sacrifice was performed.
The Emperor visited Zhāolíng.
On the *xīnsì* day,
a grand sacrifice was performed.
An order was issued that all capital crimes, both concluded and unconcluded, in the areas of Fèngtiān, Jílín, and Hēilóngjiāng, be commuted,
and all military exiles and lesser crimes be pardoned.
On the *guǐwèi* day,
the Emperor personally offered sacrifices at the tomb of Kèqín Jùnwáng Yuètúo.
On the *jiǎshēn* day,
the Emperor personally offered sacrifices at the tombs of Wǔxūn Wáng Yánggǔlì, Hóngyì Gōng Éyìdū, and Zhíyì Gōng Fèiyīngdōng.
On the *yǐyǒu* day,
the Emperor went to the Temple of Confucius to perform rites.
In the ninth month, on the *jiǎwǔ* day,
Jīn Cóngshàn, a student (*shēngyuán*) from Jǐnxiàn,
was sentenced to beheading
for speaking out about establishing a successor and an empress,
and for suggesting the Emperor accept advice and practice virtue, which displeased the imperial will.
He was sentenced to beheading.
On the *wùxū* day,
Zhōngyīn, President of the Board of Rites, passed away.
Jīn Cóngshàn was executed
for presumptuous slander and denunciation.
On the *jǐhài* day,
Débǎo was appointed President of the Board of Rites.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
an edict was issued again explaining the pitfalls of establishing a crown prince,
and clearly stating the date of the Emperor's abdication.
On the *rénzǐ* day,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
Gāo Pú was sentenced to beheading for embezzlement.
Chùokètuō was dismissed from office for failing to detect Gāo Pú's misconduct.
Yǒngguì was appointed President of the Board of Civil Office.
On the *yǐmǎo* day,
Màilāsùn was appointed acting President of the Board of Civil Office.
In the winter, tenth month, on the *jǐwèi* day,
in anticipation of the seventieth birthday (*wànshòu*) in the *gēngzǐ* year,
and an imperial tour to Jiāngsū and Zhèjiāng,
an order was issued for an extraordinary provincial and metropolitan examination (*ēn kē xiāng huìshì*),
and a general remission of taxes.
On the *jiǎxū* day,
Táo Yì, Provincial Administration Commissioner of Jiāngsū, was dismissed and sentenced to beheading
for abetting Xú Shùkuí.
On the *bǐngzǐ* day,
the fixed tax arrears for the forty-second year, due to drought, were remitted for thirty-two departments, sub-prefectures, and counties, including Gāolán in Gānsù.
In the eleventh month, on the *wùzǐ* day,
the contribution of whole jade *rúyì* scepters and large jade pieces was prohibited.
On the *rénchén* day,
it was decided that postal services would be managed by the circuit intendants,
and the Gānsù postal and transport circuit was abolished.
Relief was provided for the current year's drought in nine departments and counties, including Xīng'ān in Guǎngxī.
On the *gēngzǐ* day,
the fixed tax arrears for the forty-second year, incurred due to disasters, were remitted for seven departments, sub-prefectures, and counties, including Níngxià in Gānsù.
In the twelfth month, on the *gēngshēn* day,
the dike works at Yífēng, Hénán, collapsed.
Gāo Jìn and others were handed over to the appropriate board for severe deliberation.
On the *bǐngyín* day,
Guótài was instructed to severely suppress the Yìhéquán cult bandits in Guànxiàn, Shāndōng.
On the *jiǎxū* day,

relief was provided for the current year's floods and droughts in thirty-four departments, counties, and garrisons, including Dāngtú in Ānhuī, and for drought in fifteen departments, counties, and garrisons, including Xiāngyīn in Húnán,
and the fixed tax was remitted to varying degrees.
In the forty-fourth year, spring, first month, on the first day, *bǐngxū*,
Chén Huīzǔ was transferred to Governor of Hénán,
and Zhèng Dàjìn to Governor of Húběi.
On the *yǐwèi* day,
Grand Secretary and Governor-General of Liǎngjiāng, Gāo Jìn, passed away.
Sānbǎo was appointed Grand Secretary of Dōnggé,
remaining concurrently as Governor-General of Húguǎng; Sàzài was appointed Governor-General of Liǎngjiāng;
and Lǐ Fènghàn was appointed Governor-General of Riverways in Jiāngnán.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
the Emperor went to the Western Mausoleum,
and three-tenths of the current year's poll tax was remitted for the areas traversed.
The Fúzhōu Deputy Lieutenant-General was abolished.
On the *yǐsì* day,
Āguì was ordered to go to Hénán to inspect river works.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
the Emperor visited the Tàilíng and Tàidōnglíng mausoleums.
On the *xīnhài* day,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
In the second month, on the *guǐhài* day,
Zuǒ Dūyùshǐ Màilāsùn resigned due to illness.
On the *bǐngzǐ* day,
Zēngfú was appointed Governor of Fújiàn,
and Shēnbǎo was appointed Zuǒ Dūyùshǐ.
On the *gēngchén* day,
an order was issued to compile the memorials of the various officials of the late Míng dynasty.
The edict stated:
"Among the offensive and censorable books sent from the various provinces for destruction,
such as Xú Bìdá's *Nánzhōu Cǎo*,
Xiāo Jìnggāo's *Shū Cǎo*,
and Sòng Yīhán's *Yèyuán Fēngshì*,
those that sharply address the弊病 of that time
are not ashamed to be candid and outspoken.
Although their rulers ignored them,
the fervent and urgent presentations of the signs of decay and disorder of that era
are sufficient for examination and reference.
We believe it would be better to select those of greater significance
and compile them separately,
naming the collection *Míngjì Zòushū* (Memorials of the Late Míng),
to form a single book,
to serve as a perpetual warning.
As for the ministers who spoke to the previous dynasty,
if there are occasional words that offend Our Dynasty,
they should not be severely blamed,
but should be appropriately altered and selected for inclusion,
while the rest should still be separately withdrawn and destroyed."
On the *rénwǔ* day,
imperial temporary palaces were constructed in places like Lóngquánzhuāng in Jiāngnán.
In the third month, on the day of Bǐngshēn,
Yīnglián was ordered to serve concurrently as the Governor-General of Zhílì.
On the day of Dīngyǒu,
Dé fú was ordered to serve concurrently as a Grand Secretary Assisting in Administration.
Yáng Jǐngsù was transferred to be the Governor-General of Zhílì,
and Sānbǎo to be the Governor-General of Mǐn-Zhè.
Túsīdé was appointed Governor-General of Húguǎng,
and Shūcháng as Governor of Guìzhōu.
On the day of Yǐsì,
Tán Shàngzhōng was ordered to serve concurrently as Governor of Shānxī.
On the day of Jǐyǒu,
relief was provided for the drought of the previous year in Jiāngxià and thirty-nine other prefectures, departments, counties, and garrisons in Húběi.
In summer, in the fourth month, on the day of Jǐwèi,
the Commissioner for the Expansion of the Pìzhǎn Office was renamed the Commander of the Tǔlǔfān Detachment.
On the day of Wùchén,
the Emperor proceeded to the Xīlíng.
On the day of Rénshēn,
the Emperor paid respects at the Tàilíng and the Tàidōnglíng.
On the day of Dīngchǒu,
the Gānsù Post and Transport Circuit was renamed the Lánzhōu Circuit of Division and Patrol.
On the day of Wùyín,
Yuán Shǒudòng was appointed Governor-General of River Affairs for Hédōng,
and Hú Jìtáng as President of the Board of Punishments.
On the day of Jǐmǎo,
the Emperor reviewed the troops of the Jiànruì Battalion.
On the day of Gēngchén,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
In the fifth month, on the day of Yǐwèi,
the Emperor conducted the autumn hunt at Mùlán,
and remitted three-tenths of the land and poll taxes for the current year in the areas passed through.
On the day of Bǐngshēn,
Lǐ Shìjié was appointed Governor of Guǎngxī.
On the day of Xīnchǒu,
the Emperor resided at the Bìshǔshānzhuāng.
On the day of Bǐngwǔ,
Fùgāng was appointed Governor of Fújiàn.
On the day of Dīngwèi,
the Emperor proceeded to the Wénmiào to perform the Xīdiàn ceremony.
In the sixth month, on the day of Dīngmǎo,
arrears of silver taxes totaling 235,000 liǎng and grain taxes totaling 1,050,000 dàn, each with a remainder, from the 27th to the 37th year of Qiánlóng in Gānsù were remitted.
On the day of Wùchén,
the Qìn Hé River breached its banks in Wǔzhì and Hénèi, Hénán.
On the day of Gēngchén,
a Manchu city was constructed in Tǔlǔfān.
In autumn, in the seventh month, on the day of Yǐwèi,
Sūn Shìyì was appointed Governor of Yúnnán.
In the eighth month, on the day of Wùchén,
the Emperor went to Mùlán for a hunt.
On the day of Xīnwèi,
Héshēn was ordered to learn and serve as an Imperial Bodyguard.
On the day of Jiǎxū,
the imperial clan member Yǒngwěi was appointed General of Hēilóngjiāng.
On the day of Yǐhài,
the Níngshòugōng was completed.
In the ninth month, on the day of Gēngzǐ,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
In winter, in the tenth month, on the day of Rénxū,
the people's arrears of community granary grain from the 20th to the 37th year of Qiánlóng in Yán'ān and three other prefectures and departments in Shǎnxī were remitted.
The horse silver due from the thirty-nine families of Fanzi in Nàkèshū, Xīzàng, was remitted.
On the day of Yǐhài,
the regular taxes of the disaster-stricken areas in Zhuānglàng and seventeen other sub-prefectures, departments, and counties in Gānsù were remitted.
In the eleventh month, on the day of Jiǎshēn,
the regular taxes of Bózhōu and eleven other prefectures and counties in Ānhuī were remitted.
On the day of Wùxū,
Sōngchūn, the General of Hángzhōu, was dismissed from office for indulging in pleasure and idleness,
and a general edict was issued to reiterate the warning.
On the day of Guǐmǎo,
relief was provided for the disaster victims in Gāolán and twelve other sub-prefectures, departments, and counties in Gānsù,
and the regular taxes for the current year were also remitted.
On the day of Bǐngwǔ,
Yáo Chéngliè was appointed Governor of Guǎngxī.
Wǔ Mǐtài was given a special imperial seal as Commissioner and ordered to escort the Bānchán to Rèhé.
In the twelfth month, on the day of Guǐchǒu,
Attendant Secretary Déchéng was ordered to Hénán to assist in river conservancy work.
On the day of Jiǎyín,
Vice President of the Board of Revenue Dǒng Gào was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
On the day of Yǐmǎo,
Guìlín, the Governor-General of Liǎngguǎng, died.
Bāyánsān was appointed to succeed him,
and Yǎdé was appointed Governor of Shānxī.
On the day of Wùwǔ,
Grand Secretary Yú Mǐnzhōng died.
Túsīdé, the Governor-General of Húguǎng, died.
Fùlèhún was appointed to succeed him,
and Chuòkètuō was appointed to serve as President of the Board of Works.
On the day of Bǐngyín,
relief was provided for the flood victims of the current year in Miǎnyáng and seven other prefectures, departments, and garrisons in Húběi.
On the day of Jǐsì,
Chéng Jǐngyī was appointed Grand Secretary of the Wényuāngé,
Jī Huáng was transferred to be President of the Board of Civil Office and Grand Secretary Assisting in Administration,
and Zhōu Huáng as President of the Board of Works.
On the day of Xīnwèi,
Yáng Jǐngsù, the Governor-General of Zhílì, died.
Yuán Shǒudòng was appointed to succeed him.
Chén Huīzǔ was transferred to be Governor-General of River Affairs for Hédōng,
and Róngzhù as Governor of Hénán.
In the 45th year, in spring, in the first month, on the day of Gēngchén, the first day of the month,
on the occasion of the Emperor's 70th birthday in the eighth month,
an imperial edict was issued, granting various degrees of special favors.
On the day of Xīnsì,
the regular taxes of Yífēng and thirteen other disaster-stricken prefectures and counties in Hénán were remitted.
On the day of Xīnmǎo,
the Emperor went on a tour to Jiāng and Zhè,
and remitted three-tenths of the regular taxes for the current year in the areas passed through in Zhílì and Shāndōng.
On the day of Rénchén,
arrears of taxes in Shùndé and four other prefectures in Zhílì were remitted.
On the day of Jǐhài,
arrears of taxes and granary grain in Lìchéng and twenty-eight other prefectures and counties in Shāndōng were remitted.
On the day of Jǐyǒu,
Lǐ Biǎo, the King of Cháoxiǎn, presented congratulations for the Emperor's birthday,
and a gracious edict was issued in response.
The embankment works in Rénhé and Hǎiníng, Zhèjiāng, were repaired.
In the second month, on the day of Guǐchǒu,
Shūcháng, together with Héshēn and Kānníng'ā, were ordered to investigate the various accusations against Lǐ Shìyáo in Hǎiníng.
On the day of Jiǎyín,
three-tenths of the regular taxes for the current year in the areas passed through in Jiāngnán and Zhèjiāng were remitted.
Arrears of taxes from before the 43rd year in the Liǎngjiāng region were remitted.
On the day of Bǐngchén,
Lǐ Fènghàn was transferred to be Governor-General of River Affairs for Hédōng,
and Chén Huīzǔ as Governor-General of River Affairs for Jiāngnán.
On the day of Dīngsì,
the regular grain tax for the current year in Táiwān Prefecture was remitted,
and disaster-related arrears of salt households and unpaid silver for Sichuan transport were remitted in Liǎnghuái.
On the day of Jǐwèi,
the Emperor crossed the river,
and inspected the embankment works at Qīngkǒu East Dam.
On the day of Jiǎzǐ,
the regular taxes for the current year in the provincial capitals and their adjacent prefectures and counties in Jiāngnán and Zhèjiāng were remitted.
On the day of Wùchén,
the Emperor visited Jiāoshān.
On the day of Rénshēn,
the Emperor visited Sūzhōufǔ.
The breach at Yífēng was closed.
On the day of Jǐmǎo,
arrears of taxes in Rénhé and other counties in Zhèjiāng were remitted.
In the third month, on the day of Xīnsì,
the Emperor visited Hǎiníngzhōu to view the tidal bore.
On the day of Rénwǔ,
the Emperor visited Jiānshān.
Suǒnuò mùcèlíng was summoned to the capital,
and Kuílín was appointed Military Governor of Wūlǔmùqí.
On the day of Guǐwèi,
the Emperor visited Hángzhōufǔ.
On the day of Jiǎshēn,
the Emperor visited Qiūtáogōng to review the navy.
Bóqīng'é was appointed President of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
On the day of Rénchén,
Lǐ Zhìyǐng was transferred to be Governor of Zhèjiāng,
Lǐ Hú as Governor of Guǎngdōng,
and Liú Yǒng as Governor of Húnán.
As the period for the Imperial Review had arrived,
Àguì and others were granted discussion of their conduct,
and Zuǒdūyùshǐ Cuī Yīngjiē and others retired with their original ranks.
On the day of Guǐsì,
Luó Yuánhàn was appointed Zuǒdūyùshǐ.
On the day of Dīngyǒu,
Lǐ Shìyáo was dismissed from office and arrested for questioning.
Sūn Shìyì was dismissed from office
and sent to Yīlí to serve.
Fúkāng'ān was appointed Governor-General of Yún-Guì,
and Suǒnuòmùcèlíng as General of Shèngjīng.
On the day of Xīnchǒu,
Yīnglián was appointed Grand Secretary of the Dōnggé,
and Héshēn as President of the Board of Revenue.
On the day of Bǐngwǔ,
the Emperor proceeded to the Ming Tàizǔ Líng to offer wine.
In summer, in the fourth month, on the day of Jǐyǒu, the first day of the month,
the Emperor crossed the river.
On the day of Rénzǐ,
Wèi Shú from Shòuguāng, Shāndōng, was executed
for writing a book with rebellious and absurd content.
On the day of Dīngsì,
the Emperor arrived at Wǔjiādūn,
inspected the Gāojiāyàn embankment works,
and crossed the river.
Three-tenths of the regular taxes due from Tàiyuán and sixteen other prefectures and departments in Shānxī, as well as Guīhuàchéng and other sub-prefectures, were remitted,
while Dàtóng, Shuòpíng, and Hélíngé'ěr and their subordinate areas were entirely remitted.
On the day of Xīnyǒu,
Yáng Kuí was transferred to be Governor of Shǎnxī,
Liú Bǐngtián served concurrently as Governor of Yúnnán,
Yán Xīshēn as Governor of Guìzhōu,
and Wú Tán as Governor of Jiāngsū.
On the day of Dīngmǎo,
Yáng Kuí was transferred to be Governor of Hénán,
Yǎdé as Governor of Shǎnxī,
and Kānníng'ā as Governor of Shānxī.
On the *jiǎshēn* day of the fifth month,
the Grand Secretaries and Nine Ministers changed Héshēn's proposed sentence for Lǐ Shìyáo from "awaiting execution" to "decapitation."
An edict was issued to all governors-general and governors to express their opinions,
and propose and memorialize them.
On the *dīnghài* day,
the Emperor returned to the Jīngshī.
On the *guǐsì* day,
Wāng Rúyáng and one hundred and fifty-four others were granted the *jìnshì jíyì chūshēn* in varying degrees.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
Sūn Shìyì's crime was pardoned.
On the *jǐhài* day,
the Emperor conducted the autumn hunt at Mùlán.
On the *yǐsì* day,
the Emperor stayed at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
this year's land tax was remitted for Mǐnyáng and five other prefectures and counties in Húběi affected by floods.
On the *yǐmǎo* day,
Grand Secretary Sānbǎo was summoned to join the cabinet and handle affairs.
Fùlèhún was transferred to be the Governor-General of Mǐnzhè,
and Shūcháng to be the Governor-General of Húguǎng.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
Héshēn was appointed as the Commandant of the Imperial Bodyguard of the Bordered White Banner.
On the *gēngwǔ* day,
the Guōjiādù River in Suīníng, Jiāngsū, burst its banks.
In the seventh month of autumn, on the *dīngchǒu* day,
Sūn Shìyì was reinstated as a compiler.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
the Bānchán Éěrdé Ní came from Hòuzàng to have an audience.
The Emperor held court in the Qīngkuàng Diàn,
granted him a seat,
and offered tea.
On the *wùxū* day,
the Yǒngdìng Hé in Liángxiāng, Shùntiān, burst its banks.
On the *gēngzǐ* day,
the Emperor held court in the Wànshù Yuán,
and bestowed a banquet upon the Bānchán Éěrdé Ní, princes, dukes, and ministers,
Mongolian kings, *bèilè*, *bèizǐ*, dukes, imperial sons-in-law, and *tàijí*,
and also granted varying degrees of robes, hats, gold, and silk.
On the *xīnchǒu* day,
the river in Cáoxiàn, Shāndōng, and Kǎochéng, Hénán, burst its banks.
On the *rénchén* day,
Lǐ Běn was appointed Governor of Guìzhōu.
In the eighth month, on the *wùshēn* day,
relief was provided to Nínglíng and three other counties in Hénán affected by floods.
On the *yǐmǎo* day,
Grand Secretary Chéng Jǐngyī passed away.
On the *dīngsì* day,
the breach in the Yǒngdìng Hé was closed.
Zhèng Dàjìn, the Governor of Húběi, presented gold artifacts,
which were not accepted,
and he was severely reprimanded.
On the *jǐwèi* day,
on the Emperor's 70th birthday,
he held court in the Dànbó Jìngchéng Diàn,
where princes, dukes, ministers, and Mongolian kings, *bèilè*, *bèizǐ*, imperial sons-in-law, and *tàijí* offered congratulatory rites.
On the *guǐyǒu* day,
Mǐn Èyuán was transferred to be the Governor of Jiāngsū,
and Nóng Qǐ to be the Governor of Ānhuī.
On the *jiǎxū* day,
the Emperor visited the Eastern and Western Mausoleums,
and remitted three-tenths of this year's land tax for the areas traversed.
Relief was provided to Zhūjì and six other counties in Zhèjiāng affected by floods.
In the ninth month,
Jī Huáng was appointed Grand Secretary of Wényuān Gé,
and Cài Xīn was appointed Minister of Personnel and Assistant Grand Secretary.
Zhōu Huáng was transferred to be Minister of War,
and Zhōu Yuánlǐ was appointed Minister of Works.
On the *rénwǔ* day,
the Emperor visited the Zhāoxī Líng, Xiàolíng, Xiàodōng Líng, and Jǐnglíng,
and offered wine at the tomb of Empress Xiàoxián.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
the Emperor visited the Tàilíng and Tàidōng Líng.
The breach at Guōjiādù in Suīníng was closed.
On the *yǐwèi* day,
the Emperor returned to the Jīngshī.
On the *yǐsì* day,
relief was provided to Húnchūn, Jílín, affected by floods.
In the tenth month of winter, on the *wùshēn* day,
Lǐ Shìyáo's sentence was finalized as "decapitation with execution deferred."
Yǎdé was transferred to be the Governor of Hénán.
On the *xīnyǒu* day,
this year's land tax was remitted for Yífēng and five other counties in Hénán affected by floods.
On the *rénxū* day,
this year's land tax was remitted for Bázhōu and sixty-two other prefectures and counties in Zhílì affected by floods.
This year's land and drought tax was remitted for Qīnghé and seven other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Jiāngsū.
The land tax for the 44th year was remitted for Gāolán and thirty-four other administrative divisions in Gānsù affected by floods.
On the *jiǎxū* day,
Bóqīng'é was ordered to act as the Left Censor-in-Chief,
and Héshēn continued to concurrently act as the Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
In the eleventh month, on the *gēngchén* day,
Bóqīng'é was appointed Imperial Commissioner,
to escort the Bānchán Éěrdé Ní to the Mùlúwūsū area.
On the *rénwǔ* day,
Qìngguì was appointed General of Wūlǐyǎsūtái.
On the *guǐwèi* day,
the Bānchán Éěrdé Ní passed away in the Jīngshī.
In the twelfth month, on the *yǐmǎo* day,
relief was provided to famine victims in Gāolán and seventeen other administrative divisions in Gānsù.
On the *gēngshēn* day,
due to the collapse of the Huìtóng Sìyì Guǎn,
which killed Korean nationals,
the Minister of Rites and others were sent to the board for severe deliberation.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
Āguì was ordered to inspect the seawalls with Chén Huīzǔ, Fùlèhún, and Lǐ Zhìyǐng.
In the first month of spring in the 46th year, on the *jǐmǎo* day,
the hereditary ranks of the Mongolian Khalkha,
Qīnghǎi Dörbet, Torgut, and Khoshut,
and the kings, dukes, *jāsak*, and *tàijí* of Huíbù were settled.
On the *bǐngshēn* day,
King Lǐ Biǎo of Korea expressed gratitude for the bestowed silks,
and continued to offer local tributes;
he was kindly urged to accept them.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
Fùlèhún and Lǐ Zhìyǐng were summoned to the capital.
Chén Huīzǔ was appointed Governor-General of Mǐnzhè,
concurrently managing the Governor of Zhèjiāng,
and overseeing river and dike works.
Lǐ Fènghàn was transferred to be the Governor-General of Riverways of Jiāngnán,
and Hán Hóng to be the Governor-General of Riverways of Hédōng.
In the second month, on the *bǐngchén* day,
this year's land tax was remitted for Zhūjì, Zhèjiāng, affected by floods.
On the *guǐhài* day,
Āguì was ordered to inspect river works in Jiāngnán and Hénán.
On the *yǐchǒu* day,
the Emperor made a western tour to Wǔtái Shān,
and remitted three-tenths of this year's land tax for the areas traversed.
On the *bǐngyín* day,
outstanding taxes were remitted for seven prefectures and counties in Bǎodìng, Shùntiān.
On the *jǐsì* day,
Yǎdé was transferred to be the Governor of Shānxī.
On the *gēngwǔ* day,
Fùlèhún was appointed Governor of Hénán.
Wáng Suì was sentenced to strangulation.
On the *jiǎxū* day, the first day of the third month,
the Emperor visited Zhèngdìng Fǔ to review troops.
On the *yǐhài* day,
this year's land tax was remitted in varying degrees for Bózhōu and eight other prefectures and counties, and Fèngyáng and two other garrisons in Ānhuī affected by floods.
On the *bǐngzǐ* day,
this year's land tax was remitted in varying degrees for Qīnghé and seven other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Jiāngsū affected by floods.
On the *wùyín* day,
Qìngguì was summoned to the capital,
and Bātú was ordered to act as the General of Wūlǐyǎsūtái.
On the *xīnsì* day,
the Emperor stayed at Wǔtái Shān.
On the *jǐchǒu* day,
this year's land tax was remitted in varying degrees for Gāolán and fourteen other administrative divisions in Gānsù affected by hail.
On the *jiǎwǔ* day,
Zōngshì Sōngchūn was appointed General of Suīyuǎn Chéng.
On the *gēngzǐ* day,
the Emperor returned to the Jīngshī.
On the *rénchén* day,
the Salar Hui rebels Sū Sìshísān and others in Xúnhuà Tīng, Gānsù, revolted,
capturing Hézhōu.
Mǎ Biāo, the Commander-in-Chief of Xī'ān, was ordered to suppress them with Lè'ěrjǐn.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
the Hui rebels attacked Lánzhōu,
and Āguì was ordered to Gānsù to direct the strategy for suppressing the rebels.
In the fourth month of summer, on the *jiǎshēn* day, the first day of the month,
Minister Héshēn, Imperial Son-in-Law Lāwàngduō'ěrdàojǐ, and Commandant of the Imperial Bodyguard Hǎilánchá,
along with *bātúlǔ* bodyguards,
were ordered to Gānsù to suppress the rebels.
On the *yǐsì* day,
Nóng Qǐ, the Governor of Ānhuī, was ordered to Gānsù to manage military supplies.
Lǐ Shìyáo's crime was pardoned,
and he was granted a third-rank button and sent to Gānsù.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
the imperial army in Gānsù recaptured Hézhōu,
and Rén Hé advanced to relieve the provincial capital.
On the *gēngshēn* day,

Yǐn Jiāquán, who had retired as Chief Minister of the Court of Judicial Review, was charged with presumptuously requesting his father be honored in the Confucian Temple and with writing wildly rebellious books,
and was sentenced to strangulation.
This year's land tax was remitted for Bázhōu and forty-nine other administrative divisions in Zhílì affected by floods.
On the *wùchén* day,
Qián Qǐ and one hundred and sixty-eight others were granted the *jìnshì jíyì chūshēn* in varying degrees.
On the *gēngwǔ* day,
Lè'ěrjǐn was arrested,
and Lǐ Shìyáo was appointed to manage the affairs of the Governor-General of Shǎnxī-Gānsù.
As he had not yet arrived,
Āguì concurrently managed them.
Héshēn was recalled to the capital.
On the *xīnwèi* day,
this year's land tax was remitted for Shòuzhōu and eleven other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Ānhuī, and Yífēng and four other counties in Hénán, affected by floods.
In the fifth month, on the *xīnmǎo* day,
Āguì and others were ordered to suppress the new religion of the Hui people.
In the intercalary fifth month, on the *guǐmǎo* day, the first day of the month,
Lè'ěrjǐn was sentenced to decapitation.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
outstanding taxes were remitted for Fùníng and six other counties and garrisons in Jiāngsū.
On the *gēngxū* day,
the Emperor conducted the autumn hunt at Mùlán.
On the *bǐngchén* day,
the Emperor stayed at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
In the sixth month, on the day Gēngchén,
the river burst its banks at Wèijiāzhuāng in Suīníng, Jiāngsū.
On the day Jǐchǒu,
due to the accumulated years of fraudulent relief claims in Gānsù,
the Ministry of Justice was ordered to strictly interrogate Lèlěrjǐn,
and Wáng Dànwàng was arrested and brought to the capital.
On the day Rénchén,
the arrears of grain from granaries were remitted for the people of Xī'ān and twelve other prefectures and departments in Shǎnxī.
On the day Guǐsì,
the Huí bandits Sū Sìshísān and others in Gānsù were executed.
In autumn, in the seventh month, on the first day RénYín,
the sea overflowed in Chóngmíng, Tàicāng, and other departments and counties in Jiāngsū.
Wáng Tíngzàn, the Provincial Administration Commissioner of Gānsù,
was dismissed from his post and arrested for fraudulent relief claims and excessive expenditures.
On the day Bǐngwǔ,
Kuílín was appointed General of Wūlǐyǎsūtái,
and Míngliàng was appointed Military Governor of Wūlǔmùqí.
On the day Jǐyǒu,
the river burst its banks at Wànjǐntān and Qǔjiālóu in Yífēng, Hénán.
On the day Gēngshēn,
Zhèng Zhāo, the leader of the Kingdom of Xiāmluó (Siam), sent envoys bearing memorials and tribute.
On the day Xīnyǒu,
Āguì was ordered to inspect the river works in Hénán and Shāndōng.
On the day Yǐchǒu,
the king's younger brother, Zhào Wēng, of the Kingdom of Nánzhǎng (Luang Prabang), presented tribute.
On the day Gēngwǔ,
Wáng Dànwàng was sentenced to decapitation;
Lèlěrjǐn was granted self-immolation;
Wáng Tíngzàn was sentenced to strangulation.
The current year's fixed tax for Chóngmíng County, Jiāngsū, was remitted.
Disaster relief was provided for the flood-stricken areas of Chóngmíng and nine other sub-prefectures, departments, and counties in Jiāngsū, and Yífēng County in Hénán.
In the eighth month, on the day Jiǎxū,
disaster relief was provided for the flood-stricken areas of Lǒngxī and four other counties in Gānsù.
Half of the fixed tax was remitted for Jīn County and seven other counties.
On the day Jǐmǎo,
Yuán Shǒudòng and others were impeached for inaccuracies in inspecting grain reserves,
and referred to the board for strict deliberation.
On the day Rénwǔ,
Fúkāng'ān was transferred to be Governor-General of Sìchuān;
Fùgāng was appointed Governor-General of Yún-Guì;
Yáng Kuí was appointed acting Provincial Governor of Fújiàn.
On the day Yǐyǒu,
disaster relief was provided for the flood-stricken areas of Qiánjiāng and four other departments and counties in Húběi.
On the day Bǐngxū,
the Emperor went to Mùlán for the autumn hunt.
The breach at Wèijiāzhuāng was closed.
In the ninth month, on the day Wùshēn,
Wáng Tíngzàn was executed by strangulation.
On the day Dīngmǎo,
disaster relief was provided for the flood-stricken areas of Jīnxiāng, Shāndōng.
In winter, in the tenth month, on the day Bǐngzǐ,
disaster relief was provided for the flood-stricken areas of Tóngshān and other counties in Jiāngsū.
On the day Dīngchǒu,

disaster relief was provided for the flood-stricken areas of Zōupíng and twenty-nine other departments and counties, Jìníng and three other garrisons, and Yǒngfù and three other salt fields in Shāndōng.
On the day Yǐyǒu,
disaster relief was provided for the flood-stricken areas of Cāngzhōu and four other departments and counties, and Yánzhèn and four other salt fields in Zhílì.
On the day Wùzǐ,
disaster relief was provided for the flood-stricken areas of Xiángfú and thirteen other counties in Hénán.
On the day Gēngyín,
disaster relief was provided for the flood- and drought-stricken areas of Jiāngxià and seventeen other departments and counties in Húběi.
On the day Guǐsì,
disaster relief was provided for the flood- and drought-stricken areas of Língbì and twenty-four other departments, counties, and garrisons in Ānhuī.
On the day Dīngyǒu,
the Emperor, in response to a memorial from Censor Liú Tiānchéng,
decreed:
"The method of equal field distribution
will inevitably lead to the poor not yet becoming rich,
while the rich become poor first.
We, ruler and ministers, should only advocate frugality and simplicity,
know shame and fear,
and then the four classes of people will follow."
The tribute of furs from Shǎnxī was abolished.
In the eleventh month, on the day Gēngzǐ,
Zhōu Yuánlǐ, Minister of Works, requested to retire due to old age and was granted leave;
Luó Yuánhàn was appointed to replace him.
Liú Yōng was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief,
while temporarily retaining the post of Provincial Governor of Húnán.
On the day Bǐngwǔ,
Lǐ Shìjié was appointed Provincial Governor of Húnán.
On the day Wùchén,
Zhèng Dàjìn was appointed Governor-General of Zhílì.
In the twelfth month, on the first day Jǐsì,
Yáo Chéngliè was transferred to be Provincial Governor of Húběi.
Zhū Chūn was appointed Provincial Governor of Guǎngxī.
On the day Dīngchǒu,
Yǎdé was appointed Provincial Governor of Guǎngdōng;
Tán Shàngzhōng was appointed Provincial Governor of Shānxī.
On the day Wùzǐ,
the Grand Secretaries and others debated and rejected Jī Huáng's request to restore the old course of the Yellow River;
the Emperor approved it.
On the day Gēngyín,
Bì Yuán, impeached by Censor Qián Fēng,
was demoted by three grades in official rank but retained in office.
On the day Xīnmǎo,
Nóng Qǐ was transferred to be Provincial Governor of Shānxī;
Tán Shàngzhōng was transferred to be Provincial Governor of Ānhuī.
In the spring of the 47th year, in the first month, on the day Gēngzǐ,
Chén Huīzǔ and Mǐn Èyuán were demoted by three grades in official rank but retained in office.
On the day Yǐmǎo,
the Wénsù Pavilion in Shèngjīng was completed.
On the day Bǐngyín,
the Sīkù Quánshū (Complete Library in Four Sections) was completed.
In the second month, on the day Jǐsì,
