the Emperor attended the Wényuān Pavilion,
bestowed a banquet upon the chief compilers and other officials of the Sīkù Quánshū,
and awarded them according to their ranks.
On the day Dīnghài,
Āmǐdá, Imperial Guard of the Qiánqīng Gate, was ordered to offer sacrifices to the River God.
In the third month, on the day Gēngzǐ,
the Emperor visited Pánshān.
On the day Rényín,
the Emperor stayed at Pánshān.
On the day Guǐchǒu,
Yǎdé was transferred to be Provincial Governor of Fújiàn;
Shàng'ān was appointed Provincial Governor of Guǎngdōng.
On the day Jiǎyín,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
On the day Yǐmǎo,
arrears of grain totaling 2,450,000 shí and silver totaling over 300,000 liǎng in Gānsù were remitted.
On the day Wùwǔ,
the fixed tax for flood-stricken areas of Chángshú and twenty-eight other sub-prefectures, departments, counties, and garrisons in Jiāngsū was remitted.
On the day Guǐhài,
the fixed tax for flood-stricken areas of Tiānjīn and thirty-nine other departments, counties, and sub-prefectures in Zhílì was remitted.
In summer, in the fourth month, on the day Wùchén,
Héshēn and Liú Yōng, along with Censor Qián Fēng, were ordered to investigate the case of empty granaries in Shāndōng.
On the day Wùyín,
the fixed tax for flood-stricken areas of Shòuguāng and five other counties in Shāndōng was remitted.
On the day Jǐmǎo,
Guótài, Provincial Governor of Shāndōng, was dismissed from his post and arrested for questioning;
Míngxìng was appointed to replace him.
On the day Xīnsì,
the Emperor reviewed the Firearm Division troops.
On the day Jiǎshēn,
the fixed tax for flood-stricken areas of Yǒngjì County, Shānxī, was remitted.
On the day Dīnghài,
the Emperor reviewed the Jianrui Camp troops.
On the day Rénchén,
Cài Xīn, Associate Grand Secretary and Minister of Personnel, requested leave,
which was granted.
Liú Yōng was appointed acting Minister of Personnel.
On the day Jiǎwǔ,
Luó Yuánhàn was dismissed;
Liú Yōng was appointed Minister of Works;
Wáng Jié was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate;
Qìngguì was appointed General of Shèngjīng.
In the fifth month, on the day Dīngyǒu,
Āguì was summoned to the capital;
Hán Hóng and Fùlèhún were ordered to plan and manage river works.
On the day Jǐhài,
disaster relief was provided for the flood-stricken areas of Cǎozhōu, Yǎnzhōu, Jìníng and other prefectures and departments in Shāndōng, and Xúzhōu, Fēng, Pèi and other counties in Jiāngsū.
On the day Xīnchǒu,
the fixed tax for flood-stricken areas of Xiángfú and six other counties in Hénán was remitted.
The newly constructed Bā'ěrgásùn city was named Jiādé.
On the day Wùshēn,
the Emperor visited Mùlán.
On the day Gēngxū,
the fixed tax for flood-stricken areas of Huáiníng and eighteen other departments and counties, and Ānqìng and five other garrisons in Ānhuī was remitted.
On the day Jiǎyín,
the Emperor stayed at the Summer Resort.
In the sixth month, on the day Bǐngzǐ,
Guótài and Yú Yìjiǎn were sentenced to decapitation.
Fùgōng was appointed Provincial Governor of Ānhuī.
In autumn, in the seventh month, on the first day Bǐngshēn,
Āguì was again ordered to oversee river works.
On the day Wùxū,
Suǒnuòmùcèlíng was sentenced to decapitation.
On the day Guǐmǎo,
Guótài and Yú Yìjiǎn were granted self-immolation.
On the day Jiǎchén,
regarding the excessively superior tribute handled by Lǐ Shìyáo and Guótài,
which led to their crimes,
a decree was issued to all Governors-General and Provincial Governors that they should only strive for integrity and self-discipline,
and not specialize in presenting lavish tributes.
On the day Jǐwèi,
Hé Yùchéng was appointed acting Director-General of River Conservancy for Hédōng.
On the day Guǐhài,
the fixed tax for flood-stricken areas of Lǒngxī and four other counties in Gānsù for the 46th year was remitted.
In the eighth month, on the day Dīngmǎo,
Fúkāng'ān was appointed Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard.
On the day Guǐyǒu,
Zōngshì Yǒngwěi was appointed General of Jílín;
Zōngshì Héngxiù was appointed General of Hēilóngjiāng.
On the day Jiǎxū,
Yīnglián, Jī Huáng, Héshēn, Lǐ Shìyáo, and Fúkāng'ān were granted the title of Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent;
Liáng Guózhì and Zhèng Dàjìn were granted the title of Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent;
Sàzài was granted the title of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
On the day Rénwǔ,
disaster relief was provided for the flood-stricken people of Pèixiàn and other departments and counties in Jiāngsū,
and Zōu and Yì counties in Shāndōng.
On the day Guǐwèi,
the Emperor visited Mùlán for the autumn hunt.
On the day Yǐyǒu,
Suǒnuòmùcèlíng was granted self-immolation.
On the day Rénchén,
disaster relief was provided for the flood-stricken people of Yǎnzhōu and other prefectures and counties in Shāndōng.
In the 9th month, on the day Bǐngshēn,
the Wénlán Gé in Zhèjiāng was built.
On the day Rén Yín,
the Emperor returned and was stationed at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the day Guǐ Mǎo,
Défú, the Minister of Justice (Xíngbù Shàngshū), died.
Kānìng'ā was appointed to replace him.
Yīnglián was ordered to temporarily manage the Ministry of Justice.
On the day Yǐ Sì,
Zōngshì Yǒngwěi was transferred to be the General of Shèngjīng,
and Qìngguì was transferred to be the General of Jílín.
On the day Xīn Hài,
Chén Huīzǔ was stripped of his office and arrested for interrogation.
Fùlèhún was transferred to be the Governor-General of Mǐnzhè,
and Fúcháng'ān acted in his stead.
Lǐ Shìjié was transferred to be the Governor of Hénán,
and Zhā Lǐ was appointed as the Governor of Húnán.
On the day Jǐ Wèi,
relief was provided to flood victims in Yùhuán and other areas of Zhèjiāng.
On the day Xīn Yǒu,
the additional land tax for flood-stricken areas in Chéngdé and five other halls and counties of Fèngtiān was remitted.
In winter, 10th month, on the day Guǐ Yǒu,
the newly built city of Kù'ěrkālāwūsū was named Qìngsuí,
and the city of Jīnghé was named Ānfù.
On the day Dīng Mǎo,
relief was provided for flood victims in Rǔyáng and sixteen other counties of Hénán.
On the day Jiǎ Shēn,
Zhèng Dàjìn, the Governor-General of Zhílì, died.
Yuán Shǒudòng acted in his stead.
Fú Sōng was appointed as the Governor of Zhèjiāng.
Relief was provided for areas afflicted by floods and droughts in Shòuzhōu and sixteen other prefectures, counties, and garrisons of Ānhuī.
In the 12th month, on the first day Guǐ Hài,
Chén Huīzǔ and Guódòng were condemned to be beheaded.
On the day Jiǎ Shēn,
Cháng Qīng was promoted to General of Hángzhōu.
Wū'ěrtúnàxùn was appointed as the Military Governor (Dūtǒng) of Cháhār.
In the 48th year, spring, 1st month, on the day Jiǎ Wǔ,
Yīxīng'ā was appointed as the Governor of Húnán.
On the day Wù Shēn,
Sàzài was appointed as the Governor-General of Liǎngjiāng,
Bì Yuán as the Governor of Shǎnxī,
and Liú Bǐngtián as the Governor of Yúnnán.
In the 2nd month, on the day Jiǎ Zǐ,
Chén Huīzǔ was granted self-execution,
and Wáng Suì was executed by beheading.
On the day Yǐ Chǒu,
Yùqí was appointed as the Governor-General of Grain Transport (Cáoyùn Zǒngdū).
On the day Bǐng Yín,
Lāwàngduō'ěrzì was appointed as an Imperial Bodyguard (Yùqián Dàchén).
On the day Wù Chén,
an order was issued to build a Bìyōng at the Imperial Academy (Tàixué).
On the day Xīn Wèi,
the Emperor went to the Western Mausoleums (Xīlíng),
and three-tenths of the additional land tax for the passing areas was remitted.
On the day Yǐ Hài,
the Emperor went to the Tàilíng and Tàidōnglíng.
On the day Wù Zǐ,
Sìxiān, the fifth-generation descendant of Xióng Tíngbì, the Ming Dynasty's Liaodong Commissioner (Liáodōng Jīnglüè), was granted the title of Instructor of Confucian Studies (Rúxué Xùndǎo).
In the 3rd month, on the day Xīn Chǒu,
the Grand Secretary (Dàxuéshì) Āguì and others were granted deliberation.
Qián Zǎi, the Vice Minister of Rites (Lǐbù Shìláng), and others were granted retirement with their original ranks.
Governor-General Yuán Shǒudòng and others, Governor Nóng Qǐ and others were granted deliberation.
Zhū Chūn was summoned to the capital,
and Liú was appointed as the Governor of Guǎngxī.
On the day Jiǎ Yín,
the additional land tax for flood and drought-stricken areas in Tóngshān and nineteen other prefectures and counties, and Huái'ān and three other garrisons of Jiāngsū was remitted.
Summer, 4th month, on the day Yǐ Chǒu,
Zhálafēng'ā, the Prince of Kālāqìn, an Imperial Bodyguard, died.
Lāwàngduō'ěrzì was appointed as an Imperial Bodyguard.
On the day Yǐ Hài,
the Emperor reviewed the Firearm Corps (Huǒqì Yíng) troops.
On the day Xīn Sì,
Fúkāng'ān was summoned to the capital.
In the 5th month, on the day Rén Chén,
Fúkāng'ān was appointed as the Grand Minister of the Imperial Household Department (Lǐng Shìwèi Nèidàchén) for the Bordered Yellow Banner.
Lǐ Fènghàn was granted the titles of Minister of War (Bīngbù Shàngshū) and Censor-in-Chief on the Right (Yòudū Yùshǐ).
On the day Jiǎ Chén,
Zhū Chūn was appointed as Censor-in-Chief on the Left (Zuǒdū Yùshǐ).
On the day Bǐng Wǔ,
Yǒngguì, Associate Grand Secretary (Xiébàn Dàxuéshì) and Minister of Personnel (Lìbù Shàngshū), died.
The additional land tax for flood-stricken areas in Shòuzhōu and eleven other prefectures and counties of Ānhuī from the previous year was remitted.
On the day Dīng Wèi,
Yuán Shǒudòng, the Governor-General of Zhílì, died.
Liú acted in his stead.
Sūn Shìyì was appointed as the Governor of Guǎngxī,
and Wǔ Mítài as Minister of Personnel and Associate Grand Secretary.
On the day Jǐ Yǒu,
the Emperor fell ill.
Yǒngróng was ordered to offer sacrifices at the Fāngzé on his behalf.
On the day Guǐ Chǒu,
the Emperor visited Mùlán.
On the day Gēng Shēn,
the Emperor was stationed at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
In the 6th month, on the day Yǐ Chǒu,
the Tǐrén Gé caught fire.
On the day Yǐ Yǒu,
the additional land tax for flood-stricken areas in Yǒngfù and five other salt fields of Shāndōng from the previous year was remitted.
On the day Dīng Hài,
relief was provided for flood victims in Guǎngjì and six other prefectures and counties of Húběi.
Autumn, 7th month, on the day Wù Xū,
Hǎilù was ordered to act as the General of Yīlí,
and Túxīyì as the Military Governor of Wūlǔmùqí.
On the day Yǐ Mǎo,
Cài Xīn was appointed as Grand Secretary of the Wénhuá Diàn,
Liáng Guózhì as Associate Grand Secretary,
and Liú Yǒng as Minister of Personnel.
In the 8th month, on the day Jiǎ Wǔ,
the Dàlài Lǎma was bestowed with a jade tablet and a jade seal.
On the day Jiǎ Xū,
Míngliàng, Bālín Tàibù and others were stripped of their offices and arrested for interrogation.
Hǎilù was appointed as the Military Governor of Wūlǔmùqí.
On the day Yǐ Hài,
the Emperor traveled from Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng to Shèngjīng to visit the mausoleums,
and five-tenths of the additional land tax for the passing areas for this year was remitted.
On the day Gēng Chén,
Yīnglián, Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince (Tàizǐ Tàibǎo) and Grand Secretary, died.
On the day Xīn Sì,
the Emperor was stationed at the Hānàdá Grand Camp.
Lātnàxīdì, the Prince of Kālāqìn, and others welcomed the imperial carriage,
and rewards were bestowed accordingly.
On the day Dīng Hài,
the Emperor was stationed at the Wǔlǐtún Grand Camp.
Gōnggélābùtán, the Prince of Kē'ěrqìn, Bātú, the Prince of Bālín, and others welcomed the imperial carriage,
and rewards were bestowed accordingly.
On the day Wù Zǐ,
Bǐng, the fifth-generation descendant of Yuán Chónghuàn, the Ming Dynasty's Liaodong Commissioner, was granted selection for an 8th or 9th rank official position.
In the 9th month, on the first day Jǐ Chǒu,
the Emperor was stationed at the Sìbǎozǐ Eastern Grand Camp for a shooting review.
The Eleventh Imperial Prince Yǒngxīng and others were ordered to escort the imperial册寶 (cèbǎo, imperial patents and seals) to Shèngjīng,
to be stored in the Imperial Ancestral Temple (Tàimiào).
On the day Guǐ Sì,
the Emperor was stationed at the Lǎobiān Grand Camp for a shooting review.
The King of Joseon (Cháoxiǎn Guówáng) sent envoys to present tribute.
On the day Yǐ Wèi,
the additional land tax for all prefectures of Fèngtiān for the 49th year of Qiánlóng was remitted.
On the day Wù Xū,
the Emperor visited the Yǒnglíng.
On the day Jǐ Hài,
the Grand Sacrificial Ceremony (Dàxiǎng Lǐ) was performed.
The Xīngjīng city was inspected.
The granary stores of the households belonging to the Ministry of Revenue (Hùbù) in Shèngjīng were remitted.
Five-tenths of the rice, beans, and straw bundles due from banner lands in Shèngjīng and other areas were remitted.
Death sentences in Fèngtiān and other areas were commuted,
and crimes below military exile (jūnliú) were remitted.
On the day Guǐ Mǎo,
the Emperor visited the Fúlín.
On the day Jiǎ Chén,
the Grand Sacrificial Ceremony was performed.
The Emperor visited the Zhāolíng,
and offered condolences at the tomb of Wǔxūn Wáng Yánggǔlì.
On the day Yǐ Sì,
the Grand Sacrificial Ceremony was performed.
On the day Bǐng Wǔ,
the Emperor offered condolences at the tomb of Kèqín Jùnwáng Yuètúo.
On the day Dīng Wèi,
the Emperor offered condolences at the tombs of Hóngyì Gōng Èyìdū and Zhíyì Gōng Fèi Yīngdōng.
On the day Wù Shēn,
the Emperor presided over the Chóngzhèng Diàn to receive congratulations.
He presided over the Dàzhèng Diàn and bestowed a banquet upon the accompanying imperial princes, kings, dukes, and high officials,
with rewards bestowed accordingly.
On the day Jǐ Yǒu,
the Emperor went to the Qīngníng Gōng to sacrifice to the gods,
and bestowed sacrificial meat upon the imperial princes, kings, dukes, and high officials.
On the day Gēng Xū,
the Emperor returned.
On the day Wù Wǔ,
an imperial decree was issued to the Court of Imperial Household (Zhānshì Fǔ) to prepare for the promotion of literary officials (cí chén),
and reiterating that the establishment of a crown prince (jiànchú) was absolutely impermissible.
Winter, 10th month, on the day Rén Xū,
relief was provided for drought victims in Yúlín and eight other prefectures and counties of Shǎnxī.
On the day Guǐ Hài,
the Emperor was stationed at the Wénshū'ān Temporary Palace.
On the day Rén Shēn,
the Emperor visited the Zhāoxīlíng, Xiàolíng, Xiàodōnglíng, and Jǐnglíng.
On the day Yǐ Hài,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
In the 11th month, on the day Jǐ Hài,
Guódòng was released.
On the day Gēng Zǐ,
as Fúlóng'ān had not yet recovered from his illness,
Fúkāng'ān was ordered to assist in managing the Ministry of War.
On the day Xīn Chǒu,
Liú was ordered to instruct the prefectures and counties near Yùtián to dig up locust nymphs.
On the day Rén Yín,
Liú was ordered to investigate and handle the Yìhéquán heterodox sect in Nángōng County.
On the day Jǐ Yǒu,
Ākèdòng'ā was appointed as Assistant Military Governor (Cānzàn Dàchén) of Wūlǐyàsūtái,
and Nà'ěrhúshàn as Assistant Military Governor of Tǎ'ěrbāhātái.
In the 12th month, on the day Bǐng Yín,
Fúkāng'ān was ordered to proceed to Guǎngdōng,
to jointly try the salt merchant cases with Yǒngdé.
In the 49th year, spring, first month, on the *dīngwèi* day,
the Emperor made a southern tour,
remitting three-tenths of this year's land taxes for the areas passed through in Zhílì and Shāndōng.
On the *wùshēn* day,
outstanding tax arrears were remitted for the twelve prefectures and departments of Zhílì, including Shùntiān.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
Sūn Shìyì was transferred to be the Governor of Guǎngdōng,
and Wú Yuán was appointed Governor of Guǎngxī.
On the *bǐngchén* day,
outstanding tax arrears were remitted for the twenty-one departments, counties, and garrisons of Shāndōng, including Lìjīn.
Bāyánsān was summoned to the capital.
Shūcháng was transferred to be the Governor-General of Liǎngguǎng.
Tèchéngé was appointed Governor-General of Húguǎng,
and Bǎoníng was appointed General of Chéngdū.
Second month, on the *rénxū* day,
the Emperor visited Tài'ān Prefecture,
and went to the Dài Temple to perform rites.
On the *bǐngyín* day,
the Emperor visited the tomb of Shàohào.
He proceeded to Qūfù to visit the Temple of the Former Sage.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
sacrificial rites were offered to the Former Sage,
and wine was poured at the Kǒng Cemetery.
Sacrifices were made at the Temple of Yuánshèng Zhōu Gōng.
On the *rénshēn* day,
outstanding tax arrears were remitted for all jurisdictions of Jiāngníng, Sūzhōu, and Ānhuī.
Three-tenths of this year's land taxes were remitted for the areas passed through in Jiāngnán and Zhèjiāng.
Yǒngbǎo was appointed Governor of Guìzhōu.
Gifts were bestowed upon the elderly people of Jiāngnán and Zhèjiāng.
On the *wùyín* day,
sacrifices were made to the River God.
The Emperor crossed the river.
Punishments for crimes below military exile were reduced in the three provinces of Jiāngsū, Ānhuī, and Zhèjiāng.
On the *rénwǔ* day,
fixed taxes were remitted for Jiāngníng and Sūzhōu in Jiāngnán,
and for the counties attached to the prefectural city of Hángzhōu in Zhèjiāng, and other such places.
On the *jiǎshēn* day,
outstanding tax arrears for the 45th and 46th years were remitted for the salt household (families) of Liǎnghuái.
Third month, on the *bǐngxū* day (the first day of the month),
sacrifices were made to the River God.
The Emperor crossed the river,
and visited Jīn Shān.
On the *dīnghài* day,
the Emperor visited Jiāo Shān.
Zhōu Huáng was transferred to be the Left Censor-in-Chief.
On the *jǐchǒu* day,
Wáng Jié was appointed Minister of War,
to assume office after the mourning period was over.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
the Emperor visited Sūzhōu Prefecture.
On the *rénchén* day,
outstanding tax arrears from the 30th to 44th years were remitted for the twenty-four departments, counties, and garrisons of Húběi, including Jiāngxià.
On the *yǐwèi* day,
the Emperor went to the Temple of Culture to perform rites.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
an additional three-tenths of the fixed taxes were remitted for the three prefectures of Hángzhōu, Jiāxīng, and Húzhōu in Zhèjiāng.
On the *jǐhài* day,
the Emperor visited Hǎiníng Department to sacrifice to the Sea God.
As Guō Zhōngyuè, a *jìnshì* by imperial bestowal from Fújiàn, was already 104 years old
and came to Zhèjiāng to welcome the imperial carriage,
he was awarded the title of Director of the Guózǐjiān.
On the *gēngzǐ* day,
the Emperor visited Jiān Shān to observe the tidal bore.
He inspected the embankment works.
On the *xīnchǒu* day,
the Emperor visited Hángzhōu Prefecture.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
the Emperor went to Shèngyīn Temple to offer sacrifices to the divine image of the Holy Ancestor.
On the *wùshēn* day,
the Emperor reviewed the Fújiàn navy.
On the *gēngxū* day,
the Emperor returned from Hángzhōu.
Qìngguì was reassigned as the General of Fúzhōu.
Dū'ěrjiā was appointed General of Jílín.
One additional Deputy Commander-in-Chief was added for Xī'ān.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
the Emperor sojourned in Sūzhōu Prefecture.
Bāyánsān was stripped of his office.
Intercalary third month, on the *bǐngchén* day (the first day of the month),
Fúlong'ān, Minister of War, died.
Fúkāng'ān was appointed Minister of War,
and Fùxīng was acting Minister of Works.
On the *rénxū* day,
the Emperor visited Jiāngníng Prefecture.
On the *jiǎzǐ* day,
sacrifices were made at the tomb of Míng Tàizǔ.
On the *yǐchǒu* day,
the Emperor reviewed the banner troops garrisoned in Jiāngníng Prefecture.
On the *wùchén* day,
the Emperor crossed the river.
On the *bǐngzǐ* day,
the Emperor sacrificed to the River God,
and crossed the river.
Yīlíng'ā was appointed Minister of the Imperial Household Department.
In this month,
fixed taxes for the previous year's floods and droughts were remitted for the eight departments, counties, and garrisons of Jiāngsū, including Shàngyuán,
and the ten departments and counties of Ānhuī, including Huáiníng, and the three garrisons, including Ānqìng.
Summer, fourth month, on the *bǐngxū* day,
fixed taxes for the previous year's flood disaster were remitted for the five departments and counties of Zhílì, including Wǎnpíng.
On the *gēngyín* day,
the Emperor sacrificed at the Yǔ Temple.
On the *rényín* day,
Lǐ Shòu was appointed Governor of Jiāngxī.
On the *jiǎchén* day,
due to drought in Hénán, including Wèihuī,
outstanding tax arrears were remitted for sixteen counties, including Jíxiàn.
On the *yǐsì* day,
outstanding tax arrears were remitted for the seven departments and counties of Zhílì, including Dàmíng.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
Tián Wǔ and others, new Muslim converts in Gānsù, rebelled.
Lǐ Shìyáo and Gāngtǎ were ordered to suppress them.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
Hǎilù was appointed Assistant Minister-in-Charge of Wūshí.
On the *gēngxū* day,
outstanding tax arrears from the 38th to 46th years were remitted for Shǎnxī and Gānsù.
On the *xīnhài* day,
Lǐ Shòu was transferred to be Governor of Húnán,
and Yīxīng'ā was appointed Governor of Jiāngxī.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
Rú Fēn and 112 others were bestowed the title of *Jìnshì Jídì* (Successful Candidate in the Highest Imperial Examination) and various other ranks.
In this month,
fixed taxes for the previous year's flood disaster were remitted for the four counties of Húběi, including Huángméi, and the three garrisons, including Wǔchāng.
Fifth month, on the *bǐngchén* day,
Chuòkètuō was stripped of his office and arrested for questioning due to an incident.
Qìngguì was appointed Minister of Works.
Chángqīng was transferred to be the General of Fúzhōu,
and Yǒngduó was appointed General of Hángzhōu.
On the *jǐwèi* day,
Qìngguì was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
On the *rénxū* day,
the Emperor conducted the autumn hunt at Mùlán.
On the *guǐhài* day,
outstanding tax arrears were remitted for the three prefectures and departments of Shǎnxī, including Yán'ān.
On the *wùchén* day,
the Emperor sojourned at the Summer Resort.
On the *jǐsì* day,
Fúkāng'ān and Hǎilánchá were ordered to Gānsù to suppress and capture the Muslim rebels.
On the *jiǎxū* day,
Āguì was ordered to lead the Firearm and Elite Battalions to Gānsù to suppress the rebellious Muslims.
Āguì was appointed General,
and Fúkāng'ān, Hǎilánchá, and Wǔdài were all appointed Assistant Ministers-in-Charge.
On the *yǐhài* day,
the Muslim rebels in Gānsù captured Tōngwèi County,
and it was later recovered.
Shūliàng was appointed Commander of the Vanguard.
On the *gēngchén* day,
Lǐ Shìyáo was stripped of his office for negligence and error.
Fúkāng'ān was appointed Governor-General of Shǎnxī and Gānsù.
Gāngtǎ was stripped of his office and arrested for questioning due to missing an opportunity.
On the *xīnsì* day,
Qìngguì was transferred to be Minister of War,
and Fùxīng was appointed Minister of Works.
Āyáng'ā was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.
On the *guǐwèi* day,
Hǎo Shuò, Governor of Jiāngnán, was arrested for questioning due to corruption.
In this month,
fixed taxes for the previous year's flood disaster were remitted for the three prefectures and departments of Shāndōng, including Yǎnzhōu.
Sixth month, on the *gēngyín* day,
this year's fixed taxes for Gānsù were remitted.
On the *jiǎwǔ* day,
disaster relief was provided for the flood-stricken areas of Chálíng and Yōuxiàn in Húnán.
On the *rényín* day,
Sānbǎo, Grand Secretary of the Dōnggé, died.
On the *wùshēn* day,
Shūlín was appointed Governor of Ānhuī.
In this month,
fixed taxes for the previous year's floods and droughts were remitted for the thirteen departments, counties, and garrisons of Ānhuī, including Huáiníng.
In autumn, in the seventh month, on the *jiǎyín* (甲寅) day, which was the first day of the month,
there was a solar eclipse.
On the *dīngsì* (丁巳) day,
Cáo Xiùxiān (曹秀先), Grand Secretary of the Board of Rites, passed away.
Yáo Chéngliè (姚成烈) was appointed Grand Secretary of the Board of Rites.
Lǐ Shòu (李綬) was transferred to be the Governor of Húběi (湖北),
and Lù Yào (陸燿) was appointed Governor of Húnán (湖南).
On the *jǐwèi* (己未) day,
Hǎo Shuò (郝碩) was granted permission to commit suicide.
On the *jiǎzǐ* (甲子) day,
the Hui (回) bandits at Shífēngbǎo (石峯堡) in Gānsù (甘肅) were suppressed.
The bandit leader Zhāng Wénqìng (張文慶) and others were captured.
Ā Guì (阿桂) was granted the title of Light Chariot Commandant.
Fúkāng'ān (福康安) was promoted and enfeoffed as Marquis Jiāyǒng (嘉勇侯).
Hǎilánchá's (海蘭察) son, Ānlù (安祿), was promoted to Second-class Imperial Bodyguard.
Wǔ Dài (伍岱) was appointed Governor-General.
All were granted the title of Cavalry Commandant.
Hé Shēn (和珅) was again granted the title of Light Chariot Commandant.
The rest received various appropriate rewards.
On the *bǐngyín* (丙寅) day,
Cháng Qīng (常青) was appointed Governor-General of Wūlǔmùqí (烏魯木齊).
On the *guǐyǒu* (癸酉) day,
Wǔ Mítài (伍彌泰) was appointed Grand Secretary of the Dōnggé (東閣).
Hé Shēn (和珅) was transferred to be Grand Secretary of the Board of Civil Office and Auxiliary Grand Secretary,
also concurrently managing the Board of Revenue.
Fúkāng'ān (福康安) was appointed Grand Secretary of the Board of Revenue,
while retaining his post as Governor-General of Shǎnxī (陝西).
On the *wùyín* (戊寅) day,
an order was issued to promulgate military discipline regulations.
On the *guǐwèi* (癸未) day,
Lǐ Shìyáo (李侍堯) was sentenced to beheading.
Gāng Tǎ's (剛塔) crime was pardoned,
and he was exiled to Yīlí (伊犁).
This month,
the arrears of land tax from the previous year's drought disaster in Yúlín (榆林) and eight other prefectures and counties in Shǎnxī (陝西) were remitted.
In the eighth month, on the *jǐchǒu* (己丑) day,
the Yellow River breached its banks in Suīzhōu (睢州), Hénán (河南).
Ā Guì (阿桂) was ordered to supervise its repair.
On the *guǐsì* (癸巳) day,
arrears of silver of 350,000 *liǎng* and grain of 470,000 *shí* from previous years in Gānsù (甘肅) were remitted, with varying amounts for different areas.
On the *yǐwèi* (乙未) day,
because Rèn Tiāndǔ (任天篤) from Yǎnshī (偃師) county, Hénán (河南), lived with nine generations under one roof,
an imperial poem and an imperial calligraphic plaque were bestowed upon him.
On the *jǐhài* (己亥) day,
the Emperor went to Mùlán (木蘭) for a hunt.
On the *xīnchǒu* (辛丑) day,
Zhāng Wénqìng (張文慶) and others were executed.
On the *jiǎchén* (甲辰) day,
Zhèng Huá (鄭華), the elder son of the King of Xiāmluó (暹羅國), sent his vassal to present local products
and requested enfeoffment.
In the ninth month, on the *guǐchǒu* (癸丑) day, which was the first day of the month,
relief was provided for the flood disaster in Sùzhōu (宿州) and other places in Ānhuī (安徽).
On the *yǐmǎo* (乙卯) day,
due to the pacification of the Hui (回) bandits,
Hé Shēn (和珅) was enfeoffed as a First-class Baron.
On the *gēngshēn* (庚申) day,
the Emperor stopped at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng (避暑山莊).
On the *jiǎzǐ* (甲子) day,
Wū'ěrtúnàxùn (烏爾圖納遜) was transferred to be Governor-General of Cháhā'ěr (察哈爾),
and Jīfú (積福) was appointed General of Suīyuǎn Chéng (綏遠城).
On the *jiǎxū* (甲戌) day,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
On the *bǐngzǐ* (丙子) day,
Chuòkètuō's (綽克托) crime was pardoned.
On the *gēngchén* (庚辰) day,
Grand Minister of State Xīmíng (西明) and Hanlin Academy Reader-Academician Āsù (阿肅) were ordered to go to Cháoxiǎn (朝鮮)
to enfeoff the Crown Prince.
This month,
relief was provided for the flood disaster in Huázhōu (華州) and three other prefectures and counties in Shǎnxī (陝西).
In winter, in the tenth month, on the *xīnmǎo* (辛卯) day,
an order was issued to hold the Qiānsǒuyàn (千叟宴) again.
On the *wùxū* (戊戌) day,
relief was provided for the flood disaster in Nánchāng (南昌) and six other counties in Jiāngxī (江西).
On the *jǐyǒu* (己酉) day,
the sentences of criminals in the capital whose cases were confirmed in the Autumn Assize and Capital Assize and whose appeals had been rejected more than three times were reduced.
In the eleventh month, on the *yǐchǒu* (乙丑) day,
an edict stated that for all criminals whose cases had been postponed for three times in the Autumn Assize and Capital Assize,
their sentences should be reduced appropriately.
On the *rénshēn* (壬申) day,
the work on the Suīzhōu (睢州) river closure was completed.
On the *gēngchén* (庚辰) day,
Bǎozhù (保住) was ordered to remain as the Resident Minister in Tibét.
Fúlù (福祿) was appointed Minister for Western Affairs in Xīníng (西寧).
In the twelfth month, on the *jiǎchén* (甲辰) day,
an edict stated that for officials and commoners aged ninety or above attending the Qiānsǒuyàn (千叟宴),
one of their children or grandchildren would be permitted to assist them;
for grand ministers aged over seventy,
if their walking was somewhat difficult,
one of their children or grandchildren would also be permitted to assist them.
This year,
Cháoxiǎn (朝鮮), Liúqiú (琉球), Xiāmluó (暹羅), and Ānnán (安南) came to pay tribute.
In the fiftieth year, in spring, in the first month, on the *xīnhài* (辛亥) day, which was the first day of the month,
on the occasion of the fiftieth anniversary of the nation,
the Emperor issued an edict granting various special favors.
On the *bǐngchén* (丙辰) day,
the Qiānsǒuyàn (千叟宴) ceremony was held,
with three thousand people, from princes downwards, feasted at the Qiánqīng Gōng (乾清宮).
Various rewards were bestowed.
On the *dīngsì* (丁巳) day,
Zhōu Huáng (周煌), Censor-in-chief of the Left, retired,
and Jì Yún (紀昀) was appointed Censor-in-chief of the Left.
Wú Yuán (吳垣) was transferred to be Governor of Húběi (湖北),
and Sūn Yǒngqīng (孫永清) was appointed Governor of Guǎngxī (廣西).
On the *wùchén* (戊辰) day,
Kuílín (奎林) was summoned to the capital,
and Lāwàngduō'ěrzǐ (拉旺多爾濟) was appointed acting General of Wūlǐyāsūtái (烏里雅蘇台).
On the *jiǎxū* (甲戌) day,
Āqímù Bóukè Ālǐmù (阿奇木伯克阿里木) of Kāshígā'ěr (喀什噶爾) was discovered to have secretly colluded with Sàmùsàkè (薩木薩克).
He was sentenced to beheading.
On the *yǐyǒu* (乙酉) day,
relief was provided for the flood disaster in Píngxiāng (萍鄉) and three other counties in Jiāngxī (江西).
On the *dīnghài* (丁亥) day,
the Emperor offered sacrifices to the ancient sages
and lectured at Bìyōng (辟雍).
On the *wùzǐ* (戊子) day,
arrears of land tax were remitted in Jíxiàn (汲縣) and fourteen other counties in Hénán (河南).
On the *jǐchǒu* (己丑) day,
an imperial examination was held for officials of the Hanlin Academy and the Imperial Household Department.
Lù Bókūn (陸伯焜) and Wú Jǐng (吳璥) were promoted to the first class,
and the rest were promoted or demoted appropriately.
An examination was held for officials of the Six Boards, and promoted officials from the Hanlin Academy and the Imperial Household Department.
Qìnglíng (慶齡) was promoted to the first class,
and the rest were promoted or demoted appropriately.
On the *xīnmǎo* (辛卯) day,
Bì Yuán (畢沅) was transferred to be Governor of Hénán (河南),
and Hé Yùchéng (何裕城) was appointed Governor of Shǎnxī (陝西).
On the *jiǎchén* (甲辰) day,
arrears of land tax were remitted in Jiāngníng (江寧) and six other prefectures and sub-prefectures in Jiāngnán (江南).
This month,
relief was provided for the flood disaster in Píngxiāng (萍鄉) and three other counties in Jiāngxī (江西), and Jiàn'ān (建安) and two other counties in Fújiàn (福建),
and for the drought disaster in Jíxiàn (汲縣) and fourteen other counties in Hénán (河南).
In the third month, on the *rénzǐ* (壬子) day,
the Emperor visited Pánshān (盤山).
On the *jiǎyín* (甲寅) day,
the Emperor went to Míng Chánglíng (明長陵) to offer wine.
On the *dīngsì* (丁巳) day,
the Emperor stopped at Pánshān (盤山).
On the *xīnyǒu* (辛酉) day,
300,000 *shí* of tribute grain from Hénán (河南) and Shāndōng (山東) were diverted
to provide relief for the drought disaster in Wèihuī (衞輝), Hénán (河南).
On the *jiǎzǐ* (甲zǐ) day,
arrears of land tax were remitted in Āndōng (安東) and Fùníng (阜寧), Jiāngsū (江蘇).
On the *bǐngyín* (丙寅) day,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
On the *dīngmǎo* (丁卯) day,
Yǒng Duó (永鐸) was appointed Assistant Minister in Yīlí (伊犁),
Cháng Qīng (常青) was appointed General of Xī'ān (西安),
Kuílín (奎林) was appointed Governor-General of Wūlǔmùqí (烏魯木齊),
and Fùxīng (復興) was appointed General of Wūlǐyāsūtái (烏里雅蘇臺).
Shū Cháng (舒常) was appointed Grand Secretary of the Board of Works,
and Sūn Shìyì (孫士毅) was concurrently appointed acting Governor-General of Liǎngguǎng (兩廣).
On the *yǐhài* (乙亥) day,
arrears of land tax were remitted in Bàzhōu (霸州) and forty-nine other prefectures and counties in Zhílì (直隸).
On the *bǐngzǐ* (丙zǐ) day,
arrears of land tax from the previous year's flood disaster in Shāngqiū (商丘) and six other prefectures and counties in Hénán (河南) were remitted.
In summer, in the fourth month, on the *jiǎshēn* (甲申) day,
an earthquake occurred in Sùzhōu (肅州) and other places in Gānsù (甘肅).
Relief was provided.
On the *rénchén* (壬辰) day,
the Emperor reviewed the soldiers of the Jiànruìyíng (健銳營) battalion.
On the *dīngyǒu* (丁酉) day,
Kānìng'ā (喀寧阿) and Hú Jìtáng (胡季堂), Grand Secretaries of the Board of Punishments,
and Mùjīng'ā (穆精阿) and Jiāng Shèng (姜晟), Vice Grand Secretaries, were demoted to Fourth-rank button
for inaccurate examination of cases.
On the *wùxū* (戊戌) day,
Cài Xīn (蔡新), Grand Secretary, retired.
This month,
arrears of land tax from the drought disaster in Jíxiàn (汲縣) and other counties in Hénán (河南) were remitted.
Relief was provided for the drought disaster in Xiángfú (祥符) and other prefectures and counties.
In the fifth month, on the *rénzǐ* (壬子) day,
old and new arrears of land tax were remitted in Xiángfú (祥符) and sixteen other prefectures and counties, and Zhèngzhōu (鄭州) and thirty-two other prefectures and counties in Hénán (河南).
On the *jiǎyín* (甲寅) day,
Yǒng Bǎo (永保) was transferred to be Governor of Jiāngxī (江西),
and Chén Yòngfū (陳用敷) was appointed Governor of Guìzhōu (貴州).
On the *jǐwèi* (己未) day,
one million *liǎng* of silver from the Liǎnghuái (兩淮) transport treasury were allocated to Hénán (河南) for disaster relief.
On the *bǐngyín* (丙寅) day,
the Emperor conducted an autumn hunt at Mùlán (木蘭).
On the *dīngmǎo* (丁卯) day,
there was famine in Píngyáng (平陽) and other areas in Shānxī (山西).
Poor people were given two months' worth of grain.
On the *rénshēn* (壬申) day,
the Emperor stopped at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng (避暑山莊).
On the *bǐngzǐ* (丙zǐ) day,
Liáng Guózhì (梁國治) was appointed Grand Secretary of the Dōnggé (東閣),
concurrently Grand Secretary of the Board of Revenue,
and Liú Yǒng (劉墉) was appointed Auxiliary Grand Secretary.
Cáo Wénzhí (曹文埴) was appointed Grand Secretary of the Board of Revenue.
On the *dīngchǒu* (丁丑) day,
the banditry in Zhéchéng (柘城) was suppressed.
This month,
relief was provided for the drought disaster in Tóngshān (銅山) and sixteen other prefectures and counties in Jiāngsū (江蘇), and Língxiàn (陵縣) and forty other prefectures and counties in Shāndōng (山東).
In the sixth month, on the day of Rénwǔ,
due to delays in grain transport,
Sàzǎi and others were sent to the appropriate ministry for severe deliberation,
and ordered to make separate compensations.
On the day of Yǐyǒu,
Bóqīng'ā, Shàngshū of the Lǐfānyuàn, died.
On the day of Bǐngxū,
Liúbǎozhù was appointed Shàngshū of the Lǐfānyuàn.
On the day of Xīnchǒu,
Kuílín was appointed acting Jiāngjūn of Yīlí,
and Yǒngduó was appointed acting Dūtǒng of Wūlǔmùqí.
On the day of Yǐsì,
an order was issued to again detain one hundred thousand shí of Jiangxi's grain tribute in Ānhuī for disaster relief.
This month,
disaster relief was provided for the drought in Bózhōu and eight other prefectures and counties in Ānhuī.
In autumn, the seventh month, on the day of Jǐyǒu,
Fùlèhún was transferred to be the Zǒngdū of Liǎngguǎng,
Yǎdé was appointed Zǒngdū of Mǐnzhè,
and PúLín was appointed Xúnfǔ of Fújiàn.
On the day of Gēngxū,
PúLín was transferred to be the Xúnfǔ of Húnán,
and Xú Sìzēng was appointed Xúnfǔ of Fújiàn.
On the day of Xīnyǒu,
Lǐ Qìngfēn was appointed Xúnfǔ of Guìzhōu.
On the day of Yǐchǒu,
one million liǎng of silver from the Hùbù was allocated to Hénán for disaster relief.
On the day of Xīnwèi,
disaster relief was provided for the floods in Dàizhōu and six other prefectures and counties in Shānxī.
On the day of Yǐhài,
Kuílín was appointed Jiāngjūn of Yīlí,
and Yǒngduó was appointed Dūtǒng of Wūlǔmùqí.
In the eighth month, on the day of Yǐyǒu,
Àguì was ordered to go to Hénán to inspect the disaster,
and also to Jiāngnán and Shāndōng to investigate river transport.
On the day of Guǐsì,
the Emperor went on a hunting expedition to Mùlán.
On the day of Gēngzǐ,
disaster relief was provided for the floods in Cháoyì County, Shǎnxī.
On the day of Guǐmǎo,
Yīsāng'ā was appointed Xúnfǔ of Shānxī.
In the ninth month, on the day of Jǐyǒu,
Fúkāng'ān was ordered to go to Ākèsū to appease the Huí people.
Qìngguì was appointed Cāncàndàchén of Wūshí,
and acting Zǒngdū of Shǎnxīgān.
Hǎilù was demoted to Lǐngduì Dàchén of Yīlí.
Míngliàng, as Cāncàndàchén of Yīlí, was ordered to act as Cāncàndàchén of Wūshí.
On the day of Jiǎyín,
the Emperor resided at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the day of Wùwǔ,
Yǒngbǎo was transferred to be Xúnfǔ of Shǎnxī,
and Hé Yùchéng was transferred to be Xúnfǔ of Jiāngxī.
On the day of Wùchén,
the Emperor returned to the Jīngshī.
On the day of Rénshēn,
disaster relief was provided for the drought in Chángzhōu and fifty-six other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Jiāngsū.
In winter, the tenth month, on the first day of Dīngchǒu,
Lèbǎo and Sōngyún were summoned back to the capital,
and Fózhù was ordered to reside in Kùlún,
to work together with Yùnduān Duō'ěrzì.
On the day of Gēngchén,
disaster relief was provided for the drought in Bālíng and ten other prefectures and counties in Húnán.
On the day of Xīnchǒu,
disaster relief was provided for the drought in Bózhōu and fifty-one other prefectures and counties, and Fèngyáng and nine other garrisons in Ānhuī.
This month,
the annual tax quota for hail and flood disasters in Gāolán and twelve other sub-prefectures, prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Gānsù was remitted.
Disaster relief was provided for floods and droughts in Píngxiāng and sixteen other prefectures and counties in Zhílì,
and for droughts in Yǒngchéng and twelve other prefectures and counties in Hénán.
In the eleventh month, on the day of Yǐhài,
based on the calculation of the solar eclipse for the first day of the Yǐmǎo year, the sixtieth year of Qiánlóng,
an imperial decree was issued to abdicate in the following year.
This month,
disaster relief was provided for the drought in Yìxiàn and nine other prefectures and counties in Shāndōng,
and for floods and hail disasters in Hézhōu and seven other prefectures and counties in Gānsù.
In the twelfth month, on the day of Dīngchǒu,
regarding the Censor Fùsēn'ā's memorial requesting that the dìdīng land and poll tax be collected in kind,
an imperial edict sternly rejected it as absolutely unfeasible,
and dismissed him.
On the day of Bǐngxū,
Míngliàng was appointed Cāncàndàchén of Wūshí,
and Qìngguì was appointed Cāncàndàchén of Tǎ'ěrbāhātái.
On the day of Rényín,
Guǎngdōng foreign merchants and the customs supervisor of Yuèhǎiguān were prohibited from making tribute.
This month,
disaster relief was provided for the floods in Cháoyì and three other counties in Shǎnxī.
This year,
Cháoxiǎn came to pay tribute.
Běnjì 15, Gāozōng Běnjì 6
In the fifty-first year, spring, the first month, on the first day of Bǐngwǔ,
there was a solar eclipse,
and court congratulations were waived.
On the day of Wùshēn,
the Hùbù was ordered to allocate one million liǎng of silver to be sent to Ānhuī for disaster relief.
On the day of Xīnyǒu,
Yáo Chéngliè, Shàngshū of the Lǐbù, died,
and Péng Yuánruì was appointed to replace him.
On the day of Bǐngyín,
Pǔfú was appointed Zhù Zàng Dàchén.
On the day of Gēngwǔ,
Hé Yùchéng, Xúnfǔ of Jiāngxī, reported that grain prices were rising daily,
caused by excessive transport from Jiāng and Chǔ.
The Emperor believed he intended to curb grain sales,
and severely reprimanded him.
Fàn Jiànzhōng was ordered to go to Hāmì to handle affairs.
In the second month, on the day of Gēngchén,
the Emperor held a banquet at the Jīngyán,
and ordered a new song of warning to be performed,
setting it as an annual precedent.
Huáng Shìjiǎn, TíDū of Fújiàn Water Forces, was promoted to Tàizǐ Tàibǎo.
On the day of Yǐyǒu,
the Emperor went on a hunting expedition to Nányuàn.
On the day of Xīnmǎo,
Shàngshū Cáo Wénzhí,
and Shìláng Jiāng Shèng and Yīlíng'ā were ordered to go to Zhèjiāng Province to inspect the storehouses.
On the day of Rénchén,
the Emperor went to the Xīlíng,
and toured Wǔtái Shān,
remitting three-tenths of the tax quota for the areas passed through.
On the day of Bǐngshēn,
the Emperor visited the Tàilíng and Tàidōnglíng.
On the day of Dīngyǒu,
the arrears of silver and rice from the previous year's disaster in Shùndé, Guǎngpíng, and Dàmíng prefectures in Zhílì were remitted.
On the day of Jǐhài,
Túsàbù was appointed Xúnfǔ of Húběi.
On the day of Guǐmǎo,
the outstanding taxes of Xīnzhōu and six other prefectures and counties in Shānxī were remitted.
In the third month, on the day of Bǐngwǔ,
the Emperor resided at Wǔtái Shān.
On the day of Bǐngchén,
Sàzǎi, Zǒngdū of Liǎngjiāng, died,
and Lǐ Shìjié was transferred to replace him.
Bǎoníng was appointed Zǒngdū of Sìchuān,
and Èhuī was appointed Jiāngjūn of Chéngdū.
On the day of Jǐwèi,
the Emperor inspected the Hūtúo Hé,
and reviewed the troops of Zhèngdìng Garrison.
On the day of Rénxū,
the Emperor offered sacrifices at the Dìyáo Miào.
On the day of Guǐhài,
Lǐ Shìyáo was ordered to act as Shàngshū of the Hùbù.
On the day of Jiǎzǐ,
disaster relief was provided for the victims in Cháoyì and three other counties in Shǎnxī.
On the day of Gēngwǔ,
the Emperor returned to the Jīngshī.
On the day of Xīnwèi,
Yīlíng'ā was appointed Xúnfǔ of Zhèjiāng.
In summer, the fourth month, on the day of Jǐmǎo,
Grand Secretary Àguì was ordered to go to Jiāngnán to plan river works.
On the day of Yǐyǒu,
Dòu Guāngnài, Commissioner of Education for Zhèjiāng, reported that the granary shortages in Jiāxīng, Hǎiyán, and Píngyáng counties each exceeded one hundred thousand,
and that county and prefecture purchases for granary storage
were all converted into silver payments,
for convenience of reallocation.
Cáo Wénzhí and others were ordered to investigate thoroughly and report back.
Disaster relief was provided for the floods in Dàizhōu and six other prefectures and counties in Shānxī.
On the day of Jǐchǒu,
Dòu Guāngnài was ordered to work with Cáo Wénzhí and others to investigate the granary shortages in Zhèjiāng.
In the fifth month, on the day of Bǐngwǔ,
Àguì was ordered to go to Zhèjiāng,
to work with Cáo Wénzhí and others to investigate the granary shortages,
and also to inspect the sea dikes.
On the day of Bǐngchén,
Fùlèhún was dismissed from office,
and handed over to Àguì and others for interrogation.
On the day of Dīngsì,
Sūn Shìyì was appointed Zǒngdū of Liǎngguǎng,
Túsàbù was transferred to be Xúnfǔ of Guǎngdōng,
and Lǐ Fēng was appointed Xúnfǔ of Húběi.
On the day of Jǐwèi,
Lǐ Shìyáo was appointed acting Zǒngdū of Húguǎng.
On the day of Xīnwèi,
the Emperor conducted the autumn hunt at Mùlán.
Disaster relief was provided for the earthquake in Dǎjiànlú and other places in Sìchuān.
This month,
the annual tax quota for the previous year's drought in Shàngyuán and fifty-six other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Jiāngsū was remitted.
In the sixth month, on the day of Dīngchǒu,
the Emperor resided at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the day of Yǐyǒu,
Fúsōng was appointed acting Xúnfǔ of Shānxī.
On the day of Dīnghài,
the Yuánjiāng in Chángdé prefecture, Húnán, overflowed.
On the day of Xīnchǒu,
Fùgāng was transferred to be Zǒngdū of Mǐnzhè,
and Tèchéng'é was appointed Zǒngdū of Yúnguì.
Bì Yuán was appointed Zǒngdū of Húguǎng,
and Jiāng Lán was appointed Xúnfǔ of Hénán.
In autumn, the seventh month, on the day of Wùshēn,
the annual tax quota for the previous year's drought in Shāngqiū and twelve other prefectures and counties in Hénán was remitted.
On the day of Rénzǐ,
the river overflowed at Lǐjiāzhuāng, Qīnghé, Jiāngsū.
On the day of Dīngsì,
Àguì was ordered to go from Zhèjiāng to Qīngkǒu,
to work with Lǐ Shìjié and others to manage the blocking and construction affairs.
On the day of Jǐsì,
Cáo Xībǎo impeached Heshēn's servant Liú Quán,
but could not provide solid evidence,
so by imperial grace, he was dismissed from office but allowed to retain his post.
In the intercalary seventh month, on the day Gēngchén,
Grand Secretary, Earl Wǔmǐtài passed away.
Liú Bǐngtián was summoned to the capital.
Tán Shàngzhōng was appointed Governor of Yúnnán.
On the day Jǐchǒu,
Dòu Guāngnài, Education Commissioner of Zhèjiāng and Right Vice Minister of Personnel, was stripped of his office.
On the day Gēngyín,
Fùlèhún was sentenced to decapitation.
On the day Yǐwèi,
Heshēn was appointed Grand Secretary of the Wénhuá Hall,
to manage the affairs of the Board of Revenue.
Fúkāng'ān was appointed Minister of Personnel and Associate Grand Secretary,
remaining in his post as Governor-General of Shǎnxī and Gānsù.
Fúcháng'ān was appointed Minister of Revenue.
Chuòkètú was made acting Minister of War.
On the day Wùxū,
relief was provided for the flood-stricken areas of Wǔlíng and Lóngyáng in Húnán.
In the eighth month, on the day Bǐngchén,
the Emperor proceeded to Mùlán for a hunt.
On the day Gēngshēn,
Sōngchūn was transferred to be General of Suīyuǎrchéng,
and Jīfú to be General of Níngxià.
In the ninth month, on the day Wùyín,
the Emperor sojourned at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the day Dīnghài,
Lèbǎo was appointed Governor of Shānxī.
On the day Wùzǐ,
Yǒngbǎo was appointed Assistant Amban of Tǎěrbāhātái.
Bāyánsān was appointed Governor of Shǎnxī.
On the day Rénchén,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
On the day Jiǎwǔ,
Fúcháng'ān was transferred to be acting Minister of War,
and Chuòkètú was made acting Minister of Revenue.
On the day Yǐwèi,
Lánggān was appointed Governor of Zhèjiāng.
On the day Jǐhài,
the Emperor's eldest grandson, Beile Miándé, passed away.
Relief was provided for the flood-stricken areas of Wǔhé and seventeen other prefectures and counties, as well as Fèngyáng and five other garrisons, in Ānhuī.
In the winter tenth month, on the first day Xīnchǒu,
Fùgāng was transferred to be Governor-General of Yúnnán and Guìzhōu,
and Chángqīng to be Governor-General of Fújiàn and Zhèjiāng.
On the day Dīngwèi,
Bì Yuán was demoted to his former post as Governor of Hénán.
Jiāng Lán was restored to his post as Provincial Administration Commissioner of Hénán.
Lǐ Shìyáo was appointed Governor-General of Húguǎng.
On the day Dīngsì,
varying amounts of tax exemptions were granted for disaster-stricken areas in Ānzhōu and four other prefectures and counties in Zhílì.
In the eleventh month,
relief was provided for the flood-stricken areas of Héféi and seventeen other prefectures and counties in Ānhuī.
In the twelfth month, on the day Xīnchǒu,
bandits such as Chén Jiàn in Nánjìng county, Fújiàn, rebelled.
They were apprehended and dealt with.
On the day Rénzǐ,
Grand Secretary Liáng Guózhì passed away.
Minister of War Wáng Jié was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
On the day Wùwǔ,
Zhèng Huá was enfeoffed as King of Xiāmluó.
On the day Bǐngyín,
rebel leader Lín Shuǎngwén in Zhānghuà county, Fújiàn, rebelled,
capturing the county seat.
The county magistrate Yú Jùn died.
Chángqīng, Xú Sìzēng, and others were ordered to suppress the rebellion.
In this year,
Cháoxiǎn, Liúqiú, and Xiāmluó paid tribute.
In the spring first month of the fifty-second year, on the day Xīnwèi,
Lín Shuǎngwén captured Zhūluó and Zhúqiàn.
On the day Guǐyǒu,
È Huī was made acting Governor-General of Sìchuān.
On the day Yǐhài,
Fùlèhún's crime was pardoned.
On the day Dīngchǒu,
Lǐ Shìyáo was transferred to be Governor-General of Fújiàn and Zhèjiāng.
Chángqīng was transferred to be Governor-General of Húguǎng,
but remained in Fújiàn to oversee military affairs.
Shūcháng was ordered to act on his behalf.
On the day Guǐwèi,
Lín Shuǎngwén captured Fèngshān.
The county magistrate Tāng Dàquán died.
On the day Jiǎshēn,
Chángqīng ordered garrison commander Chén Bāngguāng to lead civilian militia to defend Lùzǎigǎng,
and reported the recapture of Zhānghuà.
On the day Dīnghài,
Wáng Jié was appointed Grand Secretary of the Dōnggé Hall,
managing the affairs of the Board of Rites.
Péng Yuánruì was transferred to be Minister of War.
Jì Yún was appointed Minister of Rites.
On the day Gēngyín,
permission was granted for Minister of Revenue Cáo Wénzhí to care for his parents until their death.
Dǒng Gào was appointed to replace him.
On the day Xīnmǎo,
Sōngyún was ordered to go to Kùlún to handle affairs.
On the day Dīngyǒu,
Chángqīng was ordered to cross to Táiwān to suppress the bandits.
In the second month, on the day Rényín,
Lín Shuǎngwén recaptured Fèngshān,
and attacked Táiwān prefecture.
Chái Dàjì led soldiers and civilians to resist.
On the day Guǐmǎo,
Lǐ Shòu was appointed Censor-in-Chief on the Left.
On the day Yǐsì,
Chánglín was appointed Governor of Shāndōng.
On the day Rénzǐ,
the annual quota of taxes for the Táiwān prefecture was remitted.
On the day Bǐngchén,
Zhūluó was recovered.
On the day Jiǎzǐ,
the Emperor proceeded to the Eastern Tombs.
On the day Dīngmǎo,
the Emperor visited the Zhāoxī Mausoleum, Xiào Mausoleum, Xiàodōng Mausoleum, and Jǐng Mausoleum.
In the third month, on the day Guǐyǒu,
the Emperor returned.
On the day Bǐngzǐ,
with the completion of the reconstruction of the Míng Tombs,
the Emperor personally inspected them,
and reiterated the prohibition on firewood collection.
On the day Xīnsì,
Fèngshān was recovered.
On the day Xīnmǎo,
Jiāng Shèng was appointed Governor of Húběi.
Huáng Shǐjiǎn was stripped of his office for impeding military affairs,
and his eldest grandson Jiāmó was allowed to inherit the ducal title.
On the day Yǐwèi,
Huáng Shǐjiǎn was arrested and imprisoned.
In the summer fourth month, on the day Xīnchǒu,
Chángqīng was appointed General.
Héngruì and Lán Yuánméi were appointed Counselors.
Lán Yuánméi was transferred to be Naval Commander of Fújiàn.
Chái Dàjì was made acting Army Commander.
On the day Wùwǔ,
the Emperor proceeded to Hēilóngtán to pray for rain.
On the day Réngxū,
Shǐ Zhìguāng and 137 others were granted the Jinshì degree with varying ranks.
On the day Jiǎzǐ,
the Emperor reviewed the firearm corps.
In the fifth month, on the first day Dīngmǎo,
Gòngchǔkèzhábù, Assistant Amban of Wūlǐyǎsūtái, was dismissed due to illness.
Sānpīlèduōěrzǐ was appointed to replace him.
On the day Wùchén,
Lán Dìxī was appointed Governor-General of River Conservancy for Héngdōng.
On the day Jiǎxū,
the Emperor went on an autumn hunt in Mùlán.
On the day Gēngchén,
the Emperor sojourned at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
The Miáo people in Fènghuáng Hall, Húnán, rebelled.
General Yǐn Déxǐ suppressed them.
In the sixth month, on the day Gēngxū,
the annual tax for land in Rénhé field, Zhèjiāng, washed away by the tide, was remitted.
On the day Rézǐ,
Chái Dàjì was appointed Army Commander of Fújiàn,
also managing the affairs of the Táiwān Commander.
On the day Bǐngchén,
Fúkāng'ān was summoned to the imperial temporary residence.
Lèbǎo was made acting Governor-General of Shǎnxī and Gānsù.
In the autumn seventh month, on the day Rénchén,
Hǎilánchá was appointed Counselor.
Shūliàng and Pǔěrpǔ were appointed commanders of the detachment,
leading imperial guards and adjutants to Táiwān to suppress the bandits.
On the day Guǐsì,
relief was provided for the flood-stricken areas of Huáiyuǎn, Fèngyáng, and other prefectures and counties in Ānhuī.
Relief was provided for the drought-stricken areas of Fēngzhèn and nine other prefectures, departments, and counties in Shānxī.
In the eighth month,
Chángqīng was dismissed.
Fúkāng'ān was appointed General,
to go to Táiwān to oversee military affairs.
On the day Xīnhài,
the Emperor proceeded to Mùlán for a hunt.
In the ninth month, on the day Réshēn,
the Emperor returned to sojourn at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng.
On the day Gēngchén,
the Emperor returned.
On the day Rénwǔ,
Chái Dàjì was transferred to be Naval Commander of Fújiàn.
Cài Pānlóng was appointed Army Commander of Fújiàn,
and also granted the title of Counselor.
On the day Xīnmǎo,
as Zhūluó was still under siege,
Fúkāng'ān was urged to proceed directly to suppress the bandits at Dàlǐyì,
and also to dispatch troops to advance to Dàjiǎxī.
In the winter tenth month, on the day Dīngwèi,
Fúcháng'ān was made acting Minister of Works.
On the day Wùshēn,
Fúlín Mausoleum was repaired.
On the day Dīngwèi,
the breach at the lower dike of Suīzhōu was closed.
On the day Bǐngchén,
Ā Guì was ordered to go to Jiāngnán to inspect the dike works at Gāoyàn and other places.
On the day Wùwǔ,

varying amounts of grain and money for the grain transport tax were remitted for the flood-stricken areas of Qīnghé and twenty-three other prefectures and counties, as well as Huái'ān and five other garrisons, in Jiāngsū, for this year.
On the day Xīnyǒu,
Fúzhōu General Héngruì was recalled to the capital
for cowardice in suppressing bandits.
È Huī was transferred to replace him.
Relief was provided for the drought-stricken areas of Bǎo'ān and seven other prefectures and counties in Zhílì.
On the day Rénxū,
Jiāngsū and Zhèjiāng were ordered to each allocate fifty thousand strings of cash for military expenses in Fújiàn.
On the *jiǎzǐ* day of the eleventh month,
Li Shìyáo and Sūn Shìyì were promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent (Tàizǐ Tàibǎo);
Chái Dàjì was promoted to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent (Tàizǐ Shàobǎo).
Imperial plaques were bestowed upon the righteous people (yìrén) of Zhuāng in Táiwān and Guǎngdōng, and of Quánzhōu.
On the *rénshēn* day,
Chái Dàjì, for steadfastly defending Jiāyì,
was enfeoffed as a First-class Earl of Valiant Righteousness (Yīděng Yìyǒng Bó),
with hereditary succession.
The fixed tax (éfù) of Jiāyì County, Táiwān, for 54 years, was remitted.
Bāyánsān reported that the Dàlài Lǎmā had sent envoys, referring to them as
“barbarian envoys” (yíshǐ).
He was reprimanded for this.
On the *yǐyǒu* day,
Kuílín, for avarice and embezzlement,
was stripped of his office and arrested for questioning.
Bǎoníng was appointed General of Yīlí.
Lǐ Shìjié was transferred to be Governor-General of Sìchuān;
Shūlín was appointed Governor-General of Liǎngjiāng;
Chén Yòngfū was appointed Governor of Ānhuī.
On the *dīngwèi* day of the twelfth month,
Fúkāng'ān and others defeated the rebels at Lúnzǐdǐng Zhuāng and other places,
lifting the siege of Jiāyì.
Fúkāng'ān and Hǎilánchá were promoted to dukes (gōngjué),
each awarded a ruby finial (hóngbǎoshí dǐng) and a four-round-dragon imperial jacket (sìtuánlóng bǔguà).
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
Chángqīng was transferred to be General of Fúzhōu.
Shūcháng was appointed Governor-General of Húguǎng;
Fúcháng'ān was appointed Minister of Works (Gōngbù Shàngshū).
Regarding Fúkāng'ān's impeachment of Chái Dàjì and Cài Pānlóng, stating that many of their achievements in battle and defense were not factual,
an imperial decree said:
"Chái Dàjì firmly maintained his resolve
and exerted all his strength to defend.
Cài Pānlóng bravely fought the rebels,
eventually reaching the county seat.
Perhaps they were disrespectful in etiquette before Fúkāng'ān,
leading to his displeasure.
How can their achievements be dismissed
and unwarranted crimes suddenly be added to them?"
Sūn Shìyì, for deploying troops and transporting weapons without distinction of boundaries (bù fēn zhěnyù),
was awarded a double-eyed peacock feather (shuāngyǎn huālíng).
On the *wùwǔ* day,
Déchén reported that Chái Dàjì was greedy, dissolute, and negligent.
Fúkāng'ān and Lǐ Shìyáo were ordered to impeach him truthfully.
Also, Yǎdé, the Minister in charge of Kashíjiāěr (Kāshígá'ěr bànshì dàchén), was arrested for conniving and concealing during his time in Fújiàn.
On the *gēngshēn* day,
Wǔlánà was appointed Acting Governor of Fújiàn.
Yǒngduó was appointed General of Shèngjīng;
Shàng'ān was appointed Military Governor (Dūtǒng) of Wūlǔmùqí.
On the *dīngmǎo* day of the first month of spring in the 53rd year,
the fixed taxes for the current year in Jìnjiāng and 19 other counties in Fújiàn, where military personnel and corvée laborers (bīngchāi) had passed, were partially remitted.
On the *xīnwèi* day,
Míngxīng reported that the rivers in Yǒngníng and other places in Shānxī were clear.
On the *bǐngxū* day,
Chái Dàjì was stripped of his office and arrested for questioning.
Chángqīng, General of Fúzhōu, was stripped of his office for conniving and concealing Chái Dàjì.
On the *jiǎwǔ* day, the first day of the second month,
Lín Shuǎngwén was captured.
Fúkāng'ān and Hǎilánchá were awarded imperial pouches (yùyòng pèináng).
The rewards for generals and officers were discussed and varied.
Grand Secretary (Dàxuéshì) Heshēn was promoted to a Third-class Earl (Sānděng Bójué).
Grand Secretaries Āguì and Wáng Jié,
and Ministers (Shàngshū) Fúcháng'ān and Dǒng Gào discussed this.
Sūn Shìyì was granted the hereditary position of Light Chariot Commandant (Qīngchē Dūwèi).
On the *yǐwèi* day,
Huáng Shǐjiǎn and Rèn Chéng'ēn were released.
On the *rén'yín* day,
Hǎilù, Assistant Military Governor (Cānzàn Dàchén) of Yīlí, was stripped of his office for making an unsubstantiated impeachment against Kuílín.
Both he and Kuílín were punished to serve as imperial bodyguards (bàitáng'ā).
On the *yǐsì* day,
the descendants of the worthies' sons (xiānxián yǒu zǐ hòuyì) were appointed as Erudites of the Five Classics (Wǔjīng Bóshì).
On the *xīnhài* day,
the Emperor went on an inspection tour to Tiānjīn.
On the *gēngshēn* day,
Zhuāng Dàtián, the rebel leader in Táiwān, was captured.
The rewards for Commander-in-Chief (Tídū) Xǔ Shìhēng and others were discussed and varied.
On the *xīnyǒu* day,
the arrears of tax (būfù) in Tiānjīn Prefecture were remitted.
On the *rénxū* day,
the Emperor reviewed troops at the Wǔlóu (Martial Review Tower).
On the *wùchén* day of the third month,
Vice Minister (Shìláng) Mùjīng'ā was ordered to Húběi
to jointly investigate cases with Shūcháng.
On the *rénshēn* day,
Lín Shuǎngwén was executed.
On the *guǐwèi* day,

Fúkāng'ān and Hǎilánchá were again awarded purple reins (zǐjiāng), golden yellow plaited coral court beads (jīnhuáng biànshānhú cháozhū), and Fúkāng'ān was also given a golden yellow sash (jīnhuáng yāodài).
On the *xīnchǒu* day of the fourth month of summer,
due to drought, the Ministry of Punishments (Xíngbù) was ordered to reduce sentences for crimes lesser than penal servitude (tú).
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
the Emperor reviewed the Jiànruì Camp troops.
On the *gēngxū* day,
the fixed taxes for the previous year's flood disaster in Qīnghé and 17 other prefectures and counties, and Huái'ān and 4 other military garrisons (wèi) in Jiāngsū, were partially remitted.
On the *jǐwèi* day,
Fùlèhún and Yǎdé were sentenced to strangulation for failing to detect Chái Dàjì's corruption.
On the *dīngmǎo* day of the fifth month,
the fixed taxes for the previous year's flood disaster in Shāngqiū and 5 other prefectures and counties in Hénán were partially remitted.
On the *guǐyǒu* day,
the fixed taxes for the previous year's flood disaster on commoners' fields and Banner lands in Bǎo'ān and 6 other prefectures and counties in Zhílì were remitted.
On the *gēngchén* day,
the Emperor went on an autumn hunt at Mùlán.
On the *guǐwèi* day,
Chángqīng's crime was pardoned.
On the *gēngyín* day,
refugees in Táiwān were relieved.
On the *bǐngshēn* day of the sixth month,
Fùgāng reported that Yèmiǎoruìdòng (Yèmiǎoruìdòng) and other tribal chiefs (tóumù) from the Měngyǔn (Měngyǔn) of Miǎndiàn (Miǎndiàn) had brought golden leaf memorials (jīnyè biǎowén) as tribute.
An edict ordered them to be escorted swiftly to the Emperor's temporary residence (xíngzài).
On the *wùxū* day,
Húbǐn Wǎngpǔ County, suffering from a flood, was relieved.
The fixed taxes for the previous year's flood disaster in Fèngyáng and 3 other prefectures, departments, and military garrisons (fǔzhōuwèi) in Ānhuī were partially remitted.
On the *xīnchǒu* day,
Húběi Chángyáng County, suffering from a flood, was relieved.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
the fixed taxes for the 51st year's flood disaster in Huázhōu and 2 other prefectures and counties in Shǎnxī were remitted.
On the *wùshēn* day,
the Ānnán people Ruan Huì and others rebelled and expelled their king, Lí Wéiqí.
Wéiqí came to seek assistance.
Sūn Shìyì was ordered to Guǎngxī to pacify and admonish them.
The fixed taxes for the previous year's drought disaster in Dàtóng and 8 other prefectures and counties in Shānxī were remitted.
On the *xīnyǒu* day, the first day of the seventh month of autumn,
because Ruǎn Huīxù, a pastoral official (mùmǎ guān) from Ānnán, brought Lí Wéiqí's mother and son to seek refuge,
Sūn Shìyì and others were ordered to console and care for them.
On the *rénxū* day,
Jiāozhōu and Shòuguāng in Shāndōng, suffering from floods, were relieved.
The Jiāng River in Jīngzhōu, Húběi, overflowed.
Both the prefectural city and the Manchu city were submerged.
Shūcháng and others were ordered to investigate and provide relief.
On the *dīngchǒu* day,
Lǐ Shìyáo, Governor-General of Mǐnzhè, was restored to the title of Earl (Bójué).
Lǐ Fèngyáo, who currently held the hereditary title, was given the rank of Commander-in-Chief (Tídū).
On the *wùyín* day,
the Jiāng River in Wǔchāng and Hànyáng, Húběi, overflowed.
Bì Yuán was appointed Governor-General of Húguǎng;
Wǔlánà was appointed Governor of Hénán;
Míngxīng was appointed Minister in charge of Wūshí (Wūshí bànshì dàchén).
Huáiníng and other prefectures and counties in Ānhuī, suffering from floods, were relieved.
Chái Dàjì was sentenced to decapitation.
Jiāng Shèng was summoned to the capital (Jīng);
Huìlíng was appointed Governor of Húběi.
On the *wùzǐ* day,
the Guō'ěrkā (Guō'ěrkā) occupied Jílóng and Nièlāmù in Hòuzàng.
Chéngdé and Mùkèdēng'ā were ordered to suppress them.
On the *jiǎchén* day of the eighth month,
Jiānlì and Shíshǒu in Húběi, suffering from floods, were relieved.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
the Emperor went to Mùlán.
On the *gēngxū* day,
due to severe floods in Mùlán,
the hunting expedition was halted.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
the Guō'ěrkā again captured Zōngkā.
Èhuī was appointed General (Jiāngjūn), and Chéngdé was appointed Assistant Military Governor (Cānzàn Dàchén) to suppress them.
On the *bǐngchén* day,
the Ānnán people Ruǎn Yuè and others fled.
Sūn Shìyì was ordered to supervise Xǔ Shìhēng in attacking them.
Fùgāng was ordered to command troops to garrison Měngzì.
On the *wùwǔ* day,
the Emperor returned to reside at the Bìshǔ Shānzhuāng (Mountain Resort).
On the *rénxū* day of the ninth month,
Xìhājuékòng (Xìhājuékòng) and other foreign chiefs (fānmù) from Miǎndiàn came for an imperial audience.
An edict stated that Xiānluó and Miǎndiàn had both recently submitted.
The two countries should cultivate good relations
and not engage in warfare as before.
On the *wùchén* day,
Miǎnyáng and Huánggāng in Húběi, suffering from floods, were relieved.
On the *guǐyǒu* day,
the fixed taxes for the previous year's flood disaster in Sùzhōu and 20 other prefectures, counties, and military garrisons (zhōuxiànwèi) in Ānhuī were remitted.
On the *gēngyín* day of the tenth month of winter,
the Guō'ěrkā invaded Sàkā in Hòuzàng.
Sūn Shìyì was ordered to leave the pass to supervise the suppression.
On the *jiǎwǔ* day,
Qiánjiāng in Húběi, suffering from a flood, was relieved.
On the *bǐngshēn* day,
Jiāngxià and 35 other prefectures and counties in Húběi, suffering from floods, were relieved.
On the *jǐhài* day,
because Lí Wéiqí was weak and obscure,
Sūn Shìyì was ordered to select a descendant of the Lí clan to come to the capital (Jīng) to pay tribute.
On the *gēngzǐ* day,
Wū Dàjīng, Commander-in-Chief (Tídū) of Yúnnán, was ordered to lead troops out of the pass,
and a manifesto was issued to Ruǎn Huì and others to return to allegiance.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
Shūlián was transferred to be Resident Amban (Zhùzàng Dàchén);
Héngruì was appointed Assistant Military Governor (Cānzàn Dàchén) of Yīlí.
Dū'ěrjiā was transferred to be General of Shèngjīng;
Héngxiù was appointed General of Jílín.
Sōngchūn was transferred to be General of Xī'ān;
Xīngzhào replaced him.
Línníng was appointed General of Hēilóngjiāng.
On the *yǐmǎo* day,
Lǐ Shìyáo was ill.
Fúkāng'ān was ordered to serve as Acting Governor-General of Mǐnzhè.
On the *xīnyǒu* day of the eleventh month,

tax exemptions were granted, with differences according to need, to Ānhuī's Wàngjiāng and twenty-five other prefectures and counties, and the local garrisons, for the regular land tax of the current year due to flooding.
On the *guǐhài* day,
Lǐ Shìyáo passed away.
Fúkāng'ān was appointed to succeed him.
Lèbǎo was made Governor-General of Shǎnxī and Gānsù.
Hǎiníng was made Provincial Governor of Shānxī.
On the *bǐngzǐ* day,
the dikes of Jiānglíng and Gōng'ān in Húběi were repaired.

Tax exemptions were granted, with differences according to need, to Húběi's Jiānglíng and thirty-five other prefectures and counties for the regular land tax of the current year due to flood disaster.
On the *jǐchǒu* day of the twelfth month,
Fùlèhún and Yǎdé were released.
Sūn Shìyì reported a victory over the rebels at Shòuchāng Jiāng.
On the *guǐsì* day,
the rebels were again defeated at Shìqiú Jiāng.
On the *bǐngshēn* day,
Líchéng was recaptured.
Lí Wéiqí was reinstated as King of Ānnán.
Sūn Shìyì was enfeoffed as a First-Class Duke of Móuyǒng.
Xǔ Shìhēng was enfeoffed as a First-Class Viscount.
On the *wùshēn* day,
Sūn Shìyì was ordered to withdraw his troops.
In the spring of the 54th year, on the *jǐwèi* day of the first month,
due to disorder in the court during the New Year's Day congratulations,
the Censor of Etiquette
and other officials were stripped of their posts.
Minister Débǎo was stripped of his peacock feather and button.
The presiding officials of the Dūcháyuàn and Hónglúsì were all sent to the relevant boards for severe deliberation.
On the *gēngshēn* day,
Chéngdé reported the recapture of Zōngkā and Jìlóng,
and the conquest of Nièlāmù.
On the *guǐyǒu* day,
Débǎo, Minister of the Board of Rites, passed away.
Chángqīng was appointed to succeed him.
On the *jiǎxū* day,
as Méngyǔn of Miǎndiàn regretted his actions and pledged allegiance,
an edict was issued for him to maintain friendly relations with his neighbors.
The King of Xiāmluó, Zhèng Huácǎi, was also granted brocades and silks,
and ordered to resolve conflicts and eliminate hostilities.
Tax exemptions were granted for disaster-related arrears of the regular land tax in Fújiàn's Dànshuǐ and five other departments and counties.
On the *guǐwèi* day,
Ruǎn Huì recaptured Líchéng.
Xǔ Shìhēng, Provincial Commander-in-chief of Guǎngxī, and others died there.
Sūn Shìyì was summoned to the capital
and stripped of his ducal title.
Fúkāng'ān was transferred to be Governor-General of Liǎngguǎng.
Wǔlānà was made Governor-General of Mǐnzhè.
Liáng Kēntáng was made Provincial Governor of Hénán.
Hǎilù was made Provincial Commander-in-chief of Guǎngxī.
On the *jiǎshēn* day,
Lí Wéiqí, King of Ānnán, again fled to seek refuge.
He was ordered to be settled in Guǎngxī.
On the *bǐngxū* day,
Sūn Shìyì was stripped of his official post,
but was ordered to continue working at Zhènnánguān with the rank of Governor-General.
In the second month, on the *gēngyín* day,
as the deadline for the Capital Review was approaching,
Grand Secretary Āguì and others were subjected to deliberation.
Academicians of the Grand Secretariat Xiè Yǒng and others were sent to the relevant board for deliberation and punishment.
Fúlù, Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, was granted retirement at his original rank.
Governor-General Fúkāng'ān and others were subjected to deliberation.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
Lèbǎo was granted an audience with the Emperor.
Bāyánsān was appointed acting Governor-General of Shǎnxī and Gānsù.
Gégbèng'é, the leader of Khéten (Hetian), was executed
after his extortion was confirmed.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
Lán Dìxī was transferred to be Governor-General of Riverways for Jiāngnán.
Lǐ Fènghàn was made Governor-General of Riverways for Hédōng.
On the *yǐmǎo* day,
an edict was explicitly issued to Fúkāng'ān, stating
that Ānnán's pestilential and barren land
was not worth waging war over.
In the third month, on the *jiǎzǐ* day,
accumulated tax arrears, as well as outstanding seed grain and rations, in Gānsù were exempted.
Outstanding granary grain in Shǎnxī's Yán'ān and two other prefectures and departments was exempted.
Fúkāng'ān was ordered to send a dispatch to Ruǎn Huì, commanding him to capture and surrender the bandits who had murdered the Provincial Commanders.
On the *yǐchǒu* day,
Liú Yōng was demoted to the rank of Vice Minister
for dereliction of duty as a tutor in the Imperial Study.
Péng Yuánruì was made Minister of the Board of Civil Office.
Sūn Shìyì was made Minister of the Board of War.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
the Emperor traveled to Pánshān.
In the summer, on the *wùzǐ* day of the fourth month,
the regular land tax for the previous year's flood disaster in the two cities of Guǎngníng and Fènghuáng in Fèngtiān was exempted,
and disaster relief was provided with differences according to need.
On the *bǐngshēn* day,
Xǔ Shìhēng was posthumously granted the title of Earl,
and his son Chéngmó was ordered to inherit it.
Sūn Shìyì was recalled to the capital.
On the *gēngzǐ* day,
Héngruì was made General of Wūlǐyàsūtái.
Fúcháng'ān was appointed acting Minister of the Board of War.
Fúkāng'ān was ordered to settle the clan members and former officials of the Lí family of Ānnán.
Pān Qǐdé, the Military Governor of Liàngshān who contributed to the military campaign, was given the rank of Assistant Regional Commander.
On the *rén'yín* day,
Āguì was ordered to re-inspect the dikes of Jīngzhōu.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
an imperial proclamation stated:
"The climate and soil of Ānnán are harsh,
and it has been decided not to wage war there again.
Ruǎn Huì has begged for surrender three times.
If he truly comes to the capital to seek imperial favor,
he may be granted a title commensurate with his status.
When We govern foreign barbarians,
We always embody the virtue of Heaven's love for life,
and have never dared to exhaust our military forces or lightly engage in war."
On the *xīnhài* day,
Hú Chánglíng and ninety-seven others were granted the *jìnshì* degree with different ranks.
Dū'ěrjiā was transferred to be General of Hēilóngjiāng.
Sōngchūn was made General of Shèngjīng.
Héngxiù was made General of Suíyuǎnchéng.
Línníng was made General of Jílín.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
as Ruǎn Huì did not come personally to plead,
but sent Ruǎn Guāngxiǎn to enter the pass with tribute,
Fúkāng'ān was ordered to refuse it.
On the *bǐngchén* day,
the regular land tax for the previous year's drought disaster in Zhílì's Xuānhuà and three other counties was exempted.
In the fifth month, on the *jǐwèi* day,
the regular land tax for the current year in Guǎngxī's Liǔzhōu and four other prefectures, through which government troops passed, was exempted.
Fúkāng'ān and others reported that Ruǎn Huì of Ānnán had sent his nephew, Ruǎn Guāngxiǎn, with a memorial and tribute to beg for surrender,
and also pleaded for an imperial audience.
This was granted,
but his tribute was refused.
On the *yǐyǒu* day,
officials were added to Yīlí Huìyuǎnchéng and Huìníngchéng.
In the intercalary fifth month, on the *gēngyín* day,
the Emperor went on the autumn hunt at Mùlán.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
the regular land tax for the previous year's flood disaster in Fèngtiān's Guǎngníng and six other cities was exempted.
On the *jiǎwǔ* day,
earthquake victims in Yúnnán's Tōnghǎi and four other prefectures and counties were given relief.
In the sixth month,
the regular land tax for the 53rd year's flood disaster in Ānhuī's Ānqìng and six other prefectures and departments was exempted.
On the *jiǎzǐ* day,
Guǎn Gànzhēn was made Governor-General of Grain Transport.
On the *wùchén* day,
flood victims in Zhílì's Líxiàn were given relief.
On the *gēngwǔ* day,
Sūn Shìyì, Minister of the Board of War, was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
On the *rénshēn* day,
Guō Shìxūn was made Provincial Governor of Guǎngdōng.
On the *guǐyǒu* day,
Chén Bùyíng was made Provincial Governor of Guìzhōu.
On the *bǐngzǐ* day,
Fúkāng'ān reported
that Ruǎn Huì, whose real name was Ruǎn Guāngpíng,
had been pardoned for his previous crimes,
allowed to surrender and pledge allegiance,
and had submitted a memorial to express gratitude and offer tribute,
also requesting to come to the capital next year to offer felicitations.
The Emperor, finding his words sincere and earnest,
enfeoffed him as King of Ānnán,
and bestowed upon him an imperial edict.
The regular land tax for the previous year's flood disaster in Húběi's Jiāngxià and twenty-three other prefectures and counties was exempted.
In the autumn, on the *yǐyǒu* day, the first day of the seventh month,
an edict was issued for disaster relief for the people
in the area around Sìzhōu, where the river had breached its banks and flowed downwards.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
flood victims in Zhílì's Ānzhōu and seven other prefectures and counties were given relief.
On the *gēngzǐ* day,
Chuòkètō, Minister of the Board of Revenue, passed away.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
Bāyánsān was made Minister of the Board of Revenue.
Qín Chéng'ēn was made Provincial Governor of Shǎnxī.
On the *wùshēn* day,
Ruǎn Guāngxiǎn and other Ānnán tribute envoys were granted an imperial audience.
In the eighth month, on the *yǐchǒu* day,
flood victims in Hénán's Yǒngchéng, Línzhāng, and other counties were given relief.
On the *wùchén* day,
flood victims in Ānhuī's Sùzhōu were given relief.
On the *jǐsì* day,
the Emperor traveled to Mùlán for a hunting expedition.
On the *jiǎxū* day,
flood victims in Zhílì's Qīngyuàn and thirty-three other prefectures and counties were given relief.
In the ninth month, on the *jǐchǒu* day,
the Gū'ěrkā tribute envoys were granted an imperial audience.
Lātnàbādū'ěr was enfeoffed as a Prince.
Bādū'ěrsàyě was enfeoffed as a Duke.
On the *gēngyín* day,
the Emperor returned to reside at the Mountain Resort for Avoiding the Heat.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
flood victims in Jiāngsū's Tóngshān and ten other prefectures and counties were given relief.
On the *bǐngshēn* day,
flood victims in Húnchūn, Jílín Province, were given relief,
and the required contribution of grain to the charitable granaries and outstanding loans of granary grain from the previous year were exempted.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
the imperial entourage returned.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
Lí Wéiqí of Ānnán, having attacked Mùmǎ from Bǎolè,
was defeated by Ruǎn Guāngpíng.
Fúkāng'ān was instructed
that if Lí Wéiqí came seeking refuge,
he should be received.
On the *xīnhài* day,
Āyáng'ā, Censor-in-Chief of the Left, passed away.
Shūcháng was appointed to succeed him.
In winter, in the tenth month, on the day *Guǐchǒu*,
the Cháhā'ěr Military Governor, Wū'ěrtúnàxùn, was dismissed.
Bǎotài replaced him.
Wǔ'ěrwǔxùn was ordered to be the Kēbùduō Assistant Minister.
On the day *Yǐmǎo*,
Fózhù was made the Wūlǐyǎsūtái Assistant Minister.
Relief was provided for flood victims in Jílín's Dǎshēng Wūlā and other areas.
On the day *Jǐwèi*,
the breach at Suīníng was closed.
On the day *Xīnyǒu*,
relief was provided for flood victims in Húnán's Huáróng and other counties.
In the eleventh month, on the day *Yǐyǒu*,
the King of Ānnán, Ruǎn Guāngpíng, offered tribute to express gratitude for his enfeoffment,
which was permitted.
On the day *Bǐngxū*,
arrears of taxes and levies were remitted for Ānhuī's Sùzhōu and fourteen other prefectures, counties, and garrisons.
On the day *Gēngyín*,
Fúkāng'ān was ordered to send Lí Wéiqí and his associates to the capital,
to be enrolled in the Hàngjūn Banner Registry,
with Lí Wéiqí serving as a hereditary Zǔolǐng.
On the day *Guǐsì*,
the Governor-General of Sìchuān, Lǐ Shìjié, fell ill.
Imperial Guard Qìngchéng was ordered to bring a doctor to diagnose him.
Sūn Shìyì was appointed acting governor-general,
and Péng Yuánruì was appointed acting Minister of War.
On the day *Wùxū*,
loans of grain from granaries in Shèngjīng and four other cities were remitted.
In the twelfth month, on the day *Gēngshēn*,
the posthumous titles of former Grand Secretary Féng Quán and others were revoked.
On the day *Xīnwèi*,
the Emperor, anticipating his eightieth birthday in the coming year,
ordered the carving of the 'Bāzhēng Màoniàn zhī Bǎo' seal.
In the fifty-fifth year, in spring, in the first month, on the first day *Rénwǔ*,
due to the eightieth birthday,
an imperial edict was issued, granting varying degrees of special grace.
Taxes and levies across all directly governed provinces were universally remitted.
On the day *Jǐchǒu*,
an edict of grace was issued to Cháoxiān, Ānnán, Liúqiú, Xiāmluó, and other nations.
On the day *Rénchén*,
Grand Secretary Héshēn was bestowed with a yellow belt and a four-panel imperial robe.
The King of Ānnán, Ruǎn Guāngpíng, was granted a golden yellow belt.
On the day *Yǐsì*,
the King of Cháoxiān, Lǐ Biǎo, offered congratulations on the birthday,
and presented local products as tribute.
On the day *Jǐyǒu*,
the King of Liúqiú, Shàng Mù, presented a memorial to express gratitude,
and offered local products as tribute.
In the second month, on the first day *Rénzǐ*,
due to errors in the construction work of Kǎochéng county in Hénán,
the Jiānglán Circuit Intendant was demoted,
and Bì Yuán and others were stripped of their posts,
but retained in their positions.
On the day *Guǐchǒu*,
the regular taxes for the fifty-fourth year's flood disaster in Zhílì's Yǒngqīng and Wǔqīng were remitted.
On the day *Jǐwèi*,
the Emperor visited the Dōnglíng and Xīlíng Imperial Tombs,
and toured Shāndōng.
Three-tenths of the taxes and levies for the directly administered prefectures and counties along the route were remitted.
On the day *Rénxū*,
the Emperor paid respects at the Zhāoxīlíng, Xiàolíng, and Xiàodōnglíng Imperial Tombs.
On the day *Gēngwǔ*,
the Emperor paid respects at the Tàilíng and Tàidōnglíng Imperial Tombs.
On the day *Xīnwèi*,
taxes and levies that had been deferred for years due to disasters in various Zhílì prefectures were remitted.
On the day *Rénshēn*,
Fúkāng'ān was ordered to bring Ruǎn Guāngpíng for an imperial audience,
and Guō Shìxūn concurrently served as acting Governor-General of Liǎngguǎng.
On the day *Yǐhài*,
the regular land tax for earthquake-stricken fields in Yúnnán's Tōnghǎi and four other prefectures and counties for the fifty-fourth year was remitted,
and the tax for fields submerged by coastal earthquakes was also abolished.
Three-tenths of the taxes and levies for the areas traversed in Shāndōng were remitted.
Zhílì Governor-General Liú Shìláng was demoted.
Liáng Kěntáng was made Governor-General of Zhílì.
Mùhélín was transferred to be the Governor of Hénán.
On the day *Wùyín*,
arrears of silver payments deferred due to disasters in various Shāndōng prefectures were remitted.
Fú Sōng was made Governor of Ānhuī.
In the third month, on the day *Yǐyǒu*,
the Emperor ascended Tài.
On the day *Jiǎwǔ*,
the Emperor paid respects at the Shàohào Mausoleum.
He then went to Qǔfù to visit the Temple of the First Teacher.
On the day *Yǐwèi*,
a sacrificial ceremony was held.
Yǎnshènggōng Kǒng Xiànpéi and other members of the Kǒng clan were bestowed with various grades of robes and silver coins.
On the day *Bǐngshēn*,
the Emperor paid respects at the Kǒnglín.
On the day *Gēngzǐ*,
one-tenth of the regular land tax for various prefectures and counties in Wūlǔmùqí was remitted.
On the day *Yǐsì*,
Méng Yǔn, the ruler of the Miǎndiàn nation, sent envoys to present a memorial congratulating the Emperor on his birthday,
offered trained elephants as tribute,
and requested an enfeoffment title.
He was ordered to be enfeoffed as the King of Miǎndiàn.
Rent for banner lands in Zhílì's Chāngpíng and seven other prefectures and counties affected by floods was remitted.
Zhāo Wēnměng, the King of Nánzhǎng, presented a memorial congratulating the Emperor on his birthday,
and offered trained elephants as tribute.
On the day *Jǐyǒu*,
the salt tax for the previous year's flood disaster in Zhílì's Chánglú and four other salt fields was remitted.
In summer, in the fourth month, on the day *Dīngsì*,
the Emperor visited Tiānjīn Prefecture.
