the Emperor accompanied the Grand Empress Dowager on a visit to Nányuàn (南苑).
The Emperor conducted a hunt.
On the *xīnsì* (辛巳) day,
the Emperor accompanied the Grand Empress Dowager back to the palace.
On the *jiǎwǔ* (甲wǔ) day,
the Emperor accompanied the Grand Empress Dowager to review the Jiànruìyíng (健銳營) troops.
On the *wùxū* (戊戌) day,
Chéng Hánzhāng (程含章) was transferred to be Governor of Jiāngxī (江西),
and Qíshàn (琦善) was appointed acting Governor of Shāndōng (山東).
In this month,
additional one month's food provisions were distributed to disaster victims in Wén'ān (文安) county, Zhílì (直隸).
In the summer, on the *jiǎchén* (甲辰) day of the fourth month,
Yán Jiǎn (顏檢) was summoned to the capital,
and Jiǎng Yōuxiān (蔣攸銛) was appointed Governor-General of Zhílì (直隸).
Nà Qīng'ān (那清安) was transferred to be Minister of the Board of Punishments,
and Yùlín (玉麟) was transferred to be Minister of the Board of War.
Assistant Minister of the Board of Revenue, Mùkèdēng'é (穆克登額), was appointed Minister of the Board of Rites.
On the *guǐhài* (癸亥) day,
the Emperor prayed for rain at Juéshēng (覺生) Temple.
On the *jiǎzǐ* (甲zǐ) day,
Lín Zhàotáng (林召棠) and two hundred forty-six others were granted the *jìnshì* (進士) degree with varying ranks.
On the *xīnwèi* (辛未) day of the fifth month,
relief was provided for the disaster in Bàzhōu (霸州) and other prefectures and counties in Zhílì (直隸).
In this month,
relief was provided to disaster victims in Bàzhōu (霸州) and thirty-six other prefectures and counties in Zhílì (直隸).
In the sixth month,

Acting Assistant Minister of Works, Zhāng Wénhào (張文浩), was ordered to collaborate with Jiǎng Yōuxiān (蔣攸銛) to inspect the Southern and Northern Grand Canals, as well as the Yǒngdìng (永定), Dàqīng (大清), and Hūtuó (滹沱) Rivers.
On the *wùwǔ* (戊wǔ) day,
Guǒlèfēng'é (果勒豐額) was appointed General of Wūliǎsūtái (烏里雅蘇台).
The Yǒngdìng (永定) River burst its banks.
On the *rénxū* (壬戌) day,
the Northern Grand Canal burst its banks.
In this month,
additional two months' food provisions were distributed to disaster victims in Jìnghǎi (靜海) and Qīngxiàn (青縣) two counties in Zhílì (直隸).
Granary grain was loaned to Rǔyáng (汝陽) and Zhèngyáng (正陽) two counties in Hénán (河南).
In the autumn, on the *wùchén* (戊辰) day of the seventh month,
Lù Yǐzhuāng (陸以莊) was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
On the *jǐsì* (己巳) day,
as Bàzhōu (霸州) and ten other prefectures and counties in Zhílì (直隸) were more severely flooded,
it was ordered that silver and rice be allocated for immediate relief.
Qíshàn (琦善) was ordered to eliminate locusts.
On the *rénwǔ* (壬午) day,
due to the flood disaster in Jiāngsū (江蘇),
commercial rice taxes at all customs barriers were remitted.
Four million six hundred thousand taels of military expenditure for Chuānchǔ (川楚) and garrison cases, which Hénán (河南) was supposed to bear, were remitted.
In this month,

one month's food provisions were distributed for flood disasters in Déhuà (德化) county in Jiāngxī (江西), Huángméi (黃梅) county in Húběi (湖北), and Tàicāng (太倉) and seventeen other prefectures, departments, and counties in Jiāngsū (江sū).
Additional relief was provided for flood disasters in Tōngzhōu (通州) and twenty-one other prefectures and counties in Zhílì (直隸).
On the *jǐhài* (己亥) day of the eighth month,
the Imperial Lectures were held for the first time.
On the *yǐmǎo* (乙卯) day,
due to flood disasters in Hángzhōu (杭州) and two other prefectures in Zhèjiāng (浙江),
sea transport commercial rice ship taxes were remitted,
and customs duties were retained to be used for relief.
In this month,
relief was provided for flood disasters in Wúwéi (無為) and sixteen other prefectures and counties in Ānhuī (安徽).
One month's food provisions were distributed for flood disasters in Jùnxìan (濬縣) and thirteen other counties in Hénán (河南).
On the *rénshēn* (壬申) day of the ninth month,
on account of the Emperor's visit to the imperial tombs, Tuōjīn (托津), Yīnghé (英和), Lú Yìnpǔ (盧蔭溥), and Wāng Tíngzhēn (汪廷珍) were ordered to remain in the capital to manage affairs.
On the *dīngchǒu* (丁丑) day,
the breach in the Yǒngdìng (永定) River was closed.
On the *rénwǔ* (壬wǔ) day,
the Emperor accompanied the Grand Empress Dowager to visit the Western Mausoleums.
On the *bǐngxū* (丙戌) day,
he visited the Tàilíng (泰陵), Tàidōnglíng (泰東陵), and Chānglíng (昌陵) mausoleums.
On the *dīnghài* (丁亥) day,
old and new taxes were remitted for Tōngzhōu (通州) and twenty-seven other prefectures and counties in Zhílì (直隸) affected by flood.
On the *jǐchǒu* (己丑) day,
the Emperor accompanied the Grand Empress Dowager back to the capital.
On the *rénchén* (壬辰) day,
Sōngjūn (松筠) was appointed General of Jílín (吉林),
and Mùzhāng'ā (穆彰阿) was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
In this month,
relief was provided for flood disasters in Tōngzhōu (通州) and forty other prefectures and counties in Zhílì (直隸), and Línqīng (臨清) and five other prefectures and counties in Shāndōng (山東).
Additional relief was provided for flood disasters in Déhuà (德化) county in Jiāngxī (江西), Huángméi (黃梅) county in Húběi (湖北), and Wǔzhì (武陟) and five other counties in Hénán (河南).
Food provisions were distributed for flood disasters in Yízhēng (儀徵) and four other counties in Jiāngsū (Jiāngsū), and Jiānglíng (江陵) and three other counties in Húběi (Húběi).

Old and new taxes were remitted and deferred for Línqīng (臨清) and sixteen other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Shāndōng (Shāndōng), and Jìzhōu (薊州) and fifty other prefectures and counties in Zhílì (Zhílì) affected by flood,
and flood taxes for Wǔzhì (武陟) county in Hénán (Hénán), Huángméi (黃梅) county in Húběi (Húběi), and old and new taxes due from various garrisons,
and also funds for house repairs were provided.
In the tenth month of winter,
relief was provided for flood disasters in Jiānglíng (江陵) and three other counties and garrisons in Húběi (Húběi),
and old and new taxes were remitted,
and funds for house repairs were provided.
One month's food provisions were loaned to Manchu Banner people in Jǐnzhōu (錦州) in Fèngtiān (Fèngtiān), and Wǔchéng (武城) county in Shāndōng (Shāndōng),
and silver and rice were loaned to flood-affected soldiers in the three battalions of Tiānjīn (天津) Garrison in Zhílì (Zhílì) and various outposts at Zǐjīngguān (紫荊關).
On the *yǐhài* (乙亥) day,
Yùdài (毓岱) was appointed Governor of Guǎngxī (Guǎngxī).
In this month,
food provisions were loaned to disaster victims in Jìngníng (靜寧) and sixteen other prefectures and counties in Gānsù (Gānsù).
Old and new taxes were remitted and deferred for flood disasters in Lǐzhōu (澧州) and five other prefectures and counties in Húnán (Húnán),
and drought disasters in Yíhé (宜禾) county in Gānsù (Gānsù).
On the *guǐchǒu* (癸丑) day,
for his achievement in capturing bandits,
Yán Rúyù (嚴如煜), Dao Administrator of Shǎnxī Shǎnnán (陝西陝安道), was granted the title of Provincial Surveillance Commissioner.
In this month,
silver and rice were loaned to soldiers stationed in disaster areas in Sūzhōu (蘇州) and five other prefectures in Jiāngsū (Jiāngsū).
In this year,
Cháoxiǎn (朝鮮), Liúqiú (琉球), Xiāmluó (暹羅), and Miǎndiàn (緬甸) came to offer tribute.
In the fourth year, spring, the first month, on the day Rénshēn,
an imperial order was issued to suspend this year's Mùlán autumn hunt.
On the day Guǐyǒu,
the Imperial Ancestral Temple was honored.
Prince Yìwěi was commanded to perform the rites on behalf of the emperor.
On the day Guǐwèi,
eighty thousand taels of silver were allocated from the Board of Revenue to be lent as rations to the impoverished people of Zhílì.
In this month,
relief was provided for the hailstorm disaster of the previous year in Tōngzhōu and thirty-seven other prefectures and counties in Zhílì,
and for one month of drought disaster in Wǔzhì County and Jùn County in Hénán.
Rations for one month were issued for the water disaster in Tàicāng and twenty-nine other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Jiāngsū,
Wúwéi and sixteen other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Ānhuī,
Hǎiníng and eleven other prefectures and counties, and Hēngpǔ and three other salt fields in Zhèjiāng,
and Ānfēng and eight other salt fields in Liǎnghuái.
Rations for one month were also issued for the hailstorm disaster in Línqīng and four other prefectures and counties in Shāndōng.
Loans of seeds, rations, and granary grain were provided for the previous year's flood disaster in Wǔzhì and eleven other counties in Hénán,

seeds and rations for the disaster-affected military and civilians in Déhuà and thirteen other counties in Jiāngxī, Huángméi and two other counties and various garrisons and military colonies in Húběi, Lǐzhōu and three other prefectures and counties in Húnán, Qínzhōu and nine other prefectures and counties in Gānsù, and Qíqíhā'ěr and two other cities,
and two months' pay and rations for the soldiers of Tàixīng Battalion in Jiāngsū.
In the second month, on the day Dīngyǒu,
Sōngyún was summoned to serve as Left Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate.
Fùjùn was appointed General of Jílín,
and Mùzhāng'ā was appointed President of the Court of Colonial Affairs and Grand Councillor.
Lí Shìxù, the Governor-General of Southern Jiangnan Waterways, passed away,
and Zhāng Wénhào was appointed to replace him.
On the day Jǐhài,
the imperial lectures (Jīngyán) were held.
On the day Jiǎyín,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to the Southern Park.
On the day Dīngsì,
the Emperor went on a hunt.
On the day Jǐwèi,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the palace.
In this month,
rations for one month were issued to the disaster victims of Tóngshān County in Jiāngsū.
Yùdài was transferred to be Governor of Jiāngxī,
and Kāng Shàoyōng was appointed Governor of Guǎngxī.
On the day Dīnghài,
the Emperor reviewed the soldiers of the Jiànruì Battalion.
Chū Pénglíng was dismissed,
and Chén Ruòlín was appointed President of the Board of Works.
Summer, the fourth month, on the day Réngxū,
granary grain was loaned to the soldiers of Dàoshìfú Battalion, Jīngzhōu City Garrison Battalion, and other battalions under Wǔchāng Prefecture in Húběi,
and two months' pay and rations were loaned to the soldiers of Xúzhōu Garrison's Central Battalion and other units stationed in disaster areas in Jiāngnán.
In the fifth month, on the day Jǐsì,
the Emperor went to Hēilóngtán to pray for rain.
On the day Jiǎxū,
it rained.
The ceremony of offering sacrifices at the Tángzi was increased.
On the day Wùyín,
the ritual of offering sacrifices to the rear hall of the Imperial Ancestral Temple for the Empress Dowager's birthday was increased.
In the sixth month, on the day Guǐsì, the first day of the month,
there was a solar eclipse.
On the day Yǐsì,
Zhāng Shīchéng was appointed Governor of Shānxī.
On the day Jiǎyín,
Zhèng Fó, King of the Kingdom of Xiāmluó, passed away.
Autumn, the seventh month, on the day Bǐngzǐ,
Hán Fēng was dismissed,
and Chén Ruòlín was appointed President of the Board of Punishments,
Lù Yǐzhuāng was appointed President of the Board of Works,
and Yáo Wéntián was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.
On the day Xīnsì,
Grand Secretary Dài Jūnyuán retired.
In this month,
granary grain was loaned to the soldiers of Wèichāng and Dé'ān battalions in Húběi.
In the intercalary seventh month, on the day Xīnchǒu,
Hán Wénqǐ, Governor of Jiāngsū, was demoted and transferred,
Zhāng Shīchéng was transferred to be Governor of Jiāngsū,
and Zhū Guìzhēn was appointed Governor of Shānxī.
On the day Rényín,
Hán Kèjūn was additionally appointed acting Governor-General of Yún-Guì.
On the day Dīngwèi,
Sūn Yùtíng was appointed Grand Secretary,
and Jiǎng Yōuxiān was appointed Associate Grand Secretary,
both remaining in their Governor-General posts.
Ní Mǎshàn, General of Chéngdū, passed away.
Yìhào was appointed General of Suīyuǎn City.
On the day Xīnhài,
Fúmián was appointed Governor of Shānxī.
On the day Yǐmǎo,
the land tax for the previous year's flood and drought disasters in Wúwéi and thirty other prefectures and counties in Ānhuī was remitted.
In this month,
silver and rice were loaned to two battalions in Jiāngnán.
In the eighth month, on the day Réngxū,
Lín Zéxú, Judicial Commissioner of Jiāngsū, was ordered to dredge the waterways of Zhèjiāng.
On the day Jǐsì,
the Emperor personally examined the Hanlin Academy scholars, attendants, and other officials,
promoting Zhū Fāngzēng and five others to the first rank,
with the rest being promoted or demoted according to their performance.
On the day Wùyín,
the imperial lectures (Jīngyán) were held.
On the day Gēngchén,
Sūmíng'ā was appointed Governor of Guìzhōu.
On the day Bǐngxū,
Bólín, the retired Grand Secretary, passed away.
On the day Dīnghài,
Chénggé was appointed Governor of Jiāngxī.
In this month,
the salt tax for the previous year's flood disaster in Xìngguó and six other salt fields, and Cāngzhōu and six other prefectures and counties in Chánglú, was remitted and postponed,
as well as the land tax for the drought disaster in Yíhé County, Gānsù.
In the ninth month, on the day Rényín,
Huáng Míngjié was appointed Governor of Zhèjiāng.
On the day Guǐmǎo,
the rent silver for the disaster-affected academy lands in Wúwéi and ten other prefectures and counties in Ānhuī was remitted.
In this month,
rations were issued to the disaster victims of Níngqiāng and three other prefectures and counties in Shǎnxī.
Silver and rice were loaned to the disaster-affected soldiers of Guāzhōu Battalion in Jiāngsū,
and granary grain for the flood and hailstorm disasters in Āndìng and other counties in Shǎnxī.
Winter, the tenth month, on the day Yǐchǒu,
the Muslim chieftain Zhāng Gé'ěr entered the Wūlúkè Garrison,
where the imperial army suffered a defeat,
and Imperial Guard Huāshānbù and others were killed in action.
On the day Bǐngzǐ,
Bāyánbātú and others led troops to suppress Zhāng Gé'ěr,
defeating him.
Zhāng Gé'ěr fled to Kālātíjǐn.
On the day Jiǎshēn,
Zhāng Xù, the retired Grand Secretary, passed away.
Based on Sūn Yùtíng's memorial proposing the opening of the Wángyíng spillway,
it was ordered to proceed quickly as circumstances allowed.
In the eleventh month, on the day Jǐyǒu,
due to the breach of thirteen forts at Gāoyàn,
Zhāng Wénhào was handed over to the Board for severe deliberation.
On the day Xīnhài,
Wénfú and Wāng Tíngzhēn were ordered to go to Jiāngnán to inspect the Gāoyàn breach.
Yán Lǎng was transferred to be Governor-General of Southern Jiangnan Waterways.
Zhāng Jǐng was appointed acting Governor-General of Hedong Waterways.
On the day Jiǎyín,
Sūn Yùtíng was implicated for favoritism and concealing Zhāng Wénhào's faults,
and was dismissed as Governor-General of Liǎngjiāng.
Wèi Yuánjù was appointed acting Governor-General.
Yùlín, President of the Board of War, was ordered to serve among the Grand Councillors.
In this month,
rations were issued to the disaster victims of Sùzhōu and Língbì Counties in Ānhuī, and various garrisons.
Pay silver was loaned to the Eight Banners in Jiāngníng and the Governor-General's and Brigade Commander's troops in Liǎngjiāng.
Rations were loaned to the disaster victims of Jìngníng and twelve other prefectures and counties in Gānsù, and those under the jurisdiction of the Magistrate of Dōnglè County.
In the twelfth month, on the day Jǐwèi, the first day of the month,
the Emperor again went to Dàgāodiàn to pray for snow.
On the day Wùchén,
Wèi Yuánjù was appointed Governor-General of Liǎngjiāng,
and Yán Jiǎn was appointed Governor-General of Grain Transport.
On the day Jǐmǎo,
Míngshān was summoned to the capital,
and Chánglíng was appointed Governor-General of Yún-Guì.
The Gāoyàn breach was closed.
Qìngbǎo was appointed General of Wūlǐyǎsūtái,
Nàqīng'ān was appointed Military Governor of Rèhé,
Míngshān was appointed President of the Board of Punishments,
with Mùzhāng'ā acting in his place.
In this month,
rations for one month and house repair fees were issued to the disaster victims of Tàihé and two other counties in Yúnnán, and the salt well households under Jǐngdōng Hall,
and rations for one month to the disaster victims of Gāoyóu and four other prefectures and counties in Jiāngsū, and the disaster victims of Qīnghé Hall.
In this year,
Cháoxiǎn and Liúqiú presented tribute.
In the fifth year, spring, the first month,
Dài Sānxī was appointed Governor-General of Sìchuān.
On the day Xīnhài,
after three years of performance review,
Túojīn, Chánglíng, Cáozhèn Yōng, Huángyuè, Yīnghé, Wāng Tíngzhēn, Jiǎng Yōuxiān, Nàyánchéng, and Yánlǎng were deliberated upon,
and Qíshàn was given the title of Governor-General.
In this month,
rations were issued to the military and civilians for the previous year's flood and drought disasters in Gāoyóu and three other prefectures and counties in Jiāngsū,
and Tiāncháng County and Sìzhōu Garrison in Ānhuī.
Seeds and rations were loaned for the flood, drought, and hailstorm disasters in Wén'ān and Dàchéng Counties in Zhílì,
Rǔyáng and Huáiníng Counties in Hénán,
Níngqiāng and six other prefectures and counties in Shǎn-Gān,
Dídào and thirty-nine other prefectures, halls, and counties in Gānsù, and those under the jurisdiction of the Sub-prefect of Sùzhōu and the Magistrates of Zhuānglàng and other counties,
rations for the salt well households affected by the water disaster in Zhōngzhèng Salt Field in Liǎnghuái,
repair fees for the water-damaged salt wells in Jǐngdōng Hall in Yúnnán,
and the previous year's land tax was remitted.
In the second month, on the day Gēngshēn,
the imperial lectures (Jīngyán) were held.
On the day Jiǎzǐ,
to visit the imperial tombs, Prince Zhuāng, Túojīn, Lú Yìnpǔ, and Wāng Tíngzhēn were ordered to remain in the capital to manage affairs.
On the day Wùyín,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to visit the imperial tombs,
and three-tenths of the land tax in the areas passed through was remitted.
The Emperor visited Zhāoxī Mausoleum, Xiào Mausoleum, Xiàodōng Mausoleum, Jǐng Mausoleum, and Yù Mausoleum.
He then went to Bǎohuáyù to inspect the eternal auspicious grounds,
and then returned to the capital.
On the day Jiǎshēn,
he went to the Southern Park for a hunt.
In this month,
rations for one month were issued to the disaster victims of Tiāncháng County in Ānhuī.
In the third month, on the day Wùzǐ, the first day of the month,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
Qíshàn was appointed Governor of Shāndōng.
On the day Jiǎchén,
Chéng Hánzhāng was appointed Governor of Zhèjiāng.
On the day Rényǐ,
Wáng Dǐng was appointed acting Vice President of the Board of Revenue with the rank of first grade.
On the day Bǐngchén,
arrears of taxes from the common people in Hénán from previous years and the additional river conservancy surcharges were remitted.
In this month,
seeds and rations were loaned to the disaster-affected people of Bǎochí and Jìnghǎi Counties in Zhílì,
Táozhōu Hall and seventeen other halls, prefectures, and counties in Gānsù, and those under the jurisdiction of the Magistrate of Zhuānglàng County,
and silver for plowing oxen to the disaster-affected Banner people in Qíqíhā'ěr.
In summer, the fourth month, on the day *Yǐchǒu*,
arrears of tribute from Zhílì from previous years were remitted.
On the day *Xīnwèi*,
Yīlǐbù was appointed Governor of Shǎnxī.
This month,
grain from the granaries was loaned to the soldiers of the two garrisons stationed in the famine-stricken areas of Níngwǔ, Shānxī, and others;
to the three garrisons in Ānlù, Húběi, and others;
and to the soldiers of the Jīngzhōu Naval Camp and Tíbiāo Rear Camp.
In the fifth month, on the day *Jiǎwǔ*,
the eunuch Mǎ Jìnxǐ was handed over to the Ministry of Punishments for sentencing, for falsely claiming to be on an imperial incense-offering mission at Húshùguān.
An edict was issued to all Governors-General and Governors, stating that
whenever a eunuch on the wanted list is encountered,
they must be diligently apprehended.
If anyone falsely claims to be on an imperial mission,
they must be immediately reported and dealt with.
On the day *Dīngyǒu*,
Huáng Yuè was relieved of his duties as Grand Minister of the Military Council due to old age,
to focus solely on ministry affairs,
and still serve in the Nánshūfáng.
Wáng Dǐng was ordered to serve as a Grand Minister of the Military Council.
Zhāng Shīchéng was transferred to be Governor of Ānhuī,
and Táo Shù to be Governor of Jiāngsū.
On the day *Wùshēn*,
Sūn Yùtíng and Yán Jiǎn were dismissed.
Wèi Yuánwù was transferred to be Governor-General of Grain Transport,
and Qíshàn was appointed Governor-General of Liǎngjiāng.
Yīlǐbù was transferred to be Governor of Shāndōng,
and Èshān was appointed Governor of Shǎnxī.
On the day *Jiǎyín*,
due to delays in grain transport this year,
Sūn Yùtíng and others were severely reprimanded by edict.
Yùtíng was handed over to the Ministry for severe deliberation,
and Wèi Yuánwù and Yán Jiǎn were to be disciplined.
This month,
relief was provided for flood victims in the prefectures and counties under Zhènyuǎnfǔ, Guìzhōu,
and their regular taxes were remitted.
Soldiers were loaned pay in silver,
and funds were provided for the repair of city yamen.
Grain from the granaries was loaned to the soldiers of the four garrisons stationed in the disaster-stricken areas of Jīngzhōu, Húběi, and others.
In the sixth month,
Jiǎng Yōuxiān was appointed Grand Secretary,
while retaining his post as Governor-General of Zhílì.
Wāng Tíngzhēn, Minister of Rites, was appointed Assistant Grand Secretary.
On the day *Dīngmǎo*,
Wèi Yuánwù was demoted three ranks in official hat insignia,
but remained in his post as Governor-General of Grain Transport.
Sūn Yùtíng and Yán Jiǎn were both instructed by Qíshàn to oversee the dredging of the Grand Canal,
with the engineering costs to be shared by Yùtíng, Jiǎn, and Yuánwù.
On the day *Jiǎxū*,
Wèi Yuánwù died.
Mùzhāng'ā, Minister of the Lifànyuàn, was appointed acting Governor-General of Grain Transport.
Pǔgōng, formerly General of Jiāngníng, was appointed acting Minister of the Lifànyuàn.
On the day *Yǐyǒu*,
based on Táo Shù's memorial,
the commuting of grain tribute in Jiāngnán was suspended,
and discussions continued regarding transport by both river and sea.
This month,
the price of grain was loaned to the five garrisons of Tíbiāo and Quánzhōu City Guard Camp in Fújiàn.
In autumn, the seventh month, on the day *Dīngwèi*,
Déyīng'ā was appointed General of Wūlǐyàsūtái,
and Héshìtài was appointed General-in-chief of Cháhā'ěr.
This month,
the regular taxes on inundated land in seven prefectures and counties including Zhílì were reduced or remitted.
In the eighth month,
Sōngfú was appointed Minister of Punishments,
Kāng Shàoyōng was transferred to be Governor of Húnán,
and Sūchéng'é was appointed Governor of Guǎngxī.
On the day *Jǐwèi*,
the imperial lecture (Jīngyán) was attended.
Chén Zhōngfú was appointed Governor-General of Grain Transport,
Chénggé was transferred to be Governor of Guǎngdōng,
and Wǔlóng'ā was appointed Governor of Jiāngxī.
In the ninth month, on the day *Yǐyǒu*,
Nàyánchéng was summoned.
Èshān was appointed acting Governor-General of Shǎnxī and Gānsù.
Chánglíng was transferred to be Governor-General of Shǎnxī and Gānsù,
Zhào Shènzhěn to be Governor-General of Yúnnán and Guìzhōu,
and Sūn Ěrzhǔn was appointed Governor-General of Fújiàn and Zhèjiāng.
Hán Kèjūn was transferred to be Governor of Fújiàn,
and Yīlǐbù was appointed acting Governor of Yúnnán.
Wǔlóng'ā was transferred to be Governor of Shāndōng,
Hán Wénqǐ to be Governor of Jiāngsū,
and Sōngpǔ was appointed Governor of Guìzhōu.
On the day *Gēngzǐ*,
Zhāng Jǐng was appointed Governor-General of River Conservancy for HéDōng.
On the day *Jiǎchén*,
Déyīng'ā was appointed acting General of Yīlí,
Sōngyún was appointed acting General of Wūlǐyàsūtái,
and Pǔgōng was appointed acting Censor-in-Chief.
Bāyànbātú and others, Assistant Ministers in Kāshígá'ěr, led troops to suppress Zhāng Gé'ěr,
and wantonly killed people of the Bùlǔtè tribe.
Their chief Tàilièkè gathered a crowd and besieged Bāyànbātú and others in Kāshígá'ěr.
Qìngxiáng dispatched Mùkèdéngbù and others to reinforce them.
Qìngxiáng was ordered to delay his return to the capital.
This month,
relief was provided for hailstorm victims in four prefectures and counties including Suídé, Shǎnxī.
Old and new regular taxes were remitted for drought and hailstorm victims in fifteen prefectures and counties including Kāizhōu, Zhílì.
In winter, the tenth month, on the day *Gēngchén*,
Chánglíng was appointed acting General of Yīlí,
Yáng Yùchūn was appointed acting Governor-General of Shǎnxī and Gānsù,
and Èshān returned to his post as Governor of Shǎnxī.
Déyīng'ā was ordered to proceed to Wūlǐyàsūtái.
Sōngyún was summoned to the capital.
On the day *Xīnsì*,
Jiǎng Yōuxiān was summoned,
and Nàyánchéng was appointed Governor-General of Zhílì.
This month,
relief was provided for hailstorm victims in three counties including Yúlín, Shǎnxī.
In the eleventh month, on the day *Rénchén*,
due to the sinking of a tribute ship from the Kingdom of Xiānluó,
an imperial edict remitted their supplementary tribute,
and the Crown Prince Zhèngfú was enfeoffed as King of Xiānluó.
On the day *Gēngzǐ*,
Tuōjīn was relieved of his duties overseeing the Ministry of Punishments,
Jiǎng Yōuxiān replaced him,
and was also appointed Grand Minister of the Military Council.
On the day *Yǐsì*,
the Emperor proceeded to Dàgāodiàn to pray for snow.
On the day *Bǐngwǔ*,
the regular taxes on land protecting the Luánhé River in Chānglí County, Zhílì, were abolished.
On the day *Dīngwèi*,
it snowed.
Qìngxiáng was ordered to serve as acting Assistant Minister of Kāshígá'ěr with the rank of General.
On the day *Rénzǐ*,
Qìngxiáng was appointed Assistant Minister of Kāshígá'ěr and General-in-chief of the Bordered Yellow Banner Han Army.
Before he took office,
Mùkèdéngbù acted in his stead.
Chánglíng was appointed General of Yīlí.
This month,
relief was provided for flood and hailstorm victims in six prefectures and counties including Mínzhōu, Gānsù.
In the twelfth month, on the day *Jǐsì*,
arrears of tribute from flood-affected Zhāngqiū and Zōupíng counties in Shāndōng were remitted.
On the day *Wùyín*,
Sēnggélínqìn, Prince of Kē'ěrqìn Commandery, was ordered to serve before the Emperor.
This month,
relief was provided for drought and insect pest victims in Jǐnzhōufǔ, Fèngtiān.
This year,
Cháoxiǎn, Liúqiú, Xiānluó, and Yuènán offered tribute.
In the sixth year, spring, the first month, on the day *Jiǎshēn*,
due to land reclamation for farming in Shuāngchéngbǎo,
Fùjùn was promoted to Crown Prince's Senior Tutor.
This month,
relief was provided for flood-affected banner households in Jǐnzhōu, Zhōngqiánsuǒ, and other places in Fèngtiān.
Rations were provided to disaster victims in Pèixiàn, Jiāngsū.
Grain from the granaries was loaned for seeds and rations to banner people in Níngyuǎnzhōu, Fèngtiān;
seven counties including Yānlíng, Hénán;
twelve prefectures and counties including Mínzhōu, Gānsù;
Xiāngyuán County, Shānxī;
and three counties including Bǎodǐ, Zhílì, affected by floods, droughts, and hailstorms.
In the second month, on the day *Wùwǔ*,
for the imperial visit to the mausoleums, Tuōjīn, Yīnghé, Wāng Tíngzhēn, and Lú Yìnpǔ were ordered to remain in the capital to manage affairs.
On the day *Jiǎxū*,
the Emperor visited the Western Mausoleums,
and three-tenths of the regular taxes in the areas passed through were remitted.
On the day *Wùyín*,
the Tàilíng, Tàidōnglíng, and Chānglíng mausoleums were visited.
On the day *Xīnsì*,
the Emperor returned to Yuánmíngyuán.
In the third month, on the day *Guǐsì*,
Zhāng Jǐng was transferred to be Governor-General of River Conservancy for Jiāngnán.
On the day *Gēngxū*,
Pān Xī'ēn was bestowed with a third-rank official hat insignia,
and appointed Assistant River Governor for the Southern River.
This month,
grain from the granaries was loaned to disaster-stricken soldiers in Língqiū County, Shānxī, and five garrisons including Jīngzhōu, Húběi.
In summer, the fourth month, on the day *Jiǎzǐ*,
the Emperor proceeded to the shrine of the Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
On the day *Jiǎxū*,
Dèng Tíngzhēn was appointed Governor of Ānhuī.
On the day *Bǐngzǐ*,
Zhū Chāngyí and 265 others were granted the Jinshì degree with differing ranks.
This month,
rations were provided to disaster victims in Pèixiàn, Jiāngsū.
Money and grain were loaned to disaster-stricken soldiers of the three garrisons of Xúzhōuzhèn, Jiāngsū,
and the two garrisons of Dé'ān and Yídū, Húběi.
In the fifth month, on the day *Yǐwèi*,
Mùkèdéng'é, Minister of Rites, was dismissed,
and Sōngyún replaced him.
Nà Qīng'ān was appointed Censor-in-Chief.
Míngshān was appointed General-in-chief of Rèhé.
On the day *Wùxū*,
Zhào Shènzhěn, Governor-General of Yúnnán and Guìzhōu, died.
Ruǎn Yuán was transferred to replace him.
Sōngfú was appointed Governor-General of Húguǎng,
Míngshān was appointed Minister of Punishments,
and Qìnghuì was appointed General-in-chief of Rèhé.
On the day *Rényín*,
arrears of tribute for inundated land in five counties including Héjiān, Zhílì, were remitted.
This month,
drought rations were provided to twelve counties including Tángyì, Shāndōng.

Rations, seeds, and grain from the granaries were loaned to five counties including Guǎngpíng, Zhílì; twelve counties including Tángyì, Shāndōng; twelve counties including Línzhāng, Hénán; and the garrisons of Xízhōu, Shānxī.
In the sixth month,
relief was provided for flood victims in Jiānglíng and Dāngyáng counties, Húběi.
Drought rations were provided to seven counties including Línzhāng, Hénán.
Pay for soldiers affected by drought was loaned to seven garrisons including Dàmíngzhènbiāo, Zhílì.
In autumn, the seventh month, on the day Guǐsì,
Zhāng Gé'ěr gathered the Huí (Muslim) multitudes of Ānjíyán and Bùlǔtè and entered the passes.
The Huí multitudes of Kāshígáěr responded to them.
Yáng Yùchūn was ordered to be Imperial Commissioner to suppress them,
and È Shān was appointed Acting Governor-General of Shǎnxī and Gānsù.
Wǔ Lóng'ā was ordered to be Imperial Commissioner to proceed to Táiwān.
On the day Jǐhài,
Déyīng'ā was appointed Assistant Amban of Yīlí,
and Lúnbù Duō'ěrzhǐ was appointed Acting General of Wūlǐyàsūtái.
On the day Gēngzǐ,
Zhāng Gé'ěr seized Hétián city,
and the Leader Amban Yīmèi, Assistant Amban Guìbīn, and others died there.
On the day Jiǎchén,
Chánglíng was appointed General Yángwēi,
and Wǔ Lóng'ā was appointed Imperial Commissioner
to assist Yáng Yùchūn in military affairs.
On the day Yǐsì,
Déyīng'ā was appointed Acting General of Yīlí.
This month,
relief was given for flood disasters in six prefectures and counties, including Gāoyóu in Jiāngsū.
Rations were provided for flood victims in three prefectures and counties, including Lǐlíng in Húnán, and in Guīhuàchéng, Shānxī.
Seed grain was loaned for flood disasters in Xīxiāng and Zhōuzhì counties in Shǎnxī,
and silver for horse feed was provided to various post stations belonging to Jǐnzhōu Prefecture in Fèngtiān.
In the eighth month,
the Huí chieftain Bābùdǐng and others seized Yīngjíshā'ěr.
On the day Jiǎxū,
Zhāng Gé'ěr seized Kāshígáěr city,
and Assistant Amban Qìngxiáng, Assistant Amban Shūěrhāshàn, and others died there.
They then advanced and seized Yèěrqiāng,
where Administrator Yīndēng'é, Assistant Amban Duōlóngwǔ, and others died.
This month,
relief was given for flood disasters in five prefectures and counties, including Hǎizhōu in Jiāngsū.
Rations were provided for flood victims in Sàlāqí Hall.
Rations were loaned for flood disasters in Húqīnhē, Suīyuǎnchéng, Shānxī.
In the ninth month, on the first day Jǐmǎo,
Huáng Yuè was dismissed,
and Wáng Dǐng was appointed Minister of the Board of Revenue.
On the day Xīnsì,
the Emperor visited Nányuàn.
Yáng Fāng, Grand Coordinator of Gùyuán, and Qí Shèn, Grand Coordinator of Gānsù, were ordered to proceed to Ākèsū military camp.
On the day Dīnghài,
the Emperor returned to Yuánmíngyuán.
On the day Wùzǐ,
Bóqǐtú was appointed Military Governor of Cháhā'ěr.
On the day Xīnmǎo,
Mùzhāng'ā was summoned to the capital,
and Yáng Màotián was appointed Acting Governor-General of Grain Transport.
On the day Yǐwèi,
Chángqīng was appointed Administrator of Ākèsū.
On the day Jǐhài,
Qìnglián reported a victory over the rebels at Āchátākètái.
On the day Xīnchǒu,
this year's wheat and grain payment due from the Huí villages near Ākèsū was remitted.
On the day Guǐmǎo,
Gébùshě was transferred to be General of Wūlǐyàsūtái.
This month,
silver and grain for rations were provided for flood victims in Sōngtáo Hall in Guìzhōu,
Guīhuà Hall in Shānxī,
Shānyáng and Yánchéng counties in Jiāngsū,
and seven halls and counties, including Liánhuā, in Jiāngxī.
In winter, the tenth month, on the day Gēngshēn,
Qìngxiáng, Assistant Amban who died in service at Kāshígáěr, was posthumously granted the title of Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
On the day Rénxū,
salt-making taxes were remitted for fourteen saltworks, including Fù'ān in Liǎnghuái, due to flood disasters.
On the day Jiǎzǐ,

one million four hundred fifty thousand taels of silver from the Jiāngsū Provincial Commissioner of Finance's treasury were allocated for flood relief in twenty prefectures and counties, including Gāoyóu.
This month,
rations were provided for military personnel and victims in eight prefectures and counties, including Sùzhōu in Ānhuī.
Old and new levies were remitted or deferred for disaster victims in forty-seven prefectures, halls, counties, and military districts, including Gāoyóu in Jiāngsū.
In the eleventh month, on the day Wùzǐ,
Chánglíng and others reported a victory over the rebels at Kēěrpíng in Ākèsū.
On the day Jǐchǒu,
due to the pacification of Táiwān,
Sūněrzhǔn was promoted to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
This month,
relief was given to disaster victims in three prefectures and counties, including Cháling in Húnán.
Rations were loaned to disaster victims in thirteen prefectures and counties, including Qínzhōu in Gānsù.
Grain taxes were remitted or deferred for flood disasters in places such as Niúzhuāng in Shèngjīng,
and old and new levies were remitted or deferred for flood disasters in five prefectures and counties, including Cháling in Húnán.
In the twelfth month, on the first day Wùshēn,
Yáng Jiàn was appointed Governor of Húběi.
Nèěrjīng'é was appointed Governor-General of Grain Transport.
On the day Bǐngchén,
Yīshíchǔkèlǔbù, Zāsàkè Prince of the Four Dàlài Hébù, was stripped of his title for presumption.
On the day Wùwǔ,
Yīnghé was transferred to be Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs,
Xǐ'ēn was appointed Minister of the Board of Revenue,
and Mùzhāng'ā was appointed Minister of the Board of Works.
This year,
Liúqiú and Cháoxiǎn offered tribute.
In the seventh year, spring, the first month, on the day Dīngyǒu,
the Huí multitudes of Hétián surrendered,
and they were ordered to be treated leniently.
Soon after, they were again seized by Zhāng Gé'ěr.
On the day Gēngzǐ,
Huìxiǎn was appointed Administrator stationed in Zàng.
This month,

flood relief was extended to military and civilian populations in twenty-three prefectures, counties, and military districts, including Gāoyóu in Jiāngsū, and to salt-making households in nine saltworks, including Dīngxī in Liǎnghuái.
Rations were provided for disaster and famine victims in Sìzhōu and Wǔhé county in Ānhuī and various military colonies,
and in Báiqíbǎo and Xiǎohēishān in Fèngtiān.

Rations and seed grain were loaned to disaster and famine victims in ten prefectures and counties, including Kāizhōu in Zhílì, seventeen prefectures, halls, and counties including Qínzhōu in Gānsù, four counties including Yuánwǔ in Hénán, five saltworks including Fù'ān in Liǎnghuái, and five halls and counties including Liánhuā in Jiāngxī,
and to Xiūwǔ and Fēngqiū counties in Hénán.
Granary grain was loaned to disaster victims in Sàlāqí Hall in Shānxī,
and silver and rice were provided to three camps including Chuānshā Hall in Jiāngsū, and eight camps including Qīngcūn.
In the second month, on the day Jiǎxū,
the Emperor went to Hēilóngtán to pray for rain.
This month,
military provisions were loaned to soldiers in three camps, including Lángshān in Jiāngsū, and adjacent disaster areas.
In the third month, on the day Jǐchǒu,
relief was given for flood disasters in prefectures and counties including Gāoyóu in Jiāngsū.
On the day Bǐngshēn,
Chánglíng and others reported a victory over the rebels at Yáng'āěrbātè.
Chánglíng was promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
On the day Dīngyǒu,
the Emperor went to Hēilóngtán to pray for rain.
On the day Jǐhài,
Chánglíng and others defeated the rebels at Shābùduěr,
capturing the Ānjíyán Huí leader Sèdíbāěrdì.
Jiǎng Yōuxiān and Mùzhāng'ā were ordered to inspect the southern river.
Nàqīng'ān was appointed Acting Minister of the Board of Works.
On the day Guǐmǎo,
Huìxiǎn was appointed Amban stationed in Zàng.
On the day Jiǎchén,
it rained.
This month,
relief was given to disaster victims in prefectures and counties including Gāoyóu in Jiāngsū.
Rations were loaned to poor people in three counties, including Zhāngyì in Gānsù, and six prefectures and counties, including Kāizhōu in Zhílì.
In summer, the fourth month, on the first day Bǐngwǔ,
there was a solar eclipse.
On the day Wùshēn,
Chánglíng and others reported a victory over the rebels at Ākèwābātè.
Chánglíng was granted a purple bridle,
Yáng Yùchūn was promoted to Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent,
and Wǔ Lóng'ā to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
On the day Rénzǐ,
Chánglíng and others recaptured Kāshígáěr,
and Zhāng Gé'ěr fled.
On the day Xīnyǒu,
Yīngjíshā'ěr was recaptured.
Because Zhāng Gé'ěr had not been captured,
Chánglíng's purple bridle, Yáng Yùchūn's Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent title, and Wǔ Lóng'ā's Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent title were revoked.
In the fifth month, on the day Gēngchén,
Yáng Fāng recaptured Hétián,
capturing the Huí leader Gáěrlè and others,
and executing them.
On the day Rénwǔ,
Lù Yǐzhuāng was dismissed,
and Wáng Yǐnzhī was appointed Minister of the Board of Works.
On the day Guǐwèi,
Qí Shàn, Zhāng Jǐng, and Pān Xī'ēn were severely deliberated upon.
Qí Shàn was dismissed as Governor-General of Liǎngjiāng,
and Jiǎng Yōuxiān replaced him.
Tuō Jīn was put in charge of the Board of Punishments.
On the day Dīnghài,
Mùzhāng'ā was ordered to learn and serve as a Grand Councilor.
In the intercalary fifth month, on the first day Yǐsì,
new and old levies in the Eight Cities of Huíjiāng were remitted.
On the day Bǐngwǔ,
Yáng Yùchūn was ordered to return,
and Yáng Fāng was appointed Assistant Amban.
On the day Wùshēn,
Yìhào was transferred to be General of Shèngjīng,
and Jìnchāng was appointed General of Suīyuǎnchéng.
This month,
grain was loaned to soldiers in Huángzhōu Commandery, Dàoshìfú Camp in Húběi.
In the sixth month, on the day Rénwǔ,
the Emperor went to Hēilóngtán to pray for rain.
On the day Bǐngxū,
it rained.
In the seventh month of autumn, on the day Rénzǐ,
Wāng Tíngzhēn, Associate Grand Secretary and Minister of Rites, passed away.
Jìnchāng was dismissed as Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard of the Bordered Yellow Banner,
and Prince Zhèng Wūěrgōng'ā replaced him.
On the day Bǐngchén,
Yáo Wéntián was appointed Minister of Rites,
and Tāng Jīnzhāo was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
On the day Dīngsì,
Lú Yīnpǔ was appointed Associate Grand Secretary.
On the day Jǐwèi,
Yīnghé was stripped of his titles of Associate Grand Secretary, Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, and the Purple Girdle
due to his failure to supervise his household retainers.
Fùjùn was summoned to be Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs and Associate Grand Secretary.
Bóqǐtú was appointed General of Jílín.
Ānfú was appointed Dūtǒng of Cháhāěr.
On the day Xīnyǒu,
Shēngyín, Dūtǒng of Rèhé, was dismissed,
and Nàqīng'ān replaced him.
On the day Guǐhài,
Nàqīng'ān was reinstated as Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
Yīnghé was stripped of his title of Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince,
demoted to a second-rank button,
and appointed Dūtǒng of Rèhé.
On the day Yǐchǒu,
Wǔlóng'ā was appointed Counselor Minister of Kāshígāěr.
Lú Kūn was appointed Governor of Shāndōng.
On the day Wùchén,
the annual taxes of various prefectures and counties in Gānsù through which military convoys passed were remitted,
and six-tenths of the annual taxes for various prefectures and counties in Gānsù and Shǎnxī that assisted with military provisions were remitted.
On the day Gēngwǔ,
in recognition of the achievement of recovering the four cities including Kāshígāěr,
Yáng Yùchūn's title of Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince was restored,
and Èshān and Lú Kūn were granted the additional title of Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince.
On the day Rénshēn,
for the renewed pacification of Huíjiāng,
Cáo Zhènyōng was promoted to Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince,
Jiǎng Yōuxiǎn and Wénfú to Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince,
and Wáng Dǐng and Yùlín were granted the additional title of Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince.
This month,
rations were distributed to banner people and commoners affected by floods in the three prefectures and counties, including Jǐnzhōu in Fèngtiān.
In the eighth month, on the day Guǐwèi,
for the Emperor's birthday (Wànshòu Jié),
banquets were suspended.
On the day Bǐngshēn,
Lú Kūn was transferred to be Governor of Shānxī,
and Qíshàn was appointed Governor of Shāndōng.
This month,
disaster relief was provided for flood victims in Lüèyáng County, Shǎnxī,
and Jiānglíng and Jiānlì Counties, Húběi.
Monthly rations were provided to disaster-affected laboring households in Jiānghuái and other areas.
New and old annual taxes were remitted or deferred for forty-seven prefectures, counties, garrisons, and departments in Jiāngsū, including Gāoyóu, that were affected by floods.
In the ninth month, on the day Guǐchǒu,
as the coffin of Empress Xiàomù was being moved to Bǎohuá Yù,
the Eldest Imperial Son Yìwěi was ordered to preside over the ancestral offering.
On the day Bǐngchén,
the Emperor proceeded to the coffin of Empress Xiàomù to offer libations.
Yīlǐbù was appointed Governor of Yúnnán.
On the day Wùwǔ,
six-tenths of the annual taxes were remitted for twenty-two prefectures, departments, and counties in Shǎnxī, including Huázhōu, through which military convoys passed.
On the day Gēngshēn,
the Emperor visited the Eastern Mausoleums (Dōnglíng),
and five-tenths of the current year's annual taxes were remitted for the areas passed through.
On the day Guǐhài,
he visited Zhāoxī Líng, Xiào Líng, Xiàodōng Líng, Jǐng Líng, and Yù Líng.
Chánglíng was summoned,
and Déyīng'ā was appointed General of Yīlí.
Dài Jūnyuán was promoted to Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince.
On this day,
the imperial procession returned.
On the day Gēngwǔ,
Yáng Guózhēn was appointed Governor of Hénán.

Four-tenths of the annual taxes for banner people and commoners in Shèngjīng Prefecture City and its fourteen subordinate areas, including Kāiyuán, through which military convoys passed, were remitted.
This month,
additional relief was provided for flood victims in Lüèyáng County, Shǎnxī.
In the tenth month of winter, on the day Gēngchén,
outstanding principal and miscellaneous taxes and grain from commoners in various provinces from Jiāqìng 25th year to Dàoguāng 5th year were remitted.
On the day Rénwǔ,
on the occasion of the Empress Dowager's birthday (Wànshòu Shèngjié),
banquets were suspended by imperial decree.
On the day Bǐngxū,
Yáo Wéntián, Minister of Rites, passed away,
and Tāng Jīnzhāo replaced him.
Pān Shì'ēn was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left of the Censorate.
On the day Gēngyín,
Bābèng'ā was dismissed,
and Érèjīn was appointed Counselor Minister of Kēbùduō.
On the day Dīngyǒu,
Lún bùduōěrjì was appointed Minister for Mongolian Affairs in Kùlún.
This month,
disaster relief was provided for flood victims in Jiānglíng and Jiānlì Counties, Húběi, and various garrisons stationed there.
Rations were provided to post-station laborers affected by floods in Guǎngníng County, Fèngtiān.
Granary grain was loaned to Dìngxiāng and Lùchéng Counties, Shānxī, for drought and hail disasters,
and to Mòěrgēn City, Hēilóngjiāng, for poor harvests.
In the eleventh month, on the day Yǐsì,
Chánglíng was ordered to supervise and, together with Yáng Fāng, handle post-pacification affairs in Huíjiāng.
On the day Bǐngwǔ,
Nàyànchéng was summoned.
On the day Gēngxū,
Nàyànchéng was appointed Imperial Commissioner,
to jointly plan post-pacification affairs in Huíjiāng with Chánglíng.
Tú Zhīshēn was appointed acting Governor-General of Zhílì.
On the day Jǐsì,
four-tenths of the land and poll tax for seven prefectures, departments, and counties in Fèngtiān, including Liáoyáng, were remitted.
This month,
disaster relief was provided for flood and hail victims in six prefectures and counties in Gānsù, including Mínzhōu.
In the twelfth month,
Yàndé was appointed General of Wūlǐyásūtái.
This year,
Cháoxiǎn, Liúqiú, and Xiānmó offered tribute.
In the first month of spring of the 8th year, on the day Bǐngwǔ,
Sōngyún was appointed acting Dūtǒng of Rèhé,
and Nàqīng'ān was appointed acting Minister of Rites.
On the day Wùshēn,
Liú Bīnshì was appointed Governor of Zhèjiāng.
On the day Rénxū,
Chánglíng reported the capture of Zhānggéěr.
On the day Guǐhài,
Chánglíng was enfeoffed as Duke Wēiyǒng
and appointed Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard.
Yáng Fāng was enfeoffed as Marquis Guǒyǒng.
Guǒqísīhuān was transferred to be General of Suīyuǎnchéng.
On the day Yǐchǒu,
Cáo Zhènyōng was promoted to Grand Preceptor,
Wénfú to Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince,
and Yùlín to Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.
Mùzhāng'ā was granted the additional title of Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince,
and also appointed Grand Councillor.
Yáng Yùchūn was appointed Governor-General of Shǎnxī and Gānsù.
On the day Bǐngyín,
Jiǎng Yōuxiǎn was promoted to Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince.
Yīnghé's title of Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince was restored.
Nàyànchéng was ordered to proceed to Kāshígāěr again as Imperial Commissioner,
to handle post-pacification affairs together with Yáng Fāng.
On the day Dīngmǎo,
Xǐ'ēn was granted the additional title of Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince.
This month,
rations were provided to impoverished commoners in Pèixiàn County, Jiāngsū.
Loaned grain for disaster and poor harvests was provided to Cāngzhōu and eight other prefectures and counties in Zhílì,
seeds to Jiānglíng and Jiānlì Counties, Húběi, and various garrisons stationed there,
granary grain to Dìngxiāng and four other counties in Shānxī,
and funds for house repairs to the garrisons in Jiāngníng and Jīngkǒu, Jiāngsū.
In the second month, on the day Yǐhài,
the assembled officials proposed a respectful title for the Emperor due to the renewed pacification of Huíjiāng;
he declined,
and ordered discussion on a respectful title for the Empress Dowager instead.
Shǐ Zhìguāng, Censor-in-Chief of the Left of the Censorate, passed away.
On the first day of the third month, Gēngzǐ,
there was a solar eclipse.
On the day Yǐsì,
the Emperor went hunting,
and continued to do so until Dīngsì.
On the day Wùshēn,
the Emperor returned to the palace.
This month,
rations were loaned to impoverished commoners in Kāizhōu and five other prefectures and counties in Zhílì.
In the fourth month of summer,
Guǒqísīhuān was transferred to be General of Hēilóngjiāng,
and Tèyīshùnbǎo was appointed General of Suīyuǎnchéng.
This month,

granary grain was loaned to Dàizhōu and twenty-four other prefectures and counties in Shānxī for poor harvests, to the disaster-stricken areas where troops were stationed in Húběi, and to various naval camps in Jīngzhōu.
In the fifth month, on the day Jǐyǒu,
due to the capture of Zhānggéěr,
officials were dispatched to offer sacrifices at the Imperial Ancestral Temple (Tàimiào) and the Altars of Land and Grain (Shèjì),
and the ceremony of presenting captives was held.
On the day Gēngxū,
the Emperor received the captives at the Wǔmén Gate.
Chánglíng was promoted to Grand Guardian.
Yáng Fāng was granted the additional title of Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.
On the day Rénzǐ,
the Emperor interrogated Zhānggéěr in court regarding his crimes,
and he was executed by dismemberment in the marketplace.
On the day Dīngsì,
it was ordered that portraits of the forty meritorious officials who pacified Huíjiāng and the Grand Councillors Cáo Zhènyōng, Wénfú, Wáng Dǐng, and Yùlín be painted in the Zǐguāng Gé.
This month,
granary grain was loaned to the soldiers of the Huángzhōu Brigade stationed in the poor harvest areas of Húběi.
In the sixth month, on the day Guǐyǒu,
Chánglíng, General Wēiyáng and Grand Secretary, returned triumphantly,
and Prince Zhèng Wūěrgōng'ā and others were ordered to welcome and console him.
On the day Bǐngzǐ,
Chánglíng was ordered to manage the Court of Colonial Affairs.
In the seventh month of autumn, on the day Jiǎchén,
King Lǐ Péng of Cháoxiǎn, upon the pacification of Huíjiāng,
dispatched envoys to present congratulatory memorials and local products.
On the day Bǐngwǔ,
Shēngyín was appointed Dūtǒng of Rèhé,
and Nàqīng'ān was appointed acting Minister of Rites.
In the eighth month, on the day Dīngchǒu,
on the occasion of the Emperor's birthday (Wànshòu Jié),
banquets were suspended.
On the day Jǐmǎo,
Chénggé was appointed Dūtǒng of Rèhé.
Lú Kūn was transferred to be Governor of Guǎngdōng.
Xú Xīn was appointed Governor of Shānxī.
On the day Jiǎshēn,
Yìshào, Tuōjīn, Fùjùn, and Chén Ruòlín were ordered to remain in the capital to handle affairs.
This month,
rations were provided for flood victims in four counties in Zhèjiāng, including Chún'ān.
Working capital was loaned to salt households affected by floods in Chánglú.
New and old annual taxes were remitted or deferred for four counties in Zhèjiāng, including Chún'ān, that were affected by floods.
In the ninth month, on the *wùxū* day, the first day of the month,
there was a solar eclipse.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
the Emperor visited the Eastern Mausoleums.
The additional levies on the areas traversed were remitted by three-tenths.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
due to carelessness in the Bǎohuáyù (Precious Flower Ravine) project,
Yīnghé was stripped of his office,
and Dài Jūnyuán was demoted by three ranks in his official cap insignia.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
the Emperor visited the Zhāoxī Líng, Xiàolíng, Xiàodōng Líng, Jǐnglíng, and Yùlíng mausoleums,
and also offered sacrifices at the funeral palace of Empress Xiàomù.
Dài Jūnyuán was stripped of his office.
On the *gēngxū* day,
the Emperor visited the Yùlíng mausoleum
and performed the Grand Offering ceremony.
On the *xīnhài* day,
Yīnghé was imprisoned,
and his property confiscated.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
the Emperor returned to Yuánmíngyuán.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
the Emperor visited the Western Mausoleums.
The additional levies on the areas traversed were remitted by three-tenths.
On the *dīngsì* day,
the Emperor visited the Tàilíng, Tàidōng Líng, and Chānglíng mausoleums.
On the *wùwǔ* day,
the Emperor visited the Chānglíng mausoleum
and performed the Grand Offering ceremony.
On the *gēngshēn* day,
Dài Jūnyuán was arrested and imprisoned,
and his property confiscated.
On the *xīnyǒu* day,
the Emperor returned to Yuánmíngyuán.
Tèyīshùnbǎo was transferred to be the General of Hēilóngjiāng.
Nàyànbǎo was appointed General of Suíyuǎnchéng,
and Dálíng'ā was appointed Counselor Minister of Tǎ'ěrbāhātái.
In this month,
relief was provided for flood victims among the salt-producing households in the three fields of Zhōngzhèng and others under Hǎizhōu in Liǎnghuái.
Tea money silver was lent to soldiers in the four western cities of Huíjiāng.
In winter, in the tenth month, on the *gēngwǔ* day,
Yīnghé was exiled to Hēilóngjiāng.
On the *jiǎwǔ* day,
Dūn Jùnwáng Miánkǎi was reinstated as Dūn Qīnwáng.
In this month,
relief was provided for flood victims in Hǎizhōu and other three prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Jiāngsū, and in Jiàndé and other five counties in Zhèjiāng.
One month's rations were issued to flood and drought victims in Gāoyóu and other nine prefectures and counties in Jiāngsū, and in Sìzhōu and other twenty-six counties in Ānhuī.
Grain rations were lent to flood-affected bannermen and civilians in Guǎngníng and other places in Fèngtiān,
grain *shí* to poor people in Fùyáng County, Zhèjiāng,
and silver and grain to official estates of banner garrisons in Qíqíhā'ěr and other places.

New and old regular levies were remitted or postponed for drought and flood-affected areas in Hǎizhōu and other thirty-six prefectures, departments, counties, and garrisons in Jiāngsū, Sìzhōu and other twenty-six prefectures and counties in Ānhuī, and Hǎiníng and other thirteen prefectures and counties in Zhèjiāng.
In the eleventh month, on the *jiǎchén* day,
an honorary title was added to the Empress Dowager: Gōngcí'ānyùkāngchéng Huángtàihòu.
On the *yǐsì* day,
as the ceremony for adding the honorary title to the Empress Dowager was completed,
an imperial edict was issued to the empire,
extending grace differentially.
On the *jǐwèi* day,
Dài Jūnyuán was released.
In this month,
relief was provided for flood victims in Fùyáng County, Zhèjiāng.
Flood rations were issued to Shèngjīng, Nínggǔtǎ, and other places.
In the twelfth month, on the *xīnsì* day,
Nàyánchéng memorialized on recruiting the Ėtígē'nà tribe that had surrendered to Kokand.
An edict praised this,
ordering proper pacification and governance.
In this year,
Liúqiú and Cháoxiǎn offered tribute.
In the ninth year, in spring, in the first month, on the *dīngwèi* day,
the Xīpīchákè Àimànbùlǔtè Azihèzhuó tribe surrendered.
On the *rénzǐ* day,
Yáng Fāng was promoted to Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.
In this month,
rations were issued to disaster victims in Sìzhōu and other five prefectures, counties, and garrison-farms in Ānhuī, and in Hǎizhōu and other fifteen prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Jiāngsū.
Relief was provided for impoverished victims in Bǎnpǔ and other three fields in Liǎnghuái.
Seeds were lent to flood-affected areas in Dàizhōu and Jiězhōu, Shānxī,
and granary grain to flood-affected areas in Shàngcài County, Hénán.
In the second month, on the *jǐsì* day,
the Emperor attended the Imperial Lectures.
On the *gēngwǔ* day,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Yuánmíngyuán.
The Southwest Dá'ěrwǎsī tribe of Kokand sent envoys to pledge allegiance.
An edict praised and declined it.
On the *jiǎwǔ* day,
Bóqǐtú, the General of Jílín, was appointed Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard,
and Húsōng'é replaced him.
In the third month, on the *bǐngwǔ* day,
the Emperor visited Nányuàn.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
the Emperor went hunting,
and continued to do so until the *xīnhài* day.
On the *xīnhài* day,
the chief of Lādákè from outside the Tibetan frontier presented a memorial.
On the *rénzǐ* day,
the Emperor returned to Yuánmíngyuán.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
the Emperor reviewed the Capital Garrison troops at the Yùwǔ Lóu.
On the *wùwǔ* day,
Qíshàn was summoned,
Nè'ěrjīng'é was appointed Governor of Shāndōng,
and Zhū Guìzhēn was appointed Grand Director of Grain Transport.
In summer, in the fourth month, on the *guǐyǒu* day,
Dài Sānxī was summoned,
and Qíshàn was appointed Governor-General of Sìchuān.
On the *rénwǔ* day,
Tú Zhīshēn was demoted for errors in judicial review,
and Sōngyún was appointed acting Governor-General of Zhílì.
On the *bǐngxū* day,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Hánhuī Lóu to review the archery and horsemanship of the imperial princes and imperial bodyguards.
On the *wùzǐ* day,
Lǐ Zhènjūn and two hundred twenty-one others were granted the *jìnshì* degree with varying ranks.
In this month,

grain rations and seeds for last year's drought were lent to Qiánzhōu and other five departments, prefectures, and counties in Húnán, and granary grain for poor harvests to Shuòzhōu and other twenty-three prefectures, departments, and counties in Shānxī.
In the fifth month, on the *dīngyǒu* day,
Empress Xiàomù's coffin was moved to the main hall of Bǎohuáyù,
and her spirit tablet to the eastern side hall.
In this month,
granary grain was lent to the two garrisons of Jīngzhōu city defense and naval forces, and the Yídū garrison in Húběi, affected by flood.
In the sixth month, on the *yǐchǒu* day,
Fúmián was appointed Counselor Minister of Kēbùduō.
On the *jǐsì* day,
horse tribute silver was remitted for the Tibetan tribes affected by snow disaster in Kālāwūsū and other places in Xīzàng,
and relief was provided for the disaster-affected officers, soldiers, and households of the Dámu Eight Banners.
On the *jiǎxū* day,
Déyīng'ā, the General of Yīlí, died,
and Yùlín replaced him.
Sōngyún was transferred to be Minister of War.
Bóqǐtú was appointed Minister of Rites.
On the *dīngchǒu* day,
Ānfú was summoned,
and Fúkèjīng'é was appointed acting Military Governor of Cháhā'ěr.
In this month,
granary grain from last year's flood was lent to the Sānxìng area.
In the seventh month, on the *jǐhài* day,
the prohibitions on official silver leaving and private goods entering the Yuèhǎi Customs were strictly reinforced.
Zālóng'ā was appointed Counselor Minister of Kāshígá'ěr.
On the *dīngsì* day,
the King of Yuènán requested ginseng and astragalus for his aging mother.
The Emperor praised and bestowed them.
In this month,
relief was provided for flood victims in Luòróng and Yǒngfú counties in Guǎngxī.
One-tenth of last year's revenue in money and grain was remitted for Wǔhé County in Sìzhōu, Ānhuī,
and the two garrisons of Fèngyáng and Sìzhōu.
In the eighth month, on the *guǐhài* day,
for the Emperor's visit to the imperial ancestral mausoleums in Shèngjīng,
Yìsháo, Tuōjīn, Tāng Jīnzhāo, and Míngshān were ordered to remain in the capital to manage affairs.
On the *gēngchén* day,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to visit the imperial ancestral mausoleums in Shèngjīng.
In the ninth month, on the *rénchén* day, the first day of the month,
there was a solar eclipse.
The regular levies for this year were remitted for Chéngdé and other five departments, prefectures, and counties along the imperial route,
and five-tenths of the regular levies for Xiùyán and other nine departments, prefectures, and counties that assisted with imperial duties.
On the *rén'yín* day,
the Cháoxiǎn tribute envoys Lǐ Xiānghuáng and others welcomed and had an audience.
On the *yǐsì* day,
the Emperor personally shot arrows,
and also reviewed the archery and horsemanship of the Shèngjīng officers and soldiers.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
the Emperor visited Yǒnglíng.
On the *wùshēn* day,
the Grand Offering ceremony was performed.
The Xīngjīng city was reviewed.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
Bóqǐtú was demoted,
and Qíyīng was appointed Minister of Rites.
The Emperor visited Fúlíng,
offered a sacrifice at the tomb of Duke Hóngyì, Èyìdū,
and bestowed favors upon his descendants, Bókèshùn and others.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
the Grand Offering ceremony was performed.
The Emperor arrived in Shèngjīng,
and performed rituals before the precious records in the Tàimiào.
On the *yǐmǎo* day,
the Emperor went to the Tiāntán and Tángzǐ.
The Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Jiāyīn Táng.
A sacrifice was offered at the tomb of Qèqín Jùnwáng Yuètō.
The King of Cháoxiǎn, Lǐ Cóng, sent envoys to present local products.
On the *wùwǔ* day,
the Emperor went to the Dìtán.
A sacrifice was offered at the tomb of Duke Zhíyì, Fèiyīngdōng.
On the *jǐwèi* day,
the Emperor presided at the Dàzhèng Diàn,
and bestowed banquets and rewards of varying degrees upon the accompanying princes, dukes, and ministers,
Mongol princes, *bèilè*, *bèizǐ*, and dukes, as well as the civil and military officials of Shèngjīng.
In the tenth month,
Pān Shì'ēn was appointed acting Minister of Rites.
On the *xīnwèi* day,
on the Empress Dowager's birthday,
the Emperor, leading the accompanying princes, dukes, and ministers, went to the Empress Dowager's temporary palace to perform the congratulatory ceremony.
The Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Chénghǎi Lóu.
On the *rénwǔ* day,
the Emperor visited Yùlíng.
On the *jiǎshēn* day,
Wú Guāngyuè was appointed Governor of Jiāngxī.
On the *yǐyǒu* day,
the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the palace.
In this month,
one month's rations were issued to Sìzhōu and other five prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Ānhuī.
In the eleventh month, on the Dīngsì day,
Yīnghuì was summoned.
Chénggé was transferred to be the Dūtǒng of Wūlǔmùqí.
Yù'ēn was appointed Dūtǒng of Rèhé.
In this month,
food rations were distributed to the disaster-stricken banner people and commoners in Fèngtiān, Liáoyáng, and five other places.
In the twelfth month, on the Jiǎzǐ day,
King Mèngjì of Miǎndiàn sent envoys to present a congratulatory memorial.
On the Yǐhài day,
relief and comfort were provided to the disaster-stricken Fān people of the thirty-nine tribes in Xīzàng.
In this month,
earthquake relief was provided to Yìdū and Línqú counties in Shāndōng.
A fifth of the regular tax on low-lying lands in Lóngpíng and Níngjìn counties in Zhílì was remitted.
In the spring of the tenth year, in the first month, on the Dīngsì day,
King Zhèng Fú of Xiāmluó sent envoys to present a congratulatory memorial,
and offered local tribute.
In this month,
drought and flood relief was provided to Pèixiàn in Jiāngsū, Xūyí in Ānhuī, and six other prefectures, counties, and garrisons.
Silver and grain loans were provided to Cāngzhōu and Yánshān counties in Zhílì,
and Gāolán and fourteen other prefectures and counties in Gānsù for drought and flood relief.
In the second month, on the Rénxū day,
the Emperor attended the Jīngyán lecture.
On the Dīngmǎo day,
orders were given to apprehend the bandits (xiāofěi) and Nian bandits (niǎnfěi) in Hénán.
On the Dīngchǒu day,
orders were given to apprehend the secret society members (huìfěi) in Shàngyóu County, Jiāngxī.
In the third month, on the Gēngyín day,
to visit the Xīlíng tombs,
Yìshào, Tuōjīn, Chánglíng, and Lú Yìnpǔ were ordered to remain in the capital to manage affairs.
On the Jǐhài day,
the regular tax on silted fields by the lake in Lǐzhōu, Húnán, and previously borrowed seed money were remitted.
On the Rényín day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, visited the Xīlíng tombs.
Shēngyín was appointed Jiāngjūn of Suīyuǎnchéng.
On the Jiǎchén day,
Húsōng'é was transferred to be Jiāngjūn of Shèngjīng,
Fúkèjīng'é was appointed Jiāngjūn of Jílín,
and Wǔzhōng'é was appointed Dūtǒng of Cháhā'ěr.
On the Bǐngwǔ day,
the Emperor visited the Tàilíng, Tàidōnglíng, and Chānglíng tombs.
On the Jǐyǒu day,
the Emperor went to Nányuàn.
On the Gēngxū day,
the Emperor went hunting,
and continued until the Rénzǐ day.
On the Rénzǐ day,
as Ālètánshālà and other Khazak Khans requested to send their sons to pay respects,
they were ordered to have an audience in Rèhé.
In the fourth month, on the Xīnwèi day,
it was re-emphasized that officials from other provinces who were incompetent should not be transferred to metropolitan posts.
In the fifth month, on the Xīnyǒu day,
an earthquake occurred in fourteen prefectures and counties connected between Hénán and Zhílì,
and orders were given to provide special care and relief.
In the sixth month, on the Xīnmǎo day,
Jiǎng Yōuxiān fell ill,
and Táo Shù was appointed acting Governor-General of Liǎngjiāng.
On the Yǐwèi day,
Chéng Zǔluò was appointed Governor of Húnán.
In the seventh month, on the Bǐngzǐ day,
Xiāmluó sent envoys to congratulate on the Emperor's birthday and offer local tribute.
Old outstanding regular taxes in the four prefectures and counties of Hǎizhōu, Jiāngsū, were remitted.
In the eighth month, on the Yǐwèi day,
it was the Emperor's birthday,
and banquets were suspended.
On the Gēngxū day,
Jiǎng Yōuxiān was summoned to the capital,
and Táo Shù was formally appointed Governor-General of Liǎngjiāng.
Lú Kūn was transferred to be Governor of Jiāngsū.
Zhū Guìzhēn was appointed Governor of Guǎngdōng.
Wú Bāngqìng was ordered to act as Governor-General of Caoyùn (Grain Transport) with a third-rank title.
In this month,
additional flood relief was provided to Jiānlì and four other counties in Húběi.
In the ninth month, on the Wùwǔ day,
the Huí bandits from Ānjíyán again invaded Kāshígé'ěr.
Assistant Minister Tǎsīhā was defeated in battle,
and died.
Consequently, Kāshígé'ěr city was besieged.
Yùlín and others were ordered to suppress them.
Yáng Yùchūn was ordered to be stationed in Sùzhōu,
and Yáng Fāng and Hú Chāo were to lead Shǎnxī and Gānsù troops to assist in the suppression.
Èshān was appointed acting Governor-General of Shǎnxī and Gānsù.
Xú Xīn was appointed acting Governor of Shǎnxī,
and Ālèjīng'ā was appointed acting Governor of Shānxī.
On the Jǐwèi day,
Yáng Yùchūn was appointed Qīnchāi Dàchén (Imperial Commissioner)
to supervise military affairs.
Yīnghuì was appointed acting Jiāngjūn of Hēilóngjiāng.
On the Dīngmǎo day,
Chánglíng was appointed Qīnchāi Dàchén,
and ordered to lead Guìlún, Ālèhǎnbǎo, and others to Xīnjiāng.
On the Xīnwèi day,
Yùyīng was appointed acting Jiāngjūn of Hēilóngjiāng.
On the Yǐhài day,
the Emperor reviewed the troops of the Huǒqìyíng (Artillery Camp).
On the Dīngchǒu day,
Grand Secretary Jiǎng Yōuxiān was demoted to Shìláng
due to errors in judicial reviews.
Xú Xīn was summoned to the capital,
and Yán Bótáo was appointed acting Governor of Shǎnxī.
Lú Yìnpǔ was appointed Grand Secretary,
Lǐ Hóngbīn was appointed Assistant Grand Secretary,
while remaining in his post as Governor-General of Liǎngguǎng.
Tāng Jīnzhāo was transferred to be Shàngshū of the Lìbù (Ministry of Personnel),
Wáng Yǐnzhī as Shàngshū of the Lǐbù (Ministry of Rites),
Pān Shì'ēn as Shàngshū of the Gōngbù (Ministry of Works),
and Zhū Shìyàn as Zuǒ Dūyùshǐ (Censor-in-Chief of the Left).
In this month,
earthquake relief was provided to Cízhōu and three other prefectures and counties in Zhílì, and flood relief to Péngchéng and two other counties in Sìchuān.
In the tenth month,
Lú Yìnpǔ was appointed Tǐrén Gé Dàxuéshì (Grand Secretary of the Hall of Embodied Benevolence).
On the Wùzǐ day,
Fùníyáng'ā was appointed Governor of Zhèjiāng.
On the Yǐwèi day,
Chánglíng was again appointed Yángwēi Jiāngjūn,
and Hālíng'ā and Yáng Fāng were ordered to assist in military affairs.
On the Gēngzǐ day,
Lèshàn was appointed Jiāngjūn of Wūlǐyǎsūtái.
On the Xīnchǒu day,
due to delays in military matters,
Róng'ān, the Cānzàn Dàchén (Assistant Minister) of Yīlí, was stripped of his post and inherited viscount title.
On the Rényín day,
Ēnmíng was appointed Cānzàn Dàchén of Wūlǐyǎsūtái.
On the Guǐmǎo day,
Huí bandits attacked Yè'ěrqiāng,
and Bìchāng and others defeated them.
On the Dīngwèi day,
Róng'ān was arrested.
On the Rénzǐ day,
Fùníyáng'ā was summoned to the capital.
In this month,
disaster relief was provided to the victims in Dàchéng and Wén'ān counties in Zhílì.
Food rations were distributed to Wúhú and five other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Ānhuī.
Granary grain loans were provided to banner people in Hēilóngjiāng and three other places, and food rations to poor people in Gāolán and eleven other prefectures and counties in Gānsù.
In the eleventh month,
Yáng Yìzēng was appointed Governor of Húběi.
On the Yǐhài day,
Lǐ Hóngbīn and others were repeatedly instructed to investigate the secret society members in Guǎngdōng.
On the Dīngchǒu day,
Wú Guāngyuè was instructed to investigate the secret society members in Gànnán, Jiāngxī.
On the Réngwǔ day,
Sōngfú was demoted,
and Lú Kūn was appointed Governor-General of Húguǎng.
Chéng Zǔluò was transferred to be Governor of Jiāngsū,
Sūchéng'é to be Governor of Húnán.
Qí Yù was appointed Governor of Guǎngxī.
Ālèjīng'ā was appointed Governor of Jiāngxī.
In this month,
earthquake relief was provided to Ānyáng and three other counties in Hénán.
Housing repair funds were provided for flood victims in Lúlíng County, Jiāngxī.
In the twelfth month, on the Guǐsì day,
Tuōjīn was relieved of his post in the Xíngbù (Ministry of Punishments),
and Lú Yìnpǔ was appointed to replace him.
On the Bǐngshēn day,
the Huí bandits in Kāshígé'ěr and Yīngjíshā'ěr were pacified.
Tǎsīhā, the Assistant Minister of Kāshígé'ěr who died in battle, was granted the title of Dūtǒng.
In this month,
flood relief was provided to Yúnxiàn County in Yúnnán.
Silver and rice loans were provided to soldiers stationed near disaster areas in Sūzhōu and four other prefectures and departments in Jiāngsū.
Annals of Xuānzōng, Volume 2, Part 18
In the spring of the eleventh year, in the first month, on the Xīnyǒu day,
Zhālóng'ā was dismissed,
and Hālíng'ā and Yáng Fāng were appointed acting Cānzàn Dàchén of Kāshígé'ěr.
On the Yǐchǒu day,
Róng'ān was sentenced to beheading.
On the Bǐngzǐ day,
Wèi Yuánlàng was appointed Governor of Fújiàn.
King Lǐ Péng of Cháoxiǎn requested to enfeoff his grandson Huàn as the Crown Prince,
and offered local tribute.
In this month,
food rations were provided to disaster victims in Pèixiàn in Jiāngsū, Wúhú and eight other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Ānhuī, and Fùyáng County in Zhèjiāng.
Food rations, housing funds, and seeds were loaned to soldiers and civilians in Sānxìng and Shuāngchéngbǎo,
Cízhōu and nine other prefectures and counties in Zhílì,
Ānxiāng and Huáróng counties in Húnán,
Wǔ'ān County in Hénán,
and Huìníng and five other counties in Gānsù.
New and old regular taxes for soldiers and civilians in Jílín and three other places were remitted and deferred.
In the second month, on the *jǐchǒu* day,
His Majesty attended the *Jīngyán* (Imperial Lectures).
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
as he was to visit the Western Mausoleums (*Xī Líng*),
he commanded Yìshào and others to remain in the capital to manage affairs.
Nāyánchéng, having provoked conflict by expelling the Andijan Hui people,
was stripped of his title of Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent (*Tàizǐ Tàibǎo*),
and his son, Róngzhào, was also dismissed from his post as侍郎(*Shìláng*).
On the *yǐwèi* day,
Nāyánchéng was stripped of his office,
Qíshàn was transferred to be Governor-General of Zhílì,
with Wáng Dǐng acting.
Èshān was appointed Governor-General of Sìchuān,
with Nāyánbǎo acting,
and Shǐpǔ became Governor of Shǎnxī.
On the *wùxū* day,
a renewed prohibition was issued against the cultivation and sale of opium in all provinces.
On the *xīnchǒu* day,
His Majesty visited the Western Mausoleums (*Xī Líng*).
On the *yǐsì* day,
he visited the *Tài Líng*, *Tài Dōng Líng*, and *Chāng Líng*.
His Majesty inspected the "Land of Ten Thousand Years Auspiciousness" (*Wànnián Jí Dì*),
bestowing upon it the name Lóngquányù.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
His Majesty revisited the *Chāng Líng*,
performing the earth-scattering ceremony (*fūtǔ lǐ*).
He attended the Grand Sacrifice (*Dà Xiǎng Lǐ*) in the *Lóng'ēn Diàn*.
In this month,
a loan of grain was granted to the soldiers of the Jīngmén Battalion in Húběi who suffered from floods the previous year.
In the third month, on the *guǐchǒu* day, the first day of the lunar month,
Yīnghé and his sons Kuízhào and Kuíyào were released and returned to the capital.
As Límín rebels were causing trouble in Guǎngdōng,
Lǐ Hóngbīn was ordered to suppress them.
On the *xīnyǒu* day,
concerning the English merchants in Guǎngdōng who violated prohibitions,
Lǐ Hóngbīn and others were ordered to investigate and report.
In this month,
a loan of grain was granted to the soldiers of the Governor-General's banner (*Dūbiāo*), Governor's banner (*Fǔbiāo*), and various battalions in Wǔchāng and Huángzhōu, Húběi.
In summer, in the fourth month, on the *wùzǐ* day,
His Majesty reviewed the soldiers of the *Jiànruì Yíng*.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
His Majesty went to the Temple of the Black Dragon Pond (*Hēilóngtán Shéncí*) to pray for rain.
The Límín rebellion in Guǎngdōng was suppressed.
In the fifth month, on the *bǐngyín* day,
Tāng Jīnzhāo was demoted due to an incident,
and also dismissed as Chief Tutor of the Imperial Study (*Shàngshūfáng Zǒngshīfu*).
Pān Shì'ēn was transferred to be Minister of Personnel (*Lìbù Shàngshū*),
Zhū Shìyàn Minister of Works (*Gōngbù Shàngshū*),
and Bái Róng Censor-in-Chief of the Left in the Censorate (*Dūcháyuàn Zuǒ Dūyùshǐ*).
On the *wùchén* day,
Chánglíng was ordered to go to Kāshígá'ěr to deliberate on the suppression, pacification, and aftermath.
On the *xīnwèi* day,
there was rain.
In the sixth month, on the *bǐngshēn* day,
a renewed regulation was established for the punishment of officials and commoners who purchase and consume opium.
On the *jǐhài* day,
disaster relief was provided for flood victims in Sìzhōu and twenty-five other prefectures and counties in Ānhuī.
On the *gēngxū* day,
due to floods in Miǎnyáng and twenty other prefectures and counties in Húběi,
an order was issued for grain from granaries to be sold at fair prices,
and the rice tax at Húběi customs barriers was exempted.
In this month,
rations were provided to flood victims in Shàngyuán and nine other counties in Jiāngsū.
Seed grain was loaned to disaster-stricken military colonies (*tún*) in Huái'ān Guard (*Huái'ān Wèi*), Jiāngsū.
In autumn, in the seventh month, on the *wùwǔ* day,
Táo Shù was ordered to manage disaster relief in Jiāngsū with Chéng Zǔluò.
Due to floods in Ānhuī,
Dèng Tíngzhēn was authorized to purchase rice and wheat from neighboring provinces to sell at fair prices,
and to prepare military provisions.
On the *guǐyǒu* day,
Zālóng'ā was sentenced to beheading for falsely accusing the Hui king, Yīsàkè, of rebellion.
On the *xīnwèi* day,
the Resident Minister (*Cánzàn Dàchén*) for Huíjiāng and the Head Minister (*Lǐngduì Dàchén*) for Hétián were moved to Yè'ěrqiāng,
and an additional Commander-in-Chief (*Zǒngbīng*) was stationed in Bā'ěrchǔkè.
On the *jǐmǎo* day,
Mùzhāng'ā and Zhū Shìyàn were ordered to go to Jiāngnán to investigate and manage relief efforts.
In this month,
rations were provided to flood victims in Wǔlíng and five other prefectures and counties in Húnán,
and Tóngzǐ County and Shíxiàn Guard (*Shíxiàn Wèi*) in Guìzhōu.
Military provisions were loaned to disaster-stricken soldiers in Jiāngníng and six other battalions in Jiāngsū.
In the eighth month, on the *jǐchǒu* day,
it was the Emperor's birthday (*Wànshòu Jié*),
and His Majesty went to the Empress Dowager's Palace to pay respects.
He attended the *Zhèngdà Guāngmíng Diàn*,
where officials, civil and military, from princes downwards,
Mongol princes and dukes, and envoys from foreign states performed congratulatory rites,
but the banquet was suspended.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
Chánglíng was promoted to Grand Tutor (*Tàifù*).
On the *yǐwèi* day,
Sōngyún was dismissed due to illness.
Mùzhāng'ā was transferred to be Minister of War (*Bīngbù Shàngshū*),
and Fùjùn Minister of Works (*Gōngbù Shàngshū*).
Bóqǐtú was appointed Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs (*Lǐfānyuàn Shàngshū*).
On the *xīnchǒu* day,
the King of Siam (*Xiānluó Guówáng*) sent tribute envoys who brought back to Guǎngdōng officials and commoners from the interior who had been stranded by storms.
A benevolent edict praised and rewarded them.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
Bǎochāng was appointed Military Governor of Rèhé (*Rèhé Dūtǒng*).
Wú Róngguāng was appointed Governor of Húnán.
In this month,

rations and seed grain were provided to flood victims in Gānquán and eleven other prefectures and counties in Jiāngsū, Jiāngxià and sixteen other prefectures and counties in Húběi, and Déhuà and twenty other counties in Jiāngxī.
Rice was loaned to the Jiāngníng garrison (*Zhùfáng*) and Lìyáng Battalion soldiers in Jiāngnán.
In the ninth month, on the *jiǎzǐ* day,
Fúkèjīng'ā was dismissed from office due to an incident.
Bǎoxìng was appointed Military Governor of Jílín (*Jílín Jiāngjūn*).
On the *dīngchǒu* day,
the King of Vietnam (*Yuènán Guówáng*) sent envoys to return storm-stranded refugees to Fújiàn.
A benevolent edict praised and rewarded them.
In winter, in the tenth month,
Yán Lǎng was dismissed due to illness.
Lín Zéxú was appointed Governor-General of River Conservancy for Hé-Dōng (*Hédōng Hé dào Zǒngdū*).
On the *jǐchǒu* day,
the Assistant Minister of Kāshígá'ěr (*Bāngbàn Dàchén*) was changed to Head Minister (*Lǐngduì Dàchén*).
On the *yǐwèi* day,
an order was issued to retain 80,000 *shí* of tribute rice from Jiāngxī to relieve the starving people in Nánchāng and Jiǔjiāng.
In this month,

disaster relief was provided for floods in Wúwéi and twenty-three other prefectures, counties, and guards (*wèi*) in Ānhuī, Shàngyuán and twenty-six other prefectures and counties in Jiāngsū, Rénhé and seven other counties and guards (*wèi*) in Zhèjiāng, and Dīngxī and six other salt fields (*chǎng*) in Liǎnghuái.
Rations and house repair funds were provided to Tóngchéng and ten other prefectures and counties in Ānhuī,
Wǔlíng and five other counties in Húnán,
and Déhuà County in Jiāngxī.
Rations were loaned to Gāolán and eighteen other prefectures, sub-prefectures (*tīng*), and counties in Gānsù,
and funds for dike repair were loaned to the people of Wǔlíng and Lóngyáng counties in Húnán.
In the eleventh month, on the *bǐngchén* day,
Grand Secretary Tuōjīn was dismissed due to illness.
Wú Bāngqìng was appointed Governor-General of Grain Transport (*Cáoyùn Zǒngdū*).
On the *jǐsì* day,
Sōngyún was dismissed as Grand Minister of the Interior (*Nèi Dàchén*),
and retired with a demoted third-rank button (*sān pǐn dǐngdài xiūzhì*).
In this month,
rations were loaned to Tiělǐng and five other prefectures and sub-prefectures (*tīng*) in Fèngtiān and four areas in Jùliúhé,
and dike repair funds were loaned to Nánchāng and six other counties in Jiāngxī.
New and old taxes were remitted or deferred due to hail and frost disasters in Nínggǔtǎ and Shuāngchéngbǎo.
In the twelfth month, on the *yǐyǒu* day,
Fùjùn was appointed Grand Secretary (*Dàxuéshì*),
overseeing the Ministry of War,
and Wénfú was appointed Associate Grand Secretary (*Xié bàn Dàxuéshì*).
Mùzhāng'ā was transferred to be Minister of Works (*Gōngbù Shàngshū*).
Nàqīng'ān was appointed Minister of War (*Bīngbù Shàngshū*),
Shēngyín Censor-in-Chief of the Left in the Censorate (*Dūcháyuàn Zuǒ Dūyùshǐ*),
and Yàndé Military Governor of Suīyuǎn City (*Suīyuǎnchéng Jiāngjūn*).
On the *yǐsì* day,
Wú Bāngqìng was appointed Governor of Jiāngxī,
and Sūchéng'é Governor-General of Grain Transport (*Cáoyùn Zǒngdū*).
In this month,
disaster relief was extended for floods in Jiāngxià and sixteen other prefectures and counties in Húběi.
Rations were provided to flood victims in Shàngyuán and twenty-five other prefectures, counties, and guards (*wèi*) in Jiāngsū, and fifteen salt fields (*chǎng*) in Dīngxī.
Military provisions were loaned to disaster-stricken soldiers in Zhènjiāng and twenty-seven other battalions in Jiāngsū,
and Chángdé and Lǐzhōu battalions in Húnán.
In the spring of the twelfth year, in the first month, on the *xīnyǒu* day,
rice taxes on merchant ships in Hángzhōu and three other prefectures in Zhèjiāng were remitted.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
Chén Ruòlín was dismissed.
Dài Dūn yuán was appointed acting Minister of Justice (*Xíngbù Shàngshū*).
On the *guǐyǒu* day,
Wáng Yǐnzhī left office to observe mourning.
Wāng Shǒuhé was appointed Minister of Rites (*Lǐbù Shàngshū*).
In this month,
disaster relief was provided for floods and droughts in Huáiníng and twenty-one other prefectures and counties in Ānhuī,
and rations were given to poor people in Huáiníng and seventeen other counties and guards (*wèi*).
Grain was loaned to disaster victims in Dàmíng and four other prefectures and counties in Zhílì, Shāngqiū and three other counties in Hénán,

rations and seed grain were loaned to disaster victims in Jiāzhōu and four other prefectures and counties in Shǎnxī, Nánchāng and sixteen other counties in Jiāngxī, Jiāngxià and twenty other prefectures, counties, and guards (*wèi*) in Húběi, Wǔlíng and ten other prefectures, sub-prefectures (*tīng*), counties, and guards (*wèi*) in Húnán, Wèiyuán and seven other prefectures and counties in Gānsù, and Tóngzǐ County in Guìzhōu.
In the second month, on the *wùyín* day,
Zhào Jīnlóng, a Yao bandit in Jiānghuá County, Húnán, rebelled.
Lú Kūn and others were ordered to suppress him.
