On the *jǐmǎo* day,
His Majesty attended the *Jīngyán* (Imperial Lectures).
On the *jiǎshēn* day,
Liáng Zhōngjìng reported on injustices caused by implication in investigations of heterodox sects (*xiéjiào*),
and an edict was issued to rebuke him.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
Zhōngchāng was demoted.
Dài Dūnyuán was appointed Minister of Justice (*Xíngbù Shàngshū*).
On the *yǐwèi* day,
Sūn Ěrzhǔn, Governor-General of Fújiàn and Zhèjiāng (*Mǐnzhè Zǒngdū*), died.
Chéng Zǔluò was appointed Governor-General of Fújiàn and Zhèjiāng,
Lín Zéxú Governor of Jiāngsū,
Wú Bāngqìng Governor-General of River Conservancy for Hé-Dōng (*Hédōng Hé dào Zǒngdū*),
and Zhōu Zhīqí Governor of Jiāngxī.
On the *bǐngshēn* day,
Lǐ Hóngbīn was ordered to suppress the Yao bandits.
On the *rén yín* day,
as he was to visit the Eastern Mausoleums (*Dōng Líng*),
he commanded Yìshào and others to remain in the capital to manage affairs.
In the third month, on the day Jǐyǒu,
Hú'nán Provincial Commander Hǎilíng'ā and Brigade General Mǎ Tāo and others attacked the Yáo rebels in Níngyuǎn,
suffered a defeat,
and died.
On the day Rénzǐ,
the Emperor visited the Eastern Mausoleums,
and remitted three-tenths of the land tax for the areas passed through.
On the day Yǐmǎo,
the Emperor visited Zhāoxī Líng, Xiàolíng, Xiàodōng Líng, Jǐnglíng, and Yùlíng.
On the day Bǐngchén,
Húsōng'é was summoned,
and Yìhào was appointed acting General of Shèngjīng.
On the day Jǐwèi,
the Emperor went to the Southern Hunting Park for a hunt.
On the day Gēngshēn,
Chánglíng was summoned.
On the day Guǐhài,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
On the day Gēngwǔ,
Board of Revenue President Xǐ'ēn was ordered to Hú'nán to suppress the Yáo rebels,
and Wénfú was appointed acting Board of Revenue President.
In this month,
relief was extended for flood victims in Jiāngxià and Hànchuān counties in Húběi.
Food rations were distributed to disaster victims in Qīngyáng county, Ānhuī.

Loans of food rations and seeds were granted to disaster victims in Gāolán and six other prefectures and counties in Gānsù, and to military colonists' households in Qiánzhōu and four other prefectures and counties in Hú'nán,
and granary grain was given to flood-affected soldiers of the Governor-General's banner, Provincial Commander's banner, and Wǔchāng City Guard battalion in Húběi.
In the summer, fourth month, on the day Guǐsì,
prayers for rain were offered.
On the day Wùxū,
it rained.
On the day Xīnchǒu,
Wú Zhōngjùn and two hundred and six others were granted the *jìnshì* degree with different ranks.
On the day Yǐsì,
Lú Kūn and others defeated the Yáo rebels at Yángquán,
annihilated them completely,
and captured Zhào Jīnlóng's son and over fifty rebel leaders.
In this month,
granary grain was again distributed for flood victims in Yángzhōu, Jiāngsū.
In the fifth month, on the day Dīngwèi,
the number of various land and naval camps in Fújiàn and infantry and cavalry in Zhèjiāng was reduced by varying amounts.
On the day Rénzǐ,
as Zhào Jīnlóng had already died,
and the remaining rebels were all pacified,
Lú Kūn and Luó Sījǔ were awarded double-eyed peacock feathers and hereditary peerages as First-Class Light Chariot Commandant,
and Hú'nán Provincial Commander Yú Bùyún was promoted to Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
On the day Yǐmǎo,
the sectarian rebel Yǐn Lǎoxū and others were executed.
On the day Gēngshēn,
the Emperor prayed for rain at Hēilóngtán.
On the day Wùchén,
the Emperor went to the Temple of Heaven to pray for rain.
On the day Jǐsì,
an imperial edict ordered the Board of Punishments to clear up ordinary cases.
In this month,
granary grain was lent to flood-affected soldiers and civilians in Dàtóng and two other counties in Shānxī.
In the sixth month, on the day Gēngchén,
the Emperor walked to the Altar of Land and Grain to pray for rain.
On the day Rénwǔ,
honest criticism was sought.
On the day Dīnghài,
the Emperor went to Hēilóngtán to pray for rain.
On the day Rénchén,
Guǎngdōng Provincial Commander Liú Róngqìng was stripped of his post for his defeat in suppressing the Yáo rebels in Liánzhōu,
and Lǐ Hóngbīn was stripped of his post but retained in office.
On the day Guǐsì,
the Emperor walked to Fāngzé to pray for rain.
On the day Yǐwèi,
Fùjùn requested to be dismissed due to the drought.
It was not granted.
On the day Bǐngshēn,
Khokand sent envoys to present a memorial,
returning the captured Kashgar Muslims.
On the day Dīngyǒu,
Sōngyún's first-rank button and plume were restored.
On the day Guǐmǎo,
the Emperor walked from the Palace of Abstinence to the Altar of Heaven to perform the Great Yu Ceremony.
On this day,
it rained.
On the day Jiǎchén,
Xǐ'ēn and Húsōng'é were ordered to go from Hú'nán to Guǎngdōng to suppress the Yáo rebels.
In this month,
seeds for military colony land were lent to flood victims in Huái'ān Garrison, Jiāngsū.
In the autumn, seventh month, on the day Dīngwèi,
Róng'ān was pardoned,
and exiled to Jílín.
On the day Wùshēn,
Zhōngchāng was appointed Assistant Minister of Kobdo.
Chéng Zǔluò was ordered to reorganize the salt administration in Zhèjiāng.
Tǎwàkè and other Muslims from Khotan gathered a crowd and rebelled,
and they were captured and executed.
On the day Yǐchǒu,
Yáo Pánjūnhuá and others rebelled in Hè county, Guǎngxī,
and Qí● pacified them.
In this month,
relief was provided for typhoon victims in Pénghú Sub-prefecture, Fújiàn.
Food rations were distributed to flood victims in Tiānmén county, Húběi.
In the eighth month,
Táo Shù memorialized that English ships had again entered inland waters,
and if they did not obey regulations,
they should be severely punished.
An edict rebuked him for instigating conflict.
On the day Jiǎwǔ,
Lǐ Hóngbīn was stripped of his post,
and both Provincial Commander Liú Róngqìng and he were arrested for questioning.
Lú Kūn was transferred to be Governor-General of Guǎngdōng and Guǎngxī.
Ruǎn Yuán was appointed Acting Grand Secretary,
while remaining in his post as Governor-General of Yúnnán and Guìzhōu.
Nè'ěrjīng'é was appointed Governor-General of Húguǎng,
and Zhōngxiáng was appointed Provincial Governor of Shāndōng.
In this month,
relief was provided for flood victims in Shuòzhōu, Shānxī.
Arrears and deferrals of land tax for last year's floods and droughts were granted to Huáiníng and twenty-nine other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Ānhuī.
In the ninth month, on the first day Jiǎchén,
Yǐn Jìyuán was appointed Provincial Governor of Shānxī.
On the day Bǐngwǔ,
a dike at Lóngwō Fort in the Southern River was breached by thieves,
Mùzhāng'ā was ordered to investigate the matter jointly with Táo Shù,
and Zhāng Jǐng was stripped of his post but retained in office.
On the day Dīngwèi,
due to English ships intruding into inland waters,
coastal naval forces were ordered to be rectified.
On the day Jiǎyín,
Tèyīshùnbǎo was appointed General of Yīlí.
On the day Wùwǔ,
the Yáo rebellion in Liánzhōu, Guǎngdōng, was pacified.
The Hú'nán Yáo rebels Zhào Fújīn and others were executed.
In this month,
food rations were distributed for flood victims in Táoyuán county, Jiāngsū, Tiānmén county, Húběi, and six other counties and garrisons.
Granary grain was lent due to poor harvest in Shānyīn county, Shānxī.
In the intercalary ninth month, on the day Dīnghài,
the Emperor personally inspected the Jianrui Vanguard Battalion.
On the day Rén'yín,
because King Lǐ Chéng of Korea rejected English trade,
an imperial edict was issued to commend him.
In this month,
relief was provided for disaster victims in Fùpíng and ten other prefectures and counties in Zhílì.
Loans of food rations were granted for flood victims in Xiángfú and six other prefectures and counties in Hénán, and in Xīng'ān Prefecture, Shǎnxī.
Silver and grain were lent to drought-affected soldiers in Qíqíhā'ěr and other places.
In the winter, tenth month, on the day Yǐsì,
bandits in Qǔjiāng and Rǔyuán counties, Guǎngdōng, rebelled,
and they were suppressed.
On the day Bǐngwǔ,
Zhū Shìyàn and Jìngzhēng were ordered to Jiāngnán to investigate matters.
On the day Yǐchǒu,
Mùzhāng'ā was ordered to Húběi to investigate matters jointly with Nè'ěrjīng'é.
In this month,
relief was provided for flood and drought victims in Wúqiáo and Dōngguāng counties, Zhílì;
Táoyuán and three other prefectures and counties, Jiāngsū;
Hànchuān and four other counties and garrisons, Húběi;
Wǔhé county, Ānhuī;
and Bǎnpǔ and three other salt fields in Liǎnghuái.
Food rations were distributed to Hǎizhōu and four other prefectures and counties, Jiāngsū;
Wǔhé and eleven other counties and garrisons, Ānhuī;
Ānxiāng and Huáróng counties, Hú'nán;
and banner people in Jǐnzhōu Prefecture, Fèngtiān.
Granary grain was lent to garrison troops in the disaster-stricken area of Dàtóng Town, Shānxī.
Arrears and deferrals of new and old land tax for floods, droughts, and hail were granted to Wúqiáo and seventeen other prefectures and counties, Zhílì;
Táoyuán and sixty-three other prefectures, sub-prefectures, counties, and garrisons, Jiāngsū;
Wǔhé and thirty-nine other prefectures, counties, and garrisons, Ānhuī;
Hǎiníng and twenty-two other prefectures, counties, garrisons, and Rénhé Salt Field, Zhèjiāng;
Fù'ān and fourteen other salt fields, Liǎnghuái;
Ānxiāng and seven other prefectures, counties, and garrisons, Hú'nán;
Xízhōu and six other prefectures and counties, Shānxī;
and Hànchuān and twenty-six other prefectures, counties, and garrisons, Húběi.
In the eleventh month, on the day Wùyín,
acting Fúzhōu General Húsōng'é was appointed Imperial Commissioner,
and Commander-in-Chief Hālang'ā was appointed Assistant Commissioner,
to go to Táiwān to suppress bandits.
On the day Bǐngshēn,
ten thousand *shi* of capital granary rice were allocated for disaster relief in Wǔqīng and eight other prefectures and counties of Shùntiān Prefecture.
On the day Dīngyǒu,
Lǐ Hóngbīn was exiled to Ürümqi,
and Liú Róngqìng was exiled to Yīlí.
In this month,
food rations were lent to disaster victims in Hànzhōng and five other prefectures, sub-prefectures, and departments in Shǎnxī, and in Yíhé county, Gānsù,
and seeds were lent in Jílín and six other places.
Arrears of rent in Yíhé county, Gānsù, were remitted.
In the twelfth month, on the day Jiǎchén,
two hundred thousand *shi* of granary grain from Zhèjiāng and Jiāngxī were allocated to assist the people of Fújiàn with food.
On the day Bǐngwǔ,
Lú Yīnpǔ was granted leave,
and Wáng Dǐng was ordered to manage the Board of Punishments.
On the day Jǐsì,
Xiàoshùndài was appointed Assistant Minister of Kobdo.
In this month,
military pay was lent to various garrisons in the disaster-stricken areas of Zhílì,
and granary grain was lent to disaster victims in Fēngzhèn and five other prefectures, sub-prefectures, and counties in Shānxī.
In this year,
Korea, Lan Xang, Ryukyu, and Siam paid tribute.
In the spring of the thirteenth year, first month, on the day Dīngchǒu,
Táiwān Jiāyì bandit leader Chén Bàn was executed.
On the day Jǐmǎo,
Shēngyín and others confirmed that the embezzlement by Xi'ān General Xú Kūn was true,
and he was stripped of his post.
On the day Dīngyǒu,
Lín Qìng was appointed Provincial Governor of Húběi.
The breach in Táonán Sub-prefecture was closed.
In the second month, on the *Jiǎchén* day,
the Emperor attended the Classics Mat.
On the *Jǐwèi* day,
Yi and bandits in Yuèsuì and other places in Sìchuān rebelled.
Nà Yànbǎo and Guì Hán were ordered to suppress them.
On the *Gēngshēn* day,
relief was provided to the poor people in Duōlúnnuò'ěr who rented Mongol land and were affected by disaster.
It was also decreed that, from now on, requests for relief due to localized disasters outside the passes would not be granted.
On the *Rénxū* day,
Wāng Shǒuhé was concurrently appointed acting Minister of Personnel.
This month,
relief was provided to disaster victims in Jìzhōu and seven other prefectures and counties in Zhílì.
Granary grain was loaned to poor people in Hánzhōng and five other prefectures, sub-prefectures, and departments in Shǎnxī.
In the third month, on the *Bǐngzǐ* day,
Grand Secretary Lú Yìnpǔ retired.
On the *Xīnsì* day,
the Emperor reviewed the troops of the Artillery Division.
On the *Bǐngshēn* day,
Lú Kūn reported the capture of Vietnamese pirates Chén Jiāhǎi and others,
and the seas were cleared.
On the *Wùxū* day,
Lín Qìng was appointed Governor-General of Riverways for Jiāngnán.
È Shùn'ān was appointed Governor of Húběi.
On the *Gēngzǐ* day,
it rained.
This month,
loans of granary grain were made to the camp soldiers at Zǐjīngguān in Zhílì,
soldiers in Jǐnzhōu Prefecture, Fèngtiān,
and *túndīng* and Miao tenants in Qiánzhōu and five other departments and counties in Húnán.
In summer, in the fourth month, on the *Rényín* day,
È Shùn'ān was transferred to be Governor of Shānxī,
Yǐn Jìyuán to be Governor of Húběi.
Lè Shàn was promoted to General of Fúzhōu.
Qìng Shān was transferred to be General of Wūlǐyàsūtái.
On the *Dīngwèi* day,
it rained.
On the *Wùshēn* day,
Hú Sōng'é was promoted to General of Chéngdū.
Bǎo Xīng was transferred to be General of Shèngjīng,
Bǎo Chāng to be General of Jílín.
Sū Chéng'é was appointed Military Governor of Rèhé,
Guì Qìng was appointed Grand Canal Governor.
On the *Jǐyǒu* day,
Pān Shì'ēn was appointed Grand Secretary of Tǐrén Pavilion,
and placed in charge of the Board of Revenue.
Zhū Shìyàn was transferred to be Minister of Personnel.
Bái Róng was appointed Minister of Public Works,
Tāng Jīnzhāo was appointed Censor-in-chief of the Left.
On the *Yǐmǎo* day,
the regular tribute from Kāshígā'ěr and Yè'ěrqiāng for the eleventh and twelfth years of Dàoguāng was remitted.
On the *Jǐsì* day,
Empress Tóngjiāshì passed away.
This month,
soldiers' rations were loaned to Yìzhōu, Shèngjīng, and seeds to the common people in Xīntián County, Húnán.
In the fifth month, on the *Xīnwèi* day, the first day of the lunar month,
Wāng Míngxiàng and 220 others were granted the *Jìnshì* degree with varying ranks.
On the *Dīngchǒu* day,
Yáng Fāng suppressed the Yi bandits in Yuèsuì,
defeated them decisively,
and proceeded to suppress the border Yi bandits.
On the *Jǐchǒu* day,
the border bandit leader Sāngshùgé and others were executed.
On the *Dīngyǒu* day,
Xǐ'ēn was relieved of his duties as Grand Minister of the Imperial Guard and Minister of Revenue,
and was instead appointed Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
Grand Secretary Cháng Líng was ordered to oversee the Board of Revenue,
Pān Shì'ēn to oversee the Board of Public Works.
Mù Zhāng'ā was transferred to be Minister of Revenue,
Bó Qǐtú to be Minister of Public Works.
On the *Jǐhài* day,
the border Yi bandits in Sìchuān were pacified.
In the sixth month, on the *Gēngzǐ* day, the first day of the lunar month,
there was a solar eclipse.
This month,
seeds were loaned for hail-damaged areas in Bóyě and three other counties in Zhílì.
In the seventh month, on the *Jiǎshēn* day,
the Emperor personally examined the Hanlin and Court of Imperial Stud officers,
promoting Tián Sōngnián and two others to the first rank,
while the rest were promoted or demoted with varying ranks.
On the *Rénchén* day,
the deceased Empress was posthumously honored with the title Xiàoshèn Empress.
Qí ● was transferred to be Governor of Guǎngdōng,
and Huì Jí was appointed Governor of Guǎngxī.
This month,
relief was provided for flood-stricken areas in Gǔzhōu and four other departments and counties in Guìzhōu.
In the eighth month,
this month,
relief was provided for flood-stricken areas in Dūjiāng and two other departments in Guìzhōu.
In the ninth month, on the *Gēngwǔ* day,
the coffin of Empress Xiàoshèn was moved to Tiáncūn,
and the Emperor personally saw it off.
On the *Yǐhài* day,
Yáng Fāng was promoted to First-Class Marquis.
On the *Rénchén* day,
Guì Qìng was appointed Military Governor of Rèhé.
Sōng Pǔ was transferred to be Grand Canal Governor.
Shǐ Pǔ was transferred to be Governor of Guìzhōu.
Yáng Míngyáng was appointed Governor of Shǎnxī.
On the *Jiǎwǔ* day,
the regular taxes for this year were remitted for earthquake-stricken areas in Kūnmíng and ten other prefectures and counties in Yúnnán,
and relief was also provided.
This month,
relief was provided for flood-stricken areas in Shàngyuán and six other counties in Jiāngsū.
In the tenth month, on the *Wùwǔ* day,
Bù Yàntài was transferred to be the Assistant Military Governor of Yīlí,
Cháng Dé to be the Assistant Military Governor of Tǎ'ěrbāhātái.
On the *Jǐwèi* day,
Tāng Jīnzhāo was appointed Minister of Public Works,
Shǐ Zhìyǎn was appointed Censor-in-chief of the Left.
This month,
relief was provided for disaster victims in Shàngyuán and twelve other counties and garrisons in Jiāngsū,
Ānxiāng and Huáróng counties in Húnán,
Qǔyáng County in Zhílì,
and three places in Hēilóngjiāng.
Relief was provided for flood-stricken areas in Wǔchāng and six other counties in Húběi.
Rations were distributed to disaster victims in Huáiyuǎn and six other counties in Ānhuī.
In the eleventh month, on the *Bǐngxū* day,
the Emperor went to Dàgāo Hall to pray for snow.
Yù Tàì was appointed Governor of Guìzhōu.
On the *Dīnghài* day,
Wǔ Zhōng'é was appointed Military Governor of Rèhé.
Kǎi Yīnbù was appointed acting Military Governor of Cháhā'ěr.
In the twelfth month, on the *Dīngsì* day,
land taxes were reduced or remitted for flood-inundated areas in Héjiān and five other counties in Zhílì.
This month,
relief was provided for flood-stricken areas in Shàngyuán and twelve other counties and garrisons in Jiāngsū.
This year,
Cháoxiǎn, Yuènán, Liúqiú, and Miǎndiàn paid tribute.
In the spring of the fourteenth year, in the first month, on the *Dīngmǎo* day, the first day of the lunar month,
on the *Xīnwèi* day,
Wén Fú was relieved of his duties as Grand Minister of the Imperial Guard for the Bordered Yellow Banner,
and Zài Quán replaced him.
On the *Dīngchǒu* day,
Miǎndiàn envoy Niè Niǔyé Gōngnàyá died in the capital.
On the *Gēngchén* day,
Li bandits in Dānzhōu, Guǎngdōng, rebelled,
and Lú Kūn was ordered to suppress them.
On the *Jiǎshēn* day,
due to disaster in Hángzhōu and other prefectures in Zhèjiāng,
customs duties on rice transported by foreign merchants and Zhèjiāng people were remitted.
Bandits in Yǒng'ān and other counties in Fújiàn kidnapped people for ransom,
and were apprehended and punished.
It was permitted for grain taxes in Hángzhōu and Húzhōu prefectures in Zhèjiāng to be collected in both white and red grains,
and early-ripening rice could also be submitted.
On the *Dīnghài* day,
Pān Shì'ēn was ordered to serve above the Grand Councilors.
On the *Wùzǐ* day,
the proposals regarding the three-year performance review for Cháng Líng and others were approved.
Sōng Yún was ordered to retire with the title of Military Governor.
Qí ● reported that the siege of Liàngshān, Yuènán, was lifted,
and that Ruan Wenquán and others, the prefects of Qīquán Yīzhōu, sought to enter the pass,
but were refused.
This month,
relief was provided to the poor people in Qǔyáng County, Zhílì.

Rations and seeds were distributed to Shàngyuán and eight other counties in Jiāngsū, Hǎiníng and four other prefectures and counties in Zhèjiāng, and Nánchāng and twenty-two other counties in Jiāngxī, for last year's crop failures.

Granary grain, rations, and seeds were loaned to Shuòzhōu and ten other prefectures and counties in Shānxī, Jiāzhōu and fourteen other prefectures, departments, and counties in Shǎnxī, Nánchāng and six other counties in Jiāngxī, Wǔchāng and eighteen other prefectures, departments, counties, and garrisons in Húběi, Lǐzhōu and four other prefectures and counties in Húnán, and Gāolán and nine other prefectures, departments, and counties in Gānsù, for last year's disasters.
In the second month, on the *Bǐngshēn* day, the first day of the lunar month,
Zhū Shìyàn was granted leave to visit his parents,
and Tāng Jīnzhāo was appointed acting Minister of Personnel.
The Brigade General of Bá'ěrqúkè, who oversaw troop rotation, was changed to a Major General.
On the *Jǐhài* day,
the Emperor attended the Classics Mat.
On the *Guǐmǎo* day,
Shēng Yín and others were ordered to investigate incidents in Shāndōng and Hénán,
and Jìng Zhēng was appointed acting Censor-in-chief of the Left.
On the *Yǐsì* day,
Lǐ Hóngbīn and Liú Róngqìng were released and returned to their hometowns.
On the *Bǐngwǔ* day,
due to rising grain prices in Jiāngsū,
boat taxes at various passes for commercial rice from Sìchuān and Húguǎng were remitted.
On the *Wùshēn* day,
as Lǐ Tài Jiāo, the Education Commissioner of Guǎngdōng, committed suicide,
Lú Kūn was ordered to conduct a thorough investigation.
On the *Jǐyǒu* day,
regulations for inspecting the springs of the Grand Canal in Shāndōng were established.
On the *Gēngxū* day,
for the visit to the Western Mausoleum,
Yì Shào and others were ordered to remain in the capital to handle affairs.
On the *Rénzǐ* day,
Kǎi Yīnbù was ordered to investigate incidents in Wūlǐyàsūtái.
Sū Lèntōng'ā was appointed acting Military Governor of Cháhā'ěr.
On the *Xīnyǒu* day,
Zhū Shìyàn was relieved of his duties due to mourning,
Tāng Jīnzhāo was transferred to be Minister of Personnel,
Wāng Shǒuhé was appointed Minister of Public Works,
Shǐ Zhìyǎn was appointed Minister of Rites,
Hé Línghàn was appointed Censor-in-chief of the Left.
On the *Yǐchǒu* day,
Grand Secretary Fù Jùn passed away.
This month,
rations were distributed to Shàngyuán and eight other counties and garrisons in Jiāngsū for last year's disaster.
Seeds were loaned to Gǔzhōu Department in Guìzhōu for last year's disaster.
In the third month, on the *gēngwǔ* day,
Míngshān (明山) was dismissed due to illness.
Chénggé (成格) was appointed Minister of Punishments (Xíngbù Shàngshū 刑部尚書),
with Nàqīng'ān (那清安) concurrently acting in the post.
Chángqīng (長清) was appointed General of Ürümqi (Wūlǔmùqí Dūtǒng 烏魯木齊都統),
and Xīngdé (興德) was appointed Assistant Administrator of Yarkant (Yè'ěrqiāng Cānzàn Dàchén 葉爾羌參贊大臣).
On the *guǐyǒu* day,
the Emperor visited the Western Mausoleums (Xīlíng 西陵),
and offered libations before the coffin of Empress Xiàoshèn (孝慎皇后) at Tiáncūn (田村).
Three-tenths of the land tax (èfù 額賦) for passing through were remitted.
On the *dīngchǒu* day,
the Emperor visited the Tàilíng (泰陵), Tàidōnglíng (泰東陵), and Chānglíng (昌陵) mausoleums.
On the *gēngchén* day,
the Emperor returned to the capital (Jīngshī 京師).
On the *rénwǔ* day,
the Emperor visited the residence of the late Grand Secretary (Dàxuéshì 大學士) Fùjùn (富俊) and offered libations.
On the *yǐyǒu* day,
due to the disaster suffered by the Khalkha (Kā'ěrkā 喀爾喀) pastoralists,
Kǎiyīnbù's (凱音布) request was granted
to postpone the survey of the boundary.
The land tax of the previous year was remitted for the three departments and counties of Qīngxī (清溪) and others in Sìchuān (四川) that were disturbed by "Yi bandits" (yífěi 夷匪),
as well as for the two battalions of Níngyuè (寧越) and Yuèsuī (越嶲).
In summer, fourth month, on the *dīngyǒu* day,
based on a memorial by the Supervising Secretary (Gěishìzhōng 給事中) Huáng Juézì (黃爵滋),
the governors-general and governors of all provinces were ordered to revive academies (shūyuàn 書院),
select principals (shānzhǎng 山長),
investigate the *bǎojiǎ* (保甲) system,
repair water conservancy projects,
plan for grain storage,
strictly prohibit the accumulated abuses of deducting pay and assigning soldiers (kòuxiǎng pàibīng jīchè 扣餉派兵積弊),
investigate the evasion of foreign customs duties (yángshuì 洋稅),
and strictly prohibit the export of pure silver (wènyín 紋銀) and the private minting of foreign silver (yángyín 洋銀).
On the *wùxū* day,
the rent and tax (zūfù 租賦) on official land damaged by floods in Lètíng (樂亭) County, Zhílì (直隸) was remitted.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
Prince Yí (Yí Jùnwáng 儀郡王) Miánzhì (綿志) passed away.
On the *jiǎyín* day,
libations were offered at the residence of the late Prince Yíshùn (Yíshùn Jùnwáng 儀順郡王) Miánzhì (綿志).
His son, Yìyīn (奕絪), succeeded as a *Bèilè* (貝勒).
On the *dīngsì* day,

Vice Minister (Shìláng 侍郎) Zhào Shèngkuí (趙盛奎) and the former Director-General of River Conservancy (Hédū 河督) Yán Lǎng (嚴烺), who was at home, were ordered to jointly inspect the dyke projects in Zhèjiāng (浙江) with Fùníyáng'ā (富呢揚阿).
On the *xīnyǒu* day,
Sūqīng'ā (蘇清阿) was appointed Assistant Administrator of Yili (Yīlí Cānzàn Dàchén 伊犁參贊大臣).
On the *jiǎzǐ* day,
the Emperor went to Tiáncūn (田村) to perform the annual sacrifice before the coffin of Empress Xiàoshèn (孝慎皇后).
In this month,

grain from official and private granaries (míntún cānggǔ 民屯倉穀) was loaned to the people of Yuèyáng (岳陽) and twelve other prefectures, departments, and counties in Shānxī (山西) that suffered from poor harvests.
Fifth month, on the *jǐsì* day,
Ēnmíng (恩銘) was appointed acting Governor-General of Grain Transport (Cáoyùn Zǒngdū 漕運總督).
On the *rénshēn* day,
Kǎiyīnbù (凱音布) was appointed General of Cháhār (Cháhār Dūtǒng 察哈爾都統).
On the *guǐyǒu* day,
the land tax of the previous year was remitted for Kūnmíng (昆明) and ten other prefectures and counties in Yúnnán (雲南) that suffered from earthquake disasters.
On the *xīnsì* day,
the Emperor went to Tiáncūn (田村) to offer libations before the coffin of Empress Xiàoshèn (孝慎皇后).
On the *bǐngxū* day,
Lú (盧) and others were ordered to expel the British opium-dealing hulks,
and not allow them to anchor.
On the *gēngyín* day,
the Confucius Forest (Kǒngzǐ Lín 孔子林) and Temple (miào 廟) at Quèlǐ (闕里), Shāndōng (山東) were repaired.
On the *jiǎwǔ* day,
a clear instruction was issued to Duō'ěrzì Lābùtǎn (多爾濟喇布坦) and others, stating that in all matters concerning negotiations with Russia (Éluósī 俄羅斯), old regulations must be followed.
In this month,
seeds for military-cultivated land (túntián zǐzhǒng 屯田籽種) were loaned to the two garrisons of Huái'ān (淮安) and Dàhé (大河) that suffered from poor harvests.
Sixth month, on the *wùshēn* day,
due to floods in the provincial capital of Fújiàn (福建),
permission was granted to transport grain from the granaries of Gǔtián (古田) and Fúqīng (福清) counties, and to sell rice at a stable price by merchants in Xiàmén (廈門).
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
because the common people (mínrén 民人) of Dálātè (達拉特) Banner, Ordós (È'ěrdōsī 鄂爾多斯), who privately rented Mongolian land, resisted arrest and injured a *Tàijí* (台吉),
Èshùn'ān (鄂順安) was ordered to arrest and deal with them.
On the *rénxū* day,
Ēnmíng (恩銘) was officially appointed Governor-General of Grain Transport (Cáoyùn Zǒngdū 漕運總督).
In this month,
arrears of grain tax were remitted and deferred for the Muslim households (huíhù 回戶) of Yè'ěrqiāng (葉爾羌) and two other cities.
Autumn, seventh month, on the *yǐchǒu* day,
orders were given to investigate the accumulated abuses of deficits and shortages in grain transport,
and to reiterate the prohibition of private trading in the capital (Jīngchéng 京城) and the supply of diverted grain.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
Bóqǐtú (博啟圖) was granted leave,
and Yìhào (奕顥) was appointed acting Minister of Works (Gōngbù Shàngshū 工部尚書).
On the *wùchén* day,
the Khokandian Beq (Huòhǎn Bókè 霍罕伯克) requested trade and tax exemption,
sent envoys to offer tribute,
and also requested to enter court annually (niánbān rùjìn 年班入覲);
this was granted.
On the *gēngwǔ* day,
Sūqīng'ā (蘇清阿) was ordered to investigate the reclamation of land in Bā'ěrchǔkè (巴爾楚克) and Kāshígá'ěr (喀什噶爾).
The land tax was remitted for four counties in Fújiàn (福建) that were disturbed by "Taiwan bandits" (táifěi 台匪),
as well as for various properties and grain taxes seized by rebels in Dànshuǐ (淡水) Department.
On the *rénshēn* day,
Tèyīshùnbǎo (特依順保) and others were ordered to appropriately deliberate on the regulations for joint patrols along the border.
Chéng Zǔluò (程祖洛) reported the capture and execution of foreign pirates (yángdào 洋盜) Liú Sì (劉四) and others.
On the *jiǎxū* day,
the Zhiyí (支夷) of the border department in Sìchuān (四川) revolted,
and Húsōng'é (瑚松額), Yáng Fāng (楊芳) and others were ordered to investigate and handle the matter.
Relief was provided for flood disasters in Jiāngxī (江西).
On the *bǐngzǐ* day,
Minister of Works (Gōngbù Shàngshū 工部尚書) Bóqǐtú (博啟圖) passed away.
Qíyīng (耆英) was transferred to be Minister of Works (Gōngbù Shàngshū 工部尚書),
Shēngyín (昇寅) was promoted to Minister of Rites (Lǐbù Shàngshū 禮部尚書),
and Jìngzhēng (敬徵) was promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief (Zuǒ Dū Yùshǐ 左都御史).
On the *rénwǔ* day,
Guìliáng (桂良) was appointed Governor of Hénán (Hénán Xúnfǔ 河南巡撫).
On the *wùzǐ* day,
a breach occurred at Zhūjiāwān (朱家灣) on the Eastern River (Dōnghé 東河).
In this month,
relief was provided for flood disasters in Nánchāng (南昌) and thirteen other counties in Jiāngxī (江西).
Rations and house repair expenses were given to military personnel and civilians affected by floods in Wǔlíng (武陵) and seven other counties and garrisons in Húnán (湖南).
Eighth month, on the *jǐyǒu* day,
the Northern Sea Dyke (Běihǎitáng 北海塘) in Zhèjiāng (浙江) was rebuilt as a stone dyke.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
Wǔzhōng'é (武忠額) was appointed General of Uliastai (Wūlǐyàsūtái Jiāngjūn 烏里雅蘇台將軍),
with Lúnbù Duō'ěrzì (倫布多爾濟) acting in the post.
Sōngpǔ (嵩溥) was appointed General of Rehe (Rèhé Dūtǒng 熱河都統).
On the *gēngshēn* day,
the Zhiyí (支夷) on the border of Sìchuān (四川) were pacified.
Lú Kūn (盧坤) reported that the British merchant William John Napier came to Yuè (粵),
sent a letter referring to "Great Britain" (Dà Yīngguó 大英國),
and requested a temporary suspension of trade.
An edict was issued regarding this.
On the *xīnyǒu* day,
the Emperor went to the coffin of Empress Xiàoshèn (孝慎皇后) and offered tea and wine.
In this month,
relief was provided for three places including Gàizhōu (蓋州) in Shèngjīng (盛京),
Jiàndé (建德) and Chún'ān (淳安) counties in Zhèjiāng (浙江),
and Nánchāng (南昌) and twenty-five other counties in Jiāngxī (江西) that suffered from flood disasters.
Grain from granaries was loaned to Gāolán (皐蘭) and six other counties in Gānsù (甘肅) that suffered from drought.
New and old land taxes were remitted and deferred for Nánchāng (南昌) and twenty-five other prefectures, departments, and counties in Jiāngxī (江西).
Ninth month, on the *yǐchǒu* day,
British warships entered the inner river of Guǎngdōng (廣東),
Lú Kūn (盧坤) was stripped of his office but retained in his post.
On the *gēngwǔ* day,
the Emperor reviewed the soldiers of the Jiànruì Battalion (Jiànruì Yíng 健銳營).
On the *guǐyǒu* day,
the British warships departed,
Lú Kūn (盧坤) was restored to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent (Tàizǐ Shǎobǎo 太子少保),
but remained stripped of his office and retained in his post.
In this month,
relief was provided for flood disasters in Wǎnpíng (宛平) and seven other prefectures and counties in Zhílì (直隸),
and Xīnmín (新民) and four other prefectures, departments, and counties in Fèngtiān (奉天).
Seeds were loaned to Guǎngzhōu (廣州) and Zhàoqìng (肇慶) two prefectures in Guǎngdōng (廣東) that suffered from floods,
and grain from granaries was loaned to the banner people and commoners of Dǎshēng Wūlā (打牲烏拉) affected by floods.

New and old land taxes were remitted and deferred for Dàchéng (大城) and fifty-one other prefectures, departments, and counties in Zhílì (直隸), and Tàiyuán (太原) County in Shānxī (山西) that suffered from flood disasters.
Tenth month, on the *jǐyǒu* day,
Imperial Noble Consort Niǔhùlù Shì (鈕祜祿氏) was established as Empress,
and an imperial edict was issued to grant various favors.
On the *rénzǐ* day,
the Empress Dowager (Huáng Tàihòu 皇太后) was given the honorific title Gōngcí Ānyù Kāngchéng Zhuānghuì Huáng Tàihòu (恭慈安豫康成莊惠皇太后),
and an imperial edict was issued to grant widespread favors.
On the *xīnyǒu* day,
Nàqīng'ān (那清安) was dismissed due to illness.
Jìngzhēng (敬徵) was appointed Minister of War (Bīngbù Shàngshū 兵部尚書),
and Yìhào (奕顥) was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief (Zuǒ Dū Yùshǐ 左都御史).
In this month,
relief was provided for flood disasters in Huángméi (黃梅) and three other counties and garrisons in Húběi (湖北), and Ānxiāng (安鄉) and four other counties and garrisons in Húnán (湖南).
Rations were loaned to Gāolán (皐蘭) and eight other prefectures and counties in Gānsù (甘肅) that suffered from drought and hail disasters.
Eleventh month, on the *yǐchǒu* day,
Wāng Shǒuhé (汪守和) was transferred to be Minister of Rites (Lǐbù Shàngshū 禮部尚書),
and Shǐ Zhìyǎn (史致儼) was appointed Minister of Works (Gōngbù Shàngshū 工部尚書).
On the *rénshēn* day,
Minister of Rites (Lǐbù Shàngshū 禮部尚書) Shēngyín (昇寅) passed away.
Yìhào (奕顥) was appointed Minister of Rites (Lǐbù Shàngshū 禮部尚書),
and Ēnmíng (恩銘) was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief (Zuǒ Dū Yùshǐ 左都御史).
Zhū Wéibì (朱為弼) was transferred to be Governor-General of Grain Transport (Cáoyùn Zǒngdū 漕運總督).
On the *bǐngzǐ* day,
Gùnchǔkè Cèléng (棍楚克策楞) was appointed Assistant Administrator of Tarbagatai (Tǎ'ěrbāhātái Cānzàn Dàchén 塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣).
On the *jǐmǎo* day,
Minister of Punishments (Xíngbù Shàngshū 刑部尚書) Dài Dūnyuán (戴敦元) passed away,
and Shǐ Zhìyǎn (史致儼) was transferred to replace him.
Wáng Yǐnzhī (王引之) was appointed Minister of Works (Gōngbù Shàngshū 工部尚書).
On the *gēngchén* day,
Wū'ěrgōng'é (烏爾恭額) was appointed Governor of Zhèjiāng (Zhèjiāng Xúnfǔ 浙江巡撫).
On the *bǐngxū* day,
Wénfú (文孚) was appointed Grand Secretary (Dàxuéshì 大學士) with charge of the Ministry of Personnel (Lìbù 吏部).
Mùzhāng'ā (穆彰阿) was transferred to be Minister of Personnel (Lìbù Shàngshū 吏部尚書) and Assistant Grand Secretary (Xiébàn Dàxuéshì 協辦大學士),
Qíyīng (耆英) was transferred to be Minister of Revenue (Hùbù Shàngshū 戶部尚書),
Jìngzhēng (敬徵) was transferred to be Minister of Works (Gōngbù Shàngshū 工部尚書),
and Yìhào (奕顥) was transferred to be Minister of War (Bīngbù Shàngshū 兵部尚書).
Zàiquán (載銓) was appointed Minister of Rites (Lǐbù Shàngshū 禮部尚書).
Minister of Works (Gōngbù Shàngshū 工部尚書) Wáng Yǐnzhī (王引之) passed away.
On the *dīnghài* day,
Hé Línghàn (何淩漢) was appointed Minister of Works (Gōngbù Shàngshū 工部尚書),
and Wú Chūn (吳椿) was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief (Zuǒ Dū Yùshǐ 左都御史).
In this month,
relief was provided for flood disasters in Líshuǐ (麗水) County, Zhèjiāng (浙江).
New and old land taxes were remitted and deferred for Jiàndé (建德) and sixteen other prefectures, departments, counties, and garrisons in Zhèjiāng (浙江) that suffered from flood disasters.
In the twelfth month, on the day *Guǐsì*,
Kokand again invaded Sèlǐkùlè.
Xīngdé and others were ordered to deliver an imperial edict to them.
Wénfú was appointed Grand Secretary of the East Cabinet.
On the day *Bǐngshēn*,
the border barbarians in Sìchuān again rebelled.
Yáng Fāng was demoted to second-class marquis,
stripped of his Imperial Bodyguard post,
and designated as a candidate for general-in-chief.
On the day *Jiǎchén*,
Fùsēngdé, the General of Hēilóngjiāng, was transferred to be the General of Xī'ān,
and Yìjīng was appointed in his place.
On the day *Guǐchǒu*,
the Emperor went to Dàgāo Hall to pray for snow.
This month,
relief was granted to the soldiers' pay in various battalions in the disaster-stricken areas of Zhílì,
to the silver and rice for the Eight Banners officers and soldiers in Jiāngníng,
and to the seeds and dike repair fees for the nine counties including Nánhǎi in Guǎngdōng.
This year,
Cháoxiān, Liúqiú, Miǎndiàn, and Xiāmluó paid tribute.
In the spring of the fifteenth year, in the first month, on the day *Jiǎzǐ*,
Grand Secretary Cáo Zhènyōng passed away.
On the day *Rénwǔ*,
Chánglíng was dismissed from his post as Grand Minister of the Imperial Household Department due to accepting gifts from Kokand.
[This also meant] managing affairs of the Board of Revenue.
On the day *Bǐngxū*,
Yáng Yùchūn, the Governor-General of Shǎnxī and Gānsù, retired,
but was still cordially invited to come to the capital.
Húsōng'é was appointed Governor-General of Shǎnxī and Gānsù.
Bǎoxīng was transferred to be the General of Chéngdū.
Yìjīng was appointed General of Shèngjīng,
Bǎochāng as General of Hēilóngjiāng,
and Sūqīng'ā as General of Jílín.
This month,
relief was provided to the banner households affected by disaster in the three areas including Niúzhuāng in Fèngtiān.
Rations were distributed to the nine counties including Nánchāng in Jiāngxī,
and the six prefectures and counties including Jìngyuǎn in Gānsù.
Relief was granted for disaster-stricken granary grain and seeds in the three prefectures and counties including Tàiyuán in Shānxī,
the twenty-six prefectures and counties including Nánchāng in Jiāngxī,
the four prefectures and counties including Ānxiāng in Húnán,
and Qínzhōu and Jìngyuǎn County in Gānsù.
In the second month, on the day *Bǐngshēn*,
Ruǎn Yuán was appointed Grand Secretary concurrently managing the Board of Punishments,
Wáng Dǐng as Assistant Grand Secretary,
Yīlǐbù as Governor-General of Yúnnán and Guìzhōu,
and Hé Xuān as Governor of Yúnnán.
On the day *Gēngzǐ*,
Qímíngbǎo was appointed Acting General of Hēilóngjiāng.
On the day *Dīngwèi*,
Chánglíng was ordered to manage the Court of Colonial Affairs,
Wénfú to manage the Board of Revenue,
Pān Shì'ēn to manage the Board of Works,
Ruǎn Yuán was reassigned to manage the Board of War,
and Wáng Dǐng to manage the Board of Punishments.
Lǐ Huàn, the Imperial Grandson of Cháoxiān, succeeded to the title of King of Cháoxiān.
On the day *Wǔwǔ*,
Sūqīng'ā, the General of Jílín, passed away,
and Bǎochāng was transferred to replace him.
Xiángkāng was appointed General of Hēilóngjiāng.
In the third month,
Cáo Shùn, a bandit in Zhàochéng County, Shānxī, rebelled,
and the magistrate Yáng Yánliàng died.
They then besieged Huòzhōu.
Èshùn'ān was ordered to suppress them.
On the day *Yǐhài*,
the Emperor personally ploughed the sacrificial field.
He made an imperial hunt in Nányuàn.
On the day *Gēngchén*,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
This month,
rations for disaster and famine were distributed to the five prefectures, counties, and departments including Gāolán in Gānsù.
In summer, in the fourth month,
the border barbarians in Sìchuān were pacified,
and Èshān was promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent,
and bestowed a double-eyed peacock feather.
On the day *Jiǎyín*,
Liú Yì and two hundred seventy-six others were granted the *Jìnshì* degree with varying ranks.
On the day *Dīngsì*,
the Emperor went to the Black Dragon Pool Temple to pray for rain.
In the fifth month, on the day *Dīngmǎo*,
Yáng Yùchūn, the retired Governor-General of Shǎnxī and Gānsù, was promoted to first-class marquis,
and granted full salary.
On the day *Xīnwèi*,
Cáo Shùn, the bandit leader of Zhàochéng County, and others were executed.
On the day *Dīngchǒu*,
the Emperor again went to the Black Dragon Pool Temple to pray for rain.
Lì Yùměi was appointed Director-General of River Conservancy for Hé-Dōng.
On the day *Gēngchén*,
it rained.
This month,
relief was granted for drought-stricken granary grain in Fèngtái and Qìnshuǐ counties in Shānxī.
In the sixth month, on the day *Bǐngwǔ*,
the assessed land tax for flood-affected reed fields in Dāntú, Jiāngsū, was reduced.
In the intercalary sixth month, on the day *Dīngmǎo*,
Jìngzhēng was demoted,
Zài Quán was appointed Minister of the Board of Works,
Ēnmíng as Minister of the Board of Rites,
and Wǔzhōng'é as Left Censor-in-Chief.
Bǎochāng was transferred to be the General of Wūlǐyǎsūtái,
Xiángkāng as General of Jílín,
and Hāfēng'ā as General of Hēilóngjiāng.
On the day *Jǐsì*,
the autumn executions for this year were suspended.
In autumn, in the seventh month, on the day *Jiǎchén*,
Wénfú was relieved of his duties as Grand Councilor,
but was still ordered to manage the Board of Civil Office as Grand Secretary.
Pān Shì'ēn was reassigned to manage the Board of Revenue,
and Mùzhāng'ā to manage the Board of Works.
Zhào Shèngkuí, Right Vice Minister of the Board of Punishments, and Sàishàng'ā, Right Vice Minister of the Board of Works, were ordered to learn and serve as Grand Councilors.
This month,
rations were distributed to Miǎnxian and Luòchuān counties in Shǎnxī, affected by floods,
and Huáróng and three other counties and garrisons in Húnán, affected by drought.
In the eighth month, on the day *Jiǎzǐ*,
on the occasion of the Empress Dowager's sixtieth birthday,
arrears of taxes in all provinces were generally remitted.
On the day *Gēngchén*,
an edict stated:
"Among the Censorate, Fényzànxūn, Jīn Yìnglín, Huáng Juézì, and Zēng Wàngyán have been promoted to capital officials,
in order to widely encourage loyal remonstrance.
They must not avoid suspicion or resentment,
and should still, at all times, truthfully and directly present any shortcomings in the people's livelihood, national economy, appointments, and administration,
so that they may be considered and adopted."
Lú Kūn, the Governor-General of Guǎngdōng and Guǎngxī, passed away,
Dèng Tíngzhēn was appointed Governor-General of Guǎngdōng and Guǎngxī,
Qí Sù (or Jí Sù, 祁肅) as acting Governor-General,
Sèbùxīng'é as Governor of Ānhuī.
On the day *Jiǎshēn*,
the Emperor visited the Western Mausoleums.
On this day,
the coffin of Empress Xiàoshèn was moved from Tiáncūn,
and five-tenths of the assessed tax in the passing areas was remitted.
This month,
rations were distributed to Fǔgǔ County, Shǎnxī, affected by hail disaster.
In the ninth month, on the day *Jǐchǒu*,
the coffins of Empress Xiàomù and Empress Xiàoshèn arrived at Lóngquányù,
and the Emperor personally offered sacrifices.
On the day *Gēngyín*,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
On the day *Wùxū*,
Línqìng was appointed Director-General of River Conservancy for Jiāngnán.
On the day *Bǐngwǔ*,
Zhū Wéibì was dismissed due to illness,
and Ēntèhéng'é was appointed Director-General of Grain Transport.
This month,
rations were distributed to salt workers affected by floods in the two salt fields of Bǎnpǔ and Zhōngzhèng in Liǎnghuái.
Tax collection was deferred for hail disasters in Yúlín County and Jiāzhōu in Shǎnxī,
and drought disasters in Jīnxī and nine other counties in Jiāngxī.
In winter, in the tenth month, on the day *Wùwǔ*,
Yùshū was appointed Assistant Amban of Kobdo.
On the day *Jiǎzǐ*,
on the occasion of the Empress Dowager's sixtieth birthday,
the Emperor bestowed an honorific title, "Gōngcí Kāngyù Ānchéng Zhuānghuì Shòuxī Empress Dowager."
On the day *Yǐchǒu*,
on the Empress Dowager's sixtieth birthday festival,
the Emperor led the princes, dukes, and ministers to Shòukāng Palace to perform the congratulatory ceremony.
The Emperor presided over the Tàihé Hall,
and the ministers presented memorials and performed the congratulatory ceremony.
An imperial edict decreed universal grace with varying distinctions.
Fùníyáng'ā was appointed General-in-Chief of Wūlǔmùqí.
On the day *Guǐwèi*,
Imperial Censor Tāng Péng was dismissed for impeaching Zài Quán against the Emperor's will.
The retired Grand Secretary Tuōjīn passed away.
This month,
rations were distributed to the five prefectures and counties including Yángqǔ in Shānxī, Yuèzhōu garrison in Húnán,
and Hǎiníng and thirteen other prefectures and counties in Zhèjiāng, affected by disaster.
Grain was loaned to the naval battalion in Jīnzhōu, Fèngtiān.
Old and new assessed taxes and miscellaneous levies were remitted or deferred for Huáróng and fourteen other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Húnán,
and Hǎiníng and thirty-one other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Zhèjiāng, affected by disaster.
In the eleventh month, on the day *Wùxū*,
the Emperor personally visited the residence of Grand Secretary Tuōjīn to offer condolences.
This month,
rations were distributed to the three famine-stricken areas including Jílín.
In the twelfth month, on the day *Jǐwèi*,
the Emperor again went to Dàgāo Hall to pray for snow.
On the day *Yǐchǒu*,
the coffins of Empress Xiàomù and Empress Xiàoshèn were interred in the underground palace.
On the day *Yǐhài*,
Lèshàn was appointed General of Jílín.
This month,
relief was granted for soldiers' pay in the Jiāngsū Provincial Brigade and the Chéngshǒu and Liúhé battalions in disaster areas.
Assessed taxes for flood-affected areas in Sōngtáo Department, Guìzhōu, were remitted or deferred.
This year,
Cháoxiān and Liúqiú paid tribute.
In the spring of the sixteenth year, in the first month, on the day *Yǐwèi*,
Chēlúnduō'ěrzì was appointed Minister for Affairs in Kùlún Měnggǔ.
On the day *Rényín*,
fifty thousand taels of silver from the Shāndōng Treasury were allocated to relieve famine in the three prefectures of Dēng, Lái, and Qīng.
On the day *Yǐsì*,
Yùtài was transferred to be Governor of Húnán.
Hè Chánglíng was appointed Governor of Guìzhōu.
This month,
relief was provided for flood and drought disasters in Yìwū and three other counties in Zhèjiāng.
Rations were distributed to banner people in flood-affected areas including Guǎngníng in Fèngtiān.
On the *bǐngchén* day of the second month,
Zhōu Zhīqí was transferred to be the Governor of Húběi.
Chén Luán was appointed Governor of Jiāngxī.
On the *jǐwèi* day,
for the visit to the Eastern Tombs,
Prínce Sù and others were ordered to remain in the capital to manage affairs.
On the *jǐsì* day,
the Emperor reviewed the troops of the Artillery Division.
On the *guǐyǒu* day,
the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs,
and remitted three-tenths of the annual taxes for the areas passed through.
On the *bǐngzǐ* day,
the Emperor visited the Zhāoxīling, Xiàoling, Xiàodōngling, Jǐngling, and Yùling.
Bandits Lán Zhèngtún and others rebelled in Wǔgāngzhōu, Húnán;
Wú Róngguāng was ordered to suppress them in conjunction with Nà'ěrjīng'é.
On the *wùyín* day,
arrears of taxes for the border prefectures of Sìchuān were remitted.
On the *jǐmǎo* day,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
In the summer, on the *guǐhài* day of the fourth month,
Liáng Zhāngjù was appointed Governor of Guǎngxī.
On the *dīngchǒu* day,
Lín Hóngnián and 172 others were granted the *jìnshì* degree with varying ranks.
This month,
food relief was granted to the disaster-stricken population of Qínzhōu and eight other prefectures and counties in Gānsù.
On the *bǐngshēn* day of the fifth month,
the Emperor went to Hēilóngtán to pray for rain.
On the *wùxū* day,
Wāng Shǒuhé, Minister of Rites, died;
Wú Chūn was appointed Minister of Rites,
and Lǐ Zōngfǎng was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
the Emperor went to the Dragon King Temple in Jìngmíngyuán to pray for rain.
This month,
food relief was granted for poor harvests in Bǎodǐ County, Zhílì.
In the autumn, on the *guǐwèi* day of the seventh month,
Zhōng Xiáng was appointed Governor-General of Mǐnzhè,
and Jīng'ébù was appointed Governor of Shāndōng.
On the *yǐyǒu* day,
because Hāfēng'ā reported Dūtǒng Gāo Kānài's letters interfering in public affairs,
he was promoted to Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
On the *jǐchǒu* day,
Gāo Kānài was stripped of his office
and exiled to Rèhé.
On the *bǐngshēn* day,
Grand Secretary Wénfú retired.
On the *gēngzǐ* day,
Mùzhāng'ā was appointed Grand Secretary and concurrently managed the Ministry of Works;
Qí Shàn was appointed Associate Grand Secretary,
but remained in his post as Governor-General of Zhílì.
Qí Yīng was transferred to be Minister of Personnel,
Yìhào to be Minister of Revenue,
Xī'ēn to be Minister of War,
Wǔzhōng'é to be Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs,
Kǎiyīnbù to be Censor-in-Chief of the Left,
and Lèshàn to be Dūtǒng of Cháhā'ěr.
On the *rényín* day,
Ēnmíng was removed from his posts as Minister and Dūtǒng,
and Zhào Shèngkuí was removed from his posts as Grand Councilor and Vice Minister.
Guìqìng was appointed Minister of Rites.
On the *rénchén* day of the ninth month,
Fùníyáng'ā was appointed Governor of Shǎnxī,
and Lián Jìng was appointed Dūtǒng of Wūlǔmùqí.
On the *gēngzǐ* day,
the Emperor reviewed the troops of the Jiànruì Battalion.
On the *wùshēn* day,
the three halls of Yuánmíngyuán caught fire.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
because Qí Yīng accepted commissions from eunuchs,
he was stripped of his posts as Minister, Dūtǒng, and Minister of the Imperial Household Department.
Yìjīng was appointed Minister of Personnel,
and Bǎoxīng was appointed General of Shèngjīng.
Censor-in-Chief of the Left Kǎiyīnbù was transferred to be General of Chéngdū,
and Jìngzhēng replaced him.
This month,
relief was distributed to the disaster victims in places like Báiqíbǎo in Shèngjīng, Shuòzhōu and eleven other prefectures, departments, and counties in Shānxī, and Sōngtáo Tīng in Guìzhōu.
Relief efforts were extended for disaster victims in Shénmù County, Shǎnxī.
New and old annual taxes were remitted for disaster-stricken areas in Shuòzhōu and eleven other prefectures, departments, and counties in Shānxī, and those under Yúlín Fǔ in Shǎnxī.
In the winter, on the *bǐngchén* day of the tenth month,
Chángqīng was promoted to Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
Food relief, granary grain, and seeds were granted for disaster and poor harvest in Jīngzhōu and eight other prefectures and counties in Gānsù, and Shānyīn County in Shānxī.
New and old annual taxes were remitted or deferred for areas affected by floods and droughts in Jǐngzhōu and twelve other prefectures and counties in Zhílì.
On the *rénwǔ* day of the eleventh month,
Jìngzhēng was appointed Minister of Works,
Wǔzhōng'é was transferred to be Censor-in-Chief of the Left,
and Yìjì was appointed Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
the Emperor went to Dàgāodiàn to pray for snow.
This month,
food relief was granted for frost and hail damage in Fǔgǔ and four other counties in Shǎnxī.
Annual taxes for flood-stricken Ānzhōu and three other prefectures and counties in Zhílì were remitted or deferred.
On the *dīngsì* day of the twelfth month,
the Emperor again went to Dàgāodiàn to pray for snow.
On the *guǐhài* day,
it snowed.
This year,
Cháoxiǎn and Xiāmluó paid tribute.
In the spring of the seventeenth year, on the *jǐmǎo* new moon of the first month,
Yìjì was appointed Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard.
Chánglíng was bestowed with a four-panel *qìpáo*.
Pān Shì'ēn was promoted to Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
On the *rénchén* day,
Wáng Zōngchéng, Minister of War, died;
Zhū Shìyàn replaced him.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
sectarian bandits Mǎ Gāng and others rebelled in Wéixiàn, Shāndōng;
they were captured.
On the *gēngzǐ* day,
Nà'ěrjīng'é was demoted to Governor of Húnán,
Lín Zéxú was appointed Governor-General of Húguǎng,
Chén Luán was transferred to be Governor of Jiāngsū,
and Yùtài was appointed Governor of Jiāngxī.
This month,

granary grain, food relief, and seeds were granted for flood, drought, locust, hail, and frost disasters in Shuòzhōu and eleven other prefectures, departments, and counties in Shānxī, Jiāzhōu and nine other prefectures and counties in Shǎnxī, and Jīnzhōu and thirteen other prefectures and counties in Gānsù.
On the *yǐmǎo* day of the second month,
sectarian bandits Shěn Zhī and others rebelled in Jiāyì County, Fújiàn;
they were captured and executed.
This month,
granary grain was granted for Jízhōu and seven other prefectures and counties in Shānxī.
On the *wùyín* new moon of the third month,
for the visit to Bǒjìshān,
Prince Dūn Miánkǎi and others were ordered to remain in the capital to manage affairs.
On the *gēngyín* day,
the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager to Bǒjìshān,
and remitted three-tenths of the current year's annual taxes for the areas passed through.
On the *jiǎwǔ* day,
the Emperor accompanied the Empress Dowager back to Yuánmíngyuán.
Qí Yīng was appointed Dūtǒng of Rèhé.
On the *yǐwèi* day,
the Emperor went to the Míng Tombs.
On the *bǐngshēn* day,
the Emperor offered wine at the Míng Chángling, Xiànling, Tàiling, Jǐngling, and Yǒngling.
Shūguì, the Yán'ēn Hóu and a descendant of the Míng dynasty, was appointed Minister without portfolio.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
the Emperor returned to Yuánmíngyuán.
In the summer, on the *gēngshēn* day of the fourth month,
Yàndé was ordered to interrogate the case of Dānpílè, acting Zásàkè Bèilè of Màomíng'ān, and others, who impeached their league chief.
On the *jiǎzǐ* day,
Yán Bǎotáo was appointed Governor of Yúnnán.
This month,
granary grain was granted for Púzhōu and twenty-four other prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Shāndōng, and Níngwǔ County in Shānxī.
On the *wùyín* day of the fifth month,
Guìqìng resigned due to illness;
Yìjì was transferred to be Minister of Rites,
Wǔzhōng'é was appointed Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs,
and Kuízhào was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
Zhōu Tiānjúe was appointed acting Governor-General of Grain Transport.
On the *gēngxū* day of the sixth month,
due to the memorial from Censor Zhū Chéngliè stating that more than thirty million silver *liǎng* flowed out of the coastal ports of Guǎngdōng annually,
no less than ten million from each of the coastal ports of Fújiàn, Zhèjiāng, and Jiāngsū,
and also more than twenty million from the coastal port of Tiānjīn,
the coastal Governors-General and Governors, and the Superintendents, were ordered to strictly supervise and investigate.
On the *wùwǔ* day,
Censor-in-Chief of the Left Kuízhào and Vice Minister of Revenue Wénqìng were ordered to learn to serve as Grand Councilors.
On the *jǐwèi* day,
Qí Shàn was appointed acting Governor-General of Zhílì.
On the *rénshēn* day,
barbarian bandits rebelled in Mǎbiāntīng, Sìchuān;
Èshān was ordered to suppress them.
On the *jiǎxū* day,
Yìshān and others reported capturing and executing the Khoqand bandit leaders Ādánà and others.
This month,
seeds were granted to the disaster-stricken Huái'ān and Dàhé garrisons in Jiāngsū.
In the autumn, on the *bǐngzǐ* new moon of the seventh month,
Vice Minister Wōshénà and others were ordered to invest the Cháoxiǎn King's consort.
On the *rénwǔ* day,
Lèshàn was transferred to be General of Jīngzhōu,
and Sàishàng'ā was appointed Dūtǒng of Cháhā'ěr.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
an imperial edict was issued to Lì Yùměi,
to change the brickwork of the Eastern River into crushed stone.
On the *dīngsì* day,
Délèng'é, Minister of Xīníng Affairs, was transferred to be General of Jīngzhōu,
and Sūlèfāng'ā replaced him.
On the *jiǎxū* day,
Gē'ěrkā's annual tribute exceeded the customary amount;
a mild edict was issued to decline it.
On the *gēngyín* day of the ninth month,
Zhōu Tiānjúe was formally appointed Governor-General of Grain Transport.
On the *guǐsì* day,
Nà'ěrjīng'é was summoned to the capital.
On the *jiǎwǔ* day,
Qián Bǎochēn was appointed Governor of Húnán.
On the *jiǎchén* day,
five-tenths of the annual taxes for drought-stricken Xíngtái and Fùchéng counties in Zhílì were remitted.
In the winter, on the *bǐngwǔ* day of the tenth month,
the Emperor visited Grand Secretary Chánglíng's residence to inquire about his illness.
On the *xīnwèi* day,
the pearl tribute from Jílín was suspended.
This month,
seeds and food relief were granted to disaster-stricken Bǎo'ān County, Shǎnxī,
and granary grain was also granted for Suídé and four other prefectures and counties.
New and old annual taxes were remitted or deferred for disaster-stricken Yìngzhōu and ten other prefectures and counties in Shānxī, and Qíqíhā'ěr and three other cities.
On the *xīnmǎo* day of the eleventh month,
Chánglíng was promoted to First Class Duke Wēiyǒng.
This month,

seeds, food relief, and granary grain were granted to the poor in Jīnzhōu and nine other prefectures and counties in Gānsù, Nánchāng and thirteen other counties in Jiāngxī, and Jiāzhōu and five other prefectures and counties in Shǎnxī.
In the twelfth month, on the *dīngwèi* day,
the Yi bandits of Liángshān were pacified.
On the *jǐsì* day,
Lǐ Zōngfǎng was dismissed due to mourning.
Zhuó Bǐngtián was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
On the *gēngwǔ* day,
Yàndé was ordered to remain in the capital due to old age.
Gùnkǔkè Cèlèng was appointed General of Suīyuǎnchéng.
This month,
grain and seeds for spring planting were loaned to the people of Dìngbiān and Āndìng counties in Shǎnxī.
This year,
Joseon, Ryukyu, Siam, and Vietnam offered tribute.
In the eighteenth year, on the first month, the first day, *jiǎxū*,
Kuízhào and Wénqìng were appointed Grand Councilors.
On the *yǐhài* day,
Grand Tutor, Grand Secretary, First-Class Duke Chánglíng passed away.
On the *bǐngzǐ* day,
the Emperor personally visited Chánglíng's residence to offer sacrifices.
On the *yǐyǒu* day,
the Yi bandits of Sìchuān were pacified.
This month,

grain, seeds, and granary stores were loaned to disaster victims in Gùyuán and fourteen other prefectures, departments, and counties in Gānsù, and Píngdìng and five other prefectures and counties in Shānxī.
In the second month, the first day, *guǐmǎo*,
Qíshàn was appointed Grand Secretary,
and continued to act as Governor-General of Zhílì.
Yīlǐbù, Governor-General of Yún-Guì, was appointed Associate Grand Secretary,
and remained in his post.
On the *yǐsì* day,
Shǐ Zhìyǎn was dismissed due to illness.
Qí Yí was appointed Minister of Punishments.
Yíliáng was appointed Governor of Guǎngdōng.
On the *rénxū* day,
Kālāshā'ěr City was repaired.
On the *wùchén* day,
the sea dikes in Zhèjiāng were repaired.
This month,
seeds were loaned to Huáiyuǎn and Fǔgǔ counties in Shǎnxī due to poor harvests.
In the third month, on the *yǐhài* day,
due to the visit to the imperial tombs, Prince Sù and others were ordered to remain in the capital to manage affairs.
On the *wùzǐ* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, visited the Western Tombs,
and remitted three-tenths of the regular taxes in the areas passed through.
On the *rénchén* day,
the Emperor visited the Tàilíng, Tàidōnglíng, and Chānglíng tombs,
and offered wine at the mausoleums of Empress Xiàomù and Empress Xiàoshèn.
On the *yǐwèi* day,
the Emperor, accompanied by the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
On the *bǐngshēn* day,
the Emperor proceeded to Nányuàn for a hunt,
and continued until the *wùxū* day.
On the *gēngzǐ* day,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
On the *xīnchǒu* day,
Gálèdān Xīliètú Sāmádì Bākèshí offered tribute.
This month,
granary stores were loaned to Liáozhōu and thirteen other prefectures, departments, and counties in Shānxī due to poor harvests in the previous year.
In the summer, fourth month, on the *gēngshēn* day,
Fùníyáng'ā and others were disciplined with varying punishments for establishing the Wǔlǔmùqí Academy.
A further decree ordered the Generals, Military Governors, and Ministers of Xīnjiāng to diligently train their troops,
so that everyone would be skilled in battle and prioritize practical governance over empty fame.
On the *jiǎzǐ* day,
Wǔ Chánghuá was appointed Governor of Húběi.
On the *bǐngyín* day,
Niǔ Fúbǎo and one hundred and ninety-four others were granted the *jìnshì* degree with varying ranks.
On the *xīnwèi* day,
Yìchū was appointed General of Yīlí.
Tuānduōbù was appointed Assistant Military Governor of Yīlí.
In the intercalary fourth month, on the *bǐngzǐ* day,
the Emperor visited Hēilóngtán to pray for rain.
On the *xīnsì* day,
it rained.
Huáng Juézī, Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, memorialized to request that all opium smokers in the interior be punished with death.
Decrees were issued to the Generals of Shèngjīng, Jílín, and Hēilóngjiāng,
and the Governors-General and Governors of the directly administered provinces, to express their views and memorialize.
On the *jǐchǒu* day,
Xǐ'ēn was stripped of his Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent title and position as Minister of War.
Chénggé was transferred to be Minister of War.
Èshān was appointed Minister of Punishments.
Bǎoxìng was appointed Governor-General of Sìchuān.
Qíyīng was appointed General of Shèngjīng.
Huìjí was appointed Military Governor of Rèhé.
On the *gēngyín* day,
Yìjì was transferred to be Minister of Revenue.
Chénggé was transferred to be Minister of Rites.
Yìhào was appointed Minister of War.
In the fifth month, on the *bǐngwǔ* day,
the Emperor visited Hēilóngtán to pray for rain.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
it rained.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
Grand Secretary Ruǎn Yuán retired.
Wáng Dǐng was appointed Grand Secretary,
and continued to manage the Ministry of Punishments.
Tāng Jīnzhāo was appointed Minister of Revenue and Associate Grand Secretary.
Zhū Shìyàn was appointed Minister of Personnel.
Zhuó Bǐngtián was appointed Minister of War.
Yáo Yuánzhī was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
On the *wùchén* day,
Prince Dūn Miánkǎi was dismissed from his posts in the imperial court and as Clan Affairs Administrator,
and fined three years of his princely stipend.
In the sixth month, on the *xīnwèi* day,
arrears of taxes and copper and lead remittances due from Mǎbiān and Léibō departments in Sìchuān and various workshops were remitted.
On the *dīngchǒu* day,
Prince Dūn Miánkǎi was demoted to Prince of the Commandery.
On the *jǐmǎo* day,
Tuānduōbù was appointed Assistant Military Governor of Tǎ'ěrbāhātái.
Guānfú was appointed Assistant Military Governor of Yīlí.
This month,
grain was provided to soldiers and civilians affected by floods in Zhènyuǎnfǔ prefecture, Guìzhōu.
In the autumn, seventh month, on the *wùshēn* day,
Èshān, Minister of Punishments, passed away.
Bǎoxìng was appointed Minister of Punishments.
Sū Tíngyù was appointed acting Governor-General of Sìchuān.
In the eighth month, on the *bǐngxū* day,
a decree commended Lín Zéxú and others for their memorial on the investigation and apprehension of opium traffickers and the confiscation of opium paraphernalia.
On the *jǐchǒu* day,
Chénggé was dismissed.
Kuízhào was appointed Minister of Rites.
Ēnmíng was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
Yìjì was ordered to manage the Court of Colonial Affairs.
Sàishàng'ā was appointed acting Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
Bùyàntài was appointed Military Governor of Cháhā'ěr.
This month,
grain was provided to disaster victims in Āndìng and Fǔgǔ counties in Shǎnxī.
In the ninth month, on the *bǐngwǔ* day,
Prince Zhuāng Yìwǔ and others were stripped of their titles for opium smoking.
On the *dīngwèi* day,
the Emperor reviewed the troops of the Jiànruì Battalion.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
Xǔ Nǎijì, Junior Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, requested the relaxation of the opium ban.
He was ordered to retire.
Lín Zéxú was summoned to the capital.
Wǔ Chánghuá was appointed acting Governor-General of Húguǎng.
On the *xīnyǒu* day,
Qián Bǎochēn was transferred to be Governor of Jiāngxī.
Yùtài was appointed Governor of Húnán.
Zhū Shìyàn, Minister of Personnel, passed away.
Tāng Jīnzhāo was transferred to be Minister of Personnel.
Wú Chūn was appointed Minister of Revenue.
Gōng Shǒuzhèng was appointed acting Minister of Rites.
This month,
grain was provided to disaster victims in Wéixiàn county, Shāndōng.
In the winter, tenth month, on the *gēngyín* day,
Shèngguì was appointed Assistant Military Governor of Wūlǐyǎsūtái.
This month,

old and new regular taxes were remitted or delayed for thirteen prefectures and counties in Shēnzhōu, Zhílì; twenty-two counties in Nánchāng, Jiāngxī; thirty-four prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Shòuzhōu, Ānhuī; eleven counties in Nèihuáng, Hénán; eight prefectures, counties, and garrisons in Lǐzhōu, Húnán; and Níngyuǎnzhōu, Fèngtiān, due to disasters.
In the eleventh month, on the *rényín* day,
Yīlǐbù and others were ordered to investigate and ban poppy cultivation in Yúnnán.
On the *rénzǐ* day,
Bǎoxìng was appointed Governor-General of Sìchuān.
Ēnmíng was appointed Minister of Punishments.
Yùchéng was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
Lín Zéxú was appointed Imperial Commissioner,
to investigate and handle affairs at the seaports of Guǎngdōng,
and to command the provincial navy.
Zhōu Tiānjué was appointed acting Governor-General of Húguǎng.
Tiělín was appointed acting Governor-General of Canal Transport.
On the *dīngsì* day,
the Emperor visited Dàgāodiàn to pray for snow.
Gùqìng was appointed Assistant Military Governor of Kēbùduō.
On the *yǐchǒu* day,
Yìhào, Minister of War, was stripped of his post.
Yùchéng was transferred to be Minister of War.
Lóngwén was appointed Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
On the *bǐngyín* day,
Hāfēng'ā was summoned to the capital.
Shūlúnbǎo was appointed acting General of Hēilóngjiāng.
This month,
grain was distributed to soldiers and civilians in Huáiyuǎn and Āndìng counties in Shǎnxī,
and in Sānxìng area of Nínggǔtǎ.
In the twelfth month, the first day, *wùchén*,
bandits led by Xiè Fǎzhēn and others rebelled in Rénhuái county, Guìzhōu.
Yīlǐbù was ordered to suppress them.
On the *xīnwèi* day,
Prince of the Commandery Dūn Miánkǎi passed away.
His princely title was posthumously restored.
The Emperor personally attended his funeral three times to offer sacrifices.
On the *yǐhài* day,
the Emperor again visited Dàgāodiàn to pray for snow.
On the *bǐngxū* day,
the Emperor once more visited Dàgāodiàn to pray for snow.
On the *gēngyín* day,
the Assistant Minister of Kùlún was relocated to Kēbùduō,
to serve as Assistant Minister of Kēbùduō.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
Sàishàng'ā was appointed Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
On the *yǐwèi* day,
Yáo Yuánzhī, Censor-in-Chief of the Left, was dismissed.
Gōng Shǒuzhèng replaced him.
With the pacification of the rebellion,
Yīlǐbù was awarded a double-eyed peacock feather.
Yú Bùyún was promoted to Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
This year,
Joseon, Ryukyu, and Siam offered tribute.
In the spring of the nineteenth year, in the first month, on the *wùxū* day, the new moon,
Jìn Fēng Huì Jùnwáng Miányú was elevated to *qīnwáng*.
On the *wùwǔ* day,
Yìshān was summoned to the capital,
and Guānfú was appointed acting *Yīlí jiāngjūn*.
In this month,

loans of grain and seeds were granted for the flood, drought, and hail disasters in Húnán's Wǔlíng county, Shǎnxī's Jiāzhōu and eight other *zhōu* and counties, and Gānsù's Gùyuán and four other *zhōu* and counties.
In the second month, on the *rénwǔ* day,
an imperial examination was held for *Hànlín*, *Zhànshì*, and other officials,
and Lǐ Guóshí and three others were promoted to the first class,
while others were promoted or demoted with distinctions.
On the *bǐngxū* day,
for the visit to the Eastern Tombs,
Sùqīnwáng Jìngmǐn and others were ordered to remain in the capital to manage affairs.
Lín Zéxú was ordered to go to Hǔmén and Àomén
to prevent foreign ships from entering the sea and domestic bandits from going overseas.
In the third month, on the *gēngzǐ* day,
the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs,
and three-tenths of the regular taxes were remitted for the passing areas.
On the *xīnchǒu* day,
Wú Chūn was dismissed due to illness,
Hé Línghàn was transferred to *Hùbù shàngshū*,
Chén Guānjùn was appointed *Gōngbù shàngshū*,
Gōng Shǒuzhèng was appointed *Lǐbù shàngshū*,
and Liáo Hóngquán was appointed *Zuǒdūyùshǐ*.
On the *guǐmǎo* day,
the Emperor visited Zhaoxīlíng, Xiàolíng, Xiàodōnglíng, Jǐnglíng, and Yùlíng,
and offered wine at the garden tomb of Duānhuì Tàizǐ.
On the *yǐsì* day,
Táo Shù was dismissed due to illness,
Lín Zéxú was transferred to *Liǎngjiāng zǒngdū*,
Chén Luán was appointed acting *Liǎngjiāng zǒngdū*,
Yùqiān was appointed acting *Jiāngsū xúnfǔ*,
Guìliáng was appointed *Húguǎng zǒngdū*,
and Zhū Shù was appointed *Hénán xúnfǔ*.
On the *bǐngwǔ* day,
the Emperor went to the Southern Hunting Park for a hunt.
On the *xīnhài* day,
the Emperor returned to the capital.
On the *yǐmǎo* day,
Lín Zéxú and others reported that foreign hulks had surrendered opium,
and an edict praised them
and granted rewards.
The memorial by Lín Zéxú and others to
temporarily postpone discussions on mutual trade was approved.
The *Wūlǔmùqí dūtǒng* Lián Jìng was transferred to *Chéngdū jiāngjūn*,
Huìjí was appointed in his place,
Ēnmíng was appointed *Rèhé dūtǒng*,
and Lóngwén was appointed *Xíngbù shàngshū*.
On the *bǐngchén* day,
Tiě Lín was appointed *Zuǒdūyùshǐ*.
In the summer, in the fourth month, on the *xīnwèi* day, the new moon,
Wú Wénróng was appointed *Fújiàn xúnfǔ*.
On the *dīngchǒu* day,
Zhōu Tiānjué was transferred to *Hénán xúnfǔ*,
and Zhū Shù was appointed *Cáoyùn zǒngdū*.
On the *wùzǐ* day,
the Emperor visited the Wànshòushān Temple to pray for rain.
On the *dīngyǒu* day,
due to drought in Zhílì,
the rice tax on grain coming from Fèngtiān, Shāndōng, and Hénán to Zhílì was remitted.
In the fifth month, on the *xīnchǒu* day,
it rained.
The retired Grand Secretary Lú Yìnpǔ passed away.
In this month,
tax relief was granted for the earthquake disaster in Yúnnán's Làngqióng and Dèngchuān two *zhōu* and counties.
In the sixth month, on the *bǐngyín* day,
Zhōng Xiáng, the *Mǐnzhè zǒngdū*, was dismissed from office because his official seal was stolen,
Zhōu Tiānjué was appointed in his place,
and Niú Jiàn was appointed *Hénán xúnfǔ*.
On the *dīnghài* day,
Tàizǐ Shàobǎo and former *Liǎngjiāng zǒngdū* Táo Shù passed away.
On the *xīnmǎo* day,
Zhōu Tiānjué was transferred to *Húguǎng zǒngdū*.
In the autumn, in the seventh month, on the *rénzǐ* day,
Lín Zéxú was ordered to issue a proclamation against opium trafficking to England and all foreign merchants in Guǎngdōng.
In this month,
grain was distributed for the flood disaster in Húnán's Huáróng county.
In the eighth month, on the *gēngwǔ* day,
Jīng Èbù was transferred to *Chéngdū jiāngjūn*,
and Tuōhúnbù was appointed *Shāndōng xúnfǔ*.
The *Wūlǐyǎsūtái jiāngjūn* Bǎochāng was summoned to the capital,
and Lián Jìng was appointed in his place.
In this month,
disaster relief grain was distributed to Shǎnxī's Jiāzhōu and two other *zhōu* and counties.
In the ninth month, on the *gēngzǐ* day,
Tuōhúnbù was ordered to investigate and deal with sea pirates in Dēngzhōu, Shāndōng,
and reorganize the naval forces.
On the *xīnchǒu* day,
the Emperor reviewed the troops of the Jiànruì Battalion.
On the *jǐyǒu* day,
Hāfēng'ā was transferred to *Guǎngzhōu jiāngjūn*,
Gùnchǔkècèlèng was transferred to *Hēilóngjiāng jiāngjūn*,
and Dékèjīnbù was appointed *Suíyuǎnchéng jiāngjūn*.
In the winter, in the tenth month,
Shēn Qǐxián, the *Shānxī xúnfǔ*, passed away,
and a posthumous pension was granted according to the precedent for *shàngshū*.
Yáng Guózhēn was appointed *Shānxī xúnfǔ*.
In this month,
relief was provided for flood disasters in Ānhuī's Wúwéi and ten other *zhōu* and counties, and various *wèi* garrisoned areas.
Relief was provided to disaster victims in Húběi's Huángméi and two other counties.
Grain was distributed for flood and drought disasters in Húběi's Miǎnyáng and eight other *zhōu* and counties,
Shāndōng's Méngyīn county,
Shǎnxī's Fǔgǔ and Shénmù two counties,
and Húnán's Huáróng county and nine *zhōu* and *wèi* areas.

New and old regular taxes were remitted or postponed for flood disasters in Ānhuī's Wúwéi and thirty-one other *zhōu* and counties, Húběi's Miǎnyáng and twenty-five other *zhōu* and counties, Hénán's Suīzhōu and twenty other *zhōu* and counties, and Húnán's Lǐzhōu and eight other *zhōu* and counties, and *wèi* garrison areas.
In the eleventh month, on the *gēngzǐ* day,
British ships entered the Guǎngdōng sea port,
and Lín Zéxú led the imperial army to drive them away,
suspending their trade.
Chéng Màolái was appointed *Ānhuī xúnfǔ*.
On the *wùshēn* day,
Dékèjīnbù was transferred to *Guǎngzhōu jiāngjūn*,
Sōngpǔ was appointed *Suíyuǎnchéng jiāngjūn*,
and Shūlúnbǎo was appointed *Hēilóngjiāng jiāngjūn*.
On the *gēngxū* day,
Jìkèmòtè was ordered to go to Kùlún
to welcome the Zéwōzūn Dānbā Hútúkètú for an audience.
In this month,
grain was distributed to disaster victims in Jiāngxī's Déhuà and six other counties, and Shānxī's Yìngzhōu and three other *zhōu* and counties.

New and old regular taxes were remitted or postponed for disasters in Jiāngxī's Nánchāng and twenty-two other counties, Shānxī's Yìngzhōu and seven other *zhōu* and counties, and Zhílì's Ānzhōu and four other *zhōu* and counties.
In the twelfth month, on the *guǐhài* day,
the acting *Liǎngjiāng zǒngdū* Chén Luán passed away,
Dèng Tíngzhēn was transferred to *Liǎngjiāng zǒngdū*,
Lín Zéxú was transferred to *Liǎngguǎng zǒngdū*,
and Yùqiān was appointed *Jiāngsū xúnfǔ*.
On the *guǐyǒu* day,
Zéwōzūn Dānbā Hútúkètú and others had an audience.
Yīlǐbù was transferred to *Liǎngjiāng zǒngdū*,
and Dèng Tíngzhēn was transferred to *Yúnguì zǒngdū*.
On the *guǐwèi* day,
*Xíngbù shàngshū* Lóngwén was ordered to serve on the Grand Council (*Jūnjī dàchén*).
Dèng Tíngzhēn was transferred to *Mǐnzhè zǒngdū*,
and Guìliáng was transferred to *Yúnguì zǒngdū*.
On the *wùzǐ* day,
Chén Guānjùn was dismissed,
and Liáo Hóngquán was appointed *Gōngbù shàngshū*.
Grand Councilor Wénqìng was dismissed.
In this year,
Cháoxiān and Liúqiú paid tribute.
In the spring of the twentieth year, in the first month, on the *rénchén* day, the new moon,
Wáng Dǐng was granted the title of *Tàizǐ Tàibǎo*.
On the *wùxū* day,
Ālèjīng'ā was appointed *Rèhé dūtǒng*.
On the *jǐhài* day,
the *Lǐfānyuàn* prohibited the Zéwōzūn Dānbā Hútúkètú from using a flag and parasol,
and this was not reported in advance.
Yìjì was stripped of his titles as *Yùqián dàchén*, *Hùbù shàngshū*, *Zǒngguǎn Nèiwùfǔ dàchén*, and the purple bridle,
and was dismissed from managing the *Lǐfānyuàn*.
Sài Shàng'ā was demoted to a second-rank button.
Lóngwén was transferred to *Hùbù shàngshū*.
On the *rén'yín* day,
Empress Niǔhùlùshì passed away.
On the *wùshēn* day,
the late Empress was posthumously titled Xiàoquán Huánghòu.
On the *gēngxū* day,
Yìjì was arrested for questioning.
On the *gēngshēn* day,
Yìjì was found to have accepted silver from Shābùláng,
and was exiled to Hēilóngjiāng.
Sài Shàng'ā and others were all handed over to the ministry for severe deliberation.
In the second month, on the *guǐhài* day,
Ālèjīng'ā was appointed *Xíngbù shàngshū*,
Nà'ěrjīng'é was appointed *Rèhé dūtǒng*,
and Hāfēng'ā was appointed *Xīníng bànshì dàchén*.
On the *dīngmǎo* day,
*Hùbù shàngshū* Hé Línghàn passed away,
and Zhuó Bǐngtián was appointed in his place.
Qí Jùnzǎo was appointed *Bīngbù shàngshū*,
and Shěn Qí was appointed *Zuǒdūyùshǐ*.
On the *dīngchǒu* day,
Lì Yùměi, the *Hédōng Hédào zǒngdū*, passed away,
and Wénchōng was appointed *Hédōng Hédào zǒngdū*.
In this month,
grain was distributed to the poor people of Ānhuī's Tóngchéng county.
Grain was lent to the soldiers of Shānxī's Hébǎo and other battalions.
In the third month,
Hé Rǔlín was ordered to learn and serve on the Grand Council (*Jūnjī dàchén*).
Yìshān was summoned to the capital,
and Bùyàntài was appointed *Yīlí jiāngjūn*.
On the *xīnhài* day,
Bìchāng was appointed *Cháhā'ěr dūtǒng*.
In this month,
granary grain was lent to Shānxī's Jízhōu and eight other *zhōu* and counties.
In the summer, in the fourth month, on the *xīnyǒu* day, the new moon,
Xiàoquán Huánghòu was posthumously enfeoffed,
and an edict was issued the next day.
On the *jǐsì* day,
Jīng Èbù was transferred to *Jílín jiāngjūn*.
On the *bǐngzǐ* day,
Xiángkāng was appointed *Kùlún bànshì dàchén*.
On the *wùyín* day,
the Emperor visited Hēilóngtán to pray for rain.
On the *yǐyǒu* day,
Lǐ Chénglín and one hundred and seventy-nine others were granted the *jìnshì jíyǐ* rank and other statuses with distinctions.
On the *wùzǐ* day,
the Emperor visited Guǎngùn Cí to pray for rain.
In this month,
granary grain was lent to the officers and soldiers of Zhílì's Zǐjīnguān and its affiliated Fútúyù and two other battalions.
In the 6th month, on the day Dīngmǎo,
Shèkèjīná was appointed General of Suīyuǎnchéng.
On the day Dīngchǒu,
Lín Zéxú and others reported on destroying the foreign opium boat.
On the day Gēngchén,
British ships entered the sea off Zhèjiāng,
besieging Dìnghǎi County seat.
Yú Bùyún was ordered to join Wūěrgōngé and others to reinforce it.
On the day Jiǎshēn,
the British captured Dìnghǎi County,
and Magistrate Yáo Huáixiáng and others died there.
Wūěrgōngé and Zhèjiāng Admiral Zhù Tíngbiāo were stripped of their posts,
but retained in their positions.
Hú Sōngé was transferred to be General of Rèhé,
and Nèěrjīngé was appointed Governor-General of Shǎnxī and Gānsù.
In autumn, the 7th month, on the day Guǐsì,
British ships attacked the Zhàpǔ seaport in Zhèjiāng.
Qímíngbǎo was ordered to lead troops to resist them.
British forces attacked the Xiàmén forts in Fújiàn,
but Battalion Commander Chén Shèngyuán and others repelled them.
On the day Bǐngshēn,
Zhèjiāng Provincial Governor Wūěrgōngé was stripped of his post,
and Liú Yùnkē was appointed in his place.
On the day Dīngyǒu,
Yīlǐbù was appointed Imperial Commissioner
to proceed to Zhèjiāng to suppress and manage the situation.
Yùqiān was concurrently appointed Acting Governor-General of Liǎngjiāng.
Tuānduōbù was appointed Assistant Minister of Yīlí,
and Huāshāntài was appointed Assistant Minister of Tǎěrbāhātái.
On the day Jiǎchén,
British ships anchored outside the Tiānjīn estuary,
delivering a letter to Qíshàn to present their grievances.
Qíshàn was ordered to receive it,
but was instructed not to allow them to enter the port.
On the day Bǐngwǔ,
Huāshāntài was transferred to be Commander of the Kēshígāěr Affairs Office,
Tuānduōbù was transferred to be Assistant Minister of Tǎěrbāhātái,
and Fúxīngé was appointed Assistant Minister of Yīlí.
On the day Gēngxū,
Lín Zéxú and others reported on the continued capture of opium traffickers.
An imperial edict criticized them severely
for making empty excuses.
On the day Yǐmǎo,
British ships reached Shānhǎiguān and other places.
On the day Bǐngchén,
Yīlǐbù and others were ordered that,
should the British present any letters,
they were to accept and report them promptly.
That month,
disaster relief was provided to the flood-stricken people in Miǎnyáng and three other prefectures and counties in Húběi.
In the 8th month, on the day Jiǎzǐ,
Shào Jiǎmíng was appointed Acting Provincial Governor of Zhèjiāng.
On the day Bǐngzǐ,
the British again invaded Xiàmén in Fújiàn,
but Admiral Chén Jiēpíng and others repelled them.
On the day Jǐmǎo,
Qíshàn was appointed Imperial Commissioner
to proceed to Guǎngdōng to investigate and manage the situation,
and an edict instructed Yīlǐbù and the coastal Governors-General and Provincial Governors to defend the strategic passes,
and not to question foreign ships anchored in the outer sea.
Nèěrjīngé was transferred to be Acting Governor-General of Zhílì,
and Hú Sōngé was appointed Acting Governor-General of Shǎnxī and Gānsù.
On the day Gēngchén,
Liánjìng was transferred to be General of Chéngdū,
and Délèngé was appointed General of Wūlǐyàsūtái.
On the day Xīnsì,
Yùqiān reported that the British had presented their original letter,
which he dared not report.
An imperial edict severely reprimanded him.
That month,
rations and housing repair funds were provided to the flood-stricken people in Shàngyuán and fourteen other counties in Jiāngsū.
In the 9th month, on the day Gēngyín,
Lín Zéxú and Dèng Tíngzhēn were ordered to be handed over to the Board for severe deliberation and punishment.
Qíshàn was appointed Acting Governor-General of Liǎngguǎng.
On the day Xīnmǎo,
based on Tuōhúnbù's report that British ships had sailed south,
Qíyīng and Tuōhúnbù were ordered to consider withdrawing defensive troops.
Dèng Tíngzhēn was summoned to the capital,
Yán Bótáo was appointed Governor-General of Mǐnzhè,
and Zhāng Lǐzhōng was appointed Provincial Governor of Yúnnán.
On the day Jiǎwǔ,
Zhōu Tiānjúe and others were ordered to provide relief for the flood-stricken people in various prefectures and counties in Húběi.
On the day Yǐwèi,
Lín Zéxú and Dèng Tíngzhēn were stripped of their posts,
and ordered to proceed to Guǎngdōng to await investigation.
On the day Jǐhài,
British ships entered the inner seas of Cíxī and Yúyáo counties in Zhèjiāng,
but Yīlǐbù and others repelled them.
Wūěrgōngé was arrested and interrogated
for not forwarding the British letter.
That month,
rations were provided to the flood-stricken people in Tàixīng County, Jiāngsū.
In the 10th month, on the day Rénshēn,
due to the imperial visit to the mausoleum, Prince Zhuāng and others were ordered to remain in the capital to manage affairs.
On the day Rénwǔ,
with Empress Xiàoquán's coffin to be interred at Lóngquányù,
the Emperor proceeded to Guāndédiàn to perform the ancestral burial ceremony.
On the day Yǐyǒu,
Lùpǔ was transferred to be General of Wūlǐyàsūtái.
That month,
relief was provided to the disaster victims in Cāngzhōu and three other prefectures and counties in Zhílì.
